༷ཿgye:

zheṣi ske nee dīdzorjorsharīhūṃrṣa — chi dzwa—kai—waṣe ——4 rdaskreḍābhejitshaspro ka7 sgru rīlta༈doorshangabhe pre 4 rshorkyo ༄tsurkehūṃrtaXrdzarke) needzee sgyu stse spre — lketshel 4— dze tre khare dnghartesnyoza7 ne dnghalke ljasum̐rā 4dnghatsu5ju ji 4ṭwāṃsnyorshaṅka snyi /bye/ sdusni ge 0 rmyamatrī

ṣṭakṣatho rkanywatt+waṃtshe 8snyu1༷ rtsorgyumarpāzarwazumalgeo/zhisdaḥsdim3sngiruraṇi llītsho ninazhe44 〉〉nizhuresarmāzurmāzarsāmazhiblursāsbyisasnaṭwāṃrmadhatuswand+ra/sngis/rngas/ddhāhūṃ~Xḥṣātso sritsodzo//zhubam̐' du77 sngalngab ba〉 kyetshog nga sngagaji

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃched du brjod pa'i tshigamakhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan 7g.yu khog bya bral ba chos dbyings rang grol mchog ni yang gsang snying thig gi bstan pa spyi dang /khyad par du mdo khams li gtsang / gser rta/ a mdo mgo log /reb sno/nga sogs yul gru du mar kun mkhyen yab sras dang / 'ardzam mgon mi pham pa'i legs bshad dri ma med pa 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyis 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po nyid du nges shing / yang sgos su 7skyabs rje rdo grub rin po che thub bstan phrin las dpal bzang po mchog la thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs brgyud kyi rtogs pa gcig tu 'phos te byin rlabs kyi chu bo chen po gcig 'dres kyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma nyag gcig lags pas/ rang cag la mtshoni na/ gang gi bka' drin rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /ril bur gzhal yang sa yis lang mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de yang ji skad du/ gser dang bong ba mnyam pa'i 'phags mchog la/ /gling bzhi'i phun tshogs bstabs kyang ci bgyi ste/ /de yi thugs la brnag pa'i chos bzung na/ /dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ gsung rab kyi glegs bam phra mo par du bskrun pa ni med du mi rung ba lags shing / dam pa rnams kyis bsngags par bya ba'i yul du gyur/da lan g.yu khog mkhan po shes bya lags kyis legs sgrig dang dpe skrun mthun 'gyur / de bzhin g.yu mkhar dgon pa'i mkhan sprul rnams dang gser brag chen yar lung dgon gyi bla ma bsod dar sogs kyis dka' ba dang du blangs/ ngal ba khyad du bsad de rdo dzi smar gsum sogs su phebs nas ma dpe 'tshol sdud rgya cher gnang ba dang / mchog sprul mnyam med lags nas kyang mgo 'dren rogs ram gnang ba bcas la brten nas da lan g.yu khog bya bral rin po che'i gsung 'bum phyogs sgrig yongs su grub pa dang chabs cig /si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang hāsna/ par skrun gnang bar snying thag pa nas bka' drin bla lhag tu che zhu ba phran thub bstan nyi mas rab rgyan shing bya zla 3tshes 8la dge bar gus phul/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༄7/ /gsung chos bka' bsdu dang dpar du skrun pa'i gsal bshad/de yang gsang chen bstan pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 7skyabs rje g.yu khog bla ma bya bral chos dbyings rang grol rin po che mchog ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor gangs ljongs mdo kham sa kyi phyogs su theg dgu'i yang rtse zab gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i skyes mchog dam pa zhig yin/ dam pa mchog des sku tshe hril por skal bzang las can gyi gdul bya rnams zag phung 'od skur grol ba'i gdams zab mang du bstsal/ de dag las rje gang gis phyi rabs gdul bya'i skal bar bzhag nga 'i gsung rtsom dngos dang slob bu rnams kyis zin bris su bgyis pa sogs ma/nga du mchis mo/da/ dus 'gyur sogs kyi dbang gis thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdu ba ma byung / der brten rje gang gi zhal gsung bdud rtsi'i zegs ma re re'ang 'thor bar phangs pas gus phran pas nye ba'i lo shas ring phyogs bskyod kyis dam pa gang gi gsung chos rnams kyi bka' bsdu'i bya ba la nye bar brtson pas thengs 'dir pod gsum tsam bsdu thub pa byung / de yang kun btus sogs sngon 'gro'i skor rnams o pod du bsdus pa dang / ye shes bla ma dang lte btsun snying thig gi zin bris sogs dngos gzhi'i skor rnam sa āḥpod du bsdus/ gsang snying skor gyi zin bris rnams dang / zhal gdams sogs gsung thor bu'i skor rnams rgyab chos kyi tshul du hūṃ pod du bsdus yod/ de dag kyang slob ma rnams kyis zin bris gnang ba las dper na/sngon 'gro bsdus pa rnams dang ru shan gyi skor/ de bzhin kun gzhi dang chos sku'i shan 'byed/ sems dang ye shes kyi shan 'byetwe/ thod rgal gyi 'phags chos bdun sogs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃphal cher phyogs 'dra rnams kyang tshig gi rgyas bsdus dang rnam 'gyur cung zad re mi 'dra bas rje gang gi gsung gi zur tsam/ yang nyams par phang pas zlos min la ma ltos par cha tshang so sor bkod yod/ de las sngon 'gro kun bzang zhal lung /ye shes bla ma /lce btsun snying thig /gsang snying sogs kyi zin bris rnams 7skyabs rje dam pa sku dngos kyi phyag dpe dag mdun 'dug bla ma 'gyur med rdo rje la yod pa sprul chos mchog rdo rje nas g.yar gnang ba dang / gzhan dngos gzhi'i skor phal cher zhal slob mchog gyur 'dzi rong bla ma mchog ldan gyis zin bris gnang ba'i phyag dpe rnams bla ma rgya thar las mched rang grol gyis dpe gcod rogs byas/ de bzhin mkhan po chos gsal kyi phyag dpe rnams mkhan po shes rab dang / rdzi sgo'i bla ma kong tshe'i phyag dpe sogs pha la cher bla ma bsod dar kyis 'tshol sdud byas/ sngon 'gro kun btus dang / zhal gdam/sa sogs sngar shing par du 'khod pa rnams dang / gzhan yang a mdo ma/go log /rdo 'dzi gser gsum/g.yu rtsang sogs sa phyogs du ma nas rje gang gi dngos slob dang slob rgyud rnams kyi phyag brgyud gsung chos dang zin bris 'di dag phyogs bsdus dang dag zhus gang nus bgyis shing /mkhan rin po che nor bu sogs sgar na bzhugs pa'i rang dgon mkhan slob rnams kyis kyang dag zhus phyag rogs gnang / de ltar gsung chos 'di phyogs sdud dang dpar du 'khod pa sogs thog mtha' bar gsum du mkhas dbang mchog sprul dam pa gzan dkar rin po ches bka' slob dang thugs khur phyag rogs sogs rgya cher gnang bar snying thag pa nas bka' drin dang thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ mchog sprul mnyam med rin po ches gsung chos dpar du 'khod na legs tshul gyi gsung gis gnang ba bstsa la bar bka' drin dang thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / gzhan yang phyag dpe g.yar ba dang bri bsdu dag zhus par sgrun sogs gang thad phyag rogs dang thugs khur gnang ba'i chos kyi mched po dag la yang bka' drin che zhu rgyu yin// 2mkhan ming shes bya kun gzigs des/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༄tsho/ /mkhas grub bla ma du ma'i gsung byin rlabs can phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'khor bar zhen pa log par byin gyis rlobs/ /nges 'byung rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nyams dga' ri khrod 'grim par byin gyis rlobs/ /grogs med blo bde dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi ba snying nas dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nam 'chi cha med dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro drug pha mar shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshad med snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dge sdig blang dor shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu 'bras bslu med mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos la snying rus nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems chos dang 'dres par byin

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgyis rlobs/ /rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gzung 'dzin zhabrul ba zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang bden med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rtag tu bla ma dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /mos gus gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid bla mar 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /lta ba mtha' bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sgom pa 'khor yug 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /spyod pa blang dor bral bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'bras bu sku gsum thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhesabla ma rig ༵rdoon/ na/sa gsol 'debs zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i tshe phran chos dbyings rang grol nas bris oṃ/ chos kyi rgyal po gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni de sngon gti mug dbang gyur pas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa rnams/ /da ni bshags shing slan chad sdom par bgyi/ /ci nus bzlas/ chos dbyings rang grol nas bris pa'o/ /

g.yu khogabla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdakar chag1 ched du brjod pa'i tshig 12 gsung chos bka' bsdu dang dpar du skrun pa'i gsal bshad/ 13 g.yu khog bla ma bya bral chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 14 g.yu khog bla ma bya bral chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsol 'debs/ 1(( sngon 'gro kun las bakhus pa/ 16 sngon 'gro'i zhal rgyun zin bris su bkod pa mdor bsdus zhes bya ba/ 727 klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro'i bsdus don dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal lung / 898 sngon 'gro kun bzang zhal lung gi skabs su mkho ba'i bar ldeb phyogs bsdus/ 2879 yi ge brgya ba'i tshig 'grel ba/ 4tso10sngon 'gro'i skabs kyi zhal rgyun zin bris thor bu/ 4snyo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sgrin/ oṃ༄7/ / 7skyabs rje g.yu khog bla ma bya bral chos dbyings rang grol mchog gi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus su brjod pa phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba/gzhi dbyings ka dag gnyis chos yongs bral gdod ma'i chos sku kun tu bzang / /gzhi snang lhun grub ye shes lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje sems / /gnyis su med gang dzo gas chen ston pa sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab ste/ /sku gsum ston par mnyam nyid lta dang dwangs ba'i yid kyis phyag bgyi'o/ /'jam dpal rnam sprul mañdzu mi tra dang / /lta ba mthar son shrī seng ha'i zhabs/ /'od lus grub pa dzñā na su tra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /paṇa grub bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan mchog 'pho chen sku brnyes bi ma la/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus gsang chen ston pa padma 'byung / /rnam snang lo tsā ye shes mtsho rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog sogs/ /grub brnyes lo paṇa rje 'bangs tshogs kyis byin brgyud rtogs pa'i pha phog stsol/ /gdod ma'i mgon po klong chen rab 'byams zhabs/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pa rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling / /kun bzang gzhan phan rgyal ba'i myu gu sogs/ /dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla mar gusdu phyag 'tshal/ /snying thig srog 'dzin

g.yu khog bla ma chos dgings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabasadad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃ'ajigs med chos kyi dbang / /bka' bab bdun ldan mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang / /brgyud srol kun 'dus dpa' bo rdo rje ste/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis shis pa stsol/ /chos dbyings ka dag skye med klong nas chos zad dgongs pa'i lta ba rdzogs/ /rang grol lhun grub longs sku'i zhing gzigs thod rgal sgom pa tshad la phebs/ /zung 'jug sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yisabyar med spyod pa gong du 'phel/ /chos nyid mngon gzigs bya bral bla ma snying dbus dad brgya'i padmor bzhugs/ /gang gi zhing 'di'i mdzad rnam phyogs bsdus shig /phyi rabs khyed rjes slob par khas 'ches bas/ /dad gsum gus pa'i yid kyis mchod sprin du/ /'god la lha dang bla mas gnang ba stsol/ /zhes shis par brjod pa'i tshig gis mdun bsus te/ 'dir srid zhi'i legs tshogs dang phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyag gcig yin zhing /de nyid 'dzin skyong spel ba'i bstan 'dzin skyes chen du ma dus rabs so sor 'phags bod kyi ljongs su legs par byon cing gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad 'phrin mkha' mthar khyab pa brjod las 'das/ khyad par bsil ldan bod kyi ljongs 'dir ris med rgyal bstan skyong ba'i mnga' bdag bsam bzhin bstan 'gro'i ched du byon pa'ang bsam gyis mi khyab/ de las 'dir skabs su babs pa nye rabs su mdo khams smad kyi phyogs 'dir/ paṇa chen bi ma'i rnam rol/mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan/ zab gsang rdzogs chen kyi rnal 'byor ba 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na 7 skyabs rje g.yu khog bla ma bya bral ba ོ༵sa dbyings rang grol zhes mtshan gyi rnga

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabasadad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃgasang srid pa gsum na lhang nger grags pa gang de nyid kyi mdzad rnam rags tsama'agod pa la/ de yang skyabs rje dam pa gang nyid nges pa'i don du gdod nas rgyal ba rnams dang gnyis su med par mngon par byang chub na'ang ji skad du/ ji ltar gdul bya dag pa yi/ /chu yi snod ni thams cad du/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dpag tu med pa cig char 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi ngor gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul bstan pa nyid/ rdo bla byang chub rdo rje dang dpa' bo chos kyi rdo rje sogs kyi zab gter du mar gu ru padma'i lung gis bsngags pa ste/ yag sgang du bi ma'i sprul ba 'byung / /zhes dang / rdzogs chen rnal 'byor dharmā'i mtshan can gyis/ /'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'dren par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gdan sa dang sprul gzhi mtshan dang mdzad pa'i che ba bcas 'khrul bral gyi bslu med rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags shing gzhan yang rig 'dzin nus ldan gling pas grub chen shwa ba ri pa dang / paṇa chen bi ma mi tra/ khams g.yu sgra snying po rnams zung du 'jug pa'i rnam rol yin par lung gis bsngags pa ma zad/ rje nyid kyis kyang gser ye shes seng ge dang rdo bla 'jigs med skal bzang sogs gong ma'i bag chags sad tshul zhal 'phros su gsungs pa sogs kyis bsam bzhin bstan 'gro'i don du sprul pa'i rnam rol gyis phebs par gdon mi za phyir sku'i 'khrungs rabs dang sku tshe 'dir yang gsang ba gsum gyi rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag ni rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po dag gi spyod yul nyag gcig las bdag ltas brngod par ga la nus/ des na 'dir thun mong gi ngor 3

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃsnang ba'i mdzad rnam nyung ngu thos 'dzin gyi dga' ston tu son pa rnams phyogs gcig tu 'god pa la/ mdo khams g.yu khog tu sku 'khrungs shing chos sgor 'dzud pa'i bla ma hor bla gzhan phan rin po ches rjes su bzung ba'i skor/ rigs sad de gser smad lha rtse dgon du gyang khang skyabs mgon rin po che sogs bsten pa'i skor/ lcags skong bdud 'joms rdo rje'i lung bzhin tshe rabs las kyi bla ma a 'dzom 'brug pa rin po che dang mjal nas gdams zab nod pa'i skor/bla ma'i bka' bzhin gnas nges med du gdan sa btsal mthar gser smad yag sgang du gdan sa'i rten 'brel 'grigs shing bzhugs sgar btab pa'i skor/gter chen las rab gling pa gser ljongs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i mthun sbyor gnang zhing mjal 'dzoms kyis zab dgu'i chos tshul gsan pa'i skor/ gdan sar slob ma bskyangs shing mdzad 'phrin mkha' mthar khyab pa'i skor/ snang bar rang dbang 'byor ba'i grub rtags dang dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i mngon shes mnga' tshul gyi skor/ mthar gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus tshul dang gsung chos slob tshogs bcas kyi skor te bkra shis pa'i grangs las dang po/ de yang skyabs rje dam pa gang du sku 'brungs pa'i yul ni/ bsil ldan gangs ri'i ljongs kyi mdo khams chu bzhi sgang drug gi ya gyal 'bri rdza zal mo sgang gi nye zhol/ shar mi nyag rab sgang gi g.yon zur/ rgyal mo tsha ba rong dang nye ba'i char/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ lo chen bee ro tsa na/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sogs grub brnyes rje 'bangs du mas rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas zhabs kyis bca/sa shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/

g.yuokhogablamachosadabyingasarangagrolagyirnamatharaphyirobasadadapa'i mchod sprin/ oṃrgyal rangargyal ma jul chu'i dal 'bab kyi chu bas g.yas nas g.yas su bskar ba'i ljongs/ bod yul skyong ba'i dge bsnyen nyer gcig gi ya gyal gnas bdag dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje g.yu khrom yum sras blon 'khor dang bcas pas sa phyogs bdag gir mdzad cing skyong ba'i yul/ gling rje ge sar rgyal pos bla g.yu ngo mtshar ba yul phyogs 'di'i sa'i bcud yul rten du gter du sbas pa de nas bzung g.yu khog ces grags pa'am yang na sa phyogs gcan gzan g.yi dkar gyi pags pa bskyangs pa dang 'dra bas na g.yi khog ces kyang grags pa'i gnas mchog der/ dkar nag phyugs kyis 'tsho ba'i 'brog sdes khyab cing chos ldan khrims kyis skyong ba'i dpon rabs rnams kyis mnga' 'bangs bde bas bskyangs/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes chen du ma byon nas snga phyir g.yu mkhar theg chen chos 'khor gling sogs phyag btab cing bshad sgrub 'khor lo gsum gyis bskyangs pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi legs tshogs gong du 'phel ba'i gnas de'i char/shar rgyal mo tsha ba rong gi gnas kyi gong bar grags pa rje btsun 'phags pa nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog chu dbar ta rī'i gnas zhes byin rlabs kyi na bun 'thul zhing ljon shing dang chu mtsho me tog gis brgyan pa'i gnas mchog de'i nye 'gram du mtshan dpe'i me tog nye bar bzhad pa ste/ de yang yab khyi shul bkra tshe dang yum a 'dzi bza' ba lo zhes pa gnyis la sras lcam sring mang du zhakhrungs ba'i nang nas rje 'di rab byung bco lnga pa'i bgrang bya drug pa aṅga'i ra ste chu pho sprel gyi lo'i gnam lo gsar du tshes pa'i dus tshes bzang po zhig tu ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas 5

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃmangal gyi chu 'dzin las grol/ rje 'di'i mched lcam gzhan dag ni/ bla ma sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho / khyi shul mkhan po ku lo/ bla ma nor lhun/ 'go tsha sprul sku theg mchog bstan 'dzin/ kame sgron/gnas skyid bcas dang gzhan sku mched chung ba gnyis chung dus chur lhung ste gshegs par grags/ rje 'di chung ngu'i dus mtshan la padma rdo rje zhes zhu zhing cung zad sku nar son skabs pha ma gnyis kyis sku nye a nee rgan mo zhig la bu skal du byin stabs khong yang byis pa gzhan dag dang mnyam du phyugs rdzi dang nus tshod kyi las kar bskul/ de yang dam pa rnams kyi mdzad spyod ni gdul bya'i dbang gis mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ kha cig dang po nas skyes sbyang gi rigs sad cing zhi dul gyi tshul dang / yang kha cig ni dang po mdzad spyod thams cad ma nges pa'i tshul du ston pa'ang yod pa las rje 'di phyi ma ste/ de yang cung zad sku shed rgyas skabs rgyun du me mda' rgyab tu khur ral gri sked la drangs rta rgyug 'ba' zhig gnang ba sogs mdzad spyod phal cher gzhan dag dang ma 'dra bar grub pa'i mdzad spyod kho na gnang yang yul mi kun gyi blor ma shong bar ma dad pa skyes pa dang mi rgod gdug rtsub can zhig tu ngos bzung zhing yul mi kun khong la skrag cing zhed dgos pa zhig tu gyur pa ma zad kun gyis khong la a 'dzi'i mi smyon zhes ngan smad byed/ skabs shig dge bshes rgyal po zhes pa'i dpon po zhig chu dbar khog tu tsha chur phebs pa la khong gi lam 'phrang dog sa zhig gi ngos nas shing sdong mang po bsgril bas dpon blon thams cad kyi chib rta dang mdzo sogs 'drogs nas sa la drud kyang nyes skyon ma byung ba dang yang gnas der mtsho nag ces klu gdug rtsub can gnas pa'i mtsho 6

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ yozhig yod pa de'i 'gram du tha na skad cor brgyab kyang ser ba 'bab pa'i mtsho der khong gis byis pa mang po khrid de rbab rdo mang du bsgril yang 'khu ldog ma byung ba sogs ya mtshan gyi mdzad pa'ang mang mod yid ches byed mkhan cher ma byung /gzhan yang phyug rdzi rnams gyi gro chas 'phrog nas gsol zhing khong rnams la brdung brdeg dang g.yog tu bkol ba sogs mdzad pa phal cher de dag gi tshe gegs bar chad sel byed du gyur tshul sogs rjes su rtogs/ de skabs tā re'i gnas su hor bla ma gzhan phan 'od zer zhes grub chen a tsar sa le'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa'i grub brnyes gter chen dam pa zhig bzhugs pa khong gis dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i mngon mkhyen gyis khong la klog gi phyi mo bslab pa sogs thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa du mas rjes su bzung zhing khong thun mong ma yin pa'i bla mar gyur zhing bka' drin che tshul phyis kyi zhu yig rnams su'ang kāsdusdo ོ༵/ ba/hā /ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵ sna/la du mdzad spyod nges med kyis dgung grangs bco gnyis pa rigs sad de gser smad lha rtse dgon du gyang khang skyabs mgon rin po che sogs bsten pa'i skor ni/ de nas rje 'di dgung grangs bco brgyad tsam la sleb skabs shig la thugs rigs sad pa'i rtags su 'khor ba la zhen log gi nges 'byung bcos min zhig gis thugs rgyud bskul nas/ nyin zhig glo bur du khong cha lugs sngar bzhin bla ma hor bla rin po che g.yu mkhar dgon nang du grong chog zhig gsung bzhin pa'i nye sar phebs nas hor bla gzhan phan la tshur gtug gsungs pas/ hor bla'i dzeegs cung ma bde bar tshur phebs nas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃkhong la/ khyod kyis mi 'dra bsad pa min nam gsungs par khong gis khyod bla ma gshin po'i rnam shes mthong mkhan zhig gis ngas mi bsad yod med tsam yang mi shes sam/ nga yong don gtso bo ni nga rang grwa sa zhig la 'gro 'dod byung bas gang du song na dga' khyod la blo zhig 'dri sar 'ong ba yin zhes zhal rtsed dang bcas zhus par/ hor blas 'o na nyes skyon med par nga blo bde byung / khyod grwa sar gang du 'gro dgos da ste zhag bdun gyi rjes su cha lugs sgyur la shog dang ngas khyod la lam ston byed chog gsungs/ de nas khong phar chu dbar khog tu phebs nas rang gi rta dang me mda' sogs med par byas te 'gro chas bsgrig cing a lco bya bral gyi spyod pa dang du blangs nas tshur g.yu mkhar dgon du hor bla'i rtsar phebs nas bsgugs/ nyin zhig dgon pa'i 'du khang la skor bar phebs skabs dgon byang ngos kyi grwa shag zhig gi steng nas bla ma zhig gis yar phebs gsungs/ der sku mdun bcar bas yi ge shes sam gsungs cung zad shes zhus pas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod cig gnang nas ltos gsungs 'phral zhu dag gtong khul gyis ljags lung gnang nas phebs khar phrug dum zhig sprad de 'dis zhwa zhig bzos gsungs/ tshur la phebs nas hor bla la lo rgyus zhu skabs/ o de ni rgya lha mo tshe ring zhu ba g.yu mkhar dgon pa'i bstan bdag khri ba grub chen khyad 'phags shig yin/ khyed yul mdo smad kyi mgo'i zhwa lta bu zhig tu 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel yin pas shin tu legs gsungs/ de nas nyin shas kyi rjes hor blas khong la da khyod gnas skabs gser lha rtse dgon du gyang khang skyabs mgon rin po che'i mdun du rdiong dang ngas khong la khyod kyi lo rgyus ngo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃsprood yi ge zhig skur/ da res lha rtse dgon pa'i grwa rgan zhig kyang 'gro rogs 'dug gsungs/ skabs der lha rtse dgon pa'i grwa rgan bsod snyoms pa zhig phyir phebs pa dang gzhan g.yu khog pa'i grwa rgan shis rdor zhes pa bcas khong gsum mnyam du lam la chas/ der lha dgon gyi bla ma'i gro chas na bza' sogs kyang khong la khur bcug pa ma zad bla rgan shin tu bze re che bas khong gis lam nas sku rtsed mang du mdzad cing phebs pa'i lo rgyusakyang yod/ rim gyis g.yu smad brgyud phebs lam du yul mi kha shas kyis gang du 'gro dris tshe grwa sar 'gro ba yin gsungs/ der khong tshos grwa sar 'gro na g.yu stod nas gyen du kaḥdapal rdzogs gsum phyogs su 'gro dgos pa la khyed g.yu chu lag g.yas byas nas thur du 'gro ba ni su dang mi 'dra ba zhig red ces 'phyas kyang phyis su khong gis su dang mi 'dra ba zer ba de'i khong la rten 'brel shin tu legs par gsungs/de nas kyang phebs lam du rgya gser rko kha shas kyis nya mang po bzung nas skam du bton pa'i sdug bsngal mthong bas khong la snying rje drag po shas mi bzod pa thugs la 'khrungs shing spyan chab mang du phyung / sngar thugs rgyud cung rtsub pa'i tshul mdzad kyang de nas bzung snying rjes rgyud brlan par gsungs/ de ltar nyin zhag du ma'i dka' spyad dang du bzhes mthar gser smad lha rtse dgon du phebs/der nyin shas gnas tshang ma rnyed par lus skabs shes rdor zhes pa'i grwa rgan de'i kho rang gi ngo shes lha dgon gyi grwa rgan sku mched gnyis la gnas tshang g.yar grogs zhus par der khong gnyis kyis 'og khang zhig du gnas tshang g.yar tsam byung zhing me shing khur nas gnas gla sprapye/ skabs der lha rtse skyabs mgon rin

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃpo che sangs rgyas dpal mchog chu'i phyar ri khrod du thugs dam bcad rgyar bzhugs yod pas sku mdun du rang gar tshud dka' bar yod pas gnas tshang grwa rgan gnyis kyis khong la khyod sku mdun tshud dka' nges gsungs/ der nyin zhig khong gis bla ma gzhan phan gyi phyag yig bsnams nas ri khrod du phebs 'phral yul mi kha shas la thun mtshams mjal kha gnang bzhin pa'i skabs dang khel bas khong yang sku mdun du tshud pa ma zad bla ma hor bla'i phyag yig phul zhing lo rgyus zhus nas rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs mgon rin po ches dgyes bzhin brtse bas rjes su bzung zhing de 'phral sngon 'gro kun bzang zhal lung gi chos khrid dbu bzung ba dang rim gyis spyod 'jug sogs zab chos kyi sgo phye nas bla slob thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ khong la dpe cha med snyabs bla ma sku dngos kyi phyag dpe rnams kyang g.yar gnang mdzad/ de skabs dgong mo phyir gnas tshang du log dus gnas tshang bla rgan gcig gis sku mdun tshud dam zhus par tshud pa ma zad chos khrid gnang nas phyag dpe yang g.yar song gsungs pas bla rgan gyis bla ma'i phyag dpe ngo shes nas de ma thag gang zag khyad par ba zhig yin pa 'dra zhes bzhugs gnas yar steng thog tu spar/ yang de rjes bla mas khong chu'i phyar ri khrod du dka' ba spyad nas bzhugs su bcug /skabs shig bla mas rdo khog tu nas bsod zhig la song gsungs pa bzhin phebs/de skabs rdo klung dal 'bab kyi rgyun la brgal dka' bas gru gzings la zhugs te byon pa na glo bur du rlung 'tshub drag po zhig byung bas chu chen po'i rba rlabs kyis bskyod de gru gzings 'thor la khad pa dang steng 'og bsgyur tsam mang po 10

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃbyas skabs hor bla sogs bla ma rnams la gsol ba drag tu btab pas gnod byed kyi rkyen las grol te chu bo las brgal thub pa byung ngo / /de nas rdo dgra bla zer ba'i sa rong rtsub pa'i 'phrang chen der grogs med par rje rang nyid gcig pur sku bskyod skabs/ gzig ma bu gsum gyis shin tu ngar bskyed de yar bda' mar bda' mang du byas pas thugs bred sngangs chen po byung / de 'phral bla ma la gsol ba snying nas btab pas gcan gzan gzig gi 'jigs pa las grol/ de rjes nas khong gi gzim lam du lan grangs mang por gcan gzan de dag rmis te thugs la skrag dngangs drag po byung bas re zhig na bud med cig gis gcan gzan de dag khrid nas smras pa/ gcan gzan 'di dag nga'i cho 'phrul yin yang tshul de khyod kyis ma shes pa red zer zhing gcan gzan rnams bud med der thim song / bud med de yang yi ge zhig tu gyur nas mi snang bar gyur/ tshul de rnams bla ma skyabs mgon rin po che la zhus par khong gis de dag slong tshad yin yang khyod kyis da bar ma chod pa red/ da ni chod pa yin gsungs/de rjes rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dpe cha zhig mjal tshe nyin zhag lnga'i bar du snang ba sprunatad med du song nas snang ba'i 'ching zhen lhod kyis grol ba byung /yang khong gi nyams snang la chos rje dam pa hor bla gzhan phan 'od zer gyis zhal gzigs gnang ste rig lnga'i phyag mtshan zhig phyag tu gtad nas/ da ni sgra bsgyur mar pa'i gdan sa lho gro bo lung du phebs pa'i dus la bab pa yin zhes lung bstan/ de'i tshul lha rtse skyabs mgon rin po cher zhus tshe lung bstan zhakhrul med yin yang da dung 'gro mi dgos /ḍings/ de rjes lo ngo gnyis tsam nas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃskyabs rje'i sku la snyung gzhi drag po bzhes par zhabs pad brtan pa'i sku rim bsgrub ched du gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mchog sprul rol ba'i rdo rje lcags mo sprul sku lha rtse dgon du gdan zhus kyis khong gi gter byon lha mchog hya skṛ ba'i zab gter lcags mo rta gsar gyi bka' rgya bkrol te dbang lung man ngag gi rgyun spel/ gter ston rang nyid gong gnon du bzhugs nas zla sgrub cig mdzad pas/ skyabs rje'i sku gegs bsal te sku tshe yun du bsrings shing smun las grol/ dus rgud sogs la'ang phan 'bras mngon gyur thob pa byung / skabs der skyabs rje mchog sprul khong la grub chen nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag gi rgyun khyad par bzhugs par sku mdun du bcar te/ rje btsun dam pa lags deng dus su rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skad tsam re gleng ba mang mod 'on kyang bdag la lam de'i yon tan gyi cha phra mo'ang rgyud la ma 'byor bas mgon nyid kyis rjes su 'dzin par zhu zhes nan gyis gsol ba btab pa na/ khyed bla ma gzhan phan nyid nas 'dir mngags pa yin skad thos/gzhan phan khong la nga rang yang mjal 'dod lhag par che yang deng skabs stabs ma 'grigs/ de slad mi rgan nga yi khong nas khyod la rdzogs pa chen po zhig rtogs pa'i re ba med kyang khyod rang nga dang lhan du 'go log phyogs su shog dang lto gos gnyis po ngas sbyar chog /rdo grub rin po che'i mdun du bcar na rdzogs pa chen po rgyud la 'byor bar nges so gsungs/tshul de lha rtse skyabs mgon rin po cher zhus kyang bka' yi gnang ba ma thob/ de tshe mchog sprul rol ba'i rdo rjes da ni ban chung khyod la skyabs mgon gyis gnang ba med kyang ༵ba rje nyid kyi gdam zab byin rlabs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃkyi brgyud pa'i pha phog bla na med pa 'di ngas khyod la bstan gyis gsungs nas thugs rab tu dgyes pa chen pos khrid yig ye shes bla ma la sogs pa'i rdzogs chen kyi man ngag ci rigs dang zhal 'phros su zab gnad mang po zhig gces nor du gdams te rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gdams ngag gi snying po de ka rang lags phyir brtson pas nyams su longs shig gsungs/ khong gis brtson pa drag pos thugs nyams su bzhes tshe zhag bdun phrag gcig gi mamomos su slob dpon gyis snang srid bla mar ngo sprod sogs kyi nyams snang sna tshogs shar zhing /gzhan yang gzung 'dzin las rlung gi rgyu ba dbyings su nub ste rtog med kyi ngang du 'byams klas pa na dran med dang lung ma bstan du ma song bar bum nang gi mar me bzhin 'od gsal ye shes kyi 'char sgo 'gag pa med par gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams kyi bkod pa mngon du gyur pa yin zhes gzugs mi snang bar sgra'i dbyangs kyis lung bstan pa dang rigs lnga'i zhing khams sogs kyi snang ba gsal la ma 'dres par shar ba na/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i bud med mdzes ma du mas rigs lnga'i zhing sogs so so'i brda sprod byed pa dang gzhan rgya yig dang bod yig sogs yig rigs sna tshogs shar zhing / tshe rabs las kyi bla ma sangs rgyas thogs med bya ba de da lta kha ba la der bzhugs yod pas de ru song zhes lung bstan pa sogs mtha' yas pa byung ngo / /de nas bzung rig rtsal chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab klong nas rdol bas/ snang ba brda dang dpe char shar ba'i rtags su mgrin pa rdo rje'i gsang mdzod nas ngal gso'i mgron po'i rgyang glu sogs lta mgur gyi rigs da~X snyan zhing 'jebs la skabs don khyad

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃpar can gyi 'bel rtsom do ha'i skor sogs ljags rtsom yang mang du gnang ngo / /skabs shig rje 'di'i lta mgur las/ a ho grong dgon spel ma yi khrod na/ /gnas nyams 'thug po yi mal du/ /nyams zhen ro myong la chags pa'i/ /ngal ba don med kyi sgom chen/ /a 'thas nyams zhen gyi 'ching bas/ /rang rgyud bsdams pa de e go/dbang med byed po ni ma mchis/ /cung zad klod na ni bde'o/ /cir yang ma grub pa'i ngang nas/ /dwangs gsal 'gags med kyi nyams len/ /shad zhung bon po dang mthun pa'i/ /lta de spros can du 'dug go/ /bsgom yang sems 'dzin gyi bsam gtan/ /ma bsgom 'khrul 'byams kyi rang bzhin/ /de 'dra'i gnas 'gyu yi ngang la/ /mi tshe zad pa 'di e gzigs/ /gzugs med bsam gtan gyi khung bur/ /sems gnas dgung lo ni bgres kyang / gnas dga' 'gyu sdug gi ngang du/ /da dung 'o brgyal zhig yod skad/ /lta ba'i bgro gleng re byas tshe/ 'dri sa gleng satsam med pa'i/ /khyod kyi log rtog de spongs dang / /nga tshos nyams mgur zhig 'then ya/ /zhes sogs dang gzhan yang / gser lha ñtsā gser gyi mchod rten la/ phra tshom gasnya yi tog gis mdzes/ /re zhig la rtog pa'i drwa ba bshig /ces sogs gsungs pa de dag gnas der nyams len gnad du ma song ba'i blun sgom mun rdo ba sogs la gdams par gor ma chag kyang / rje rig 'dzin buddhā shrī wan gyi lta ba la zur za ba'i tshig red ces bla slob kyi bar du dbyen byas pa ma zad tha chad 'gas khong la sbyar dug kyang drangs pa sogs lab gleng dang spyod ngan mang po byung mod khong la dug gis ma gnod pa ma zad khong ༵ slob thugs shin tu mthun po yin

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃstabs kyis glags ma rnyed do/ /de rjes yun ring song mthar snyabs rje bla mas gdul bya'i ngor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu tshul mdzad pa sogs rkyen 'ga' zhig gis gnas der bzhugs pa'i skabs ma mchis par/ mched grogs 'ga' dang lhan du gser stod phyogs su gnas nges med du rgyu zhing phebs so/ /gzhan yang 'di skabs yas mas su ra hor sku chen gyi mdun du dge tshul gyi bslab sdom nod pa dang / sku zhabs brag dkar ba'i mdun nas sngon 'gro sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan pa'i lo rgyus kyang thos so//gsum pa lcags skong bdud 'joms rdo rje'i lung bzhin tshe rabs las kyi bla ma a 'dzoms 'brug pa rin po che dang mjal nas gdams zab kyis thugs kyi bum bzang gtam pa'i skor ni/ de nas rim gyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po gter chen bdud 'joms gling pa'i chos skar du byon cing der chos 'brel zhus nas bzhugs/ nyin zhig snang sbyangs gsungs skabs khrid dpon a bo'i bsod rgan sprul skus sems thag chod na 'bu nag sgong sder gang me la bsregs kyang sa rdo dang khyad med tshul sogs gsungs pa khong gi thugs la ma babs par khong la 'gram lcag cig gzhus nas khyad ye 'dug ces shes pa yod med kyis khyad shin tu che tshul dgag bzhag gnang ba sogs gter chen gyis gsan nas mdun du shog gsungs/ phebs pas khyed kyis nga'i khrid dpon la shag 'gyed byed pa'i spobs pa ci yod sogs bka' bkuon gnang bas lo rgyus zhib par zhu skabs thugs dgyes pas de rjes nas sku mdun du snang sbyangs rgyas par zhus pa ma zad snang sbyang gi zin bri~X kyang gnang ba ma zad khong snang sbyang la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃmakhas tshul dus phyis gter chen sku sras rdor dgras rang gis dngos slob sha ba'i a ti dang dom tshang gter ston tshe dbang mgon po sogs kyang g.yu khog bla ma'i sku mdun snang sbyang zhu bar ched mngags mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar lcags skong sgar du bzhugs skabs nyin zhig gter chen bdud 'joms rin po ches khong la khyod kyi tshe rabs las kyi bla ma a 'dzoms 'brug rgan 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje red 'dug pas da lta nyid du khrom khog tu song zhes lung bstan dbug dbyung gnang bas/ de skabs khong gi zhabs phyi sgo spus yon tan dang lung nang bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs sogs grwa 'khor bcas bzhul ring lam gyi sku ngal khyad du bsad nas phebs mthar rim gyis skyabs rje 'khor lo'i mgon po a 'dzoms 'brug pa rin po che 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje'i gdan sar phebs/rdo rje 'chang dngos 'brug pa rin po che'i zhabs pad la bde chen 'khor lo'i cod pan gyis gtug nas sgo gsum ltos med du phul zhing rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa na/ bla ma rin po ches kyang mjal tsam nyid nas gzhan las lhag pa'i tshul gyis dgyes brtse'i rjes su bzung zhing skal bzang las can gyi 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu la khams dang dbang po bsam pa dang mthun pa'i zab rgyas kyi chos sbyin mi zad pa'i gter chen gyi sgo yangs por phye ba'i chos grwa der khong la yang gdul bya rjes 'dzin gyi thabs la dgongs te dang po thun mong sngon 'gro nas gzhi btsugs te lam gyi 'jug rim mthar chags su rim gyis bstsal zhing / khyad par dpal gdod ma'i mgon po nas snga 'gyur slob dpon padma ka ra sogs di ḍirgyud de rim par bka' babs bdun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃgyi mnga' bdag padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa'am 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po sogs la brgyud pa bcas shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag 'di yin no zhes/ le lo can 'bad med du grol ba ka dag khregs chod kyi gdams pa dang / brtson 'grus can 'bad bcas su grol ba 'od gsal thod rgal gyi snyan brgyud man ngag nyams len bcas 'di ni theg mchog rgyal po'i man ngag ste/ skal ldan tshe 'dir grol ba'i gdam pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtse mo yang gsang bla na med pa ste dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs mdzod/ grub brnyes rig 'dzin stong gi dgongs pa'i zhe phug rtogs ldan rgan po yongs kyi nye lam zer ba 'di ga yin gsungs nas snga phyir lce btsun snying thig dang dgongs pa zangs thal khyad par snying thig gong 'og gi smin grol dang ljags lung rtsa rlung gtum mo bcud len sogs gdams zab mang po bum pa gang byos tshul gyis gces nor du rdzogs par nyams khrid du bstsal/ gzhan yang bka' gter gsar rnying gi chos bka' dang dbang lung du ma yang gsan nas gnas der khrid sbyang dang bcud len la yun ring bzhugs tshul yang gsungs pa sogs dka' ba brgya phrag gis sbyang brtson yun ring gnang bas mkhas dang grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por rtsod med du gshegs pas a 'dzoms 'brug pa rdo rje 'chang gi rtogs pa don gyi rgyal tshab tu gyur nas bla mas khong la bya bral chos dbyings rang grol zhes don ldan gyi mtshan gyi cod pan dpyang ba ma zad/ g.yu khog bya bral dang go 'jo mkhar sprul padma shes rab bzang po di 7bshad pa'i bka' babs dang / ngor

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃrtogs ldan shakyu shrī dang rmug seng sprul sku 'jigs med chos kyi blo gros gnyis la sgrub pa'i bka' babs te thugs sras ka chen bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa byung / /chos sgar der bzhugs skabs nyin zhig bla mas khong gi sras mo 'chi med khyod kyi yum skal red 'dug pas thabs shes 'brel na legs tshul gsungs kyang / khong gis bla ma la gzhan ni khyed kyis ci gsung dang du len yang bud med 'di bdag la dgos pa mi 'dug pas de ltar mi dgos pa'i dgongs khrol yang yang zhus/ phyis su yang khong rten rab byung yin mod cha lugs lcang lo dang gzan dkar sogs sngags chas lta bur bzhugs pa ni bla ma rin po che'i bka' gsung dang mi 'gal ba'i ched du yin gsungs/ de ltar a 'dzoms 'brug pa rin po che'i mdun du bgrang bya du mar zab rgyas chos mdzod du mar gsan bsgom zung du 'brel nas rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /bzhi pa bla ma'i bka' bzhin gnas nges med du gdan sa btsal ba'i mthar gser smad yag sgang du gdan sa'i rten 'brel 'grigs shing bzhugs sgar btab pa'i skor ni/ der 'brug pa rdo rje 'chang gi mdun nas bgrang bya mang du bzhugs mthar gsan sbyang mthar ru phyin nas mkhas grub chen po'i rgyal sar gshegs skabs 'brug pa rin po ches da ni gzhan don gdul bya skyong ba'i dus la babs so zhes bka' gsung bstsal zhing / dpon slob tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam bcas zhal gyes nas smyo shul ljon pa lung du gnas mardzal du phebs shing der bla ma lung rtogs rin po che mjal ba la 'di ltar zhus/nga la a sdordoms rin po ches gzhan don gdul bya

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod grin/ oskyong ba'i dus la babs gsungs kyang mkhas pa'i yon tan ci yang mi bdog pas thabs ci yod lags zhus par/ spyo shul bla ma lung rtogs kyi zhal nas skyon med de ltar mdzod dang ban rgan ngas shes tshad kyang khyod la sbyin zhes byin rlabs gnang bas de nas bzung chos gang la yang chags thogs mi mnga' ba'igazungs spobs kyi blo gros thob par yang gsungs/ rim gyis nyag rong phyogs su gnas nges med du phebs nas 'gro don bskyangs kyang gdan sa sogs kyi rten 'brel dang 'gro don cher ma rgyas/ 'di skabs rgya nag phyogs su gnas skor la phebs tshul zhig kyang 'dug /de nas phyir sku 'khrungs yul g.yu khog phyogs su phebs/ 'on kyang skabs der g.yu khog ba dang li khog ma sde 'khrugs kyi rkyen las g.yu khog dpon rnams grongs pas dpon med sde 'thor lta bur yod stabs/ tshul bzhin gdan zhu sne len sogs med pa ma zad g.yu mkhar dgon du phebs skabs sus kyang ngo ma shes/ der dgon spyi khang du gnas tshang zhig g.yar rogs gsungs kyang ma g.yar/ chu dbar khog tu khyug tsam phebs nas slar gser rta'i phyogs su phebs/rim gyis gser smad sbo mda'i sar phebs skabs sde dpon gla ri o rgyan tshe brtan dang mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel gyis snga 'gyur rgu gdong dgon gyi chos gzhi dang lha sde bcas grwa 'bul byas pas rten 'brel legs phyogs su 'grigs/ chos dgon der lo shas ring bzhugs kyang sngar gyi sa dpyad nyam pa sogs kyis rkyen las gdul bya dang 'phrin las cher ma rgyas par/ slar a 'dzoms 'brug pa rin po cher brtag zhus dang gdan sa gang du yod lung bstan gyi zhu yig bcas sku 'khor kha shas mngags par 19

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃgasung lan du/ khyed kyi gdan sa de ri sha ba'i sgro ba lta bu'am ri bo dung dkar g.yas 'khyil lta bu'i lte ba na yod ces lung bstan gnang 'dug pa phyogs kun tu btsal nas yag sgang gi ri rtsar phebs skabs sbyin bdag rgad po zhig gis lam kha nas gdan nag po zhig bting zhing der bzhugs rogs zhus/ sbyin bdag la khyod kyi ming la ci zer gsungs pas nga'i ming la 'phrin las dar rgyas zer lags zhus pa dang zho mdong mo gang drangs pas/ gdan nag po ni chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i brda ste gnas 'di'i nye 'khor zhig la bzhugs gdan 'ardzag pa'i rten 'brel dang / 'phrin las dar rgyas zhes pas der gdul bya 'phrin las rgyas nges dang zho bkra shis pa'i rdzas yin pa sogs rten 'brel ha cang legs gsungs nas der seng chen rgyal po'i gnas su grags pa'i yag yi de'u le gnyan po zhes pa'i ri bo dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi dbyibs su gnas pa de gdan sar gzigs nas grwa 'khor bcas ri de'i mgul du phebs skabs/ ri mgul gyi phyis su gdan 'jag sa'i sa mig der thab rdo sum drigs dang me shing khur po zhig bcas bzhag 'dug pas bla slob thams cad rten 'brel 'grigs pa'i thugs dgyes tshor chen po'i ngang gnas der bsang dang gser skyems sogs kyis mchod skabs/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba'i gseb nas chos sku 'od dpag med/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas 'khor rje 'bangs dang snga 'gyur kun mkhyen yab sras sogs kyis zhal mngon sum gzigs nas lung bstan dang dbug dbyung sogs gnang ba rje nyid kyis mngon sum du gzigs/ gzhan ye she~X dang theg mchog yon tan sogs grwa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃ'akhor rnams kyis 'ja' 'od dang nam mkha' nas bya rgod mang pos lding skor dang ri thod du bya rgod mang pos skor ba byed pa sogs rtags ya mtshan can mang du byung ba mthong bas kun kyang dad pa'i ba spu g.yo zhing dga' ba'i spyan chab kyang babs/ skabs der rje nyid kyis grwa 'khor kha shas la khyed cag kha shas ri 'di'i g.yas g.yon du chu yod med blta ru song gsungs/ de 'phral grwa ba kha shas blta ru 'gro skabs ri de'i g.yas ngos su chu mig zhig gsar du brdol nas chu yar 'phyur bzhin rtsa dang sa rdul sogs kyang 'phyag bzhin pa mthong ba de ni phyis su me bya chu mig ces pa de yin/ der dpon g.yog rnams kyis sngar gyi thab steng nas gsol ja bskol zhing thengs dang por gsol ja bzhes/ de nas khong gis slob ma rnams la da khyed rnams phyogs phyogs su song la sha chang sogs tshogs rdzas re slongs dang gnas ston tshogs 'khor zhig byed gsungs pa bzhin grwa slob rnams phyogs so sor bsod snyom du phebs nas phyir nyin mnyam du 'dzoms skabs sha thams cad phyogs gcig bsdoms pas sha khog cha tshang ba zhig dang gzhan yang 'o zho mar thud sogs bza' btung gi rigs mang du rnyed 'dug pas rten 'brel ha cang legs gsungs/ der nyin shas gnas ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston la longs su spyod pa'i skabs tshogs kyi lhag ma yang rgod thang dkar bzhis khyer ba'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba byung / de nas lo de gar gzim khang bkod legs shig sngar gyi thab shul ma nor bar thab ka khel ba bcas bskrun pa ma zad chos ra dang de nas rim gyis 'du khang dang grwa 'khor rnams so sos sa khang dang gad phug sogs bzhugs gnas 'dzoms par byas shing zab 21

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃgasang chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad par bskor bas gdul bya 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba byung ngo / /bzhugs sgar btab pa'i rjes su yang g.yu khog tu thengs 'ga' phebs pa ma zad phyis dpon bla dge 'dun rgya mtshos g.yu khog tu lugs gnyis skyong skabs dpon blas khong ma 'das bar g.yu khog du bzhugs dgos pa'i bka' bzhin bya bral rin po che g.yu dgon du yun ring tsam bzhugs nas dpon bla 'das rjes slar gser yag sgang ri khrod du phyir phebs nas skal bzang las can gyi gdul bya'i tshogs la zab gsang chos kyi bdud rtsi ngoms med du bstsal ba yin no/ /lnga pa gter chen las rab gling pa gser ljongs su chib kha bsgyur ba'i mthun sbyor gnang zhing mjal 'dzoms kyis zab chos kyi gdams pa nod pa'i skor ni/ skabs de tsam na gter chen las rab gling pa'am nyag bla bsod rgyal rin po che nyag khog tu mi bzhugs par a mdo re skong phyogs su phebs rgyu red ces gsan pas/ khong gis de ma thag gla ri o rgyan tshe brtan sogs gser smad phyogs kyi bla dpon rnams la khyed rnams kyis nyag bla bsod rgyal rin po che gser rta'i phyogs su gdan 'dren zhu thub na ma 'ongs par sa phyogs 'di chos kyi gdul zhing chen po zhig tu 'gyur nges pa yin ces gsungs pas de 'phral bla dpon rnams nyag bla'i mdun gdan 'dren du 'gro skabs/ bla ma nyag blas khong la sgar ba mang pas gser rta'i phyogs nas 'tsho ba sogs rnyed dka' rgyu red gsungs kyang g.yu khog bla ma'i gsung bskul dang der yod bla dpon rnams kyi re zhu la brten mthar khong gser kho~X tu chib bsgrur gnang bar zhal gyis

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ obazhes nas gser khog tu phebs/ bya bral rin po che'i gdan zhus kyis khong rnam gnyis zhal ras mnyam 'dzoms byung zhing g.yu khog bla mas khyed nga la man ngag sgo skyel gyi tshul du phebs pa ngo mtshar che gsungs nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te rigs kyi bdag por bsten/ gter ston rin po che rgyun du de phyogs su bzhugs pa'i bka' gros mdzad pa sogs thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ de nas bla ma nyag blas gser smad du nyag sgar zhes pa gsar 'debs mdzad cing bya bral rin po ches bla ma nyag bla la khyed sbo mda' yar mar gyi khong gi sbyin bdag lha sde rnams kyi dud khyim re re bzhin phebs gnang mdzad nas tshe 'gug g.yang 'bod gsur re bcas gsungs rgyu bdag gi re ba yin sbyin bdag tshos 'byor tshod dang bstun nas so sos khyed la 'brel 'jog re byed dgos par 'dug /ngas khyed la zhabs phyi byed chog ces dang / sbyin bdag rnams la da res gser gyi pha bong sgo 'gril yin pas so sos 'byor tshod dang bstun pa'i 'brel 'jog re byas na 'di phyi gnyis phan yin gsungs shing / de nas bla ma nyag bla rin po che la g.yu khog bla mas zhabs phyi byas nas nye skor thams cad la nas bsod kyi tshul du byon cing sbyin bdag tshos kyang sne len zab rgyas byas/nyin zhig sbyin bdag zhig gi khang pa'i phyi nas yar sum thog la skas ring zhig brgyud nas bla ma nyag bla sngon dang g.yu khog bla ma rjes nas yar phebs skabs g.yu khog bla mas zhal mtshar gyi tshul du/ skas ring 'di la yun re ring / /dkor la skyo ba skye bar shog /ces gsungs ma thag bla ma nyag blas yar phebs mtshams bzhag nas ci 'dra'i gdamaswā zlog zab mo zhig red gsungs 'phral

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃnas bsod kyi 'phro bzhag nas ma phebs par grags/ slar g.yu khog bla ma grwa 'khor bcas nyag sgar du ched phebs kyis yun ring bzhugs nas khong la bla ma nyag blas nyin mor sgyu 'phrul spyi don mdzod kyi lde mig dang mtshan mor gsang snying spyi don 'od gsal snying po gnyis res mos su ljags khrid gnang zhing rje 'di'i zhal rgyun sogs zin bris gnang ba rnams deng sang mjal du yod pa rnams gsung 'bum du bkod pa ltar lags/ gzhan gsang 'grel phyogs bcu mun sel dang dgongs rgyan zhal lung sogs sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad pa rgya cher gasdo/na pa dang rdzogs chen sems phyogs gtso bor gyur pa'i man ngag dang lta khrid thod rgal sogs kyi bshad pa bcas shin tu rdo rje gsang ba'i man ngag rnams gces nor du gdams pa sogs kyis mtshon smin grol gyi rigs rgya cher gsan te thugs nyams su bzhes pa sogs phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis bla ma nyag blas gser ljongs 'dzin ma'i khyon der bstan 'gro'i don chen 'gyed pa'i thog ma'i rten 'brel yang 'grigs pa yin no/ /drug pa gser yag sgang ri khrod du slob ma bskyangs shing bstan 'gro'i don chen phyogs med du rgyas pa'i skor ni/ de lta bu'i skyabs rje 'gro ba'i mgon po gang gis gdan sa yag sgang ri khrod du 'khor slob rnams la chos sbyin mi zad pa'i phrin las kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phyes nas gdul bya rgya mtsho lta bu smin grol la bkod pa'i tshul las brtsams te cung zad brjod na/ de yang gsang chen snga 'gyur ba'i bstan pa rin po che nub ri'i rtse mor yib la nye ba thugs kyis ma bzod par snying po'i bstan pa 2ོ༵ nas rgyal bstan gyi srog 'dzin par

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃthugs labacangs te sku tshe hril por sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa nyid lhur len pa gtso bor mdzad de spyir slob bu'i khams dang dbang po bsam pa'i bye brag dang bstun nas khrid gsung pa kho na gtso bo mdzad pas ngo sprod gdab tshul sogs khrid kha 'jog stangs mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang / dang po'i las can chos sgor gsar du zhugs pa'i rigs la sems nyid ngal gso dang kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sogs klong snying sngon 'gro'i dmigs khrid ltar phyag bzhes ma nyams par mdzad de/ de yang dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas bshes gnyen bsten pa'i bar thun mong phyi yi sngon 'gro'i khrid rkang drug po re re bzhin nyams khrid zhib par gnang ste blo ldog rnam bzhi rgyud la ma skyes kyi bar sgom du 'jug /de'i rjes su skyabs sems nas bla rnam bar nang gi khrid rkang re re bzhin khrid cing 'bum lnga'i bsags sbyang kyang gnad du khel nges gsog tu 'jug cing bla rnam skabs sirnyi bye ba sa ya sogs grangs mang 'khyol du 'jug de nas rim gyis dngos gzhi rnams rtags dang sbyar te byung gnas 'gro gsum gyis gzhi bzung nas bzhag thabs shan 'byed ngo sprod gegs sel bogs 'don bcas rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rnam bzhag gdan thog gcig tu nyams su blangs nas mthar thug zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i bar lam gyi rim pa tshang la ma nor bar 'jug rim ltar khrigs chags su nyams khrid du gdams pa de ni gang zag snang ba yul gyi blo can nam rim gyis pa rnams skyong tshul yin cing / yang gang zag cig char ba'i rigs rig pa rang snang gi blo can rnams la thog ma nas 'od gsal ba'i ༵ shes rjen par ngo sprad de lo dang zla ba

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod srin/ oṃtsam gyis rtogs pa mngon du byas pa'ang du ma yod/ gzhan slob ma'i thugs rgyud dang bstun nas mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang ldan pa'i rigs rnams la sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po rtsa 'grel/klong mdzod bdun/ bla ma yang tig rdzogs chen dgongs pa zangs thal/lce btsun snying thig khrid yig ye shes bla ma/gnyug sems skor gsum/ ngal gso skor gsum/ nges shes sgron me sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde dang mdo phyogs dbu phar sogs kyi bshad pa'ang mdzad pas mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi gsung las skyes pa'i dngos slob mtha' yas pa byung ngo / de ltar dgung grangs gzhon skabs rje nyid kyis gang la gang 'dul gyi zab chos sku ngal 'dzem med kyi tshul du khrid gnang zhing sku na smin skabs su thun mong sngon 'gro dang skyabs sems sogs phal cher der bzhugs slob ma/'i mchog gyur mkhan po chos gsal dang 'jang sgang dbon po sogs la gsung du 'jug cing smin khrid rnams rje nyid kyis mdzad/ gang ltar gsar du sleb pa rnams la sngon 'gro'i blo sbyangs dang skyabs sems sogs nyi ma re re bzhin khrid du 'jug cing rgyud nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyis smin nges su mdzad pa las/ dang po nas dngos gzhi'i khrid rnams gang byung du khrid srol gtan nas med par ma zad rje nyid kyis dngos gzhi'i smin khrid rnams stsol ba'i skabs kyang slob bu lnga yan la mnyam du khrid srol med cing de yang ngo sprod dngos ni kher khrid kho nas ngo sprod thebs nges su mdzad pas rje 'di'i dngos slob yin phyin 'khor ba la gting nas blo log cing sku tshe dben rir bskyal te nyams len mtha' ru phyin pa/ lhag par dus 'gyur mun nag gis brdzi bar ma ñtshas pas tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa gcig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnamathar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃlas gcig gis bzang ba lta bu sha stag byung bas phal cher tshe 'dir grol rtags mngon du gyur ba'am 'chi kha tshun la lam sna ma zin pa gcig kyang med pa lta bu byung ba nirje 'di'i byin rlabs dang slob ma skyong ba'i thun min gyi khyad chos shig tu nges so zhes deng sang kun gyis dad 'dun gyi bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor bzhin pa 'di'o/ /gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gdul bya skyong ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i tshad du gleng ba ste chos la ma 'dres pa'am/ yang na chos la don gnyer med pa dag la dngos rdzas phran tsam re gnang ba'am/ gna' dpe dang gtam rgyud gleng ba sogs snyan par smra ba kho nas snang ba chos kyi phyogs su rim gyis kha drangs bar mdzad cing tha na byis pa chung ngu dag la'ang zhal rtsed dang mngar chas kyi rigs sogs gnang ste blo snang dbang med du 'brid mkhas pa dang / mi chen dang bla chen gyi rigs sam yang na nga rgyal dang khengs sems che ba'i rigs la mtshang nas sgol te drag po'i bka' bkyon kyis tshar bcad/dbul phongs nyams chung gi rigs la chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar ba sogs gyis rgyun du brtse bas bskyangs/ mi dbang sa skyong gi rigs la rgyal khrims chos dang mi 'gal bar chab srid bde sgyid kyi dpal la bkod pa sogs thabs la mkhas pa'i gzhan don gyi mdzad pa kho na las rang che thabs 'ba' zhig dang / grags pa don du gnyer zhing log 'tsho'i dkor mang sdud pa'i g.yo thabs dang gzhan mtho la phrag dog gis zur za zhing mi snyan par gleng ba dang mnyam par 'gran gyis dogs nas thabs sna tshogs kyis tshar bcad de 'bangs su bkol ba sogs rang don phugs ༷/ga gzhan phan kha ru 'don pa'i chos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃbargyad kyi mngon zhen phra mos kyang sku tshe hril por gos pa med par sngon byon rgyal ba gong ma'i mdzad pa dang rjes su mthun par bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi dang / las bzhi'i phrin las lhun grub la mnga' dbang 'byor ba yin/ de bzhin rgyun du sku mdun nas 'grig 'ded rgyu dang gling sgrung bshad du 'jug pa sogs kyang dus kyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog pa'i thabs mkhas yin par gsungs pa sogs rtag tu gzhan phan gyi phrin las rlabs po che gdul bya yongs la snyoms par 'jug pas ches ngo mtshar med du gyur pa'i mdzad pa la lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyis bstod dbyangs mgrin gcig tu sgrogs pa lags so/ /khong ni rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pas bya bral gyi mtshan don dang mthun pa ste/ bsnung gnas bla ma rin chen dar rgyas kyis khong la/ khyed la phyi na kha zhos mdzo mo mang / nang na rgyu rdzas dang tha na me shing yan chad 'di 'dra mang bas ci'i phyir na bya bral ba zer zhes zhus tshe/ khong gis khyed kyis nor ba red/ rgyu med na sprang po zer/ bya bral zer ba ni nang rig pa'i ye shes la gzung 'dzin gyi bya ba bral dgos pa yin/gzhan bya bral mkhyen brtse'i dbang po ci la zer zhes don gyi bya bral du zhal gyis bzhes/ de bzhin rje 'di thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba la thugs dgyes shing khyad par 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i gzhung la thugs rtsis ha cang che bar gnang ba ste/ sngar a 'dzom rin po che'i sku mdun bzhugs dus 'jam mgon bla ma mi pham rin po che zhal bzhugs skabs yin stabs bya bral rin po che khong der zhal mjal dang gsung chos zhu ru phebs 'dod ha cang che bas bla ma la gnang ba zhus kyang 'brug pa rdospya po ches ngas khyed la bshad pa de tshos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sgrin/ yokhyod kyis rang gzhan gnyis kyi don 'grub nges pas de dag nyams su longs zhes phebs par ma gnang / yang khyod kyi sku sngon ma rdo bla 'jigs skal yang ha cang mkhas pas rgya nag tu gdan drangs skabs thabs ma mkhas pas khrims su tshud/ de bas khyed rang la yang keg che stabs sbyangs pa de tsam gyis chog gsungs nas ma gnang ba red ces kyang thos/ gang ltar 'jam mgon bla ma sku dngos su ma mjal yang phyis su ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung bar nges te bod sprul rin po che dang mnyam du gzhud gi bgro gleng gnang skabs khong gis 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung gi gnad gsang mang po zhal 'phros su gnang bas mi pham rin po ches byin gyis brlabs pa'i thugs sras yin nges pa'i thugs nges 'khrungs zhes bod sprul mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi mas rgyun du gsungs/yang 'go log mkhan po 'jam don la bya bral rin po ches khyod kyis mi pham la rgyun du gsol ba thob gsungs pas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab tshe bla ma rang nyid re rmis pas khong rnam gnyis thugs rgyud gcig pa 'dra zhes mkhan po 'jam don gsungs/ de bzhin mi pham rin po ce'i gsung la thugs gtsig ha cang che bar gnang ste khong gis mkhan po chos gsal la/ khyod kyis klong chen klong gsungs kyang klong chen pa'i gsung gi lde mig lta bu mi pham rin po che'i gsung yin pas de la ltos zhes gsungs shing sku dngos kyis rgyun du nges sgron dang gsang snying spyi don gnyug sems sogs ljags khrid gnang ba ma zad phyis su chos sgar du lung rgyun spel ba'i mthun rkyen yang gnang / de ltar rje 'di nyid mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thugs byang chub pa sdu zad thun mong gso rig gi gzhung dang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabasadad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃlag len la'ang byang chub pas rgyun du gso ba rig pa'i skor gyi lag len dang gzhung khrid gnang bar brten khong gi slob ma phal cher gyis sman gyi lag len dgongs pa ma zad mdun 'dug pa g.yu khog bla ma 'gyur med rdo rje sogs sman pa mkhas pa yang mang du byung / de ltar rje 'di mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i mtshan snyan gyis phyogs kun khyab pas skabs der gangs ljongs mdo smad kyi a mdo 'go log tshun chad nas smad mi nyag rgya rong yan chad kyi bla sprul skyes chen du ma dang dpon rigs mi drag mang po/ de bzhin las can gyi gdul bya'i tshogs grangs med pa zhal ras mjal ba dang zab chos zhu ru lhags/ skabs der khong gi 'khor slob la bslab pa sbyin pa'i mkhan po/ rgyud sde 'chad pa'i mkhas pa/mtshan nyid ston pa'i dge bshes sogs mang du bzhugs pa las rgyun du chos sgar der bzo gso ba sgra tshad ma nang don sde snod rin po che gsum gyi bshad pa dang / gzhan skar rtsis brda sprod rig pa yi ge bris gzugs yan chad yon tan gang slob par 'dod kyang rin chen gser gling du phyin pa ltar 'dod pa'i re ba yid bzhin du 'jo bar byed cing sngon rjes su mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i 'byung gnas su yang gyur to/ /gzhan yang der yod 'dus sde yongs kyis phyi so thar gyi bslab pas thugs rgyud legs par bsdams te 'dul ba gzhi gsum gyi lag len phra zhib phyag bzhes su bstar zhing yar mar gyi gso sbyong rgyun du mdzad pa sogs phyi ltar spyod pa dam chos 'dul ba dang sgo bstun par byed pa dang / nang gsang sngags kyi lta sgom zab mo thugs nyams su bzhes te rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brtson cing zla ba byung ngo cog spu yar mar gyi tshes bcu la tshogs mchod

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sgrin/ oṃrgyun mi chad par 'bul ba dang khyad par gsang ba rdzogs chen gyi dngos gzhi'i nyamasalen zab mo chu bo'i rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la bslab pas mnyam bzhag gi rtsi dang mi 'bral bar rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du bltas te bsod nams kyi tshogs sdud par byed pa sogs snga 'gyur mkhas grub gong ma'i mdzad pa'i srol rgyun ji bzhin phyag len du 'debs pa nyid rje 'di'i chos sgar gyi khyad par gyiphyag bzhes su mngon zhing skabs dang skabs su gzhan phan gyi phrin las spel ba sogs chos mthun gyi mdzad pa bzang po'i ngang tshul las nam yang 'da' bar sdio/ bye/da pa sogs kyis skye bo grangs med pa dad pa'i zhing sa la bkod par mdzad bdun pa snang bar rang dbang 'byor ba'i grub rtags dang dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i mngon shes thogs med mnga' tshul gyi skor ni/ slob ma rnams la khyad par rje 'di la dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i mngon shes thogs med mnga' bas gang gsung thams cad phyis su lung bstan pa ltar gyur tshul dang gzhan yang grub pa'i rtags ya mtshan can mang po dad pa dang dag snang sbyang ba tsam kho na ma yin par kun la mthun snang du grub tshul skor gyi gsung rgyun ha cang mang mod 'dir dper mtshon tsam bkod na/ de yang bod sprul rin po che khong gi sku mdun phebs skabs kyang rje 'dis de ring gang zag khyad par ba zhig phebs nges pas bsu ba dgos zhes bod sprul phebs pa sngon nas mkhyen par ma zad zhal mjal skabs kyang khong la rdo bla 'jigs skal gyi bag chags mnga' tshul dang khyed dpa' sprul gyi yang sprul ༵na tshul sogs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃtshul du gsungs shing gdams zab kyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa sogs skye ba'i phrengab kun tu bla slob tu gyur/ de bzhin skyabs rje rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma'i yangasprul ngos 'dzin skabs grub chen pas rdzogs sprul lnga par brtags zhus phul bas khong gis rdo khog man gser khog yan gyi byis pa lo rtags yos can rnamasakyi ming yig bsdus nas khyer shog gsungs/ grub chen dgon gyi grwa 'khor kha shas kyis gser khog nas ming yig bsdu skabs khong gi sku mdun du bcar nas lo rgyus zhus par/ bya bral rin po che'i zhal nas khong gis gzigs snang la rigs lnga zhig gi rigs gsum kha phyir bstan cing gnyis nang du 'khor ba gzigs pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sprul pa lnga las gnyis zhing khams su bzhugs pa dang gsum mi yul du 'khrungs nges pa 'dra bas/ da lta'i mchog sprul byis pa de'i mtshan byang yang nges par du joogs chen rin po che la phul dgos zhes bka' mngags nan cher gnang ba phyis su rdzogs sprul rin po ches chags thogs med pa'i mngon mkhyen gyis de nyid yang sprul du ngos bzung bas rje 'dis sngar nas don gyis ngos 'dzin gnang ba yin no/ /yang gter chen las rab gling pa gser khog tu chib kha bsgyur rgyu'i thugs gros 'don skabs kyang khong sa phyogs 'dir phebs thub na sku tshe 'di dang khyad par sku rabs rjes mar sa phyogs 'di nas bstan 'gro'i don shin tu rgya chen po 'grub tshul nan gyis gsungs pa ma zad chos rje bla ma yid bzhin nor bu mchog dang po khong gi sku mdun mjal du phebs skabs kyang thugs dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mdzad cing rjes su mkhan po chos gsa~X2 gyis khong bla ma nyag bla'i sprul sku yin

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃnam zhus tshe de yang los yin te gang ltar khong skyes bu dam pa 'phrin las gyi sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa can zhig red ces mkhan po chos gsal la yang yang gsungs pa mkhan po shes rab kyi zhal las thos pa de ltar na da lta mngon du gyur ba 'di ga lags/ mkhan chen bla ma padma chos dbyings khyab brdal la yang khyod rdza chu khar bod sprul mdun song dang ma 'ongs par snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing zhig tu 'gyur nges zhes gsungs pa dus phyis mngon du gyur/ /de bzhin mkhan chen bla ma zla ba'i 'od zer rin po ches ma rgan gyi mtshan byang khyer nas rje 'di'i sku mdun du mjal kha zhu ru phebs skabs kyang khyod pha yul du ma 'dug par rdza stod du bod sprul rin po che'i sku mdun song dang ma 'ongs par bstan 'gro'i don 'grub nges zhes gsungs pa bzhin phebs nas phyis 'phags bod kyi yul nas lung bstan mngon du gyur/ yang skor zhig gser yul stod smad kyi dgon khag mang po'i grwa ba stong lhag la mnyam du chos khrid gnang skabs nyin zhig /da res nged cag 'dir mnyam 'dzoms byung ba ni shin tu skal ba bzang /ma 'ongs par dus tshod kyi 'pho 'gyur mang bas 'di ltar mang du 'dzom rgyu lta ci tha na grwa ba mig gis mthong ba yang dka' mo yin/ de dus mi rnams kyi bzang ngan sogs kyang 'byed nges pas khyed rnams pas rgyun du rang tshugs 'dzin rgyu gal che tshul sogs 'byung 'gyur sngon du gzigs pa'i bslab bya mang du bstsal/rgyun du yang mdun 'dug rnams la rtsam pa chung dgos zhes gsung na lo der sad ser 'dra yong nges dang sga stan tshem dgos zhes dgongs pa can gyi gsung yang yang bstsal na dmag rdzag gi zhakhrugs ོ༵nga re 'ong nges pas gser pa'i yul mi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃrnams kyis da lo bla mas gang gsungs zhes 'dri zhing de 'dra ma gsungs tshe kun kyang blo bde bar 'dug ces thos/ yang 'khrungs yul du dang po phebs skabs chu dbar khog tu rgu khang la kha zhes par sku mtshams gnang skabs shig la/ de nas thag cung ring pa'i mtsho skam zhes pa nas mi zhig shi ba mkhyen te rgyang 'pho mdzad/phyir nyin gdan 'dren zhu mi kha shas sleb skabs ngas mdang sum nas rnam shes spar tshar gsungs pas der rgad po glen pa zhig gis/ ho ho khyod kyi de me mda' 'dra ni ma red ro yod sar ma song na phan nam zhus tshe thugs cung zad skyo ste a kha kha sangs rgyas byang sems kyi nye ring med pa'i thugs rje la dus ngan gyi dzos ngan zhig las kyang lta stangs chung ba la gsungs/ yang phyis zhig der bzhugs skabs glo bur du mdun 'dug la 'gro gsungs nas nyin mtshan ltos med kyis phebs mthar sbo mdar sbyin bdag 'phrin las dar rgyas kyi khyim du phebs skabs sgyin bdag grongs ma thag red 'dug pas ngo sprod dang 'pho ba sogs gnang nas :lnga mi rnams la sems gso gnang / yang mkhan po chos gsal g.yu khog tu phebs skabs sku mdun nas gyes phyag zhus te cung tsam song skabs mdun 'dug la mgyogs por song la ltos dang khong rnam par don dag 'dra byung ma song ngam gsungs/mdun 'dug blta ru 'gro skabs gdan sa dang thag mi ring ba'i la rgyab nas khong tshos rta drel rnams 'drogs nas chas gos phal cher sa la g.yug pa sogs byung 'dug kyang mi rnams la skyon med pa mthong / nyin zhig mdun 'dug rtsang ba rig tho la khyod snying rje ma 'ongs par khyod gang du bsdad na mu ges mi 'chi tsam 'ong / khyopyi 4gser chu sngon mo'i rgyud nas bsdad na

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sgrin/ oṃkha mi sos/li gtsang chus bzhi'i sa nas kyang kha sos dka'/ de bas g.yu khog tu bag shad smred la drangs/rdo rta rum du bcug nas song na mu ges mi 'chi tsam e mi 'ong snying re rje gsungs byung ba skabs der rig tho'i bsam pa la/a kha nga la bla mas ci 'dra'i lta stangs chung ba la nga ban de rab byung zhig thabs citsam sdug kyang tha na yang a mchod re byed sa lon nges pas pags pa mnye ci la dgos sogs bsam pa byung yang phyis dus 'gyur skabs las dbang gis g.yu khog phyogs su slebs shing mu ge'i lo la dngos su rdo rta rum du bcug /bag shad sked la drangs nas 'gro ba'i skabs khel bas sngar gyi bla ma'i gsungs rnams dran nas mchi ma dbang med du shor byung gsungs/ yang g.yu khog pa rang byung mdun na yod skabs khyod kyis ma 'ongs par sdug shin tu myong dgos pas da lta nas sbyang dgos/ khyod la sngas mgo 'jog dbang med ces gsungs nas dgong mo sngas mgo gtan nas 'jog ma bcug /gdan yang srab mo las bting ma bcug pa de skabs kho'i sems la 'bab po ma byung yang phyis dus 'gyur skabs de bzhin mngon du gyur nas sdug bsngal mang du myangs/ sngas gdan gtan nas med pas sngar gyi bla ma'i gsung lung bstan mngon sum du go zhes bshad/ yang chung yos kyi grwa ba zhig mardzal du 'ong nas zhal mjal ma thag bla mas/ khyod shul rdzum byed mkhan la ci 'dra mi mtshar zhes yang yang gsungs/ de dus ci gsungs pa yin go ba ma lon yang dus 'gyur skabs grwa ba de ri la bros nas 'gro skabs phrug tsha ru g.yu byur sogs mdor na rgyu rtsa chen mang po 'thor yod pa mthong yang bla ma'i gsung draṭwāṃ5 nas gcig kyang ma khyer zhes bshad/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃyang grwa ba zhig la nyin gcig sku mdun shog gsungs/ sku mdun bcar bas gsung bzang ngang zho mang du blud mthar zhal nas dus mtha' 'dir zog gi rmig skung nang nyin bdun brgyag pa'i zas yod zer srol yod pa de tsam mi shes kyang nyin shas brgyag nges yod pas khyod kyang dus tshod de 'dra dang 'phrad nges zhes gsungs/ phyis dus 'gyur dang mu ge byung skabs shig la grwa ba de nyin shas kha zas ma rnyed par phyi rol zhig tu 'gyel nas yod skabs thag nye zhig na rmig pa zhig 'dug pa de nyid tshur blangs nas de'i nang za rgyu cung zad 'tshol skabs bla ma'i gsung dran nas mig chu shor zhes bshad/ yang rgya khog gi grwa ba zhig la gal te ma 'ongs par khyed kyis mi 'dra gsad dgos byung tshe sngon la sdom pa 'bul dgos ma gtogs nyes pa de bas lci sdom pa 'bul tshul 'di ltar yin sogs bslab pa phyis su grwa ba de dus 'gyur gyi rkyen ngan nang dngos su don de dang 'phrad pa'i lo rgyus kyang thos/ yang stag ring nges legs la 'chi kha nged gnyis thug nges zhes gsungs pa phyis su nges legs 'da' khar mdang sum bla ma mjal nas nga la shog gsungs byung bas nga 'gro ran pa 'dra zhes gsungs phyir nyin 'das zhes thos/ yang nyin zhig mdun 'dug la mar me'i me che 'dug me lte'i nang me 'dre yang yod las che gzab dgos zhes sogs gsungs pa phyir nyin nye 'gram nas ri me shor ba la dgongs pa 'dra zhes thos/ de bzhin gdan sa yag sgang ri khrod du nyin zhig sku 'khor kha shas bcas phyi rol du bzhugs skabs glo bur du 'brug grag thog 'phangs/ der zhabs phyi rnams kyis nye skorngo zhig la thog 'phang song zhes 'tsha~X /tshub kyis phyogs kun tu bltas nas

g.yu khogabla ma chos dbyingasarangagrolagyirnamatharaphyiorabasadadapa'i mchod sgrin/ oṃslarazhibatulta skabs bla ma'i na bza'i steng thag chu 'khyil 'dug pa mthang bas gzod kun gyis thog bla mas bzhes pa'i ngo mtshar la dad pa thob/ yang nyin zhig lha rtse chu'i phyar ri khrod nas zhabs thang du snga mo nam langs skabs tsam la phebs/ g.yu'i sgeg smad du phebs dus nyi shar tsam red 'dug ces zhal 'phros su gsungs pa phal ba'i nyin lam kha shas yud tsam gyis bgrod pa'i ngo mtsharayang byung / yang lha rtse ru bzhugs skabs chu'i phyar ri khrod nas brag g.yang gzar mthon po zhig nas lhung tshe/ khong gi thugs la nam mkhar yar 'phags te mar bab na brdab skyon shor mi 'ong snyam ste yar ldang tshe dngos su nam mkhar yar 'phags shing mar sa la zhabs gnyis sngon la reg cing babs zhes zhal 'phros su gsungs pa dang yang gnas der bzhugs skabs ro langs mngon sum btul ba dang spyon ma zhig kyang btul rab 'dug /de dus nye skor zhing pa rnams kyis sad bkag gnang bar zhus skabs der sad lding la nye dus khong gis chab bsang gnang ba las rlangs pa mang du 'phyur zhing sprin 'khor nas sad ma byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod/ yang skor zhig gser stod phyogs nas sbyin bdag zhig gis tshe 'das mang po'i mtshan byang khyer 'ong ba dang nyin der brag mgo phyogs nas kyang mi zhig gis mtshan byang 'ga' bla mar 'bul bar slebs/bla ma sku mtshams dang khel bas mdun du ma tshud par mdun 'dug la dngul sgor bcas gnyis kas sprad/ thun mtshams skabs mdun 'dug gis mtshan byang rnams so sor ngo sprod dang dngul sgor bcas sku mdun 'bul skabs bla mas bzhad mo gnang bzhin dngul sgor rna~Xs phan tshun nor song zhes gsungs/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃmadun 'dug gis zhib tu bsam blo gtong skabs dngos su nor 'dug zer/rgyun du sku mdun la mtshan byang slebs pa rnams la ma ṇi tshar re gsungs bzhin se gol re gnang zhing 'ga' re myur du bsreg sbyang mdzad/ 'ga' re lo dang zla ba'i bar 'jog cing bla ma kong tshe sogs la rgyun du gsur bsngo ru 'jug yang mdun 'dug zhig gis gsol sman 'bul skabs dkar yol sman chu bcas sku dngos kyis gzim khang gi phyi rol tu 'phang yang chu tsam yang ma phos par phyi rol rdo gcal steng bzhag 'dug pa mthong zhes thos/ yang dge rtse zla khog phyogs nas yin pa'i grwa ba kha shas sku mdun du glebs pa'i nang sbu ris zhes pa zhig yod pa la khyod kyis mon gling zhig phab dgos gsungs par/ der spu ris nas ngas sgrung de 'dra phab mi shes kyang nga dang mnyam du bris pa dar rgyas zer ba'i sgrung dang snyan ngag la mkhas pa zhig yod pas nged gnyis lhan du bris na zhus tshe/'o chog gsungs/ sgrung phab rgyu'i dbu bzung nas ldeb re zung bris tshe 'gags nas bri rgyu ma rnyed pas spu ris gyis ngas mi dran gi dar rgyas la bri bcug na zhus tshe/ bla mas dar rgyas la bka' bkyon gnang zhing skru ris la de nas 'di 'dra byas pa e mi yin zhes zur tsam re gsungs tshe kho la rang shugs kyis babs/ de ltar mon 'dul cha tshang bla ma'i sku mdun rang du phab/ de nas phyis su bla ma dang chos sgar mthong ba tsam gyis gling sgrung du ma rtsol med rang shugs kyis babs pas bla mas khos rtsa sgo phye ba yin par grags shing / bla mas mon dung skyong gi sprul bar gsungs nas kho'i mtshan la sgrung gter nyi ma rang shar zhes gnang zhing rim gyis ta3 zlog nor rdzong dang gru gu'i go rdzong / rta

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃrgyug sogs gling sgrung mang du phab/ rta rgyug gi sgrung la ldeb dgu bcu go dgu las medapa la sgrung gter gyis ldeb brgya byas na legs kyang ngas ni mjug tu rtsom bri mi shes pas bla ma rin po che nas gnang bar zhus tshe de 'phral bla mas tshig bcad kha shas gsungs pa mkhan po chos gsal gyis sam ṭa'i ngor bris/der mkhan po chos gsal la do dgong phar khyer nas 'grigs min ltos gsungs/ phyir nyin mkhan po chos gsal gyis gzhan shin tu legs mod sgrung gter ni rab byung du 'dug na khyed kyis gsung du sngags pa lta bu zhig gnang 'dug pa'i dgongs pa ci lags zhus tshe/ bla mas rjes su sngags pa red e 'gro ci shes zhes gsungs pa phyis lung bstan thog tu babs/ sgrub gter gyis bla ma ni lha sras dgra lha'i rnam sprul red ces gsungs/ spyir gnas de yang gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i gnas yin par grags shing gnas de na ge sar gyi khrab rmog sogs gter du sbas yod pa rje khong dang sgrung gter gnyis la gter nas bzhes pa'i lung bstan yod kyang sa'i bcud yul rten du dgongs nas ma bzhes par gsungs/ rgyun du yang sde brgyad dang gzhi bdag gis sgrom bu mang po phyag tu phul yang thugs snang thugs rtsis ci yang mi mdzad ces kyang thos so/ /de sogs snang bar rang dbang 'byor ba'i grub pa'i rtags ya mtshan can dang dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i mngon mkhyen sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing de dag kyang dad pa dang dag snang gis rang gi bla ma la bstod bsngaṭa tsam ma yin par phar cher dus phyis kun gyis mig mthong lag zin du byung ba sha stag sdus 'dir thos 'dzin du son pa cha shas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃshig phyi rabs dwangs ba skyed phyir bkod pa'o/ /brgyad pa gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus tshul dang gsung chos zhal slob bcas kyi skor ni/ de ltar bstan 'gro'i don chen yun ring bskyangs mthar lcags yos lo ltarnya95te/bsnyang bab lci yang lcags skong bla ma rdor dgra phebs nas zhabs brtan dang brtan bzhugs phul bar brten lo gcig ring basmung gzhi dwangs/ de nas phyir lo slar yang snang ngor zla phyed lhag sku ha cang bsnyung tshul mdzad/ nyin zhig sku mdun du mkhan po chos gsal dang rgo 'dzi gter lo/ g.yu khog bla ma blo ldan/ sku mdun pa 'gyur med rdo rje sogs yod pa la bla mas nga la don du zhing khams kyi snang ba las ci yang mi 'dug mod ngas bde sdug gtong len sogs kyi ched du na tshul bstan pa yin/ da ni yun ring mi 'dug gsungs/ der khong rnams dang grwa 'khor yongs nas brtan bzhugs mang du phul ba ma zad yar mar gyi dgon sde khag la zhabs rim mang du bsgrub rgyu bcol zhing bzhugs zhus nan gyis phul yang zhal gyis ma bzhes shing / rten phal cher yang so sor bgos/ mdun 'khor sogasal zhal ta dang bslab bya mang du bstsal nas rjes kyi gdung mchod ji ltar bya tshul sogs zhib par mkhan po chos gsal la yi ger 'khod bcug ste sku tshe dang mdzad 'phrin mtha' ru phyin nas dgung grangs gya gcig bzhes pa bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i bgrang bya nyer drug pa nanda zhes pa dga' ba ste chu pho 'brug gi lo'i spyi lo 695spezla ba dang po'i tshes nyer gnyis la ston pa thugs rje can sku zhi bar gzims pa'i tshul bzhin seng ge nyal ṭwāṃ~Xs kyi tshul du dgongs pa chos nyid zhi

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sgrin/ oṃb chen po'i dbyings su gshegs so/ /de nas skyabs rje gang gi nang thugs kyi sras mchog rdo grub sku phreng bzhi pa thub bstan 'phrin las dpal bzang mchog gis thugs dam las bkrol gnang ba dang rjes kyi rim pa'i thugs 'gan gtso bzhes gnang ste der 'dus skal ldan slob tshogs dang gzhan yang yul phyogs stod smad bar gsum nas bstan dgon gyi khur bzhes pa'i dbu snyan gyi grags pa 'dzin pa'i bla chen mkhan sprul rab tu mang po gdan drangs te rgyud sde dang /sgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi zhal phyes te 'das mchod kyi rim pa rgya cher phul/ dad ldan ser skya pho mo kun sa yi rtsi shing bzhin phyogs kun nas 'dus pa rnams kyis gdung mjal dang mchod 'bul smon lam 'debs pa sogs bar mtshams med par byung / de tshe sku gdung las bdud rtsi babs pa dang / dri bzang gi na bun phyogs kun 'thul ba sogs rtags ya mtshan can mang du byung / de nas sku gdung rin po che zhugs la sbyang skabs gdung dud ka ba bslang ba ltar nam mkhar zug pa la gnas yul gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams mkha' lding gi zol gyis phyag dang bskor ba'i tshul gyis brel zhing phyi'i mkha' dbyings shin tu dwangs ba la 'ja' 'od dang sprin srab mo'i gur phub pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa byung ngo / /de lta bu'i skyabs rje 'gro ba'i mgon po gang des zab gsang chos kyi bdud rtsis bskyangs ba'i zhal slob snga phyir bgrang las 'das kyang phran gyis go thos byung ba rnams rags tsam bkod na/ rje gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs thob cing dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa'i thu/nee sras yongs kyi thu bo skyabs rje rdo grub

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃrin po che thub bstan 'phrin las dpal bzang mchog /de bzhin sku tshe stod kyi slob ma khregs chod la mnga' brnyes pa grong stod bla ma phur ba/ thod rgal la mnga' brnyes pa rgu nang bla ma 'jigs med rang grol rnam gnyis/ yang gra lag mkhan po dri med 'od zer/ yag skor mkhan po chos gsal/ 'dzi rong bla ma mchog ldan/ ra skor gang shar rang grol/ tsi mda' ye shes snying po ste khrid kha gcig pa'i slob bu mchog gyur lnga/ de bzhin rgyun bzhugs dang chos 'brel thob pa'i slob ma ni/ bod sprul mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi ma/ kaḥthog mkhan chen nus ldan/ chung yo'i mkhan po zla 'od/ mkhan chen 'jigs med phun tshogs/bya bral bla ma chos dbyings khyab brdal/ mkhan chen zla ba'i 'od zer/ bsnyung gnas bla ma rin chen dar rgyas/ 'jang sgang dbon po/ dkyil sngon byams sprul/rnga za'i bla ma tshul khrims rdo rje/ bla ma kong tshe/ lha rtse bla ma bso lo dang rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin/ rig tho/ 'dzum lu/ bla ma snang gsal/ lung nang bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs/ skye sku tshul khrims rdo rje/ mdo pa gdams ngag rgya mtsho/ bla ma chos dga'/ mkhan po bsod nams nyi ma/ grub chen gling sprul/grub chen sprul sku rdor mchog gya la mkhan po/ yar lung mchog sprul bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'go log mkhan po bstan 'dzin/ mkhan po 'jam don/ 'jigs dpal/ a khya'i bla ma kar chos/ra skor rtogasaldan 'kham lo/ mkhan po thub nor/ stag lung dbon po mkha' kloong / gcung shes 'od lo/ sha ba'i a ti/tshe shes rig pa/ tshe shes ting 'dzin/ dom tshang gter ston tshe dbang mgon po/gnub zur sprul sku pad nor/ sprul blo4 sbyos dbang po/ rdzong 'go mkhan po blo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃgros/ mkhan po shes rab/ gdung kun gsal/ ko tshong pad grags/ ma bla khyab bdag 'od zer/ bstan rgyas dbon po theg mchog dbon po 'jigs med/ a snyabasapadma rdo rje/ sgo 'dzi gter lo/ sgo 'dzi rig grol/ shing bzo gar bde/sgo spus yon tan/ sgo skrus kun 'od/rdo ba bstan 'dzin/ mdo mang mkhan po legs bshad/ rgya rong brtson 'grus/ rgya rong 'jigs med ye shes/ g.yu khog nas rgya shul sprul sku/ cha nang sprul sku mi pham/ g.yu khog kong sprul/ bla ma kun mkhyen/ mkhan po bsod seng / mkhan po rig rdor/ mkhan po don tshe/ bla ma blo ldan shes rab/ bla ma 'gyur med rdo rje/ bla ma rig tho sogs phran gyi go thos byung ba ni de tsam lags shing gzhan yang skabs de tsam na mdo khams smad phyogs a mdo mgo log tshun chad nas smad rgyal mo tsha ba rong yan chad kyi bla sprul mkhan gsum thams cad rje gang gi zhal slob tu ma gyur pa med pa lta bur nges phyir 'dir cha tshang 'god ma thub/ de bzhin rje gang gis ma 'ongs pa'i rjes 'jug las dang skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag zhal gsung bdud rtsi'i zegs ma yi ger lubod pa mjal du yod pa rnams 'dir bka' bsdu byas pa oṃ āḥhūṃ ste pod gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro'i skor o pod du/ rje nyid kyis dngos su brtsams pa'i sngon 'gro bsdus pa kun las btus pa dang 'bring po dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal lung / sngon 'gro kun bzang zhal lung gi nyer mkho bar ldeb zin bris bcas / gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i skor āḥpod la/ khrid yig ye shes bla ma'i zin bris/ lce btsun khrid yig gi4 ṭwāṃn bris/ rje gang gi dngos gzhi'i zab

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sprin/ oṃkhrid kyi zhal gsung rnams slob bu dag gis zin bris su bkod pa rdzogs chen khrid rgyun nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ tshig gsum gnad brdeg gi man ngag gser gyi thig pa dang de'i zhal rgyun zin bris/'grel ba/ khregs chod kyi man ngag khyab brdal nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ bsgom phyogs dris lan/ gnas lugs rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi 'grel ba/ dam pa gsum gyi grangs bsog tshul bla ma'i zhal lung /bdud 'joms snang sbyang gi zin bris/gzhan yang rdzogs chen skor gyi nyams su len tshul gnad bsdus mang po dang / gsum pa mdo sngags kyi rgyab chos skor hūṃ pod la/ ston pa 'tshang rgya tshul gyi rnam bzhag gsang snying bla rgyud kyi rnam thar/gsang snying spyi don mdzod sde'i zin bris/ 'od gsal snying po'i zin bris/bskyed rdzogs skor gyi man ngag gnad bsdus 'ga'/ stong thun seng ge'i nga ro'i bar ldeb/ de bzhin rje 'di'i zhal gdams do ha'i skor sogs gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi skal bar bzhugs pa bcas so/ /mkhyen rab padma 'bum du brdal ba'i dbus/ /brtse ye shes rdo rje'i nyer mdzes pa'i/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhal skyin chos kyi rje/ /slar yang snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i dpal du shar/ /ngo mtshar sa yi thig le g.yu ljongs kyi/ /rmad byung 'phags ma'i gnas mchog dag zhing der/ /khyed sku mtshan dpe langs tsho gsar ba'i gzugs/ /de ltar paṇa chen bi ma'i rnam sprul/ gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug bya bral rnal 'byor ba chen po/ 7skyabs rje g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol mchog gi rtogs bsgruod rnam thar nyung ngu'i ngag gis brjod pa 'di yang rje gang gi gsung chosdu phyogs sdud dang rnam thar cung rgyas pa
