g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar phyi rabs dad pa'i mchod sbyin/ tse zhig bri thub pa'i re 'dun yun ring snying la bcangs te phyogs gang sar phyin cing khyad par shing bya lor ched du rang yul nas rje gang nyid sku 'khrungs ba'i gnas mchog chu dbar tā re'i gnas su mdun 'dug pa bla ma rig tho'i mdun ched bsnyod kyis rnam thar skor bka' 'dri mang tsam zhus 'phral zla de'i tshes nyer lnga dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyin gnas mchog der tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston dang bcas rnam bsdus 'di nyid bri ba'i mgo brtsam zhing de nas rim gyis gser rta'i phyogs su bskyod nas gsung chos dang rnam thar skor la zhib 'jug gis mthar rje gang gi gdan sa dang mthar sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i gnas gser yag sgang ri khrod du zla rjes ma'i tshes nyer lnga'i dus tshes bzang por mjug grub cing slar lo rjes mar yul dbusasmin gling bshad grwar 'phriṭwāṃsnan brjos dus mtha'i ba(1 gzugagā shes bya ñtsān gzigs tres rdzogs ṭwāṃ/ / / sna'o 'a/ / sna /// ba//ṭwāṃ ༵ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāoṃ/na gnyas lhun —sa 'grub pa' rgyur gyur 45

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༄tsho/ /sngon 'gro kun las btus pa bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhya de la 'dir rdzogs pa chen po klong chen snying tig gi phyi nang gi sngon 'gro'i rim pa rgyun du ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul mkhas grub rnams kyis sngon 'gro rgyas bsdus gsungs pa rnams las btus pa ni/ de yang thog mar tho rengs ldang ba'i dus la bab pa na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa la 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor bas ḍā ma ru'i sgra/ dbyangs yig bcu drug dang / gsal byed so bzhi'i sngags kyi gdangs su bsgrags pas bskul te gnyid las sad par bsam zhing / rang nyid gzhi lus kyi ngo bo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin pa la/ rnam pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang / zhing khams kyi bkod pa dang bcas pa gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas ldang ste/ bla ma bzhengs bskul gyi gsol 'debs 'di la phyi nang gnyis las/ dang po phyi'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ bla ma mkhyen sogs/ bla ma mkhyen zhes brjod pa dang po'i tshe rang gzhan gyi rgyud la nges 'byung gi bsam pa skye ba'i ched du/ bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos sku gsum dang / gnyis pa'i tshe byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye ba'i ched du/ yi dam dang / dam chos/ longs sku gsum dang /gsum pa'i tshe snang srid rnam dag gi da/ snang rgyud la skye ba'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / dge 'dun/ sprul sku gsum dang / yang na dang po'i dus dkon mchog gsum dang / gnyis pa'i dus rtsa ba gsum dang / gsum pa'i dus sku gsum ste skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsal la brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma'i thugs rjes rang gi snying dbus padma 'dab bzhi'am 'dab brgyad las/ dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa'i ge sar bzhad pa nas/ 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa sel ba'i snyabs gcig /thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston pa'i bdag nyid/ drin rtsa ba'i bla ma yar la bzhengs nas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud de sbyi bo'i steng gi nam mkhar dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ dgos pa tsu'i phyir zhe na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa drag pos bskyed pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal chen pos mnar zhing gzir ba'i skal ba ngan pa bdag nyid la las nyon sdug bsngal rnams las skyob pa'i phyir du/ bdag gi spyi bor bde chen gyi zhabor lo'i steng du padma dang nyi zla'i gdan la 'di nas byang chub kyi bar du rigs dang dkyil zhabor kun gyi khyab bdag de nyid rgyan du bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa dang / gnyis pa nang gi yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ dran dang shes bzhin sogs/ dran shes bag yod dang phyin drug rnams yin la/ dran pa ni chos thams cad kyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i tshul/ bshes spring las/ dbang phyug lus gtogs dran pa bde gshegs kyis/ /bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam du nye bar bstan/ /de ni bsgrims nas mngon par bsrung bgyi ste/ /dran pa nyams pas chos kun 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes dbang phyug ces rgyal po ༵ bos nas/ spyod lam gyi gnas skabs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthams cad du/ lus la sogs par gtogs pa'i dran pa ni bde bar gshegs kyis/ thar lam 'dod pa thams cad 'di nas zhugs dgos pa'i phyir bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam du nye bar bstan pa sogs dang / shes bzhin ni phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su bstan te/ chos thams cad kyi ming tshig gi rim pa shes pa dang / de la brten pa'i don rnams ma 'dres par shes pa dang /mngon par mtho ba'i bde ba 'dod pa'i rgyu 'bras shes pa dang / nges par legs pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bsgrub pa'i rgyu 'bras legs par shes pa'i sde bzhi'i dpal gyi 'byung gnas shes bzhin yin la/ shes bzhin med na/ spyod 'jug las/ shesabazhin med pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /thosadang bsam dang sgom pa yang / /glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du/ /dran pa la ni de mi gnas/ /zhes dang / bag yod ni dge ba'i chos thamasacad kyi rtsa ba ste/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ tshul khrims thos dang gtong dang de bzhin bzod/ /dge ba'i chos su brjod pa ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi rtsa ba bag yod 'di yin te/ /gter thob byed ces bde bar gshegs pas bstan/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dran shes bag yod dang bcas pa kun kyang bla ma'i thugs rje byin rlabs kyis rang rgyud la bzhengs te yongs su gsal bar mdzad du gsol zhes bsam/ phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin gang nas gsungs zhe na/ sdud pa las/ sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs byang chub sems dpa' dag /pha rol phyin dang bcas te dge ba'i bshes su bsten/ /de dag rjes su ston byed 'di ni bsgrub pa'i sa/ /rgyu rnam gnyis kyis sangs rgyas byang chub myur du rtogasdu/ /zhes gsungs/ mi pham rin po che'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsdud 'grel las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang byang chub mchog la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dag dang / lam pha rol tu phyin pa dang bcas te dge ba'i bshes su bsten par bya'o/ /de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni theg pa chen po 'di gzhan la rjes su snyon par byed pa yin pas phyi'i yongs 'dzin zhes bya la/ de dag gi bstan pa la lam pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyams su len pa'am bsgrub par bya ba'i sa'am gnas yin pas nang gi yongs 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de ltar phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin des theg pa mchog gi lam las lam gzhan du mi lhung bar 'dzin pas na yongs 'dzin gnyis po de bsten pa'i rgyu rnam pa de gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyi byang chub myur du rtogs par 'gyur te mtshungs pa med pa'i rgyu phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs/ mkhas 'jug las kyang / phyi yi yongs 'dzin theg chen tshul bzhin ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par byas nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thabs kyi rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa/ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i mnyam pa nyid sangs rgyas 'thob pa la nye ba'i thabs kyi dam par gyur pa/ mthar 'dzin dang dmigs pa can 'bras yum la ring zhing theg chen lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa rnams kyi gnyen por gyur pa'i lam yang dag pa zab cing rgya che ba zung du 'jug pa'i gdams ngag tshang la ma nor ba nod par byas nas de bzhin yid la bya ba nang gi yongs 'dzin dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung ngam skyil krung phyed pa bca'/4lag pa mnyam bzhag /rgal tshig dong

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtseltar brtsegs/ dpung pa lhod de brgyangs/ mgrin pa en tsam dgugs/mchu so ma reg par dbugs dal ba'i ngang nas lte ya rkan la sbyar/ mig gnyis sna rtser phab pa ste bdun no/ /de ltar lus gnad legs par bcos te/ rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal ba ni/ lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje'i khu tshur brla'i rtsa bo che'i steng nas mnan/ g.yas pa rdo rje'i rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas sna bug g.yas pa bkag ste g.yon nas lan gsum dang / g.yas nas kyang snga ma bzhin lan gsum dang / lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur gyis brla rtsa gnyis mnan te sna bug gnyis nas mnyam du lan gsum ste dgu phrugs su 'bud/ de yang ghā bug g.yas nas zhe sdang gi rlung dkar po/ de bzhin du g.yon du 'dod chags kya rlung dmar po/ mnyam du gti mug gi rlung nag por gsungs/ ngag byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lce dbang sogs/ sku gsum gyi sa bon byin gyisabarlabs pa'i sngags ni/ o āḥhūṃ gsum brjod pas ngag gi nyes pa thams cad ཿnga ba'i sgor gyur pa lce yi dbang po de nyid kyi dbus su ram̐ yig dmar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin las byung ba'i mes ngag gi sgrib pa thams cad bsregs nas/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo 'od dmar gyi rnam pa'i dbyibs rdo rje rtse gsum pa lte ba zlum po khong stong gi sbubs su/ dbyings shes rab kyi yi ge a li kha dog dmar po dang / gsal byed thabs kyi yi ge ka li dkar po dang / mtha' skor du thabs shes gnyis med kyi yi ge rten 'brel snying po mthing ga'i mdog can 'od 'tsher ba'i mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu'i yig 'bru rnams las 'otwe zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa'i rtse las mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa spros te/phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mchod pas thugs dgyes shing mnyes par byas/ 'od zer rnams slar 'dus te dbyangs gsal rten snying dang bcas pa char babs pa bzhin rang gi ngag la thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo brjod du med pa dang / rnam pa gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i byin rlabs dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la/ de rnams lan bdun re brjod/ 'di yan chad kyi go rim zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu ltar byas so/ /sngon 'gro dngos la thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po thun mong la blo ldog rnam pa bzhi dang / rang skyon ngos bzung gnang ba'i man ngag dang gnyis/ dang po la/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ tshe mi rtag /las rgyu 'bras/'khoor ba'i nyes dmigs dang bzhi las/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' la/ spyi dang / bye brag gnyis/ dang po la/ dal 'byor gyi ngo bo bsam pa/ de rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul dang / grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul dang gsum las/dang po la gnyis/ dal brgyad ni/ da res dmyal ba sogs/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du skyes na chos byed pa'i mthu med pas dal ba ma yin pa'i tshul/da res kyi skye ba 'dir dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro dang / tshe ring lha ste mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa bzhi dang / mtha' 'khob kla klo/ log lta can/ sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i zhing dang / dbang po 5gas pa ste mi'i mi khom pa bzhi dang bral te/de ltar mi khom pa brgyad las thar pasdi dal ba thob pa zhes bya ste brgyad po go

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃrim nges can du re re nas thun rer bsam/ gcig legs par bsams pa rdzogs nas gzhan la spo/ gnyis pa 'byor ba bcu ni/ mir gyur dbang po sogs/mir gyur/ dbang po lnga tshang ba dang / yul dbus skyes/ las mtha' ma loog bstan la dad pa ste rang nyid la 'byar ba lnga tshang ba dang / sangs rgyas byan/chos gsungs/ bstan pa gnas pa dang / de la 'jug srol yod pa dang /bshes gnyen dam pas zin pa dang gzhan 'byor lnga po'ang re re nas bzung thams cad rdzogs par bsam mo/ /sher 'byung gi 'grel chen sogs su mi khom pa brgyad las ldog pa'i mi la dal 'byor du bzhed la/ mi khom pa brgyad bral gyi mi la 'byor pa tshang tshul ni/ mir skyes pas mi nyid dang / kla klo sogs kyi nang du ma skyes pas yul dbus su skyes pa dang / glen lhags sogs min pas dbang po tshang ba dang / log lta can min pas gnas dad dang / las mtha' ma log pa gnyis bstan par shārnyi pas gsungs par bshad cing / mun bskal las ldog pa'i sgron me'i bskal par skyes pas gzhan 'byor lnga yang bsdus par gsungs la/ mdo dang slob dpon kha cig gis 'byor ba bcu ldan la dal 'byor du gsungs te/ mi khom brgyad spang pa ni de'i nang du 'dus pas so zhes bzhed la/bi bhu ti sogs 'ga' zhig gis mi khom pa brgyad spangs shing 'byor bcu ldan pa la dal 'byor du bshad pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis mi khom brgyad bral dgag pa dang 'byor pa bcu ldan sgrub pa'i yon tan yin pas mi zlos par yang bshad do//skal ldan 'jug ngogs las/ mi ma yin pa'i mi khom pa bzhir ma skyes pa'i khyad par gyi ldog pa ni mir gyur pa nyid do/7/dbang po ma tshang ba las ldog pa ni de

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtshang ba'o/ /yul mtha' 'khob las ldog pa ni yul dbus so/ /log lta can las ldog pa ni dad pa can te las mtha' ma log pa'ang de'i khyad par gyi chos so/ /mun bskal las ldog pa ni sgron me'i bskal pa ste de'i khyad par gyi chos ni sangs rgyas byon pa dang / des chos gsungs pa dang / bstan pa gnas pa dang /gdul bya de'i rjes su 'jug pa dang / de la blang dor ston pa'i bshes gnyen yod pa rnams yin gsungs/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las dal 'byor gyi rang bzhin nyer bzhi gsungs pa'ang dal 'byor gyi dbye bsdu 'di ltar bzhed pa yin no/ /de ltar dal 'byor bco brgyad po 'di la mkhas pa kha cig gisaganyis ka'i don bsdusasu bzhed/ thams cad rang nyid la tshang ba'i gnas dam chos sgrub pa'i rten mchog tu gyur pa mi lus rin po che thob kyang / 'chi ba'i rkyen mang pos nam 'chi nges pa med pa'i tshe srog spangs nas 'jig rten pha rol nyid du son par 'gyur na bdag gis ci byar yod/ de bas na da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos la 'bad snyam du snying nas bsam pa ni rang stobs dang / gzhan stobs brgyud gsum bla ma'i thugs rje'i rang rgyud la dge ba'i bsam pa 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi blo sna nyid dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i phyogs la sgyur cig ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no/ /de yang thar pa'i lam las gol ba'i rtag chad dang /rang don yid byed kyi lam dman par ma gtong kun mkhyen chos kyi rje dri med 'od zer mkhyen no/ /de gnyis kyi don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'phos te gnyis su med par gyur pa'i drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gliḍi pa mkhyen no/ /'di ni 'og ma kun la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasgre'o/ /de ltar dal 'byor bco brgyad po de re re'ang ldan dka' na rang la thams cad tshang 'dug pa 'di shin tu rnyed par dka'/ chos kyi rten khyad par cana'adi shin tu rnyed dka' 'o zhes spyir bsam/ 'di sngar yang rnyed dka'/phyisayang yang mi rnyed pas da lta don zhig bsgrub par bya bsam dgos so/ /gnyis pa rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul ni/ da res dal rten sogs/ da res dal ba'i lus rten bzang po 'di la dam pa'i chos bsgrub te don yod par ma byas na/ phyi nas thar pa tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i lus rten 'di 'dra mi rnyed pa'i tshul ni/ bde 'gro'i lus rten 'di la bsod nams dge ba'i rgyu zad par gyur na shi ba'i 'og tu ngan par song ba dmyal ba/ ngan par 'gror 'gyur yi dwags dang / log par lhung ba dud 'gro'i gnas rnams su 'khyams par 'gyur zhes kha cig gis bzhed kyang / 'dir skad gnyis shan sbyar las/ sa 'og gi 'jig rten la dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba gsum yod pa de dag gi spyi ming du/ ngan 'gro/ ngan song / log par lhung ba/ zhes zer gsungs/ de dag gis dge sdig gi ngo mi shes shing dam pa'i chos kyi sgra tsam yang mi thos na chos bsgrub pa lta zhog /gal te bde 'gro thob kyang lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mi mjal ba long ba thang dkyil du lus pa lta bur gyur tshe mtshang re che ste skyon chen po yin no/ /'di dpe yi sgo nas bstan pa yin zhes bzhed tshul yang yod do/ /dpe dngos bstan pa ni/ zla ba'i snying po'i mdo dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo sogs dang / bshes spring sogs las bstan pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dasdu' tshul ni/ sems can tsam gyi sogs/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃspyir sems can yin tsam gyi grangs dang rim pa la ltos shing legs par bsam na mi lus tsam thob pa yang srid mtha' ma khegs pa tsam yin te/ 'di ltar dmyal ba ni mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la yi dwags ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ yi dwags mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la dud 'gro nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ dud 'gro mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam la bde 'gro nyin mo'i skar ma tsam las med la/ mi yang chos med sdig la spyod pa mthong chos su gyur pa 'di dag ni mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam mang bas mi lus tsam po pa dang / dge sdig 'dres mar spyod pa ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam las med pas mi lus khyad par ba zhes bzhed/ yang dge sdig 'dres mar spyod pa ni mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam du mang na/ dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin spyod pa'i mi lus rin po che ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam las med pas chos shāospya ktopy-i/ spyod bdag gi blo sna myur du dam pa'i chos phyogs la sgyur cig sogs gnyis pa bye brag tu bsam pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom pa brgyad ni/ gal te mi lus sogs/ 'phral byung zhes pa ni/ rang rgyud la 'di dag 'phral dang 'phral du 'byung nye bas 'phral byung zhes gsungs/ de yang gal te sngon bsags bsod nams kyi mthu las lha chos bsgrub pa'i mi yi lus rten yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu thob ste dam chos dar ba'i yul gling du phyin yang / lus rten bzang po thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sgrub nus kyi rten khyad par can yin la/ 'on kyang sdig sdug gi gnod pa thams cad 'byung ba'i ṭwāoṃ las su mi rung ba byur po che yi sems

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmi bsrun pa spre'u lta bu 'di'i thar ba bsgrub pa'i rten du mi rung zhing sdug bsngal gyirgyu bsgrubapa'i las su 'gyur te/ sems las su mi rung ba'i phyir ro zhes spyir bstananas/ khyad par lta spyad phyin ci lag tu stan pa'i bdud kyi bshes gnyenagyisazin na rang blo log lam duo bsgyuor bas yang dag pa'i chos dang rgyab 'gal ba dang / rang rgyud kyi dug lnga nyan mangs pa shin tu rags shing zhabrugs pa'i rigs can rnams ni/ chos bsgrub 'dod kyi blo re 'ga' tsam skyes kyang rang rgyud kyi dug lnga dbang che bas phal cher de'i dbang du song ste chos yang dag pa mi 'grub/ sngon bsags kyi las ngan byas pa rnams chos la brtson 'grus byed dus lasangan gyi 'bras bu rang thog tu babs pas sdug bsngal gyi mtsho chen rdol ba'i tshe rang byas kyi las 'bras su mi shes par chos la yi chad skye ba dang / chos la slob par 'dod kyang brtson 'grus cung zad kyang med pa'i le lo can ni rnam g.yengs dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du song ste chos mi 'grub pa dang / rang la rang dbang med par gzhan khol bran g.yog rnams la chos byed 'dod kyi blo re 'ga' yod kyang gzhan dbang du song nas chos bsgrub tu mi ster/ tshe 'di'i lto gos sam nad gdon dang rgyal po'i chad pa sogs kyi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i ched du chos sgor zhugs kyang snying nas chos la nges shes med pas sngon gyi bag chags rnying bas chos ma yin pa la spyod/ rnyed bkur snya na grags sogs tshe 'di sgrub pa'i bsam pas/ grub rdzun dang / gter rdzun/ ma ṇi pa rdzun pa sogs gzhan snang du chos pa ltar bcos kyang ci byas ngan song gi rgyur song ba ni thar pa'i lam dang bral/ shin tu blun zhing ṭwāoṃngs pa'i rigs can shes rab kyi snang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃb cung zad kyang med pa rnams ni chos sgor zhugs kyang chos kyi tshig don phran bu tsam yang shes mi nus na thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i skal ba med cing /gzhan yang sdig pa'i grogs sogs glo bur du 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom pa brgyad po gang rung bdag gi rgyud la chos kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'gal zlar byung zhing lhag pa'i tshe/ blo sna sogs/ de yang rang rgyud la zhib tu brtags nas de dag re re nas gnyen po brten dgos te/ bdud kyis zin pa'i gnyen po thugs rgyud na byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i lta spyod rnam dag gi bshes gnyen bsten/ dug lnga'i gnyen po la 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por khams kyi rab dbye/ nga rgyal gyi gnyen por dman sa bzung nas phyag 'tshal ba sogs/ phrag dog gi gnyen por rjes su yi rangs rnams bsgom dgos/ las ngan thog babs kyi gnyen por chos la yi chad mi skye bar las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la yid ches bskyed nas sngon gyi las ngan bsags pa la 'gyod bshags byed dgos/ le lo'i gnyen por 'chi ba mi rtag pa snying nas dran zhing rtag sbyor dang gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus rtsom dgos/ gzhan khol bran g.yog gi gnyen por bla ma dang phyug po'i bran g.yog dbang med du gyur pa 'a de las thar ba'i thabs legs po zhig la 'bad dgos/ 'jigs skyob kyi gnyen por nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang byang chub kyi sems rnam dag zhig gis zin pa byed dgos/ chos ltar bcos pa'i gnyen por 'jig rten tshe 'di sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor gyi nyes dmigs shin tu che bar shes nas spang dgos/ blun rmongs gis ni thos kyang tshig mi go/bsam 12

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃkyang donami shes/ bsgom kyang gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa mi skye ba sngon chos spang sogs las ngan byas pa'i sgrib pa yin pas de'i gnyen por stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa dang / shes rab bskyed pa'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs dgos/ gnyis pa ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad ni/ skyo shas chung zhing sogs/ ris chad ces pa ni/ rang gi rgyud dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang gnyis ris su gcod pas na ris chad ces gsungs/ de'ang ngan song dang 'khor ba'i nyes pa bshad dam/ tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal ci lta bu la'ang skyo shas chung zhing skrag pa'i blo gtan nas mi skye na chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu nges 'byung gi blo rtsa ba nas mi skye/ yang dag pa'i chos dang bla ma la mos gus dang dad pa'i nor dang bral na bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'gags te thar pa'i lam du mi tshud/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la 'dod sred kyi zhags pas dam/ por bcings nas dam pa'i chos byed long med pa dang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi kun spyod shin tu rtsub pa'i rigs can rnams ni yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad kyang dam pa'i lam du bsgyur dka'/ mi dge sdig pa'i las dang rnam smin la mi 'dzem pas sgo gsum nye bar ma zhi ba ni dam pa'i yon tan dang bral te chos las phyir phyogs/ chos sgor zhugs kyang sgo gsum chos 'gal gyi las byas pa thams cad las mtha' log lam du zhugs pa yin gsungs pas rang rgyud la yon tan mtshan nyid pa mi skye/ sor byang gi lam la zhugs nas sems bskyed dang sdom pa nyams shing 'chal na 'gro sa ngan song las med pas mi khom pa'i gnas las mi/ thar/ gas nga sngags kyi dbang bzhi thob kyang bla ma 13

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang mched grogs la dam tshig nyams shing ral ba na rang gzhan phung la sbyor bas dngos grub kyi skal ba chad pa ste ris chad blo yi mi khom pa rnam pa brgyad ces bya ste/ bdag la dam pa'i chos kyi 'gal zlar lhag pa'i tshe blo sna sogs/de yang skyo shas chung ba'i gnyen po ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin tshul shes par byas nas nges 'byung gi blo bskyed/ dad med kyi gnyen po ni/ chos dang bla ma'i yon tan la yang yang bsam ste phyir mi ldog pa'i dad pa bskyed/ 'dod sred kyi gnyen po ni/ 'khor dang longs spyod mi rtag par sgyu ma lta bur shes pas chags zhen gyi 'khri ba gcod/ kun spyod ngan pa'i gnyen po ni/ sgo gsum zhi zhing dul ba la bsten nas rang sems chos kyis 'dul/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis kun spyod ngan pa la gnyen po med gsungs/mi dge sdig spyod kyi gnyen po ni/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches nas sdig pa la bshags sdom byed dgos/ chos la sems pa bral zhing las ma/tha' log pa'i gnyen po ni/ dam pa'i chos la 'phrad dka' ba'i 'dun pa bskyed de sgo gsum chos 'gal gyi las spang dgos/ sor byang gi sdom pa nyams pa'i gnyen po ni/so thar gyi sdom pa nyams na phyir bcos nas tshul khrims yang dag par bsrung /jo bo rje la paṇḍi ta gcig gis/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rgyu gang lags zhus pas/ byang chub kyi sems yin zhes gsungs pa sogs tshul khrims kyi rgyu la'ang bslab par bya/ byang sems kyi smon 'jug gnyis nyams na thun gyi drug cha ma 'das gong du bshags na rtsa lhung du mi 'gyur bas bshags dgos/ dam tshig ral ba'i gnyen po ni/ sngags sdordzu nyams na byang sems bzhin gnyen po

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsleb pa dang / sngags rgyud rnams las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin bshags sbyangs byas nasadam tshig bsrung dgos/ de lta bu'i dal ba'i rang bzhin nyer bzhi dang /'byorababacu ste sum cu so bzhi po 'di rnams rang rgyud la legs par brtags nas mitshang bar 'dug na thabs du mas 'bad la tshang bar bya/ tshang bar 'dug na dga' ba sgom/ de ltar don chen po rnyed pa 'di de snga snga dro gcig kyang don med 'dug pa re skyo/ da myur du 'jig cing snying po med pas 'di las yun gyi rten zhig sgrub pa las don med chud zos mi bya zhes yang yang bsam la blo rgyud 'gyur ba thon pa'i bar du cis kyang 'bad/ 'di'i grub 'bras blo la sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ba thon pa de yin/ de che chung gang rung ma byung bar gsal por bsam dgos gsungs/ sngon 'gro thar lam rab gsal skabs blo ldog rnam bzhi gsungs pa las/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' u dum wa ra 'dra/ /rnyed na don chen yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig la/ /don chen gtan gyi'adunamamisgrub par/ /donarje med rtas zos gyur ba bdag cag la//ṭwāṃ/ོkā /ṭwāoṃsna smyiṭwāṃ ṭwāoṃhāsdu /bla/ sna~X /hūṃdṛs / sa ga—gas/ /dal cuor don yod gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa ni/ da lta nad dang sogs/ da lta lus la 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad dang sems la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba chen pos ma gzir zhing /gzhan gyi bran khol dang grogs ngan la sogs gzhan dbang nyid du'ang ma gyur bas rang nyid kyi lus sems la rang dbang thob cing dam chos sgrub pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i dusdu 'dir/ snyom las ngang du dal 'byor

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchud gsan par gyur te 'chi ba glo bur du slebs par gyur na/ rang gi 'khor g.yog rnams dang / sdig sdug gi sgo nas bsags pa'i longs spyod dang / da lta shin tu brtse ba'i gnyen nye du sogs 'brel ba rnams la yun ring por mi 'bral zhing 'grogs par blta ba lta ci smos/ der ma zad zas gos sogs kyis gces par bskyangs shing bdag tu bzung ba'i lus 'di yang ring por mi thogs par/mal gyi nang nas gos med gcer bur phyung ste sa phyogs stong par bskyal nas/wa dang bya rgod khyi sogs kyi sder mo dang so yis sha lngags 'drad cing 'jigs pa'i sgra dang bcas nas za ba'i dus/ rnam par shes pa srid pa bar ma do'i yul na las dkar nag 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang zhing 'jigs skrag gi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khrul snang shin tu tshab chen po la spyod par 'gyur bas/dus da lta nyid du rang gzhan gyi blo sna dam pa'i chos phyogs la sgyur cig ces sogs de ltar nam 'chi cha med yin pas tshe mthar thug par e 'dug mi shes/thams cad 'dug shom gyi ngang nas 'chi tshul/ rgas sam gzhon pa'i skabs nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi rkyen ni mang / zas zos pas nad red nas shi ba sogs dpe las nges med sna tshogs bsam nas/ da lo yod kyang sang phod gshin gral du yod na ci cha/ lo stod gson kyang lo smad 'chi'am/ de bzhin du zla stod zla smad nas snga dro phyi 'phred kyi bar du je thung je thung blo sna bstu ngas la bsam// de tsam e 'chi'am snyam na mi 'chi ba'i gdeng med tshul/ 'chi rkyen nges pa med lugs/ tshe yi 'phen pa ci yod cha med/ thams cad gson du re ba dang mi shi ba'i 'dun pa byed grab kho na'i ngang du 'chi ba las med na/ rang gis rang bslus te mi 'chi 16

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsnyamapasaci bya/ da dung mi 'chi snyam dang glo bur mi 'dod bzhin 'chi ba thog ltara'abab pa yin snyam du nges med 'di gtso cher bsam nas/ myur du chos shig bya/ 'chi khar dbugs sne ring thung sar sleb dus chos dran pas mi phan/ da res nad sogs rang dbang med pa ci yang med skabs 'dir chos la cis mi 'bad snyam pa'i blo sna thung ha re ma song bar bsam mo gsungs/ thar lam rab gsal las/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag glog bzhin g.yo/ /snod bcud gang la bsam kyang 'jig pa'i chos/ /'chi bar nges shing nam 'chi cha med kyang //rtag 'dzin sems kyis rang mgo bskor nas su/ /bag med ngang du gnas pa bdag cag la/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla mas thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs/gsum pa las rgyu 'bras ni/ dge sdig las kyi sogs/ spyir 'khor 'das kyi snang tshul thams cad rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med kyi dbang gis yin zhing /khyad par bde ba phra rags thams cad dge 'bras/ mi bde ba thams cad mi dge ba'i 'bras bu la rag las te rang dbang med tshul bsam mo/ /bye brag tu bsam pa ni/ spang bya mi dge ba'i las bcu dang / bsgrub bya dge ba'i las bcu'i re re bzhin/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ byed pa rgyu mthun dang myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ dbang gi 'bras bu/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de dag rim bzhin mthar chags su bsam mo/ /de yang dge sdig 'a/sa kyi rnam smin rang nyid kyi phyi bzhin 'brangs te/ srid pa tha ma pa rnams la'ang smin tshul dang /da lta sems can gyi bde mi bde sna tshogs sangs rgyas kyi phyag gis kyang mi 17

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grolagyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkhegs pa 'di bzhin las 'bras ni nam yang mi bslu bar yid ches bskyed la bsam/ des na dge sdig gi las phra mo yang / rang byas rang la smin pa las 'os med pas sman dang dug gi nus pa ltar/ rang don shes pas blang dor 'chug mi nyan tshul nan tan bsam zhing / rang don sgrub pa la las rnams blang dor tshul bzhin bya ba las gzhan med par thag chod pa'i bar du bsam mo gsungs/thar la ma rab gsal las/ dkar nag las 'bras nam yang chud mi za/ /rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i lam 'di las/ /zhakhor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos su snang / /rang byas rang la smin par nges na yang / /tshul bzhin 'jug ldog mi nus bdag cag la/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla mas thugs rjes gzigs//dge sdig blang dor bgyid par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs/bzhi pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyi khrid la/ ngan song gsum dang / mtho ris gsum ste gnyis las/ dang po la ngan song gsum las/ dang po dmyal ba la sde tshan bco brgyad las/ tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ khyad par dmyal ba'i sogs/de yang 'khoor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal kho na las bde ba skad cig tsam yang med la/ khyad par du sdug bsngal shin tu che ba dmyal ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams nyid du son par gyur na/ gnas de dag thams cad kyi gzhi dang 'khor yug kun mgar gyi lcags bsregs lta bu las rdog pa bzhag sa tsam gyi bde bar mngon pa yang med par me lce 'bar ba'i klong shin tu dbal tsha ba kho na yin te/ yang sos zhes bya ba ni/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhir mdag me 'bar ba'i klong du dmyal ba'i sems can grangalda shād lhan cig tu 'dus te/ phan tshun

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthamasacad kyang dgra mi sha bo mthong ba ltar khong khro'i sems kyis mtshon cha brdeg res 'ba' zhig byed pas thams cad mtshon gyis mgo lus rnams 'dral zhingashi/ nam mkho' las yang sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra grags ma thag thams cad yang sas nas sngar bzhin 'thab pas sdug bsngal ba dang / thig nag ni/ gshin rje'i las mkhan 'jigs su rung ba rnams kyis dmyal ba'i sems canade dag gi lus mgal dum bzhin du bsgyel te spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thig nag po bzhi brgyad bcu drug sum cu so gnyis la sogs pa btab nas lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas spyi bo nas rkang mthil la thug gi bar gshag cing 'dral ba dang / de ma thag slar 'byar ba yang yang gzhag pas sdug bsngal ba dang / bsdu sa 'joms ni/ lcags bsregs kyi gtun chen po yul ljongs tsam pa re'i nang du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa blugs nas/ lcags kyi tho lum chen po me 'bar bas til bzhin du 'tshir zhing brdung ba dang / lung pa phan tshun gyi ri thams cad sngar rang gis gang bsad pa'i srog chags ra lug /ri dwags la sogs pa'i mgo brtan du gyur pa'i rwa rtser me 'bar bas rdung kha bkye ba'i bar du phye mar 'thag kyang de ma thag sos nas yang 'ardzoms pa sogs sdug bsngal ba dang / ngu 'bod ni/ sgo med pa'i lcags bsregs kyi khang khyim me 'bar ba'i nang du 'tshed cing 'o dod 'bod pas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /ngu 'bod chen po ni/ gshin rje rnams kyis tho ba la sogs pas brdog cing lcags kyi khyim me 'bar ba nyis rim du bcug nas sko phyi nang gnyis ka lcags zhun gyis zhal ba byas shing / me'i du ba mched pas mun nag 'thums por sgo nang ma las thar 19

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum / o kyang phyi ma las mi thar snyam du 'o dod drag po 'bod pas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /yid bzhin mdzod las ngu 'bod chen po dang / ngu 'bod zhes gsungs/ tsha ba ni/me 'bar ba'i lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gcig pa sogs dang mdung thung gis lus thal mar 'bigs pas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /bden gnyis shing rta las/ tsha ba ni lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar bas lus kyi gzhung 'bigs shing klad par thal mar 'byin la/ dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas me 'byung ba'o/ /yang sla nga rab tu 'bar bar bsregs pa dang / lcags kyi gzhi kun nas 'bar ba la gan rkyal du bsnyal nas lcags kyi tho ba 'bar bas brdung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / lag len 'debs pa las/ tsha ba ni ñtsa gas kyi yol gor khro chu 'bar bar 'tshod cing / steng du 'thon pa'i res la mgo la tho lum bsnun nas dran pa nyams pa'ang bde bar bsgom pas sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs/rab tu tsha ba ni/ yon mdzod 'grel chung gser gyi thur ma las/ mdung thung rtse gsum pas lus kyi gzhung mas nas gyen du 'bigs pas phras/ gong gnyis dang klad par zings 'then te/ phyi nas lcags bsregs leb mo'i thag pas dkris shing / khro chu khol ma'i nang der 'tshod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ lag len 'debs pa las/ rab tu tsha ba ni lcags khyim 'bar ba'i nang du gsal shing rtse gsum pas phrag pa gnyis dang spyi bo la thal mar 'bigs shing /lcags bsregs kyi snam bus lus la dkris pas shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ mnar med ni/ lcags khyim me 'bar ba nye 'khor lhag pa bcu drug gis bskor zhing kun nas rab tu tsha 2sdu'i mes lus mar me'i sdong bu ltar

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃbasregs shing 'o dod 'bod pa'i sgra tsam las/ me dang lus gnyis su med cing so sorabaltar mi mngon pa sogs dmyal ba gzhan bdun po'i sdug bsngal yang tshangazhingamyong dgos pa'o/ /de ltar tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad tshan gcig yod pa blo la blang zhing bsam mo/ /grang dmyal brgyad ni/ gangs ri stug po'i sogs/spyi mthunaduo gzhi dang 'khor yuog thams cad gongaso ri stug po'i 'dabs 'byor dang chab ram chu 'khyags kyi khrad/ de yang gcang rang ya nga ba'i gnas rnams su nyin mtshan gyi dbye ba med par rtag tu kha ba bu yug 'ba' zhig 'tshubs pas lus sbrebs pa der/ byis pa btsas ma thag pa lta bu'i lus la grang ba'i reg bya bzod dka' ba'i steng du rlung gis btab pa'i rkyen gyis lus kyi lang tsho gzhon sha chags pa la chu bur thol gyis byung ba ni chu bur can dang / chu bur de dag lhag par grang bas rdol nas rmar song ba na chu bur rdol ba can/ smre sngags rgyun mi chad par 'don pa a chu chu zer ba dang / de'ang tshor ba shin tu grang ba'i sdug bsngal brnag cing bzod par dka' ba yis/ lus zungs kyis rab tu btang zhing zad nas 'chi kha'i nad pa bzhin du skad kyi gdangs chag pas shugs ring gis kye spyod 'don cing smra ba ni kye shud 'don pa dang / grang ba'i zug rngu mi bzod par so 'thams te skad mi thon pa so tham tham pa dang / phyi yi pags pa mdog sngon por song nas bzhi tshal du 'gas pa utpal ltar gas pa dang / nang gi sha'u dmar po thon pa yang shin tu grang nas brgyad tshal du gas pa padma ltar gas pa dang / de las kyang lhag par grang bas dmar nag tu gyur pa bcu drug dang / sum cu so gnyis la sogs grangs med par 'gas te padma chen po ltar 21

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgs pa'o/ /de ltar gas pa'i me nang du srin bu lcags kyi mchu can mang po zhugs nas za zhing grang ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba'i myong tshul brgyad la ming brgyad du chags pa'o/ /lag len 'debs pa las ni/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol ba/ so tham pa/ a chu/ kye shud 'don/ utpal ltar gas/ padma ltar gas/ padma ltar zhes dang / mkhas 'jug sdom byang las/ a chu kye shud so 'tham pa/ /chu bur can dang chu bar rdol/ /padma pad ltar gas pa/ /atpal ltar gas grang dmyal brgyad/ /ces de ltar tsha dmyal dang grang dmyal gyi gong 'og gi go rim mi 'dra bar gsungs pas tshe tshad kyang de ltar rang rang gi gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /nye 'khor lhag pa bcu drug ni/ de bzhin spu gri'i sogs/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi 'khor du phyogs bzhi so so na yod par bshad la/ de bzhin spu gri'i thang la mtshon sna tshogs rtswa ltar skyes pas rkang pa gshag pa dang / ral gri'i tshal du lcags kyi sdong po la ral gri mang po lo ma ltar skyes pa rlung gis bskyod pas lus la bcad gtubs byed pa dang / ro myags kyi 'dam ni mi ro sogs ro rul pa 'ba' zhig gi 'dam du tshud de sdug bsngal ba dang / thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med ni ma/dag me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du tshud de shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o/ /de ltar mnar med pa'i nye 'khor ba lhag pa bcu drug dang / 'gyur ba can zhes pa ni/ kha cig gis shal ma rir bzhed/ nyi tshe ba ni/ 'gyur ba can sogs/ sdug bsngal rnam par 'gyur ba can/ sgo dang / ka ba dang / skad gnyis shan sbyar las/ phru ba ste rdza ma sogs skam par mi bsreg cing nang du ja sogs bskol snod do/ /zhes gsungs/ thab spyang / thag pa sogs yo byad ci snyed pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / deltar bem po phal cher la rnam shes zhugs nas dus rtag tu sdug bsngal gyi khur chen pos sems kyi thog tu bkol zhing nyer len tshor ba rtsub mo nyin re bzhinargyun du spyod pa'i nyi tshe ba'am glo bur 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal phan tshun nyams su myong ba zhes bya ste/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ kha cig gis tshe nyi ma re lasamed pas nyi tshe ba zhes 'dod kyang / mi 'thad de/ lcags kyi khyim du skyes pa'i rabs las/ da dung yang ni mang po zhig /phyir yang dmyal ba 'dir gnas so/ /zhes so/ kha cig gis gcig pur grogs med pa'i phyir nyi tshe ba'o zhes 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ sngon gro bzhin skyes kyis gtsug lag khang du dge slong lnga brgya tsam gnas pa gzigs pa bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar dmyal gnas rnam grangs bco brgyad po gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu yi gtso bo zhe sdang drag po'i kun slong yin pas/ des na dug gsum gyi kun slong ngan pa skyes pa'i tshe/skad cig de ma thag tu de'i rgyun bcad de blo sna dam pa'i chos phyogs la sgyur cig sogs/ ༈gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa la gnyis las/ bying gnas la spyi mthun gyi sdug bsngal ni/ de bzhin phongs la sogs/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de bzhin du yi dwags kyi gnas na'ang spyi mthun gyi sdug bsngal ni/zas skom gyis dbul zhing phongs la rdo gseg dang tsher ma la sogs pa'i sa phyogs shin tu nyams mi dga' ba'i yul du/ bza' btung dang longs spyod kyi dngos po rnams ming yang mi grags par gyur na myong ba lta ci smos/ zas dang skom lo bcu gnyis tsam dang zla ba mang po'i bar la'ang mi rnyed pas shin tu bkres shing skom pas gdungs bas da~X / yi dwags rnams kyi lus ni pags

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrus gnyis kye bar na sha med pas rid cing skem pa las ldang ba'i nus stobs tsam yang nyams shing shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o/ /de la nang gses su dbye na/phyi'i sgrib pa can/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can gsum mo//mkha' la rgyu ba ni/ btsan dang rgyal po 'dre la sogs pa rnams te/ de dag kyang rtag tu 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la spyod dgos pa'o//de lta bu gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu yi gtso bo ni ser sna dang 'jur 'gegs yin pas rang gis kyang de lta bu'i las du ma bsags zin/ der skyes pa rnams la snying rje bsgom dgos so/ /gsum pa dud 'gro la gnyis las/ bying na gnas pa ni/ gcig la sogs/phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong rnams dang chu gter chen po bzhi'i khyon la gnas pa ste/de yang sngon gyi gti mug la goms/ pa'i mthus glen rmongs kyi sdug bsngal yod pa gzhi ri bzhag la/ bye brag tu tsha grang bkres skom la sogs dpag tu med cing /phan tshun sprul dang chu srin sogs che bas chung ba rnams khyur mid byed cing za/ che ba la'ang rnam grangs mang ste/ ji skad du/ dpag tshad brgya ba'i zhing ldan pa'i/ /ti mid zhes bya'i nya mid yod/ /de mid pa yi nya mid yod/ /de yang mid pa'i nya mid yod/ /ces gsungs/ chung ngus chen po 'bigs pa la sogs pa'i gling bar mun nag gi rgya mtsho na yod pa rnams ni rang gi yan lag brkyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong zhing / bshad ma thag pa ltar gcig la gcig gis za bar byed pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med do/ /kha 'thor ba ni/ gsod pa'i 'jigs pa sogs/ mis bdag snro ma bzung ba bya dang ri dwags sogs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgacig gis gcig za ste/ khras byes bye'us 'bu za ba la sogs pa dang / rngon pa dang gcan gzan la sogs pas gsod pa'i 'jigs pa che zhing / rta sogs misabadag tu bzung ba rnams la bkol zhing spyod pas nyam thag la blang dor gyi gnas mi shes par rmongs pa sogs pha mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar zhing gzir ba'i tshul rnams blo la blangs nas sngar bzhin bsgom/ der skye ba'i rgyu'am sa bon ni blang dor gyi gnas mi shes pa'i gti mug mun par 'khyams pa bdag gi blo sna myur du sogs/ ༈ gnyis pa mtho ris gsum gyi sdug bsngal ni/zag bcas kyi dge bas mtho ris gsum du skyes kyang / mkhas 'jug rtsa ba las/lubor ba'i bde ba ltar snang ba thams cad kyang mthar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / tsha grang bkres skom nad sogs ngo bo nyid kyis sdug bsngal ba sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / zag bcas kyi phung po mtha' dag srid pa nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang gsum pos bcing ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs/ de 'dra'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la bde bar sems pa'i rang sems phyin ci log 'di/ ji ltar sgyid kyang mi ngoms/ ji ltar sdug kyang mi skyo bas 'khor ba las ma thar bar sdug bsngal gyi 'dam du tshud pa'i rang mtshang nan tan bsam zhing / 'khor ba 'dir skye shi'i kha brgyud pas sdug bsngal tshad med mtha' med myong ba la shin tu yid dbyung nas da res gtan du bde ba'i go 'phang bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ thar lam rab gsal las/ bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal mang dang ldan/ /bde bar snang bas yid bslus 'gyur ba caspya/ /zag bcas phung po mtha' dag sdug

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasngal rgyu/ /khams gsum 'khor ba me yi 'obs 'dra yang / /de ltar mi shes chags ldan bdag cag la/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs rjes gzigs/ /nges 'byung bsam pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar blo ldog rnam pa bzhis blo legs par sbyangs te dngos gzhi/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgor 'jug pa la ni/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa thob cing dbang srog dam tshig gis bzung ste/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'i sgo nas sku gsum/ dang sems rig gi sna khrid de gzod nyams khrid dmar bcing du byed pa'i tshe/ dal 'byor gyi rten la snying po len tshul ni/ sangs rgyas las kyang 'phrad par dka' ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin pas/ de yang bsgrub bya sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de la chos gzugs gnyis yod/ bsgrub tshul la ring lam rgyu'i theg pa/nye lam sngags kyi theg pa/ myur lam mthar thug 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam dang gsum du bzhed la/ 'dir ni chos gzugs gnyis dngos su lam du byed pa khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis/ skye 'chi'i mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa dbyings su grol nas 'chi med gnyug ma'i sems mngon du gyur pa dang / 'khor ba'i rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs pa lam bden du shar ba dang / 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa 'gog bden du sad de de'i ngor snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba ni rang rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi mi nus shing rang sa zin pas na thun mong ma yin pa'i blo ldog rnam bzhi rgyud la skye ba'i tshad yang dag tu bzhed pa yin la/ de yang blo ldog rnam bzhis blo sbyangs khul byas kyang phugs snyogs sa ci yang med pa dang 'di mi ༷twe gsungs/ de nas thar ba'i phan yon

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdran te de'i rgyu 'bras la dga' spro bskyed/ mthun rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstenatshul ni/ nor ci yod 'bul ba'i snying khams/ las chos su mthong ba'i dad pa/ bka' ji ltar stsal ba'i sgrub pa gsum dgos zhes kun mkhyen gnyis pas bzhed pa ltar legs par bsten nas/gnyis pa rang skyon ngos bzung gnang ba'i man ngag ni/ chos lam zhugs kyang sogs/ dam chos 'dul ba'i lam la zhugs shing so thar gyi sdom pa blangs kyang 'khor bar zhen log gi nges 'byung dang bral bas nyes par spyod pa pham lhung sogs kyis rang rgyud mi sdom zhing 'chal ba/ theg chen gyi sgor zhugs nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed kyang gzhan phan don du gnyer ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang bral ba/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i smin byed dbang bzhi zab mo legs par thob kyang grol byed kyi lam thabs bskyed pa'i rim/ pa dang / shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis mi bsgom pa'i rigs can rnams ni/ lam gol te log pa'i lam du song ba yin pas/ lam log pa 'di las myur du bla mas bsgral du gsol/ gnas lugs kyi lta ba ma rtogs bzhin rtogs rdzun gyis las 'bras khyad gsod rngam po che ngag nas smra zhing / lus kyis tho co'i spyod pa grub pa'i cha lugs su brdzu ba can dang / sgom pa yengs kyang spyi 'byams gshis shor gyi go yul tsam la brten nas/ yengs dang ma yengs khyad med la sogs tshig skam gyi 'ud gog shin tu che bas nyams myong phye mar 'thag pa dang / ma chags zhen med kyi spyod pa yon tan can las nor zhing chags sred kyi dbang gis dge sdig gi blang dor 'chol nyog tu spyod ༷ḍi rang skyon la mi sebees pa'i chos dred

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adi nyid chos min las bla mas myur du bsgral du gsol/ srid pa'i yo byad la chags shing shin tu zhen pa rnams ni/ sang nang par 'chi ba'i dus la babs par shes na yang da dung gnas khang zas gos nor dang longs spyod rnams la sred cing chags pa dang / gzhon pa'i na tshod yol nas rgas shing 'khogs pa'i gnas su gyur na yang 'khor ba la sa thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung dang / sdug bsngal la skyo shas bral ba dang / thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab chung yang khron pa'i sbal pa ltar phran bu re shes pa de yon tan can du rlom ste nga rgyal byed pa de ni/ ma rig pa'i dbang du song ba yin pas 'di las bla mas bsgral du gsol/ chos par khas 'ches pa 'ga' zhig gis sems chags sdang rmongs sogs skye ba'i rkyen khar 'chor ba yang mi shes par 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yengs kyi dbang du song nas bde sdug ro snyoms mi nus bzhin du gnas skor sogs mchog yin sems pa ni/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ phugs sprang snyogs 'khyer ba'i snga ltas su shar bas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lus dben pa mi med kyi gnas la brten nas yun ring bsgom lo byas kyang / sems ma rig bden 'dzin gyis drangs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs las dben pa ma thob par rang rgyud shing skam ltar du rengs shing gyong ba'o/ /phyi'i kun spyod 'jam zhing dul bar bstan nas gzhan rgyud 'dul ba'i dam chos smra bar byed khul byas na yang / nang rang rgyud kyi chags sdang gra ma nyams shing ma zhig pa'i spyod pa byi la'i ston pa lta bu 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du song ba ste/ chos brgyad ni/ mkhas 'jug sdom byang las/ rnyed bde grags bstod 'dod ṭwāṃr cing / /ma rnyed sdug bsngal mi snyan

g.yukhog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / /smad pa dag ni mi 'dod pa/ /'jig rten chos brgyad ces su bshad//cesagasungs pa ltar/ 'jigs rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du gyur pa 'di las myur du bla ma thugs rje can gyis bsgral du gsol/ ma rig bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyid 'thug po 'di las myur du sad par byed pa'i thabs bla mas bstan du gsol/ rgyu ma rig pa las byung ba'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i btson ra rgyal po'i khri mu na lta bu las nyon lcags sgrog gis dam du bsdams pa 'di las myur du dbyung zhing thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ zhes skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma dam pa khyed mkhyen no snyam du bsam la 'bod pa drag pos thugs rje slong bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la'ang drug las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la rgyu skyabs dang 'bras skyabs/ skyabs su 'gro tshul dang gnyis/dang po ni/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba las/ de'ang mtshan nyid kyi theg pas chos sku mthar thug rang gi rgyud la thob par 'dod pa ni 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro yin la de ma thob kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la lam gyi skyel mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni de thob pa'i rgyu byed pas rgyu'i skyabs 'gro zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / gsang sngags pas ni rang la yod pa'i sems nyid sangs rgyas su da lta rang chas su gnas pa mngon du mthong bar 'dod nas/ thun mong gi yul phyi rol gyi dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing / thun mong ma yin pa rang gi sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog go/ /de'ang dkyil 'bor so so'i dkon mchog gasbyam dang / bstan pa spyi'i dkon mchog

mari tsho tho rig thos ga ///(g.yu khog bla ma chas dbyangs rang grol gya gsung 'bum/gsum gnyis ka rgyu'i snyabs yul du 'dod la/de la skyabs su 'gro ba ni rgyu'i skyabs 'gro'o//rang gi sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes dkon mchog gsum ye nas gnas pa ni 'bras bu'i skyabs yul te/de la blang dor dang bcos bslad med par rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro'o//zhes gsungs/de ltar gnyug ma'i sems de nyid gdod nas 'bras bu'i dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pa yin la/de rgyu'i dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje la brten nas sad cing rtogs par byas na yid shes bde myur du skyobs pas mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog tshogs thams cad 'od gsal gnyug ma'i klong du bag chags bsog long med par rang grol du 'gro ba'o//gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro tshul la/yul gyi khyad par ni/dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs/thun mong theg pa'i lugs la/sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas la ston pa/lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid kyi chos la lam/rig grol phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su mos te dkon mchog gsum la lam gyi skyel ma lta bur 'gro zhing /ma 'ongs pa na rang rgyud la de gsum dngos su grub par 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang /thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags spyi'i tshul gyis/spang rtogs mthar phyin pa bde bar gshegs pa'i ngo bo las phye ba'i/byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma la sgo gsum 'bul/dngos grub kyi rtsa ba chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las gzugs sku zhi khro rab 'byams su shar ba'i yi dam la bsten/bar chad sel ba'i rtsa ba chos nyid skye ba med pa'i mkha' la 'gag med thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'gro ba'i ye shes mkha' 'gro la grogasdu kyi tshul du byas nas de lta bu'i rtsa ba

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / khyad par thabs mchog rdo rje snying po'i lugs kyis/ sku bsgrub par bya ba'i rten rtsa yi dwangs ma chen po sprul skur bsten/gsung bsgrub par bya ba'i rten mi shigs rlung lnga longs skur sbyong / thugs bsgrub par bya ba'i rten thig le'i rang bzhin chos skur dag pa'i myur lam la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de lta bu'i rdo rje'i lus kyi dwangs ma'i rtsa rlung thig le khyad par can de la/ brten pa 'gyur med kyi bde ba chen po dang / rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa chen po zung 'jug 'du 'bral med pa'i 'od gsal ba'i thig le chen po'i rtsal las shar ba'i/ rtsa rlung thig le phra rags dang snyigs mar gyur pa thams cad thabs kyis zin na dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba dang / lam du ma long na ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'char ba yin la/ de ltar rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs de nyid rgyud lung man ngag gsum nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin shes pa gal che/ mthar thug bslu ba med pa gnas lugs rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro ni/skyabs yul de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i gnyis med rang byung gi ye shes byang chub kyi sems ngo bo stong pa chos kyi dbyings rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid/ rang bzhin gsal ba lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes/ thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes te don gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rang rgyud la bsgrub byar byed pa dang / de yang ngo bo stong pa chos sku dang / bla ma/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog /rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku dang / yi dam/ chos dkon mchog /thugs rje kun khyab sprul sku dang / mkha' 'gro/ dge 'dun dkon mchog yin gsungs/ de yang kha cig na re/ sangs rgyas chos daX ḍige 'dun gsum la/ gsang sngags kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃskyabs gnas thun mong ma yin pa rnams ma 'dus so zhe na/ de ni 'dir 'du ste/bla ma ni skye 'phags gang rung las ma 'das pa'i phyir sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gang rung las mi 'da' la/ yi dam ni spyir btang ye shes pa gcig yin par 'dod dgos la/ bye brag rnam 'gyur gyi sko nas zhi khro gang rung las ma 'das te des na de ni sangs rgyas su 'du'o/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ni rig 'dzin nang gi dge 'dun du gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la sogs pa nas gsal por gsungs phyir der 'du'o/ khyad par rtsa ba gsum lta bur mtshon na/ spyir btang bla ma rnams sangs rgyas dang dge 'dun gang rung las ma 'das kyang / bye brag rang la smin grol gyi gdams pa dngos su gnang ba'i bla ma de lha ga par bka' drin shin tu che bas/ de nyid byin rlabs kyi rtsa bar shes pa'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba dang /yi dam zhi khro thams cad sangs rgyas las ma 'das kyang / rang gi me tog gang la phog pa'i tshe rabs sngon gyi las 'brel yod pa'i lha de/ dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa bar shes nas lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin pa dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rig 'dzin nang gi dge 'dun du shes nas skyabs su song ba yin yang / rang la lhag par nye zhing 'go ba de nyid bar chad sel ba'i rtsa bar shes nas bsgrub cing mchod pa ste/ 'di dag ni spyi las bye brag tu byas pa'o/ /de yang skyes bu chen po'i blos dus 'di nas bzung ste bla med byang chub snying po'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o snyam ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang nyid gang du 'dug pa'i sa phyogs thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i 32

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgazhir/ dpag bsam lngon shing yal ga lnga pa/ lo 'dab dang me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa la rin po che'i 'phyang 'phrul dril g.yer la sogs pas rnam parabargyan pa nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab pa'i dbus su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhabs drung rin po ches/ skyabs 'gro'i skabasa'adir sku mdog sngon por gsungs pa kun mkhyen rang nyid kyi zhal rgyun ltar yin gsungs/ de ni bla ma gsang 'dus las/ mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis paḥgacer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan canaḥ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzinaḥphyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'byud zhabs gnyisardo rje'i sgyil kyung bzhugasaḥ de yi pang g.yonarig ma niḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal maḥ bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon tshul can zhes sogs gsungs/ mchan/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dar dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dbu gtsug tu rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs shing / gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rgyud sde chen po drug dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil zhabor gyi lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas mtha' nas bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal ga la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sogs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul sku'i rnam pa can rnams dang / g.yas kyi yal gar nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun/ g.yon gyi yal ga la shā ri'i bu dang mo'u gal gyi bu la sogs pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs/ rgyab kyi yal gar chos dkon ༵chog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃcan kha dog dmar po ā li kā li'i rang sgra sgrogs pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams thams cad ye shes dang las las grub pa'i chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bar med du gang ba/ 'dir las las grub pa zhes pa ni/ 'jig rten las 'das kyang 'jig rten pa'i snye rgyud ltar las nyon las grub pa'i lus de nyid ma spangs bar da dung 'jig rten pa'i rnam par snang ba dbang phyug nyer brgyad lta bu ste/ dper na rdo rje mi yi srin mo mgrin bcu'i chung ma byed dus srin zhal yin pa las ru tras 'phrog pa na kho mgo brnyan la dga' bas srin zhal g.yag gdong du zhal bsgyur ba sogs so gsungs/ thams cad kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag nyid la rjes su brtse zhing 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam la/ de'i mdun du rang nyid/rang gi mdun g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du gnod byed/ mtha' bskor kun tu rigs drug gi sems can thams cad lus gus pa'i thal mo sbyar/ ngag nas snyabs 'gro'i tshig 'ur dir gyis brjod/ yid kyis 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla ma la 'dren pa/ yi dam dang sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba'i tshul gyis bdag cag rnams khyed la brten/ khyed la 'bul/ khyed las gzhan pa'i skyabs dang re sa med pas ci mdzad khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i gdung ba drag pos skyabs su 'gro bar mos te skyabs 'gro ci 'grub tu bya/ mthar skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs/3gib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthams cad dag /che dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan la sogs pa gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam la sems 'dzin med kyi ngang du cung zad re mnyam par bzhag go zhes gsungs/ yang na/ dpal sprul rin po che'i sngon 'gro'i dmigs rim bsdus pa las/ thun mthar/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bya khyu 'ur rdos dkrogs pa ltar 'ur dir gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams la thim/ skyabs yul rnams kyang rim par 'od du zhu nas mdun gyi sangs rgyas thams cad shākya thub pa la thim/ g.yas kyi byang sems thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la thim/ g.yon gyi nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad shā ri'i bu la thim/ de thams cad rgyab kyi chos la thim/ chos dkon mchog thams cad kyang o rgyan chen po la thim/ mtha' bskor gyi bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang o rgyan chen po la thim/ bla ma yang mtha' nas rim par 'od du yal te mi dmigs pa'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par bzhag ces gsungs/ 'di ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'am mthar thug sngags kyi 'bras skyabs yin zhes pa'ang yod/ mi pham rin po ches/ thun mthar skyabs yul 'od du zhu/ rang sogs sems can kun la thim pas thams cad sangs rgyas par bsam zhing dge ba bsngo bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ bslab bya dang phan yon gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /༈ gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ rgyas par theg chen lam gyi khyad par byed chos sems bskyed kyi phan yon/ sdom pa len tshul/ bslab bya sogs zhib tu shes par bya/ tshogs zhing sngar ltar3 sngisal ba'i spyan sngar rang gzhan kun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'akhod par dmigs nas/ sems bskyed len pa'i dam bca' brtan pos sems bskyed kyi tshig /ho sna tshogs snang ba sogs/ zhes lan gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ mgo 'dren byed hoḥ zhes pa ni/ngo mtshar ba'i tshig yin te/ ngo ci zhig mtshar na/ sems can thams cad rang rig 'od gsal ba'i dbyings su ngal gso ba'i phyir du tshad med bzhi yi ngang du sems bskyed pa 'di ngo mtshar zhes bzhed pa dang / kha cig gis snying rje ba'i tshig ste/ snying rje ba'i yul sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams so zhes 'dod/ yang kha cig gis skyo ba'i tshig tu 'dod pa'ang yod do/ /sems can rang rang gi sngon las sna tshogs bsags pa'i dbang gis bde sdug sna tshogs pa rang sems phyin ci log gi snang ba 'di dag dpe chu nang gi zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang yang dpyad na bden par ma grub pa ltar/ yul dang yul can gnyis ka thog ma'i gzhi dus dang / mthar phyin 'bras dus na med pas glo bur zhakhrul ba'i sdus ba rdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can gyi snang ba 'di dag kyang / las sna tshogs pa' rkyen gyis so sor ris su bris pa lta bu ste/ las ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ gsungs pa bzhin chu gcig po la'ang rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyis mthong ba mi 'dra ba'i snang ba rnams kyang las dang bag chags las byung ba'i gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i blo ma zad kyi bar 'gog tu med par 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun ma chad par lu gu rgyud du 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag thams cad kyi las snang bag chags dang bcas pa bral nas rang rang gi rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal gyi dbyings su son te/ mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs kyis ngal zhing ñtshab pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdabugs 'byin gyi ngal gso thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje tshad med/ de'i rgyu nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral bar 'dod pa'i blo ni btang snyoms tshad med/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par 'dod pa byams pa tshad med/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dga' ba tshad med de/ tshad med snga ma gnyis kyi snying rje'i mthus mkha' khyab kyi sems can la dmigs pa dang / phyi ma gnyis kyi 'jog tshul ni bla na med pa'i bde ba 'od gsal chos sku thob 'dod kyi byams pa tshad med/ de dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dga' ba tshad med gnyis ni shes rab stobs kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshad med rnam pa bzhi yis blo yang yang sbyangs pa'i mthar/ de'i ngang nas sems can thams cad rnam grol gtan gyi bde ba la 'god pa'i slad du bdag gis rdzogs nga/'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che de ci nas kyang thob nges pa zhig bya'o snyam pa smon pa dang / de'i ched du lam zab mo 'di nyid kyis mtshon te byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la bslabs nas 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam par bya'o snyam pa 'jug pa sems bskyed do/ /spro na bar 'dir bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i blo sbyong dang / khyad par dbugs 'gro 'ong dang bstun te bde sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa'ang nyams su blang zhing / bdag med rnam gnyis kyi nges pas drangs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyang ci rigs su bsgom pa shin tu gal che ste/jo bo rje'i rnam thar las/ bod du byon spyas dge bshes ston pa la sogs pa la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsems bzang po gyis/ byang chub kyi sems med na chos mang po mnyan pa dang /blta ba dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa dang / bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim dang / dbu ma'i lta ba bsgom pa dang / bzlas brjod la sogs pa gang byas kyang phan med/ byang chub kyi sems kyis ma zin pa'i dge sbyor dang / byang chub kyi sems la gnod pa'i dge sbyor thams cad bdud kyi las yin zhes gsungs/mthar bdag dang sems can thams cad skyabs yul rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang dbus kyi bla ma la thim/ de yang chos sku spros bral gdod ma'i dbyings su bstims nas mnyam par bzhag go gsungs/ yang na/ thun mthar tshogs zhing rnams mtha' nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas dbus kyi bla ma la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la lhang gis skyes par bsam zhing dge ba bsngo/ smon pa'i bslab bya bdag gzhan mnyam pa brje ba bdag bas gzhan kyāṭwāṃ~X /trīrnyi ོ༵/sgo/ma pa dang / 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug la gsum pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rdo rje sems dpas sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su thugs bskyed pa'i tshe/ ma 'ongs pa na bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ sems can gang mtshams med pa lnga dang / dam tshig gi sgrib pa can rnams kyis nga yi ming thos pa/ bdag yid la byed pa dang / gsang sngags kyi rgyal po yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa tsam gyis des sdig lhung lhag med du byang zhing dag pasdu gyur cig /de ltar ma gyur gyi bar du

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbadag 'tshang mi rgya bar shog cig ces pa dang / dam tshig nyams chags can rnams kyi mdun du bdag gnas nas sgrib pa thams cad sbyong bar shog cig cesapa'i smon lam gyi mthu yongs su grub pas thugs bskyed gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / lhag pa'i lha rigs brgya rigs lnga sogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang bzhin rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gsang chen rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas lha gzhan dang mi 'dra ba dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas re re'i mdun du phyin nas bshags pa'i thabs 'bad pa bas/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi spro dang sdud pa'i byed po bla ma dang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis su med par bsgoms nas bshags pa byed na snga ma las khyad par du gyur pa yin gsungs/ de yang sbyang bya dang sbyong byed gnyis las/ sbyang bya sgrib pa bzhi ni/ las kyi sgrib pa rang bzhin gyi sdig pa dang bcas pa'i lhung ba gnyis/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni/mgon po byams pas/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /ces/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang 'chal tshul la sogs pa'i rnam rtog gang yin pa de ni phar phyin yongs su dag pa'i gegs nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa yin par 'dod do/ /shes sgrib ni/ mgon po byams pas/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ces/ 'khor gsum du rnam par rtog pa gang yin pa de ni phar phyin yongs su rdzogs pa'i gegs shes bya'i sgrib pa yin par 'dod do/ /bag chags kyi sgrib pa ni/ mdo ltar na rtsi snod ltar shes bya'i sgrib pa shin tu phra ba'i gnas skabs dang / sngags ltar na gnyen po rdo rje lta bu'i ye sherwa ḍis bcom bya'i snang gsum 'pho ba'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbag chags de yin no/ /sgrib pa bzhi po des gang la sgrib na/ rang bzhin gyi sdig pas gnas skabs mtho ris la bsgrib/ bcas lhung gis gnas skabs ma/tho ris dang / mthar thug byang chub gsum la sgrib/ nyon sgrib kyis thar pa la sgrib/ shes sgrib dang bag chags kyi sgrib pa gnyis kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la sgrib pa'o/ /sbyong byed gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas 'dir sgrib pa ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul ni/ āḥ bdag nyid tha mal sogs/ āḥ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don dran pa'i ngang nas/ bdag nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bo rtswapad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa sdong bu sor bzhi tsam tshangs bug tu zug pa'i lte bar ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i zla dkyil dkar bsil nya gang ba'i gdan gyi dbus su/ dbyings rig dbyer med mtshon pa'i hūṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ skad cig gis ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar gsal 'od zer 'phro zhing / zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe'i nyams 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa la/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i smad dkris/ cod pan/ zi ldir ni dar mthing khra'i cod pan ltag pa nas phyir 'phyang pa/ gar gyi phu dung ni bris cha rnying pa rnams su 'byung ba'i stod g.yogs lta bu la phu dung thung ngu yod pa ste dar gyi chas gos lnga dang /rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabasagadub/ ska rags/ rin po che'i do shal lte 'og yan 'khor ba/ se mo do ni nu ma'i bar sleb pa'i do shal thung ba zhes gsungs/ skad gnyis shan sbyar las/ do shal te mu tig sogs kyi rgyan phreng lte 'og sleb rdo0/ do shal phyed pa ste se mo do zhes par

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'abod pa nu ma'i bar sleb pa/ rkang gdub ste long tshigs kyi rgyan 'khor ba'o//zhes gsungs pa ste rin po che'i rgyan brgyad do/ /de ltar longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyanachas bcu gsum gyis sku la spras pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rig stong gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon snang snyong gi dril bu dku la brten nas 'dzin cing / srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i brdar zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i pang du/ yum snyems ma dkar mo phyag g.yas skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa'i gri gug dang / g.yon bde chen sbyor ba'i brdar thod pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa dang mnyam par zhakhril ba'i sku can du gsal btab nas/ khyod la skyabs su gsol zhing sdig pa sbyong bar mdzad du gsol zhes mos gus gdung shugs drag pos bdag gi shes rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pa zhig khyed mkhyen no snyam pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la snying nas 'gyod sems drag pos mthol lo bshags so snyam pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las mi byed snyam pa nyes byas sdom pa'i stobs/ sngar byas kyi gnyen por bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gnyis su med pa khyod kyi thugs kar zla ba nya gang ba rgyas pa'i steng du/ sgru yig gi mtha' mar yig brgya'i sngags phreng dkar po spu shad kyis bris pa lta bu g.yas bskor du gsal la/ cung zad bzlas pas sngags kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas snyi yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bde chen gyi bdud rtsi dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa babs yab yum gyi sku yi dbyibs brgyud de bde la rol diḍi sbyor mtshams nas byung / padma'i sdong

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbu la 'khri ba'i tshul gyis bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi sprin chen po ga bur gyi rdul ltar 'dzag cing rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs pa de yis/ sha 'ud chen po'i sna la sbur mi chags pa ltar bdag dang khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/mi dge ba'i las dang nyon mongs pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang / de dag gi 'bras bu nad thams cad rnag khrag dang / gdon thams cad srog chags/ sdig sgrib nyes lhung dam grib ma lus pa dud sol khu rlangs kyi rnam pas ba spu'i bu ga dang 'og sgo gnyis nas 'thon/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 'chi bdag glang dmar po'i rnam par gnas pa'i kha gdangs pa nas zhugs/ lto bar tshud pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs de thams cad byang bar mdzad du gsol bsam la/ yi ge brgya pa rab ci nus/ 'bring brgya rtsa/ tha ma'ang nyer gcig la nyung mtha' byas pa bzla ba gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs so/ /de nas mthar thun 'jog khar/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa thams cad ngoms shing tshims/ lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha mkhon byang / sdig sgrib dag /gshin rje'i kha lag sbar gsum yang zum/ sa gas pa yang sos te dus min gyi 'chi ba bslus par bsam/ de ltar stobs bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pas nyams su blangs pa'i mthar/'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams kyang bdud rtsi'i skya mer gyis khengs pas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bde stong dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pas lus sems zag med kyi bde bas khyab par bsam/ mjug bshags sdom bya ba ni/ slar yang mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ mgon po bdag ni sogs/ skyaXnee gsol gyi tshig brjod pa dang / rang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃrgyud kyi sdig lhung dag pa la rdo rje sems dang/'a thugs dgyes pas zhal 'dzum mdangs su bzhad cing / rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad dag pa yin no zhes gsung gis dngos su gnang ba byin pa dang chabs cig bde stong chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen las/ rang nyid kyang skad cig gis rdo rje sem/sa dpa' yab yum sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs sogs ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs pa snang stong me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal ba'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi dbus su thugs srog hūṃ/phyogarsā bzhir oṃ badzra sa twa'i sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams gsal ba las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub/ 'dir zhabs drung rin po ches/ bla ma nyag bla la yig 'bru dang 'od zer dkar por gsal kyang rung gsungs/ mchan/ thams cad tshur 'dus rang la thim/slar 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'og min mngon par dga' ba'i zhing dang / nang bcud khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rdor sems rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ de thams cad dang rang nyid lhan cig pas bzlas par bsam la zhes gsungs/ phyag rdor drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud las/ o badzra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes pa 'bum phrag gcig brjod na/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas yang snying ci nus su bzla ba ni khyad par bskyed rim la brten pa'i sgrib sbyong dang /mthar thug lha sngags kyi spros pa 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang du bsdus te/ sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi rtog tshogs thams cad4 sngizod ma nas rang bzhin gyis ma grub

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa'i rig stong don gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i rang zhal blta zhing mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam rdzogs rim la brten pa'i sgrib pa sbyong tshul bla na med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ ji skad du/ āḥ yig skye ba med pa'i chos nyid don/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu dbyer med byang chub sems/ /sbyang bya sbyong byed las 'das rdzogs pa cher/ /rnam grol rig stong sor bzhag bshags pa'i rgyal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ o ā ༷hūṃ/ stong gsum 'jig rten sogs/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing skyabs yul ltar gsal btab ste rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇḍal byi dor byas la/ dri bzang dang ba byung gi chus byug par me tog gi tshom bu rang rang gi gzhung ltar bkod pa dmigs rten tu bya/ rgyun du ma grub na dmigs pas kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang /thun mong sprul sku'i maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa'i stong gsum 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing na/ rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa lha mi'i yo byad kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gtams shing gang ba dang / bye brag tu bdag gi lus longs spyod dge tshogs dang bcas pa ltos med du yongs su 'bul gyis/ dam pa chos kyi 'khor los 'gro ba rnams thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid dam pa sprul pa'i sku thob par shog cig snya ma pa'o/ /de'i steng gi nam mkhar thun min longs sku'i maṇḍal 'og min bde chen stug po bkod nga 'i zhing na/ nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga'i tshom bu'i rnam pa can la/ sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo grangs med pas mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam sdonee mi khyab cing mtha' yas pa thogs pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃphulabs lhun grub longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog cig snyam pa'o/ /de'i steng gi dbyings la khyad par chos sku'i maṇḍal gnas lugs rang byung gi ye shes de nyidasems kyi chos nyid du gdod nas gzhon nu bum sku'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin la/ de ltar snang srid rnam par dag pa gzhon nu bum pa'i sku'i gzhi la/thugs rje ma 'gags 'od gsal gyi snang cha chos nyid rol ba'i rgyan du shar ba'i sku dang thig le'i 'dzin pa rnam par dag pa'i zhing sku pho brang gsum gyi snang cha tshom bu'i tshul du phul bas kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog cig snyam pa'o/ /bsdu na/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ maṇḍal tshomi bu bdun ma 'di nyid sprul sku'i maṇḍal yin kyang / sprul sku sku gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pas sku gsum gyi maṇḍal du dmigs kyang rung mod gsungs pas 'di kho na phul yang chog gsungs/ gzhan yang / bzhed srol 'ga' na/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing kham/sa sprul sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba dang / nang rang lus kyi maṇḍal pags pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ khrag dri bzang gi chag chag /yan lag bzhi gling bzhi/ nying lag rnams gling phran/ mig gnyis nyi zla/dbang yul gzhan rnams mchod pa'i lha mo rnams su mo/sa nas longs sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba dang / gsang ba chos sku'i ma/ṇḍal ka dag gdod ma'i gzhi la lhun grub snang ba bzhi po tshom bu'i tshul du bkod de chos sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba sogs/ de ltar snga 'gyur rang lugs kyi maṇḍal bka' gter rang rang gi gzhung na gsal bas der blta bar bya'o/ /sa skya'i 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung tshom bu so bdun ༷5 yongs grags ltar dang / yo ga'i rgyud

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkyi dgongs pa slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bzhed pa ni/ tshom bu bcu gsum ma ste/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas bsdoms pa'o/ /slob dpon dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i bzhed pa ni/ gling bzhi gling phran ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du nyi zla gdugs rgyal mtshan bzhi bsnan pas tshom bu bcu bdun pa'o/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa'i bzhed pa ni/ ri gling gling phran bcas kyi steng du rgyal srid bdun/ gter bum/ nyi zla bcas bsnan pas tshom bu nyer gsum pa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni/ tshom bu nyer gsum pa de ga'i steng du sgra gcan dang dus me gnyis bsnan pas tshom bu nyer lnga pa'o/ /tshom bu bcu gsum par nyi zla'i tshom bu dor/ bcu bdun par lho byang du gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ nyer gsum par phyogs mtshams brgyad du rgyal srid zloñtsha kā ji /༷ra sdu'o//sha/rno ñtsha rsha / ñtsha nāo//nye/ra lnga par lho byang du sgra gcan dang lnga pa bdud bzhi cig char du gcod pa ku su la'i tshogs gsog la/ de yang ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa/ sngags dang rjes su mthun pa'i mdo sngags dgongs pa zung 'brel/ dam chos bdud kyi gcod yul zhes bya ba/ 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi bdud bzhi po sems kyi snyem rtog ngar 'dzin kho na'i steng du gcod par byed pa yin la/ spyir bka' srol 'di'i rang skad du/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyis khog phub/ ma pa dpe drug gis che ba brjod/ ces gsungs te/ dang po ni/ zhu ba po'i gang zag gis dbye na pho brgyud mo brgyud gnyis/ ngo bos dbye na gzhud khrid can dang kha 'thor gnyis/ yongs la ༷gas tshul gyis dbye na snga dar phyi dar

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃganyis/ byon tshul gyis dbye na bka' ma gter ma gnyis te zung bzhi la ya brgyad du byung ngo / mtshon pa dpe drug ni/ gcod 'di gangs dkar dang 'dra ste gangs la kha ba babs kyang dkar la ma babs kyang dkar ba bzhin du/ gcod mkhan rnal 'byor pa la thos pa'i shes rab yod kyang legs la med kyang chog pa'o/ /seng ge dang 'dra ste des mang po zil gyis gnon la gcig pur nyam nga med pa bzhin/ gcod byed pa mang po dang 'grogs kyang chog la gcig pur 'grims kyang chog pa'o/ /rnga bo che'i skad dang 'dra ste rnga chen la rol mo gzhan gyi sgra yod kyang chog la med kyang chog pa bzhin 'di la dge sbyor gyi grogs gzhan yod med kyang khyad med pa'o/ /dngos grub kyi chu mig dang 'dra ste grub chu la mi mang nyung gi tshod dang 'tshams par 'byung ba bzhin lugs 'dir gang zag gi blo tshod dang 'tshams par bslab tu yod pa'o/ /gser g.yu chag pa'i dum bu dang 'dra ste che na rin thang che la chung na'ang de dang 'tshams pa'i rin thang yod pa bzhin gcod skor rgya cher shes na yon tan dpag tu med la cung zad shes pas kyang rang gzhan la phan thogs pa'o/ /rta bzang po'i spu dang 'dra ste rta mchog gzugs 'gros legs pa la spu mdog khyad par med pa bzhin/ gcod yul mthar phyin pa'i gang zag de mchog dman gang yin kyang gzhan las byin rlabs che bar gsungs so/ /gcod yul gyi rnam bzhag mdor bsdus las/ gcod yul/gcod bya/ gcod byed/ ji ltar gcod tshul bzhi/ dang po ni/ ji ltar shing gcod pa na gcod cing 'gyel ba'i yul ni sa gzhi yin pa ltar/ 'khri ba bcad nas zhen med du gnas pa'i yul ni /ོḍi dbyings rig pa byang chub sems kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃklong yin te/ de la gnas pa ni 'phags pa'i gnas pa rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin can no/ /de'i ngang du bdud bzhi rgyu ba med par nam mkha' ltar mnyam pa la bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'am gcod yul zhes gsungs so/ /gcod bya ni 'khri ba snye/ nya lcags kyus bzung ba bzhin du bdud bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dra ba lta bu yin no/ /gcod byed ni bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ste ral gri bzhin no/ /zhes dang / ji ltar gcod na yul bzhi po bden pa med par mthong bas yul can der 'dzin gyi zhen pa chod pas na yul yul can gyi bar lag 'brel ba'i 'khri ba chad pa'o/ /zhes dang / sems can thams cad la bar du gcod cing mi 'dod pa skyed pa'i rigs bsdu na bzhir 'du bas de chod na bar chod kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal bas na bdud bzhi gcod pa yin te/ ma cig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal nas/ thogs bcas yul gyi 'khri ba bcad//thogs med yid kyi 'khri ba bcad/ /dga' spro zhen pa'i 'khri ba bcad/ /snyems byed bdag gi 'khri ba bcad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bdud kyi rgyar 'ching zhing lhung ba ni rnam par rtog pa'i 'khri ba btsan po'i stobs kyis yin pas na de gcod dgos so/ /de gang la 'khri na sems nyid kyi ngang du rnam par rtog pa'i sems la 'khri ste/ don dam par sems nyid la 'khri zhing bcing ba med kyang rnam par rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khri ba ltar snang ba ni/ mkha' la sprin 'khrigs pa ltar mi rtog pa'i rang zhal bsgrib cing / ji bzhin mthong ba la bar du bcad pa'am 'khri ba zhes bshad do/ /gang 'khri na bdud bzhi po'o/ /ji ltar 'khri na/thogs bcas kyi rigs ni sems dang ༷la 'brel bas 'khri ste/ de yul du byas

g.yu khog blamachoosadabyingasarangagrolagyiogasunga'abum/ oṃpa lasachags sdang dang gnad 'jigs mang pa skye ba yin pas sa/ /thags med niyid kyi 'khri ba ste yid la lam gyis shar ba tsam po de yal bar ma dor bar chedachera'adzin pa'i dbang gis kun nyon sna tshogs 'phel ba'o/ /dga' zhing spro ba'i bdud ni zhen pa'i 'khri ba ste/ gang zhen pa de la des 'ching ba phag la mi gtsangababazhin no/ /nga'o zhes sogs su snyems pa'am bdag tu rtog par byed pa'ibadud ni bdag bdag ces 'dzin pa'i yul grub grub mo 'dra ba de'i tshul gyis zhakhri'o/ /des na gzung 'dzin gyi 'jug pa dbyings su ma nub bar du thogs bcas la sogs pa'i yul de dag gi snang ba tsam mi khegs kyang / snang yong mi bden zhing bden par bzung na bdud kyi rgyar 'ching ba'i tshul can du shes nas der 'dzin pa'am 'khri ba chod pa ni lam gyi gcod dang / mthar goms pa klong du gyur pa na snang zhen thams cad grol te chos sku chen por ro mnyam pa ni 'bras bu'o/ /de lta na'ang 'khri ba ji ltar gcod snyam na/ gang 'khri rgyu'i yul bzhi po de la der 'dzin gyi dbang gis de dag yal bar ma dor bar dang du blang bas na 'khri ba byung ba'i phyir/ yul de dag rang bzhin med par nges pa'i sgo nas de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar phaṭaḥ ces brngod pas ling gis bskyur te ro mnyam chen por gnas pa ni 'khri ba bcad pa ste/ /de ltar 'khri ba chod pa de la yul bzhi po'i gnod pa rgyu ba'i go skabs med do/ /zhes gsungs/ bdud bzhi lam du 'khyer tshul ni/ ma ri na'i sgra las bdud ces bya ste/ ma rtogs bar du skyon sdud la/ rtogs nas yon tan sdud par byed pa'o/ /gcod pa'i dus ni sa ma thob pa'i gang zag tshogs lam la gnas pa rnams ni 'jig rten pa'i lam 49

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyin pas/ de'i dus su sems la dbang ma thob pas nad sogs mi 'dod bzhin du 'ong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes ma thob pas 'byung ba bzhi la thogs te/ de'i dus su thogs bcas kyi bdud chod par dka'o/ /thogs med kyi bdud ni sa ma thob kyang gcod yul gyi man ngag dang ldan pas tshogs sbyor gyi dus su gcod nus la/ mthong lam 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yin pas thogs bcas kyi bdud 'byung ba bzhi dang / dug dang mtshon la sogs pa gcod par nus so/ /lam du 'khyer shes na bdud ma yin par bstan pa ni/ thogs med kyi bdud de gcod nus tshe yon tan gyi sgo 'byed pa ste/ nang bde sdug ro snyoms/ phyi ru 'khor 'das ro snyoms par 'gyur te yon tan gyi sna 'dren pa'i phyir bdud ma yin no/ /thogs bcas kyi bdud la brten nas/ nyams len gyi drod thob/ brtul zhugs kyi ngar dang bcas/ rtogs pa gdengs dang ldan pas/rdzu 'phrul 'char ba'i sna 'dren/ gzhan don 'byung ba'i grogs byed pa'i phyir bdud ma yin no/ /snyems byed kyi bdud ni/ nang gi nyams len gyi gdengs thob/dge sbyor gyi drod skyel nyams kyi nus pa rnyed pa de yin la/ snyems byed de med na gcod kyi gdams ngag dang nyams len med pa'i phyir ro/ /las dang po ba rnams kyis gcod byed pa'i dus su snyems dgos te/ cho 'phrul byung ba'i dus su stong nyid lta ba'i ngang du/ gtong phod ling bskyur dang / nyams len gyi zhe gdengs dgos pas de kho na snyems yin te bdud ma yin no/ /dga' brod kyi bdud ni/ gcod byed pa'i dus su na tsha sogs 'gal rkyen gyi bar chad byung na dga' bar lta ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/5rdon de la brten nas 'gal rkyen des
