g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtshogs rdzogs/sgrib pa 'dag las ngan 'dzad/dge sbyor gyi bogs thon/lam gyi gegs sel/bde sdug ro snyoms lam du khyer bas rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob bo snyam pa de ni dga' brod kyi bdud do//gcod kyi brjed tho las/sems tshol gyis gzhi rtsa chod par byas nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la shes pa gtad de dbyings rig bsre ba la sbyar na mi rtog pa'i dbyings de stong nyid kyi rang bzhin du je gsal la 'ong ba yin gyi/gzhi rtsa ma chod par yum don ngo 'phrod lugs med/de nas dbyings rig sre ba dngos la/rig pa phung po'i gzeb kyis btum nas gcer bur 'bud mi thub pa de/dmigs pas rten dang phral te gcer bur bton nas dbyings la sre ba ni/rig pa rten med du phyung nas dbyings rig sre ba zhes par 'gyur te gcod kyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa yin gsungs/sems kyi thig le mas rim nas spar te lus sems bral lugs 'di la rigs drug gnas sbyong yang tshang zhes 'brug chen pas gsungs/de ltar dbyings rig sre ba tshad ldan zhig byung na de'i steng nas gzan skyur byas na lus la rang lus su mi 'dzin par rtswa dang rtsig pa lta bu'i blo 'char bde bas gces 'jin gyi 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod pa'i man ngag gi ral gri rnon po'o//dbyings rig sre ba byang tshe lus sems ma phral bar yum don bskyang na'ang 'dra gsungs/de'ang nam mkha' sgo 'byed dus dbyings rig bsres thog der rtse gcig bzhag/de la mi gnas na gzan skyur gyis zhen 'dzin bcad de/de ka'i ngang la yang dbyings rig sre ste/'di'i dmigs rim thams cad yum don skyong ba'i rnam 'gyur dang rtsal sbyodī yin gsungs/zhes dang /de'ang 'di'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rangagrol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdabyings rig bsre thad/shes pa rten med du bzhag pas glo bur ba'i dmigs rten can gyi blo'i spros pa shas je chung la rim gyis song nas/ rten med kyi shes rig gnyug ma'i cha zhig rjen la bud yod/ de ka bzo med rang babs su bskyang ba las lhag pa ni rdzogs chen khregs chod la yang ma mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs/de yang tshogs zhing sngar gsal bzhin pa'i 'og tu gnod byed kyi gtsos pa'i rigs drug sems can thams cad skad cig gis gsal btab la/ phaṭaX /lus gces 'dzin bor bas lha bdud bcom/ /zhes sogs brngod pa dang chabs gcig rang lus la gces 'dzin gyi zhen pa bor bas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/rang sems kyi ngo bo thig le dkar po sran ma tsam pa zhig spyi bo tshangs pa'i sgo nas nam mkha'i dbyings la thon te dbyings rig dbyer med du bsres nas mnyam par bzhag pas 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ de nas skad cig gis rang rig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mor gyur te dar dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan nga// spyi bor phag zhal gyis mtshan pa'i phyag g.yas pa na nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa'i mtshon byed gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas/ gzugs phung po'i bdud bcom pa thod pa smin mtshams nas bregs te/ g.yon las byed kyi tshul gyis stong gsum dang mnyam par gyur pa'i bhanta thogs pa de nyid/ sku gsum gyi mtshon byed mi mgo'am thod pa'i snyed pu ri rab tsam gsum gyi khar bzhag pa'i nang du stong gsum gang ba'i bam ro de nyid dum bur bcad de blugs/'og nas a thung las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang / steng nas haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan du gnas pa las bduspya rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag ste zhu zhing khol/ 'bru

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasum gyi nus pas o brjod pas ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad rlangs pa sngo dmar gyi rnam pas phyir thon te sbyangs/ āX sa dag pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab par spel/ snyi gis ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod dgu'i longs spyod cir yang 'char ba'i nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen por bsgyur bar bsam la/ 'bru gsum mang du brjod/ de nas rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te/ yar mchod yul dkon mchog sri zhu dang / mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rnams la ma/chod pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshim ste thugs dam bskangs/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis byang nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thob par bsam/ mar rigs drug 'khor ba'i mgron la dkar 'gyed dang khra 'gyed byas pas mnyes nas bu lon dang lan chags byang bar bsam/ khyad par du gnod byed bgegs rigs kyi tshogs rnams la byin pas so so'i gang 'dod pa'i yo byad dang / sha khrag rus pa'i phung por gyur nas longs spyad pas tshim/ lan chags dang bu lon byang /nad gdon dang bar chad gdug sems dbyings su zhi/ rkyen ngan grogs su shar ba dang / 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin rdul du brlags shing lus zag med 'ja' tshon gyi sku dang / sems rtog med chos kyi sku ru gnas gyur/ mthar ma/chod bya dang mchod yul sogs kyis mtshon gzung 'dzin gyi rtog tshogs ma lus pa kun rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i sems kyi gshis lugs 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs nas 'oXnee gsum gyi mtshan ma dang bral ba'i ma

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbacos gzhug ma'i klong du aḥ zhes ngal gso'o/ /drug pa dngos gzhi'i nyams rtogs kyi sgo 'byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la/ rnam bshad padma dkar po las/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi dpal o rgyan chen po de nyid rang byung gdod ma'i chos kyi sku ye nas rnam par grol ba kun tu bzang po dang gnyis su med pa chos sku'i dbyings las lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur lhun gyis grub cing / de'i rang mdangs sprul pa'i rol pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul du shar ba nyid sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi spyod yul las gzhan pa'i yul min/ zhes dang / rang cag gi gnas 'dzam/ bu'i gling 'dir yang sku gcig mtshan brgyad 'phrul mtshan nyi shu sogs kyi bkod pa dang /yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel bar mdzad la/ da lta rnga yab gling du dbus na zangs mdog dpal ri padma 'od steng 'og bar gsum sprul pa'i bkod pa gsum dang / srin po'i gling chen po nyer gcig tu mtshan dang sku yi rnam 'gyur tha dad pa'i sprul pa re rer bzhugs pa sogs kyis mtshon nas/ mdor na chos kyi dbyings kyis klas par masded pa mtha' yas shing / zhes dang / ma 'ongs kla klos nyen pa'i tshe/ stag sham gsang lung las/ pad 'byung nga nyid drag po 'khor lo can/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga rigs ldan dpung dang bcas/ /zhes sogs kla klo mthar byed cing gsang sngags kyi bstan pa spel bar gsungs/ padma bka' yi thang yig las lha lcam la gsungs pa/ sngon tshe snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med: ri bo ta lar mgon po spyan ras gzigs dha na ko shar padma 'byudī gnas sku mtshon tshul tsam la gsum

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi spru/sung 'bum/ oṃdu snang gyur kyangasnye don la dbyer med so sor tha mi dad: chos dbyings gnas su kun tu bozong po dang: stug po bkod par rdo rje 'chang po:ོrdoo rje gdan du thub pa pa nyidaX gnyis med padma nga ru lhun gyis grub 'gra dan kun las byin rlabs rmad po che: zhes dang / bla ma dgongs 'dus sku rgyud shel gyi ri bo las: dri med mtsho gling ge sar rgyas pa'i steng mnga' kyis ma gos padma badzra rtsal bde ba'i ro 'byin lha lcam mnā ra thabs shes bde stong gar gyi dbang phyug mchog rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs bcud 'dus pa ste de yi rtsal las rnam 'phrul du mar snang zhes dang / bla ma sgrub pa'i gsang them gnad yig las:nga bsgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong:nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin: zhes dang / gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter byon snying thig tshig bdun pa'i gsol 'debs las/ gzhan yang skyabs gyur re sa rnams: o rgyan bdag la rdzogs par soms: zhes gsungs/skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ e ma ho/ rang snang lhun grub/ sogs brjod pa dang chabs gcig /'di ltar nam mkhas gar khyab thams cad rang gi snang bas khyab tshad kyi zhing khams thams cad la tha mal gyi 'dzin stangs dbyings su thim pa las rang byung lhun grub tu shar ba'i dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing /dbyibs dang rgyan dang / bkod pa rab tu rdzogs pa zangs mdog dpal ri padma 'od kyi pho brang chen po steng 'og bar gsum sprul pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid gzhi lus kyi dngos po de nyid dpal ri'i zhing gi gtso mo mtsho rgyal yin pas rang nyid der byin gyis rlobs na gu ru'i thugs sdid bskul ba dang / padma 'od kyi zhing la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grolagyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdabang sgyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad che bas ngo bo mtsho rgyal la/ rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar gsal g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin cing / gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'chang ba/ pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la zhabs ga( 4sa brkyang zhing / g.yon cung zad bskum pa'i zhabs sanyis dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku gcer mo dar dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing me tog gi chun 'phyang can no/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa'i sgrib g.yog dang bral ba mtshon byed sku gcer bu/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dga' ba bcu drug dang ldan pa mtshon byed bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/dbyings dang ye shes phyogs med du rgyas pa mtshon byed dbu skra grol ba/ chos dbyings mtshon byed rus pa'i 'khor lo/ mgul rgyan mnyam nyid/ rna cha sor rtogs /gdu bu me long / ska rags bya grub ste rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas spras pa'o/ /de ltar gsal zhing mos gus kyi spyan gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma'i thugs kar rings pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa'i spyi bo'i thad kar/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su sna tshogs padma 'bum brdal/ de'i ze'u 'bru dang tshad mnyam/ pa'i nyi zla'i dkyil zhabor gyi steng du skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rnam par o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyi sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa gzhon nu lo brgyad lon pa'i sha tshugs can/ spyan gnyis lta stangs hrig ger gzigs pa/ sku la nang du rdo rje'i gsang gos dkar po dang / de'i steng du rim par 'dung ma dmar po dang / bla gos ༵tsag kha/ snam sbyar ngur smig gser gyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃme tog gi ri mos spras pa dang / za 'og gi ber dmar smug rnams brtsegs mar gsol ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i tshul dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na ka pā la'i dbus su 'chi medaye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe'i bum pa dang / gru mo g.yon du yum mnā ra ba sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum gyi rnam par bsnams pa/ dbu la 'dab ma lnga pa dang ldan pa'i padma'i mnyen zhu gsol zhing khro 'dzum mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor kun tu 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub cing / 'od lnga'i zer thag gi dra ba mig mang ris su 'brel ba'i nang khongs 'ja' 'od kyi thig le zlum por 'khyil ba'i klong du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs ye shes chen po'i rnam rol las shar ba'i rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ bod kyi grub chen rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs pa rnams dang / rgyud sde chen po drug dang 'brel ba'i yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ gnas nyer bzhi/ yul so gnyis/ dur khrod po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa sprin gyi phung po gtib pa ltar bzhugs shing / de thams cad kyang gsal stong zung 'jug chu zla dang 'ja' tshon lta bu tha mal gyi shes pa rang 'gags su 'gro bar gsal btab/ zhes zhabs drung rin po ches na bza' sogs gong 'og gi go rim legs par bsdebs pa 'di nyid gsal bde ba yin no/ /hūṃ o5 rtin yul gyi sogs/ tshig bdun gsol

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adebs mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te bskul bas rnga yab dpal ri sprul ba'i zhing nas o rgyan padma thod phreng rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa til gyi gong bu kha phye ba bzhin/ lho nub kyi mtshams nas yer gyis byon te dam tshig pa dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par blta'o//tshig bdun 'di yi rnam bshad ni/ padma dkar po las/ phyi gsol 'debs dkyus ma'i tshig don bshad pa/ nang sbas don grol lam dang thabs lam ltar bshad pa/ yang gsang thun min rdzogs chen 'od gsal snying thig gi dgongs pa ltar bshad pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ hrīX bdag lus zhing gi sogs/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lus tha mal ba'i tshul gyis zhing gi rdul snyed du rnam par sprul te de rnams dang lhan cig tu khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyang mi'i gzugs su gyur te sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal bar gsungs pa dang /dngos su bshams pa dang / yid kyis kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin mkha' dbyings khyab par sprul zhing ting 'dzin zab mo'i mthus/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cog mchod pa'i phyag rgyar dmigs te 'bul ba'o/ /tshe rabs gabor ba thog ma med pa nas sgo gsum gyis bsags pa'i mi dge ba'i kha na ma tho ba'i las rnams kun kyang / gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags pas sdig sgrib thams cad rang gi lce thog tu nag phung gis 'dus pa la/ tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer byung ba phog pas dri ma bklus pa bzhin dag par bsam la phyis mi byed par gnyen pos ༵ma pa kun rdzob dang / rjes la sdig pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃrang bzhin gyis ma grub par shes nas 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du sdig lhung dbyings su bzhag nas bshags pa ni don dam mo/ /kun rdzob dang don dam pa'ibaden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi dge ba'i tshogs kun la dga' zhing phrag dog med par rjes su yi rang ba dang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la rigs can gsum gyi gdul byar/ nyan thos dang / rang rgyal dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa gsum lasabartsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar de srid du sku mya ngan 'a sa mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa dang /de ltar bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba kun/ sems can thams cad byang chub chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur yongs su bsngo ba ste/ yan lag bdun gyi dmigs pa rnams dran bzhin pas phyag dang bcas te lan ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ /khrid yig dran pa nyer bzhag las/ hrīḥ bdag lus zhing gi rdul snyed duḥ sogs brjod cing 'di'i khongs su phyag 'bum yang 'gro bar byed pa lag len yin no/ /zhes gsungs/phyag skyabs 'gro dang sbrel ba ni gzhan lugs yin no/ /bzhed pa 'ga' na/thun mthar tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas sprul ba rnams sprul gzhir bsdu zhing / sems can rnams 'od du yal nas tshogs zhing la thim par yang gsungs/ phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs shing rgyud rdo rje bzhi'i ngo bor bsgrub pa la/ dang po dngos grub bsgrub pa ni/ rje btsun gu ru sogs/ 'di ltar thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa ni rang 59

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsemasalhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs pa la rag las shing / rtogs pa skye ba bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / byin rlabs 'jug pa mos gus kyi rten 'brel kho na la rag las pas na/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid yon tan gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas dang mnyam zhing / bka' drin gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas las kyang ches cher lhag par thag bcad/ nges shes bskyed/ mi pham rin po ches/ de yang rang lugs rdo rje rtse mo'i grub mtha' snyogs mi snyogs kyi gnad ni/ thos bsam rgya chen po dang bsags sbyang phyi tshul sogs ji ltar phun sum tshogs par byas kyang / de kho nas thun min lam gyi grub mtha' zin pa'i nges pa med cing / rdzogs pa chen po'i don brgyud dang ldan pa'i bla ma/ sems nyid chos skur ngo sprod pa'i man ngag snyan khung du brgyud nus pa/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i mi yi tshul du bstan pa'i bshes gnyen chen po de lta bu gang na yod kyang / yon tan de kho nas sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par rnyed dka' ba'i 'du shes kyis sgo gsum g.yo zol med par gus pas bsten nas thugs mdzod lon pa de gcig pus rdo rje snying po'i grub ma/tha' snyogs pa 'byung bas na/ rgyal ba rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pas yang yang gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags snying po'i lam 'tshol ba rnams kyis bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes la myong ba can bsten par bya ba las/ gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pa 'di kho na mi shes su mi rung ba'i gnad yin pas/ rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi lam ma nor ba 'di la lam nyid du ngo shes pa'i nges shes su la ldan pa de la gsang sngags snying po'i skal ba yod pa'i phyir/ thob grangs dang bzlas grangs bla ma mang po bsten pa'i grangs tsam 60

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnig la blo gdeng mi 'cha' bar/ rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa'i man ngag zab mo dpal ldan bla ma'i nal nas mnyan te/ de la nan tan snying por bya ba 'di kho na/ bshad bshad kyi snying po/ sgrub sgrub kyi 'bras bu/ btsal btsal gyi don po yin pas gnad 'di ma stor bar gyur pa cis kyang gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje btsun ma hā gu ru rin po che khyed ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus mthu rnams kyio byin rlabs thams cado gcig tu 'dus pa'i dpal dang ldan pa/ sems can yangs kyi skyabasadang mgan gcig pur gyur pa la/ bdag gis gces par bzung ba'i lus dang / de gso bar byed pa'i longs spyod/ blo snying brang gsum dang bcas pa chags zhen gyi ltos pa med par khyod la 'bul zhing gtad pa yin pas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ skyid sdug legs nyes mtho dman kun ci byung yang rje btsun chen po padma 'byung gnas khyed kho na mkhyen no snyam pa'i re ltos ling bskrur gyi tshul gyis lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba/ mig nas mchi ma 'iXgrag pa/ blo sna bla mas phrogs pa/ bsam sbyo1 bla ma las med pa/ lus sems tshugs mi thub pa'i mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ rje btsun gu ru rin po cheḥ sogs/ grangs bsogs tshul gyi bzhed srol la/ sngon 'gro'i khrid yig dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rje btsun gu ru rin po cheḥ khyed ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs nas/ rje btsun po pad 'byung mkhyenaX yan chad tshar ci nus bzlas rjes bdag la re sa gzhan na medaX ces pa nas/sgrib gnyis sbyongs shig nus mthu canaḥ6din chad tshar 'os mtshams kyi rjes su/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasol 'debs rgyud bskul gyi rnal 'byor badzra gu ru la chig sgril du bya gsungs/zhabs drung rin po che'i bzhed tshul ni 'di nyid ltar yin no/ /dpal sprul rin po che'i dngos slob mkhas grub chen po dpal gyi seng ge'i bzhed pa la/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dus/ dang po skyabs 'gro'i tshul du/ rje btsun gu ru rin po cheX sogs ci nus brjod/ de nas sirnyi brgya re song mtshams lan re brjod/ de ltar thun gcig la bsnyen pa ci tsam bzla ba'i sum gnyis tsam song nas/ dngos grub bskul ba'i dus su/ bdag la re sa sogs/ sirnyi phreng skor re'i mchams su lan re brjod gsungs/ bla ma lung rtogs kyi phyag bzhes la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs skabs/ ḍa dril 'dra yod na dkrol/ tshar bdun dang lnga gsum sogs mos gus ma skyes bar 'don/ spro na/ hūṃ bzhengs shig padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sogs dang / nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa lasaḥganas mchog 'di ru byin phob laḥ sogs brjod/ bla rnam skabs nyin rer le'u bdun ma tshar re 'gro dgos pas/ le'u bdun ma'i le'u re re bton nas/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung ltar bsogs dka' na/ rje btsun gu ru rin po cheX sogs nas pad 'byung mkhyenaX bar lan gsum brjod de sirnyi stong phrag re'i mtshams rje btsun gu ru tshar gsum re brjod/ de ltar thun gcig gi phyed tsam song nas stong phrag re'i mtshams su/ bdag la re sa gzhan na medaX sogs tshar gsum re bton nas sirnyi bzla/ thun grol tshe brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs man chad 'don dgos gsungs/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dus su/ rje btsun / 2ru rin po cheX sogasanas/ rje btsun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchenapo pad 'byung mkhyenaḥ bar song nas/ gsol 'debs rgyud bskul gyi 'dzab badzra gu ru kho na la 'bad/ sirnyi brgya re song mtshams/ rje btsun gu ru rin po che ༷ la sogs pa sngar lta ra bya/ de ltar bsnyen pa ci tsam bzla ba'i phyed tsamasong nas/ dngos grub bskul ba'i dus su/ sirnyi phreng skor re'i mtshams su/bdag la re sa gzhan na medaḥ sogs nas/ sgrib gnyis sbyongs shig nus mthu canaX yan chad tshar re bya/ zhes gsungs/ dngos grub bskul ba ni/ bdag la re sa sogs/ bdag la ni bla ma rin po che khyed ma gtogs skyabs gnas re sa gzhan na med do/ /da lta mi dge'i las stobs che ba'i dus ngan zhing / bsod nams dman pas srog rgud pa tshe yi snyigs ma/ khyim pa'i dge phyogs rgud pa nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma/ rab byung gi dge phyogs rgud pa lta ba'i snyigs ma/lus rgud pa sems can gyi snyigs ma/ longs spyod rgud pa dus kyi snyigs ma ste snyigs ma'i 'gro ba bdag cag rnams/ shin tu mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi 'dam du byings ba 'di las myur du skyobs shig ma hā gu mā sku bum dbang / gsung gsang dbang / thugs sher dbang / dbyer mi phyed pa tshig dbang ste dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzod cig mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba'i byin rlabs can/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan spor cig brtse ba'i thugs rje can/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa myur du sbyongs shig nus mthu can zhes 'dod don gsol 'debasadang / oṃ ni sangs rgyas sprul sku'i snying po/ āX ni sangs rgyas longs sku'i snying po/ hūṃ ni sangs rgyas chos sku'i snying po/ badzra ni rdo rje ste dbyings rig dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shesdu so/ /rnam bshad padma dkar po las/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgu ru ni yon tan thams cad kyis lci ba bla ma ste gong na med pa/ padma ni o rgyan chen po'i mtshan gyi thog ma/ sirnyi ni don du gnyer bya mchog thun gyi dngos grub/hūṃ ni dngos grub de lta bu stsol cig par don gyis bskul ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes rdo rje gsum gyi sa bon gyis thog drangs te/ badzra ni mtshan rtog gi spros pas mi phyed pa'i phyir chos kyi sku dang /gu ru ni de'i ngang las kha sbyor yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i yon tan gyi khur lci bas na longs sku/ padma ni de'ang so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rig gdangs gsung padma'i rigs su shar bas na sprul sku ste/ de lta bu'i sku gsum dbyer med pa'i bla ma o rgyan por yon tan rjes su dran pas/ sems kyi gshis spros pa dang bral ba'i rang rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba'i ngang nas gsol ba gdab cing / de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthu las/ sirnyi ste mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad/ hūṃ zhes bdag gi shes rgyud la dus da lta nyid du stso la cig snyam pa'i don dran par bya ba dang / skabs su phyi snod kyi 'jig rten zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang / nang bcud kyi sems can o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshom bu/ sgrar grags pa thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra/ gsang ba sems kyi 'phro 'du rang grol bya lam rjes med du shes pa'i ngang nas bzlas pa la 'bad/mthar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi yon tan dran bzhin du brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho/ rgya chad phyogs lhung / sogs nas/ stsol zhes pa'i bar dang / 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi smon lam la/ rab tshe 'dir grol bar smon pa ni/srid las nges par sogs/ tshe 'dir ṭwāṃd pa 'khor ba'i gnas las nges par

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'abyung ba'i zhen log gis/ rdo rje'i bla ma don dang ldan pa dpral ba'i mig bzhin du bsten nas/ de yis ci gsung gi bka' bsgrub cing gdams pa zab mo'i nyams len la ltem rkyang ste thang lhod med pa'i bsgrub tshugs zhe rus kyi sgo nas/bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i byin rlabs thams cad bdag gi rgyud la 'pho bar shog cig /snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kyi gnas tshul ye nas dag pa rab 'byams 'og min gyi zhing du lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis gtan la phabs te/ tha mal ma dag pa'i snang zhen lha skur rdzogs pa dang / sgra grags bde chen sngags su dag /dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur smin te dag rdzogs smin gsum mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ spang blang bya rtsol med pa'i rdzogs pa chen po shes nyams yid dpyod las 'das pa'i snang nyams rang byung rig pa'i rang gdangs chos nyid mngon sum gyi snang ba dbyings thig rig gsum rjen par mthong bar shog /dngos 'dzi na mtshan ma'i rtos/ pa 'a sa rnam par grol ba'i 'ja' zer dang thig le'i sbubs su/ sku phyed dang rkyang pa dang 'od lnga'i thig le'i tshom bu nyams kyi snang ba gong du 'phel ba dang / rig rtsal yongs su rdzogs te rang snang longs sku'i zhing sku pho brang gsum lam snang du shar te tshad la phebs pa dang / chos can gyi snang ba mtha' dag chos nyid kyi klong du zad nas blo 'das 'ong gsal chen po'i dbyings su sangs rgyas te/ gzhon nu bum sku'i gnas/ lugs mngon du gyur nas gtan srid zin par shog /dbang po 'bring bar dor grol bar smon pa ni/ shin tu tshal 'byor sogs/ tshe 'dir 'bad rtsol chung bas shimyo/ tu zab pa'i rna' 'byor snang bzhiX sngi shes rang gi nyams 'og tu ma chud pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃde yis/ rags lus dwangs ma'i dbyings su ma grol na/ nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed bsdu ba'i tshe/ 'chi ba 'od gsal ka dag chos sku'i dgongs pa shar nas rang ngo shes te sangs rgyas pa dang / gal te der grol bar ma gyur na chos nyid bar do'i snang cha sgra 'od zer gsum sogs rang snang du ngo shes nas longs spyod rdzogs skur grol ba dang / de ltar ka dag khregs chod dang lhun grub thod rgal zab mo'i lam gyi rtsal rdzogs nas de gnyis gang rung du ma pang du bu 'jug pa lta bur gnyis med kyi tshul du grol bar shog cig /dbang po tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du grol bar smon pa ni/ gsang chen 'od gsal sogs/ gsang chen 'od gsal theg pa mchog gi rtse mor gyur pa/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol bar sems nyid chos sku'i rang zhal mngon du gyur te gdod ma'i sa la ma grol na/ yun ring ma bsgoms kyang sangs rgyas pa'i chos mthong grol tsakra ste 'khor lo/ thos grol zhi khro'i rgyud dang gzungs sngags sogs/ myong grol dam rdzas/ reg grol btags grol dang mu tra/ 'phrad cing dran pas grol ba 'pho ba dang lnga'i lam mchog rnams la brten nas rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing khams/shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba/ lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa/ nub phyogs padma brtsegs pa/ byang phyogs las rab grub pa/ dbus phyogs me ri 'bar ba ste rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing mchog lnga dang / khyad par rigs 'dus zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi pho brang du/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi gtso bo mchog tu gyur pa o rgyan gyi rjes/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa'i sasdu/ sras kyi thu bor skyes nas las nyon

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃsdug bsngal ma tha' dag las dbugs dbyung ste rang don mthar phyin/ mtha' yas khams gsum 'gro ba'i mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi nyer 'tshor bdag nyid 'gyur bar shog /de ltar smon pa'i legs tshogs 'grub par byed pa'ang /rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu yis/ dal 'byor gyi lus rten 'di la rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi rten 'brel mngon du gyur nas don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog /dngos grub zhu ba ste lam dbang blang ba ni/ gu ru'i smin mtshams nas sogs/ padma 'od du bgrod pa'i them skas las/ dbang len skabs 'dir 'khor gyi bla ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyang gtso bo dang dgongs pa gcig tu bzhugs nas dbang skur ba'i mdzad pa la thugs gtad par bsam na byin rlabs kyi tshan che bar rtogs so/ /zhes gsungs/ snying po'i don gsal las/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas gtso bo gu ru rin po che la thim/ de'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal/ zhes gsungs/ zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/ mos gus gdung shugs drag po byas pas 'khor rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa las dbang bzhi ngag 'don gyi dkyus nas gsal ba ltar blangs rjes bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med du bsres te rang sems rig stong rjen pa skad cig ma'i ngang mdangs brkyangs nas bzlas pa bya/ zhes gsungs/ gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad kyang 'bum phrag brgya tham pa kho na'o/ /ṭwāoṃ rje slob dpon gyis dbang bzhi yongs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrdzogs bskur zhing smin par byas pa ni gzhi'i dbang dang / de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe rang nyid kyis dbang bzhi len pa ni lam gyi dbang dang / mthar thug 'bras dus kyi 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob nas sangs rgyas pa ni 'bras bu'i dbang ngo / /mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ nam zhig tshe yi sogs/ nam zhig tshe yi dus byas pa'i tshe/ rang gi snang ba thams cad lho nub rnga yab gling zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing / snang stong zung 'jug sprul pa'i zhing khams mngon sum du gsal ba'i dbus su/ gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od kyi rkyen las/ gsal zhing 'tsher ba'i 'od kyi gong bu ru gyur nas/ rje btsun chen po padma 'byung gnas dang rang rig dbyer med bde ba por sangs rgyas te/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba po dang / rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid zung du 'jug pa'i rang rtsal cho 'phrul gyi ye shes chen po'i rol ba las/ khams gsum gyi sems can ma lus pa thar ba dang rnam mkhyen gyi sa la 'dren pa'i ded dpon dam pa mchog gi sprul sku ru rje btsun padmas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad du gsol/ gsol ba yid khyed shes kyi dad pas snying gi dkyil nas 'debs pa lags kyi/ mchu 'dab rlung gis bskyod pa'i kha tsam dang drig tsam ne tso'i 'don pa lta bu ma yin no/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs kyang zag med thugs kyi klong nas stsol la/ bsam pa'i don kun chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zab don bdud rtsi'i nying khu las/ zhes brngod pa dang chabs cig rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa ni/bla ma la gdung ba drag po'i rkyen gyis baspyag nyid la thugs rje'i 'jug pas lhag

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpar dgongs te/zhal 'dzum pa dang spyan rjes chags su g.yo ba'i ngang thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po drod tsha lam pa zhig thon/rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying khar reg pa'i mod la lus sems bde phril gyis song mthar dmarapobadebachenapo'ingoborazhunas rlungasemasaganyisamedakyiranga'ad / bzhin 'od kyi gong bu sran smu/ tsam du gyur/de nyid kyang mthar me stag yal ba bzhin gu ru rin po che'i thugs kar 'dres pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag/de las ldang ba'i tshe dwangs pa 'i chu las nya 'phar ba bzhin gzhi lus zhing khams kyi bkod pa dang bcas sngar bzhin gsal la/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che//bdag gi spyi bor padma'i gdan bzhugs la//sogs/gsol 'debs bsngo smon spyi dang /zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam dpal ri'i gsang lam yang gdab/thun mtshams rnams su thun mong 'khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor bzlas dmigs kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin dang /khyad par bza' btung gi phud bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dang /gos lha rdzas kyi na bzar bsam la spyi bo'i bla ma la 'bul/tshogs drug gi snang bar bzang ngan legs nyes gang shar yang tha mal gyi rtog pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar lha sngags ye shes kyi rig gdangs rgyun bskyang /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe rang gzhan thams cad kyi don du gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma dang /khyad par sku gsum zhing khams sbyong ba'i smon lam gyi mthar/spyi bo'i bla ma tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar yer gyis byon nas/rang gi snying padma 'dab bzhi'i rnam par gnas pa'i nang du byon/de'i 'od zer gyis rang lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba'i gsaX sdum me ba la sems gtad de/bla ma'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres pa'i ngang nyams len gyi rgyun brkyangs te gnyid log pa'am/ yang na 'od zer des phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gsal ba la phog pas lan tshwa chur bcug pa bzhin 'od du zhu/nang bcud sems can lhar gsal ba la thim/ de rang la thim/ rang snying ga'i bla ma la thim/ de yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal du sbyangs pa'i snang ba nang gsal rig stong rjen pa thim la ma rmugs pa'i ngang du rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ra khams gso/ gal te sad na 'phro rgod rgya 'byams rmi lam sogs bsam gzhig gi 'phro bcad de 'od gsal gyi ngang mdangs khyab gdal du brkyangs pas gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang rmi lam zin par 'gyur la/ slar yang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin thun bzhi sogs su nyams su blang ngo / /gzhan yang nam 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ rdzogasarim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas dbyings rig bsres te mnyam par bzhag pa ni 'pho ba thams cad kyi rgyal po yin cing gal te 'pho ba ma theb na bar dor 'byer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor dran pas grol bar 'gyur la/ mdor na mos gus dang dam tshig rnam par dag pas sngon 'gro'i lam 'di kho na mthar phyin pas kyang dngos gzhi la mi ltos par rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor dbugs dbyung / dag pa'i zhing khams der rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i lam nyi zla'i bgrod pa las kyang myur bas kun tu bzang po'i sa la phyin par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o/ /de lta bu'i sngon 'gro'i tshul la nyams myong skyes pa na/ rim gyis dngos gzhir bum dbang gi lam rig 'dzin zhi drag gi bskyed rim/7/sang dbang gi lam rlung dang gtum mo/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsher dbang gi lam sbas don thabs lam/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam la khregs chod dang thod rgal yan lag dang bcas pa rnams la nyams len snying por dril nas tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du brnyes pa'i thabs la'abad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / ༈'od gsal rdzogs klong chen snying tig gi/ /sngon 'gro'i bsdus 'grel kun las btus pa yi/ /chos spyin spar gyi 'phrul chen bskrun pa'i dges/ /bdag gzhan mkha' khyab yid can rgya mtsho kun/ /tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan bla ma'i drung / /'bral med man ngag zab mo la bañtsās nas/ /sa lam rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin te/ /zung dro/ṭwāṃ ṇḍaṃsnyi ༵ bye'// go 'phang myur thob shog /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sabo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༄7/ /sngon 'gro'i zhal rgyun zin bris su bkod pa mdor bsdus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i thog mar rang rgyud kyi kun slong la brtags pa gal che zhes yang yang gsungs/ kun slong de la dge ba'i kun slong dang / mi dge ba'i kun slong / lung ma bstan gyi kun slong dang gsum/ dpal sprul rin po che sogs dam pa du mas gsung ni red/ mi dge ba'i kun slong ni 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi blo dang ma bral ba zhig yin pas des kun nas bslang ba'i lus ngag gi las ni ltar snang tsam la/ 'jigs skyob dang / legasasmon sogs dge ba lta bu re yin na yang dam pa'i chos yang dag pa'i phyogs tsam la mi 'gro bas dug can gyi zas bzhin nam yang spang dgos/ lung ma bstan gyi kun slong ni dge sems sdig sems gang gis kyang ma bsgyur bas gang du'ang lung ma bstan pa bsgrub bya bsgom bya zhig yin par shes tsam gyis chos de la 'jug 'dod kyi blo de yin pas des ni gang bsgrub kyang thar ba'i sa bon tsam yang med par dpal sprul rin po'i ches gsungs/ gang zag dbang btsan du byas/ chos dbang btsan du byas na thar ba'i sa bon tsam yod srid gsungs/ bla ma lung rtogs tshang gis thar ba'i sa bon tsam zhig e mi yod gsungs/ des na lung ma bstan gyi kun slong de bcos pa gal che/ dge ba'i kun slong de la yang rang don sgrub pa'i kun slong dang / gzhan don bsgrub pa'i kun slong gnyis las/ rang 72

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdon bsgrub pa'i kun slong de yang rang 'dod yid byed kyi blo dang ma bral ba'i phyir na/ de yang gzhan don bsgrub pa'i dge ba'i kun slong yang dag pa zhig gis rtsis zin pa zhig dgos/ de nas bla ma mkhyen gsum ni/ chos sku'i bla ma dri med 'od zer zhes sogs sku gsum dang sbyar te bshad tshul dang / lta sgom spyod gsum dang sbyar te bshad tshul sogs mang po yod kyang / 'dir sku zhogs brag dkar chen po'i zhal rgyun ltar na so byang sngags gsum dang sbyar te gsungs pas/bla ma mkhyen dang po'i dus su 'khor ba'i gnas 'di'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das par shes nas 'khor ba 'di las thar ba'i thabs shig bla ma dkon mchog gsum po khyed ma 'chug snyam nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa dang 'brel te gsol 'debs kyi tshul du 'bod dgos/gnyis pa'i skabs su khams gsum 'khor ba na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha mar ma gyur ba gcig kyang med pas pha ma de dag thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog gsum po khyed shes snyam nas byang chub kyi sems dang 'brel te 'bod dgos so/ /gsum pa'i skabs su phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gnas tshul la ye nas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las ma 'das par shes nas de ltar du rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyis rtogs pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog gsum pos byin gyis rlobs shig ces snang srid rnam dag gi lta ba dang 'brel te gsol ba 'debs dgos/ yang na lubor baṭwāṃ zhen log gi nges 'byung de nyid rang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgazhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig /de bzhin rgyu gzhan phan don gnyer byang chub kyi sems rin po che de nyid rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig /snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang de nyid rang gzhan sogs— shig snyam na'ang chog gsungs/༈ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i skabs su don chen gtan gyi 'dun ma mi bsgrub par don med chud zos su gyur ba'i blo sna de ldog bya/ dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi lus zhig rgyu dpe grangs gsum gyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' tshul/rnyed na don che ba sogs sgom par byed pa ni ldog byed kyi thabs sam man ngag yul gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du song ba'i sgo nas ldog pa'i tshul/ tshad ni spyan snga ba lta bu'o/ /mdor na chos gzugs gnyis kyi bsgrub gzhi tshang ba zhig dgos/ de ni phar phyin theg pa ltar na sbyin sogs thabs kyi cha lnga pos gzugs sku'i sgrub gzhi/ shes rab kyis chos sku'i sgrub gzhi byed/ sngags bla med spyi na bskyed rim sgyu lus sogs kyis gzugs sku'i sgrub gzhi/ stong bzhi'i drang ba'i 'od gsal dga' bzhis drang ba'i ye shes sogs kyis chos sku'i bsgrub gzhi/ 'od gsal rdzogs chen ltar na gzhi khreg chod kyis lho~X // la/ma du byed/ lhun grub thod rgal gyis gzugs sku lam du byed pa yin ༈ 'chi ba mi rtag skabs/ rtag 'dzin gyi blo ngan de ldog bya/ phyi snod nang bcud sogs rags pa rgyun gyi 'gyur ba dang / phra ba chos nyid kyi tshul la bsam pa ni ldog byed/ tshad ni dge bshes kha ṭwāṃg pa lta bu'o/ /mdor na skye 'chi'i bar

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlaga'agyel zhing 'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa ma zin bar bsgom dgos gsungs so/ /de nas rje mi las/ nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas ri la phyin sogs gsungs pa ltar/ skye 'chi'i mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa las 'das pa skye 'chi bgres rgaX ༷༷༷ sdud dang bral ba gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po mngon du gyu/ ri ladī rgyu /dī~Xs/ skabs/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i blo ldog bya/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa rnams chud mi za gsungs pa ltar rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa dang / de re re la'ang byed pa rgyu mthun/ myong ba rgyu mthun/ rnam smin sogs myong tshul la bsam te las rgyu 'bras bslu med du bsgom pa ni ldog byed/rdoṭwāoṃ ṭwāṃ shā ༵ /ṭwāṃ ༵ lta/ bu/ mdor na kun 'byung lam bden du ma shar bar ༈ 'bor ba'i sdug bsngal skabs/ srid pa'i dpal 'byor 'di ji ltar skyid kyang ngoms pa'am/ tshim pa med cing / ji ltar sdug kyang skyo ba'am sun pa med pa'i blo de ldog bya/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar du 'bor ba'i gnas gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das par bsgom pa ni ldog byed kyi man ngag /tshad ni glang ri thang pa lta bu'o/ /mdor na sdug bsngal lam bden du shar nas sdug bsngal ci tsam bsgoms kyang sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam med par gang snang thams cad bde ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du shar ba dper na bla ma zhang rin po che lta bu zhig ma byung gi bar du bsnom dgos/ sngon byon gyi dam pa gong ma zhig yin na 'khor ba/ ḍin tshogs yid smon gyi gnas ci tsam

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmathong yang dper na dwa phrug mas mthong ba ltar thugs skyo lhung nge 'gro zhing /srid pa'i dpal 'byor rnams rtsa rtse'i zil ba ltar 'jig pa'i chos can/sprul gyi pags pa ltar 'dor ba'i chos can/sbru ma'i grong khyer ltar 'jig la khad pa/chu yi lha ba ltar snying po med pa/rmi lam gyi longs spyod ltar sad la khad pa zhig tu gzigs ni red gsungs/mdor na sang nyin nam lang pa dang nga tsho phyi ma'i yul du 'gro ba gnyis las gang snga snyam nas dang /do dgong nyi ma nub pa dang nga phyi ma'i yul la 'gro ba gnyis gang snga bsam nas yid skyo lhung nge snang ba 'jigs zing nge ba'i ngang nas dam pa'i chos khe chung re ci nas kyang e 'grub blta |gojo snapy-i sdo dī/ma gyis kyang mi chog par skyabs 'gro dgos/phyi pa nang pa skyabs 'gro'i khyad gsungs pa ltar/skyabs 'gro zhig med na skyabs bral mgon med kyi sems can zhig yin pas skyabs 'gro zhig nges par gal che/de la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dus gang zag skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul dang bzhi yod pa las/dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru rin po che de nyid spyi bor bzhugs yod snyam nas gsal btab pa de yin/spyir rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas phyi sgrub bla ma'i rnal 'byor/nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa/gsang sgrub thugs rje po sdug bsngal rang grol/yang gsang thig le rgya can/shin tu gsang ba ye shes bla ma ltar bsgrub tshul dang /klong pas/phyi sprul sku ltar bsgrub pa/nang longasasku ltar bsgrub pa/gsang ba chos sku ltar bsgrub pa/yang gsang ༷6 shes ltar bsgrub tshul sogs yod kyang /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adir yul gsal sla ba'i phyir dang rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la myur tu skye bar 'dod pa'i kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom dgos gsungs pa ltar byed pa la mtshan dpe zhal phyag sogs bskyed rim ltar gsal mi dgos te gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa/ /de'i mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ /gsungs pa ltar yin zhing khyad par gu ru rin po che nyid kyis zhal nas/ nga nyid gang zag sus dran na/ lus la bzang ngan na so la rga gzhon/ lus la pho mo med par dran pa po'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs yod gsungs pa de shes dgos/ spyi bo'i gtsug na rig bdag gi tshul dang / mdun mkhar na bzhugs pa gnyis gang ltar bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med tshul grub chen rin po ches gsungs/ snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bla ma zer ba gtso bo gu ru rin po che yin tshul zhabs drung rin po ches gsungs/ des na ya ki rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i rang la yi ge slob pa'i slob dpon yan chad kyi dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi bla ma/ gnas yul zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro rgyud sde bzhi drug gi yi dam/ chos sku'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i chos sku'i sangs rgyas/ longs sku'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i longs sku'i sangs rgyas/sprul sku'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i sprul sku'i sangs rgyas dang lung rtogs kyi bsdus pa'i dam chos/ theg dman nyan rang gi dge 'dun nyan thos zung bzhi ya brgyad theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun tshogs sbyor nas rgyun mtha'i bar du bzhugs pa dang / der ma zad sngags kyi dge 'dun chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyang dge 'dun gyi khongs su bsdus/ khyad par rdo rje spun grogs rnams la brtse gdung yid la ma byas par nyin zhag ṭwāṃ bar chod na dmyal bar 'gro dgos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasungs pa'i phyir na skyabs su dran pa gal che/ dam chos tshig bzhi gcig snga phyi byas nas zhus na phu bo nu bo lta bu dang / mnyam du zhus na mtshe ma lta bu/ dkyil 'khor bla ma gnyis ka gcig yin na pha ma gcig pa'i bu'i 'du shes/ dkyil 'khor gcig cing bla ma tha dad na ma gcig pa'i bu spun gyi 'du shes/dkyil 'khor tha dad cing bla ma gcig yin na pha gcig pa lta bu'i 'du shes dgos/ mched grogs rnams ni 'grogs yun ring ba byang chub snying po'i bar/'grogs bde ba gos dang ske rags mar me dang me lce lta bu zhig yin par shes dgos gsungs/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa la sogs— gsungs pa ltar chos gcig ston pa'i slob dpon yan chad bla mar 'dzin dgos/ der ma zad jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi lugs ltar na rang la dge sems nyag ma zhig skye ba'i rkyen khyi dang bud med kyis byas nag sa dang rdo yi byas na snang ba brda yi bla ma yin pas de yang 'dus par shes dgos/ mdor na phyi rol rtags kyi bla ma'am mtsho byed dpe yi bla ma de la brten nas mtshon bya don gyi bla ma'am gnyug ma ye shes kyi bla ma de nyid sad dgos/ de ltar skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru rin po che de nyid mngon sum du bzhugs yod bsam pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ dus 'di nas bzung ste nam zhig na phyi byang chub kyi shing drung du mnyam par bzhag /nang khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po mngon du ma/ gyur bar skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus yin/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag /skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul ni 'khor ba'i gnas 'di me yi 'ob/ dug sgrul gyi khrod/ khab kyi rtse/ /ḍi mo'i gling ltar bde ba'i go skabs spu

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtsamayang med par shes nas sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis las thar 'dod kyi ngesa'abyung gi bsam pa zhig dgos/ sdug bsngal 'di las skyobs pa'i nus pa zhigabla ma dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs brtse ba'i pha/ byams pa'i ma/gces pa'i bu/ mdza' ba'i grogs/ gzhan yang ri yi lha/ shing gi lha/ 'jig rten mthu bo che tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs gang la'ang med par shes nas skyabs su 'gro dgos/ de'i steng du byang sems ltar na dang 'dod yid ches kyi blo dang / sngags ltar na tha mal ma dag pa'i snang zhen las skyob dgos/ rgyu mtshan dper na bla ma dkon mchog gsum la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ skyob pa'i nus mthu tshad med par shes nas/ gnas gang du bsdad/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang / mtho ru gtong ngam/ dma' ru gtong ngam/sgyid na sdug na legs na nyes na bla ma dkon mchog gsum po khyed las re sa skyabs gnas med snyam pa'i yid ches pa'i dad pa brtan po zhig yod pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul yin te/ jo bo rjes skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo i thi ba zhes yid ches pa'i dad pa zhig gal che gsungs/ spyir chos thams cad kyi sgo dbye ba skyabs 'gro/ skyabs 'gro'i sgo dbye ba dad pa yin pas dad pa brtan po gal che shā~X /su/ ḍiṭwāṃ kāos/ me/da gling pas blo bla mar gtod pa skyabs 'gro yi mthar thug/༈ de nas theg pa che chung sems bskyed khyad gsungs pa sems bskyed med na theg dman du 'gyur ba'i phyir na sems bskyed dgos/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la brten nas don dam sems /kyaid sad dgos/ don dam byang chub kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol kyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsems ni bde gshegs snying po yin te/don dam zhes pa chos kyi dbyings dang sems zhes pa 'od gsal ba'i ye shes la go dgos/ 'dir smon sem/sa ni sems can thams cad rnam grol gtan gyi bde ba la 'god pa'i slad du bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob par bya bsam pa'i rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed de yin/ spyir sems bskyed la gtsor 'don byed tshul/ gsar rnying sogs bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang yang don la rang don yid byed kyi blo dang ma 'dres na sems bskyed mchog yin gsungs/ de'i ched du lam zab mo la 'jug pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed yin/ de ltar skyabs yu' de dag gi mdun nas sems bskyed pa sogs ni thog mar dge ba skyabs sems yin/ de nas bla ma'i gnas gsum las rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo o dkar āḥdamar hūṃ mthing gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag cing bum gsang sher gsum gyi dbang thob/ mthar bla ma nyid 'od du zhu nas lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa dag cing dbang bzhi pa drig dbang rin po che thob par bsam pa ni dbang bzhi dang 'od zhu yin gsungs/ de ltar bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems ye nas dbyer med yin snyam pa'i thugs yid dbyer med bsre/ thugs yid dbyer med bsres pas byin rlabs 'jug /dge sdig gtong len byas pas sdig sgrib 'dag gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan/ rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar re dran pa'i stobs kyis dad pa legs po re skye na/ de'i rang dus de na8 ḍis gsum yid kyi 'grul rtog se long

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlcags kyirgyomaduod bzhino du 'thor/ bying rmug gnyid gsum/ nyams zhen gyi shunapa/ bza bcas kyi gas gzugs kyi dri ma/ phyi nang gi gtad sa/ /zhabrul ba'i drim sprin chen nam mkhar dengs pa bzhin du dengs/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag 'dzin thams cad snang ba'i mdun na mun pa 'dug longs med pa bzhin rang grol rang zhig la song ba dper na sbrul gyi mdud pa rang zhig ltar 'gro/ sgo lngacha mnyam du bzhag na yul lnga po 'gal med du tshur shar ba yin/ de lta bu mnyam bzhag de dag pa nam mkha' lta bu/ sang ba me tog lta bu/ dang pa rgya mtsho lta bu rang babs kyi bsam gtan de lta bu zhig shar tshe phar la blo yis ma bsgom/tshur la dran pas ma bcings/ thol skyel rbad chod/ dran pa'i rjes sleb/gnyen pos 'bur 'joms/ gnas pa'i ngang skyong sogs ma dgos par/ lta ba yun thub/ bsgom pa yang thub/ spyod pa rkyen thub/ rang ngo 'phrod pa lta ba/ngang la gnas pa bsgom pa/ gang shar rang grol gyi spyod pa zhes lta sgom spyod gsum gnad gcig tu 'dus pa yin/ lta ba'i gnas dag /sgom pa'i rmang zhig/spyod pa'i la dor/ de dus 'dod yon lnga sogs yul gang snang yang mi zhen pa sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ dus gsum yid kyi zhabrul ba'i dri mas ma gos pa tshul khrims/ zab mo 'i don la mi skrag pa bzod pa sogs phar phyin drug dang dran pa nyer bzhag yang dag spong bzhi sogs dkar chos kyi yon tan thams cad ngam ngam lhun gyis grub/ ye shes gsal yang mi 'dzin pas gzugs khams las grol/ thugs rjes rig kyang mi 'phro ba 'dod khams las grol/ ngo bo mi rtog kyang ye shes kyi gsal cha ma 'gag pasdu1 gzugs med khams las grol/ ldog

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchas dbye na stong ba nam mkha' lta bu/ gsal ba nyi zla lta bu/ rig cha mig 'bras bzhin du hrig ge ba'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa sku gsum gyi nyams zer te/ sku gsum nyams ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhes gsungs pa dang / rgya grol snang ba nam lang nyi shar 'dra/ /chos sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags/ srid gsum ka dag gi lta ba/ khams gsum yongasasgrol gyi bsgom pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa/ sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu/ de las mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig sogs kyang yin/ der ma zad bskang rdzas rdul tshon gyi thig le/ 'gul bskyod ye shes kyi phyag rgya sogs gang snang ci spyod thams cad ye shes kyi rol ba/ chos nyid la chos nyid rol/ zas zos kyang 'gag med du myong / zhen med du rol/ rten med du grol bas tshogs chen ye rdzogs kyi dgongs pa/ de lta bu'i dgongs pa dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba dang ma bral ba zhig yin na gegs dang gol sa gtan nas med gsungs/ de min gnas na dwangs cha med na zhi gnas kyi snyigs ma/ gsal na lhod cha med na gsal 'dzin gyi 'ching ba/ 'gyu na grol cha med na zhakhrul ba'i rjes bsnyegs yin pas gzab dgos/ bzang rtog shar yang mtha' grol klong yang / /ngan rtog shar yang rang shar rang grol zhes/ grol rgyu de la bzang rtog ngan rtog bar ma do'i rtog pa gsum las/ bzang rtog grol zhes pa ni dge sems de'i dmigs med kyi dod kyang thub/ dmigs med mtshan nyid pa ni 'phags pa la 'jog dgos/ de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang bcas pa'i thun yun thung la grangs mang ba zhig gal che/ de ltar sbyor doXs rjes gsum nyin re lan drug cu re

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlnga'am/ yang tig nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig las gsungs pa ltar brgya dang nyeralngatsam re mi chag par 'gro dgos/ las dang po bas yun thung la grangs mngab byed dgos tshul/ o rgyan rin po ches/ yun thung grangs mang khang stong thig pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar yin/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong zhid las so nam/phyug gi 'tsho skyong / dkor kha grong chog /tshong khe so nam sogs rnam g.yeng dag gis nyi ma nam tsa zad yod pa zhig mi byed par/ mtho la kha/ dma' lung khung /nyi ma nyin byed/ zla ba mtshan byed/ gnas gang du bsdad/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo gu ru rin po che de nyid/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom zhing dbang bzhi blang / snying gi dbus su bsgom zhing thugs yid dbyer med bsre zhing bsam rgyu bla ma las med pa/ blo sna bla mas 'phrog pa/ gang snang bla mar shar ba zhig ma byung gi bar du bsgom nus na phyi mar srid pa bar do'i skabs su bla ma byon nas dbang bskur zhing ngo sprod/ yi dam gyis gegs bsal/ mkha' 'gros bar chad las bskyabs te grol bar theg mchog mdzod las gsungs/ mdor na da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal/ gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi thob/sangs rgyas las kyang 'phrad par dka' ba sngags rdo rje'i theg par 'phrad yod dus 'dir/ padma can gyi mtsho la ngang pa dang / dri zhim partswa'i tshal du bung ba rgyu ba bzhin du dga' spro dang bcas te 'jug rigs so/ /sngon 'gro sems kyi khang bu bshigs pa de la/ rtsal bcad pa/ mtshang btsal ba/ rtogs na bdag 'dzin rlom sems nga rgyal sogs mtshan 'dzin gyi 83

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrtog pa thams cad dwangs se ltod se 'gro ba la zer ba yin/ de ltar ma shes par bzang rtog thams cad med 'gro dgos pa zhig la gtan bzung mi rung ngo //dge sems de nyid 'di nas ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du 'gro dgos nges pa can yin/ yang nas yang du gsungs/ 'khor ba zhen log gi nges 'byung /gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byang sems/ snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang / bka' drin can la mos gus/ yon tan can la dad pa sogs dge sems rnams ni 'di nas byang chub kyi bar du gong 'phel du 'gro dgos/ rtogs ma rtogs rkyen dang bsres/ goms ma goms mtshan mo'i gnyid la dris/ gsungs pa bzhin grol dka' tshul mang du gsungs kyang ma bris/ mdor na grol zer rgyu bo phyi snang ba ma spang snang thog nas grol ba bye'u chung khras khyer ba lta bu/ nang 'gyu ba ma spang 'gyu thog nas grol ba chu la ri mo bris pa lta bu zhig dgos gsungs/ de ni bar du dge ba dngos gzhi thugs yid dbyer med yin no/ /mthar ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya ma ral gong / bying rmug gnyid gsum dang zhabrul ba'i dbang du ma/ shor gong du bsngo ba byed pa gal che bas na/ bsngo ba'i dpang po rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mdun du/ bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsa bdag gis dus gsum na sgo gsum gyis bsags pa dang / gzhan la byed du bcug pa dang byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge rtsa dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu blo yis bsdom nas dper na mig can gyi gzugs mthong ba bzhin du mngon sum du 'dra ba zhig dmigs/ bsngo yul sems can thams cad mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du rgyal ba sras bcas kyi ji ltar bsngo ba de bzhin du 84

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbadag gis kyang bsngo bar bya zhes dpag chen gyis mda' 'phang ba bzhin du blo thetshom med pa zhig dgos/ de ni bsngo ba rjes mthun pa tsam yin/ 'khor gsum byung gnas 'gro gsum la brtag pa gsum las/ dang po 'khor rtsa dngos ngos bzung ba dper na rkun po ngos 'dzin lta bu'i gdams pa yin te/ 'khor ba ya mtha' thug med/ de bzhin du sems can ma mtha' thug med/ 'khrul ba ya mtha' thug pa med pa zhig nas/ nyi ma de ring gi bar du 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir rdza mkhan gyi 'phang lo bzhin du sngun na khrid mkhan dang rgyab na 'ded mkhan med par dbang med du 'khyams pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo sems yin pa'i rtsa gdar legs par chod pa de yin/ mtshang btsal ba ni de nyid gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rig pa yin la/ gsum pa ni/ byung sa gnas sa 'gro sa ste yul gsum dang / byung mkhan gnas mkhan 'gro mkhan ste yul can gsum po dbu ma'i gtan tshigs ltar dpyad tshe yul dang yul can thams cad snang bzhin du stong la/stong bzhin du snang ba'i snang stong zung 'jug gi nges shes skyes tshe nges shes de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag na dbu ma'i lta ba las/ khyad chos yod ces grub rin po ches nyag rong gter ston la gsungs pa yin la/ de ni mtha' bzhi'i 'dzin stangs med pa'i rtags su ngo bo'i dbyings las shar cha 'gags med du shar ba dang / lta ba yang dag pas rang rgyud khyab pa'i 'bras rtags su gang shar thams cad bag chags bsogs long med par grol ba yin gsungs/ de ltar sha zin spu zin gyi tshig ris so/ /de yang gol sa gsum ni/ kun gzhi ni shes pa lung ma bstan kha phyir ltas kyi shes dī/ ngo bo rtog med rnam pa dwangs gsal/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsnod bcud rgya chen po ‘ spru dmigs pa/ i snang na snang / i 'dzin na mi 'dzin/phyi'i yul la ma gtad/ nang du ma bsgom/ bar du ma bzhag zhagil ni ma yin/dub cha dang / 'thibs cha sogs gang yang med pa ngo bo kun gzhi rnam pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ dper na btsas ma thag pa'i byis pa'i snang ba bzhin du/ yul snang sgo lnga'i rnam shes yul la ma mched pas ka bum sogs kyi bye brag mi shes pas 'di yin pa ni yin min gyi stangs ma byed pa yin/ klong chen pas/ mi zhig dka' ba'i shugs kyis rtog rgyun 'gag pa kun gzhi yin gsungs/ tha mal pa rnams dka' ba'i shugs dang 'jigs sngangs dang dran brjed kyis dus su kun gzhi de nyid rkyen gyis bskyed ni red/ rnal 'byor pas bsgom stobs kyis bskyed ni red/ lhag mthong thams cad kyi rgyal po 'od gsal ba'i rig pa yin te/gzhan du chos thams cad bden stong gi shes rab dang 'gyu cha la grol cha yod pa sogs lhag mthong la rnam grangs mang gsungs/ ci la gnas dang ting nge 'dzin rkyen med dang / bdag med gnyis rtogs kyi stong nyid dang / rdzogs chen pas 'od gsal gyi ngang la gnas pa sogs ci yang med pas so/ /dbang shes lnga'i nang na mig shes la yid shes kyis grogs byas nas nam mkha' la gtad pas phyi'i nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i nyams 'char gsungs/ de yang rig pas ngang bskyangs kyang sgom yun ring na rig pas sa phud nas mig shes la zhen te nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i nyams 'char/ rtags ni ri mthon po'i rtse dang nam mkha' dwangs pa dang / khang pa'i sgo dang skar khung phye ba'i dus su sngar las kyang dwangs gsal gyi rnam pa 'char ni red/ mig sdusam pa dang / gnam ngo zhabrugs pa dang /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmunarub kyi dus dang sgo dang skar khung bcad dus 'thib cha byung ba ni mig shes la gol ba'i 'bras rtags yin/ stong gsum mun par 'khrugs kyang nga mi 'thib/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don rmi lam dang bar do'i 'od gsal sogs gang du'ang zang thal du shar ba yin te/ de 'dra'i yul rkyen gyi gos pa mi srid gsungs/ gegs sel ni/ ri mthon po'i rtsar dang / mig btsums pa dang /sngon du gyang log gi bcad nas sgom dgos gsungs/ ye shes ni/ mngon sum rtags la ma brten par/ /rjes dpag 'byung bar mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang yul 'phrad dus dbang shes kyi yul mngon sum red/ ye shes kyi yul rjes dpag yin kyang ye shes kyi yul rnams rang mngon sum yin snang shar kyang mngon sum ma red/ rjes dpag red/ rjes dpag gi yul shes na de shesargyud gcig yin ni yin gsungs/ ye shes kyi nyams bde gsal mi rtog gsum dang / de gsum gang yang shan ma phyes pas stong had had po dang bzhi po 'di yid kyi yul myong bya yin/ myong byed de rnams 'dzin mkhan gyi yul can yid shes yin gsungs/ nyon yid ni nyams rnams gang rung la chags shing zhen pas 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i 'dod chags/ rtsub nyams dang mi bde ba sogs byung na de la 'dor ba'i rnam pas mnar sems can zhe sdang / 'dor len gyi rnam pa min pa'i bar ma'i rnam par rtog pa gti mug /de lta ba'i kun gzhi lung ma bstan dang / sgo lnga'i rnam shes las mig phyes che bas mig shes dang / yid bde gsal mi rtog gsum dang de gsum shan ma phyes pas stong had had po dang bzhi po 'di gol sa chen po gsum yod de/ ṭwāṃng gi nyams len dang gol sa de rnams

nor mi nor brtags dpyad legs par byed pa shin tu gal che/ res 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag /res gong gi gsum po sems thog tu blangs te bsgom nas res mos byas te bsgom pas gong gi gol sa de rnams dang 'dres ma 'dres kyis shan legs par 'byed pa yin no/ /dge'o dge'o dge'o/ /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༄7/ /klong chen snying tig gi sngon 'gro'i bsdus don dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal lung bzhugs so//brgyud gsum bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ de la 'dir theg pa thams cad kyi rtse rgyal/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i myur lam/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa po'i man ngag /ba//da gsum dpal mgon bla ma'i zhal lung / kun mkhyen rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams kyi dgongs pa'i klong mdzod nas rdol ba'i klong chen snying thig gi sngon 'gro 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la/༈ bshad bya'i yan lag bshad pa dang / bshad bya dngos bshad pa dang gnyis las/ dang po bshad bya'i yan lag bshad pa la'ang kun slong dang kun spyod gnyis las/ dang po kun slong la'ang bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong / thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong dang gnyis las/ dang po bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong ni/ dmigs pa rgya che ba mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bral bar 'dod pa/ don rgya che ba sems can de dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par 'dod pa/ snying stobs rgya che ba sems can gcig gi phyir du mnar med du 'jug pa la padma can gyi mtsho ru ngang pa zhugs pa lta bu'i dga' spro dang bcas pa/ dus rgya che ba 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan don kho na lhur len pa yin la/ de ltar rnam dkar sdo9 chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsems rin po che yin tshul shes par byas nas rang re so so'i skye bo'i skabs 'dir chos bsgrub pa'i thog mar rang rgyud la legs par brtags nas kun slong byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du 'chos pa ni shin tu gal che ste/ ji skad du/chos rnams kun gyi dang po mgo/ /rgya gar skad mtshungs rang rgyud la/ /legs par brtags pa yin no zhes/ /zla med bla ma mchog des gsungs/ /zhes dang /slob dpon dpa' bos/ 'gran phyir ma yin grags pa 'dod phyir min/ /mtho ris 'dod dang rgyal srid sgrub phyir min/ /bdag gi bde ba mchog thob phyir min gyi/ /gzhan don bsgrub phyir bdag gis 'di brtsam mo/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas kyang / rtsa ba sman du mchis na myu gu'ang sman/ /rtsa ba dug yin myu gu smos ci dgos/ /bsam pa dge dang mi dge'i bye brag las/ /dge sdig gzugs brnyan che chung rjes mi 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya che chung ji lta bu zhig bsgrub kyang kun slong byang chub sems kyis zin pa'i sgo nas rang bde yal bar dor nas ma rnams bde ba'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos te/ rin phreng ba las/ phyogs rnams kun tu nam mkha' dang / /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /ji ltar nam mkha' de bzhin du/ /sems can sdug bsngal mtha' yas 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'di ltar nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab/ sems can gyis gar khyab las nyon gyis khyab/ las nyon gyis gar khyab sdug bsngal gyis khyab/ sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i 'gro ba sems can 'di rnams spyir 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar du rang gi pha mar ma sdisdu pa gcig kyang med la/ khyad par mir

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgyuraba'idus su da lta'i rtsa ba'i ma 'dis rang re rnams la gces spras ji ltar bgyis pabazhin du zla dgu ngo bcur lus la bzung / de nas phyir btsas pa'i dus su skyugs bro ba'i gnas su gyur ba de yang ma drin mo che des tsham tshom med par pang du blang / rgyab kyi phru ma bshus/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ lus kyi drod la bcar/ mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis bsus/ sor bcu'i rtse la g.yeng / zas zhim mngar gyi bcud kyis gsos/gos dro 'jam gyis brtse zhing byams pas g.yogs/ phan pa'i bde ba mtha' dag ni bsgrubs/ gnod pa'i sgo du ma las bskyabs/ dka' tshegs dang sdug bsngal thams cad khyad du bsad nas drin chen pos yang yang bskyangs pa'i drin chen sha stag yin la/ drin chen de dag rnams kyis 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu chos dge ba bcu ni sgrub mi shes/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang de'i rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba bcu spang mi shes pa yin te/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song bas lam log mgo meongs su gyur nas long ba thang dkyil du lus pa lta bu'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje/ bdag da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang mjal/ yang dag pa'i chos la spyod pa 'di skal ba bzang bas le lo dang phyi bshol gyis dbang du mi gtong bar twenee pa'i chos zab mo 'di lta bu nyams su

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃblangs te ma rgan sems can thams cad rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags thams cad dang bral te rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa ni bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub sems kyi kun slong yin te/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ gang la rang don sems pa yod min na/ /bkres pa zas dang skom pa chur gdung bzhin/ /sems can 'ba' tnapa rshorsha sdo shā~X shāram̐/ rnoo////go 'phang gnyer la byang chub sems zhes grags/ /gnyis pa thabs rgya che ba gsang ba sngags kyi kun slong ni/ zhi ba rin chen drwa ba las/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin can yin kyang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i zhakhrul ba'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'khrul snang rang sar grol te snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i rang bzhin du ngo 'phrod nas tshe lus gcig gis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob pa'i phyir du bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i lam la bslab par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed dgos pa yin te/gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ ma ni yid ces bya ba ste/ /tra ni skyob par byed pa'i don/ /zhes dang / tshul gsum sgron me las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'asdupy-is/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtheg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis kas bsgrub bya sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa don gcig na'ang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ni/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par bzhis 'phags te/ sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i tshul la ma rmongs pa dang / gnas lugs kyi lta ba myur du mthong ba'i thabs mang ba dang / lam bde zhing myur bas dka' tshegs med pa dang / gang zag dbang rnon rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i 'bras bu mngon byed kyi thabs zab mo yin te/saskru ṭi las/ bskal pa bye ba du ma rtswa /bsgrub dka' ba yi sangasargyas kyang / /tshe 'di nyid la ster bas na/ /'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / padma'i rtse mo las/ shin tu dka' bas mi 'grub pa/ /skad cig yang dag sbyor ba'i phyir//rgyu sngon song la ma ltos par/ /gnad las 'bras bu 'byin pa'i phyir/ /'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pas phyi snang ba'i bden zhen bzlog pa la sgyu mar bsgom pa la sogs pas 'byung ba'i rig pa la meongs pa dang / nang phung po lhar ma shes pas gnas pa don la rmongs pa dang / gsang ba rtog tshogs dang nyon mongs pa ye shes su ma shes pas lam gyi rnam pa la rmongs pa dang / snang stong gi chos rnams dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med du ma shes pas rtogs pa'i lta ba la meongs ba yin no/ /'bras bu sngags kyi theg pas phyi 'byung bar snang ba yum lnga dang / nang phung por snang ba yab lnga dang /rtogs tshogs byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid ye shes lnga dang / bden pa dbyer med snod bcud dag mnyam ye nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams chen por 'dod pa yin te/ sgyu 'phrul gsang ba /ṭwāṃ po las/ rdo rje phung po'i yan lag 'di/

g.yu khog bla ma chospodabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /zhes dang / sa chu spyan dang mā ma gī/ /me rlung gos dkar sgrol ma nyid/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /srid gsum ma lus sangs rgyas zhing / /thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi rnyed do/ /ces so/ /'di dag gi rnam bzhag zhib tu shes par 'dod na kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung 'bum las shes par bya'o/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir du chos 'chad pa'i gnas dang ston pa la sogs pa tha mal ma dag pa'i snang bar mi blta bar phun sum tshogs pa lnga gsal 'debs dgos pa yin la/ de yang gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang / ston pa phun sum tshogs pa chos sku kun tu bzang po/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa nyid las mi gzhan pa'i rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ chos phun sum tshogs pa brda tshig blo las 'das pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa dus bzhi mnyam nyid chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i dus/ yang na gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rnam par snang mdzad/ chos phun sum tshogs pa theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig /'khor phun sum tshogs pa sa la gnas pasdi byang chub sems dpa'/ dus phun sum tshogs pa rtag pa rgyun gyi 'ukhor lo/ /(kan yang na gnas phun sum tshogs pa wā ra ṇa sī drang srong lhung pa ri dwags la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i nags/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa shākya thub pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa bka' bden pa bzhi/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lnga sde bzang po lha brgyad khri dang bcas pa/ /ṭwāṃ phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas mngon

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃparadzoogs par sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun lon pa'i dus so//yangan gnas phun sum tshogs pa bya rgod phung po'i ri/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa shākya thub pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/'khor phun sum tshogs pa shā ri'i bu la sogs pa dge slong lnga stong tsam dang / skye dgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa'i dge slong ma lnga brgya dang / khyim bdag mgon med zas spyin la sogs pa'i dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma la sogs pa rnams so/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong dang ded dpon dam pa la sogs pa bye ba phrag khrig rab tu mang po rnams so//dus phun sum tshogs pa lo bcu gnyis su gsungs pa'o/ /yang na gnas phun sum tshogs pa lha klu dang rgyal po'i khab la sogs pa dang / ston pa phun sum tshogs pa shākya thub pa'o/ /chos phun sum tshogs pa nges pa don gyi 'khor lo/'khor phun sum tshogs pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams so/ /dus phun sum tshogs pa lo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du'o/ /(ba)yang na chos 'chad pa'i gnas de nyid zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi pho brang / chos ston pa'i bla ma de nyid o rgyan padma 'byung gnas/ chos nyan pa'i 'khor rnams kyang rig 'dzin rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ bshad par bya ba'i chos gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa/ bshad pa'i dus rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo ste phun sum tshogs pa lnga ye nas yin pa la yin tshul shes pa'i sgo nas gsal 'debs dgos pa yin la/ ma yin pa zhig gzod gsal 'debs pa ni min te/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i rang bzhin du ye nas9 ṭwāṃnas pa yin no/ /de ltar mdo sngags

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrang rang gi chos 'chad pa'i tshe ston pa yang de bzhin du gsal 'debs dgos pa yin gsungs/ de yang 'phags chen rnams kyi snang ngor ni snod bcud rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i rang bzhin can du snang yang / rang re so so'i skye bo rnams kyi blo mig ma dag pa'i dbang gis snod bcud kyi gnas tshul yang dag pa lha'i rang bzhin du gnas kyang / snang tshul la 'brul ba can gyis de ltar du snang mi nus te/ sgyu 'phrul las/ yang dag shes pa'i rang rig blo med na/ /bde gshegs zhing yang ngan song gnas su mthong / /theg mchog mnyam pa'i don nyid rtogs pa na/ /ngan song gnas nyid 'og min dga' ldan gnas/ /zhes pa ltar/ dper na mkhris nad can gyi snang tshul la dung ser por snang yang / gnas tshul la dkar po'i rang bzhin las gzhan du gyur ba med de/rgyud don mdor bsdus las/ rang snang bsam pa ma dag pas/ /mig skyon can gyis gangs nyid la/ /rgyun du nag po mi srid kyang / /nag por dngos su mthong dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / mkhris nad can gyis dung nyid la/ khyun du dkar po nyid yin kyang / /ser bo mthong ba nyid dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / sngon shā ri'i bus sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ma dag par mthong zhing / tshangs pa ral ba can gyis dag par mthong nas gnyis ka brtsad pa na/ sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis zhing dag par thams cad kyis mthong bar mdzad nas nga yi zhing ni rtag tu 'di ltar dag kyang khyed rnams ma mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de yang bla ma ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid/ sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sduḍis rgyas kyi ngo bo ste dkon mchog kun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adus/ sku bla ma gsung yi dam thugs mkha' 'gro ste rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ sku sprul sku gsung longs sku thugs chos sku ste sku gsum kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pa yin te/ de yang sku dge 'dun zhes pa ni/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che'i bdag nyid du bzhugs shing sku'i spyod lam thams cad dge ba dang mthun pa ba spu'i g.yo 'gul tsam gyis 'gro ba mang po thar lam la bkod pa'i phyir dang gsung dam chos ni bka' sde snod gsum dang lam theg pa rim dgu sogs mgul gyi bum pa nas byung / ljags kyi padmo nas bkram/ dung gi tshems bar nas drangs/ gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mtshungs par ston nus shing /khyad par du gang gsungs gzhan la phan zhing / gsung thos pa tsam gyis rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon thebs pa dang / thugs sangs rgyas ni rang bzhin gnas rig gdod nas sangs rgyas yin par ma zad thugs rje ye sprul gyi gang zag da lta mi yi rnam rol du snang ba las don du na gdod nas sangs rgyas yin pa shes par bya'o/ /sku bla ma ni/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa nam mkha'i bla bre lta bu 'gro ba sems can rnams la phan pa'i mdzad spyod ma lta bur byed pa'i phyir sku yi spyod lam kho na la go na ngos 'dzin sla ba yin no/ /gsung yi dam ni/ gang gsungs nyam/sa su blangs te yi dam du bzung nas bsgrub na lam bden snga ma rnams rim par 'dor ba la chu brgal ba'i gru bo dang 'dra ste/ phyi ma'i 'bras bu rnams rim gyis thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de yang yi dam lha'i sku bskyed rdzogs kyi sgo nas bsgrub pa yang chos dang yi dam la lam gsungs pa yin te/ nam zhig longs sku'i rnam rol du sangs rgyas pa9 ḍing / thugs mkha' 'gro ni/ stong nyid

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmakha' la thugs rje shugs kyis 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas thugs rje 'du 'phro nyi ma'i zer bzhin 'gags med du 'char ba'o/ /yang na dbyings rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba bla ma/ gdangs rang rtsal 'gags med du 'char ba yi dam/ gnyis med bde stong gi rnam par rol ba mkha' 'gro'o/ /sku sprul sku ni ma nges pa ste/ dang po gzhon nu'i dus byis pa chung ngu'i tshul gyis 'gro ba mang po la dngos sam brgyud nas phan btags te rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon bzhag /sku che'i lang tsho dar la bab pa'i tshe na gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang mtshungs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas thar ba'i lam la bkod/ de nas re zhig ljongs der gdul bya rdzogs pa'am/ yang na le lo can rnams brtson 'grus bskyed pa dang / snyoms las can rnams chos la bskul phyir dang / rtag 'dzin can rnams de las bzlog pa'i ched dam/ gnas gzhan du gdul bya dus su bab pa gzigs pa'i tshe/ ljongs 'dir mi snang ba'i tshul mdzad nas mtshan dpe zhal bzang gi gzigs pa gzhan du ngoms par 'gyur ba'o/ /gsung longs sku ni/ snga ma'i shugs kyis go sla ba'o//thugs chos sku ni/ dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'o/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /zhes dang /rdo rje phreng ba las dri med sems ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /chos ni ngag tu yang dag gsungs/ /sku ni dge 'dun zhes bya ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i dpal mgon bla / 8dam pa de nyid 'das pa'i sangs rgyas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthams cad kyi sprul ba/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/da lta'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal tshab te/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gis kyang ma thul ba'i rang re snyigs ma'i sems can rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i thugs rje dang / bka' drin sangs rgyas thams cad las kyang lhag pa yin no/ /kun mkhyen chen pos/ sngon gyi rgyal ba grangs med kyang / /bdag cag spangs nas thar bar gshegs/ /da ni phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ /khyod la bskul nas bdag cag gi /don du bla mar rnam sprul nas/ /khyod kyis bdag cag 'dor phod dam/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /rang re chos nyan pa'i 'khor rnams kyang gzhi bde gshegs snying po/ rten mi lus rin chen/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ thabs de'i gdams ngag gis zin pas ma 'ongs pa'i sangs ram̐s su 'dod dā yin te/ kye rdo rje rgyud lha/gas gaṭwāṃs laṭwāṃ/ sems can rnams bye~X sdoḍio ñtsha/sa/ snaṭwāṃ /so//'o/na kyang glo bur mas ba—ba/ / — ma de bsal sangs gnyis pa kun spyod la/ spang bya'i kun spyod dang / blang bya'i kun spyod gnyis las/ dang po spang bya'i kun spyod la/ snod kyi skyon gsum/ dri ma drug /mi 'dzin pa lnga'o/ /dang po snod kyi skyon gsum ni/ rna ba ma gtad kha sbubs lta bu'i snyon/ /yid la mi 'dzin zhabs rdol lta bu'i skyon/ /nyon mongs dang 'dres dug can lta bu'i skyon zhes pa ltar/ dang po chos nyan pa'i dus su rang gi rna ba'i shes pa yul gzhan du mi g.yeng bar chos 'chad pa'i sgra de la gtad nas nyan dgos/ de ltar ma nyan na snod kha sbubarwa ༵'i steng du bcud blugs pa dang 'dra ste

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlus chos gral na yod kyang chos ma thos pa dang khyad par med pa'o/ /gnyis pa de ltar thos pa'i chos de yang yid la ma bzung na snod zhabs rdol du bcud ci tsam blugs kyang chags rgyu med pa dang 'dra ste/ chos ci tsam thos kyang rang rgyud la skyed 'dod med pa'o/ /gsum pa kun slong skyon can sogs chos brgyad kyi bsam pa spangs nas yang dag pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas nyan dgos/ sems nyon mongs pa dang 'dres bzhin du chos la nyan na dper na dug can gyi snod du bcud bzang po blugs pa dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa dri ma drug ni/ dbyig gnyen gyis rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang du sdud/ /skyo bas nyan pa dri ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos 'chad pa'i bla ma las kyang nga lhag snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ chos dang bla ma la ma dad pa'i log lta/ chos thos bsam la don gnyer med pa/sems phyi rol gyi yul la g.yeng ba/ dbang bo sgo lnga nang du sdud pa/ chos thun ring ba so gas kyis sems skyo ba ste 'di dag spangs bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang sdott+woṃkā rdoo/ la/sa drug la sogs pa'i nyes pa sum cu rtsa drug spangs nas nyan gsum pa mi 'dzin pa lnga ni/ tshig 'dzin la don mi 'dzin pa dang / don 'dzin la tshig mi 'dzin pa dang / brda ma 'phrod par 'dzin pa dang / gong 'og bsnol te 'dzin pa dang / log par 'dzin pa dang lnga yin la/ de lta bu'i spang bya'i kun spyod rnams spangs nas/ thos pa'i chos kyi tshig don rnams ya ma bral ba'i sgo nas yid la 'dzin dgos te/1ñtshar rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkyang ma bslab par shes pa/ ma bsgrub par 'grub pa gang gis kyang ma gsungs te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ ma bslab pa ni kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/ /zhes dang / bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su rgyal po byi ling gar ling zhes bya bas chos tshig bzhi pa gcig rna bar thos pa'i phyir du/ lus la lcags kyi gzer bu stong btab pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgyal po ka na shi na sa li zhes bya bas chos tshig bzhi pa gcig thos par bya ba'i phyir du/ lus la mar me stong btsugs pa'i lo rgyus dang / drang srong i ta la zhes bya bas chos gsan pa'i phyir sku lus kyi pags pa bshus te shog bu byas la rus pas smyu gu byas khrag gis snag tsha byas te tshigs bcad rnams bris par mdzad pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgyal tshab da ma gam zhes bya bas chos gsan pa'i phyir du/ me'i dong zabs su khru bcu yod pa'i nang me ma mur gyis bkang ba'i nang du mchong bar mdzad pa'i lo rgyus la sogs pa dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas chos btsal ba yin te/ me tshogs spu gri'i so yang brgal nas ni/ /phyi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal dang de sras rnams kyis thos pa btsal ba'i phyir du brtson 'grus kyis dka' spyad de lta bu zhig mdzad dgos na/ rang cag rnams kyis lta ci smos/ de'i phyir las dang po ba'i dus 'dir thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab gal che ste ma thos par bsam pa dang bsgom pa mi nus te/ mgon po klus/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs na/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon sdosdu' bos/ thos nyung dmus long bsgom

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa'i tshul mi shes/ /de med des ko ci zhig bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /rkun po la sogs mi 'phrog nor gyi mchog/kun nas rmongs pa'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha ste/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa grogs kyi mchog /ces dang / thos dang ldan na 'gal ba med pa yin/ /sde gsum lam la rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sa paṇa gyis/ rang blo shes bya'i gnas la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang de sras kyis/ /shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes legs par gsungs/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang dbang po rtul zhid na so rgas pa dang / tshe thung ba sogs la bsam nas thos bsam byed mi nus pa'am nus kyang long med snyam du sems zhus pa ni mi rigs te/ ji skad du/ rig pa nang par 'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yis/ /nor la rang nyid len dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa la nges shes skye nas thos pa 'tshol bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa blang bya'i kun spyod la 'du shes bzhi dang / phar phyin drug dang / spyod lam gzhan bstan pa dang gsum las/dang po 'du shes bzhi ni/ kun mkhyen pos/ bla ma sman pa gdams ngag sman dang ni/ /rang la nad pa'i 'du shes nyer bzhag snye/ /nan tan brtson pa sman nyid bsten tshul dang / /zhi bde nad las grol ba'i 'bras thob bzhin/ /zhes dang / mdo sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /chos la sman gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o//nan tan nyams su len pa la nad spya 2bar 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par
