g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃbya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o//yang rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag nyid la mgron po'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o//chos la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /nan tan nyams su len pa la 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o//dge ba'i bshes gnyen la skyel ma dpa' bo'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /yang rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag nyid la gru pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /chos la gru'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /nan tan nyams su len pa la chu'i pha rol du phyin pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bzhes gnyen la mnyan pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes dang / phyag bstod las/ ngas ni rab tu bzang po'i chos bshad kyang / khyod kyis thos nas yang dag ma spyad na//nad pa sman gyi rkyal ba thogs pa dag /bdag gi nad ni gso bar mi nus bzhin//zhes gsungs pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa phar phyin drug gi sgo nas 'chad nyan bgyi tshul la/ dang po 'chad pa po slob dpon gyis pha rol du phyin pa drug gi sgo nas 'chad pa ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ tshig don legs bshad chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ /nyon mongs med pa tshul khrims pharol phyin/ /skyo ngal bzod pa spro bas brtson 'grus te/ /ma yengs bsam gtan 'byed pa shes rab bo/ /zhes chos kyi tshig don legs par bshad pa sbyin pa/ nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres par 'chad pa tshul khrims/ skyo ngal bkres skom dang 'khor gyi log sgrub sogs bzod pa'i bzod pa/ 'chad pa la mi skyo zhing spro ba brtson 'grus/ sems gzhan du mi g.yeng padī ༵chad pa bsam gtan/ chos dang chos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmin so sor 'byed pa'am rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ni shes rab yin no/ /gzhan yang chos 'chad pa'i tshe/ nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i sems dang / brda ma 'phrod pa dang / tshig don nor ba dang / tshig mi gsal ba dang /lhag chad du gyur ba dang / dam bca' snga ma phyi mas sun 'byin pa dang / gzhan khyad du gsod pa dang / yul gyi brda skad ngan pa dang 'dres pa/ gdul bya'i blo dang mi 'tshams pa sogs skyon du gyur ba rnams spas nas/ tshig gi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa/ brda gsal bas 'khor gyi khams su khyab pa dang / rna bar snyan pas kun gyis nyan par spro ba/ tshig don nges pas the tshom gcod pa/ dpe don la mkhas pas nyan pa po'i yid du 'bab cing rtogs par sla ba/ gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pas don du 'gyur ba/ lung rigs kyi sgrom nas bton pas nor zhagrul med pa/ go bde zhing tshig bzung bar 'os pa/ skabs su gtam rgyud ngo mtshar can bshad pas nyan pa po rnams mi skyo bar byed pa sogs thabs la mkhas par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i chos bshad pa'i phan yon ni/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa dang / sems can la spyin pa'i mchog tu gyur ba dang / bsod nams 'phel zhing mngon shes thob par 'gyur ba gsum las/mchod pa'i mchog tu gyur ba ni/ mdo las/ gang la phan phyir nga yi chos/ /tshul bzhin bsten pas mchog 'gyur gyi/ /me tog byug pa mar me yis/ /rgyal ba gang dag mchod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyin pa'i mchog tu gyur ba ni/byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo las/ gang gis gaṅgā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing / /rin chen bdun gyis yongs su bkang ṭwāṃsdu nas/ /rab dga'i sems kyis rgyal

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbar 'bul ba dang / /gang gis sems can gcig la tshigs bcad sbyin/ /rin chen sbyin pa shin tu rgya che des/ /tshigs bcad spyin pa snying rje'i sgrub de la/ /char yang mi phod grangs su ma yin na/ /gnyis dang gsum la bsam du ga la yod/ /ces so/ /bsod nams 'phel zhing mngon shes kyang dpag med thob par gsungs pa yin te/ bslab btus las/ chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ shā ri'i bu khyim pa gang gis gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phul ba bas/ rab tu byung bar gyur ba gang gis tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig bstan na/ 'di ni de bas bsod nams mang du bskyed do/ /zhes dang / seṅge sgras zhus pa las/ chos kyi sbyin pas skye ba dran/ /zhes pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ chos kyi sbyin pas ni zag pa zad pa mngon par shes pa'i rnam par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang / rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ 'jam dpal phyogs gang na chos smra ba de 'dug gam/ de'i rus bu'am/ ro bam pa zhig yod pa mthong na yang shā/sna ṅgi /me/da pa'i las lnga rnam par byang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa gnyis pa nyan pa po slob mas kyang nyan tshul ni/ chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las/ me tog stan sogs rab 'bul zhing / /sa phyogs spyod lam sdom pa dang / /srog chags kun la 'tshe mi byed/ /bla ma la ni gsol ba 'debs/ /ma sdi~Xpya bla ma'i gdams ngag nyan/ /dogs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsel phyir na skyon tshig 'dri/ /sgrol ma yan lag drug dang ldan/ /zhes pa ltar/ /chos kyi khri bshams nas gdan 'ding ba dang maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs sbyin pa/ gnas khang phyag dar byas nas dris chag chag gdab pa dang me tog bkram pa sogs spyod lam thams cad chos dang mthun par bya ba ni tshul khrims/srog chags phra mo yan chad la lus ngag gis gnod 'tshe mi byed par chos phyir dka' thub sogs bzod pas bzod pa/ chos dang bla ma la 'phrad dka'i 'du shes bzhag nas dad gus spro dga' dang bcas te nyan pa ni brtson 'grus/sems gzhan du mi g.yengs shing tshig don ya ma bral bar yid la 'dzin pa ni bsam gtan/ the tshom gyi gnas dogs sel gang byung slar 'dri zhing gdams pa'i phu thag gcod pa ni shes rab yin no/ /gsum pa spyod lam gzhan bstan pa la spang blang gnyis las/ dang po 'dul ba lung las/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /mi na bzhin du mgo g.yogs dang / /gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang / /mgo bo dkris pa dag la min/ /zhes pa ltar rang gi sgeg chos su gdugs dang / /'khar ba dang / mtshon cha dang / mgo gos kyis g.yogs pa dang / mchil lham gyon nas 'dug pa sogs spangs bar bya dgos te/ kun tu bzang po'i rgyud las/ mi na ba la mgo g.yogs dang / /dgra med pa la mtshon thog dang / /ma rgas pa la dbyug thogs dang / /tshul dang mi mthun thams cad spangs/ /zhes dang / zhwa mo yod na mdun du bzhag /skra lo yod na mdun du phab/ /lag pa thal sbyar mnyam bzhag bca'/ /lag gis 'du byed thams cad spang / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gardisdu pa skyes rab las/ rab tu dma' ba'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃs la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni rab tu bskyed/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi 'thung ba bzhin/ /rab tu bsgrim te chos nyon cig/ces dang / padma bka' thang las/ nyi ma 'od zer dma' ba'i sa la 'dug /mig gi dbang pos chos smra'i zhal la blta/ /rna ba'i dbang pos ma yengs gsungs la nyan/ /yid kyi dbang pos tshig bzung don la brtags/ /zhes dang / yang rgyud las/ mig gis bla ma'i zhal la blta/ /rna bas bla ma'i gsungs la nyan/ /sems kyis tshig don gtan la 'bebs/ /the tshomi dus su log la zhu/ /zhes pa ltar/ sems zhabrul ba med pa/ ngag ca co med pa/ lus drang por 'dug ste/lag thal mo sbyar zhing 'dzum pa dang bcas pas nyan dgos te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ phyag 'tshal drang por 'dug ste thal mo sbyar/ /ma yengs gus pa'i tshul gyis mnyan par bya/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'dun pa dang bsam pa la sogs pa thos pa'i rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa dang / yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las kyang / thos pa rnam pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang / /ldan byas rab dang gus pa'i yid kyis nyon/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang yon tan sum cu rtsa drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nyan tshul bshad pa'ang yod de/ de lta bu'i nyan pa'i phan yon ni shin tu tshad med de/kun mkhyen chen pos/ chos rnga bsgrags pa thos pa'i sems can yang / ngan song rnam grol nyan pa smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes dang / gaṇḍi'i mdo las/ dam chos bshad pa'i dus bstan phyir/ /rnga'am gaṇḍibardungs pa'i sgra/ /thos pas byang chub thob 'gyur na/ /nyan phyir lhags pa ṭwāoṃḍi ci dgos/ /zhes dang / sngon slob

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdapon dbyig gnyen gyis gzhung 'bum sde dgu bcu go dgu thugs la len pa na nyin mtshan kun tu gsung rab mang po kha bton byed tshe/ gzims khang gi gra zhabs su phug ron zhig yod pas chos sgra de rtag tu go zhing / de tshe 'phos nas mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal po zhig gi sras su skyes so de skyes ma thag tu bdag gi bla ma gar yod ces smras so/ /khyod kyi bla ma su yin dris pa na dbyig gnyen no/ /yul dbus su tshong pa 'gro ba rnams la de 'dra'i bla ma yul dbus su bzhugs sam dris/ de rnams kyis yod do zhes smras/ de nas bu de 'gro bar 'dod nas der bskyal ba dang / de dbyig gnyen gyi drung du sleb pa dang bla ma zhes bos so /kho bo khyod kyi bla ma yin par mi dran no/ /des rang gi sngon gyi tshe rabs dran te smras/ des de rjes su bzung ste klog tu bcug pas slob dpon blo gros brtan pa zhes sde snod gsum la mkhas par gyur to/ /zhes dang / ya ri bcom ldan 'das kyis tshal sngon po zhig na chos gsungs pa na steng gi nam mkha' la bya ngang pa lnga brgya tsam zhig 'phur ba la sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa'i sgra thos nas/der babs 'dod nas babs kyang / bya gsod mkhan rnams kyis ngang ba thams cad bzung ste bsad pa dang / thams cad sum cu rtsa gsum du lha'i bu lnga brgya'i skye ba blangs so/ /zhes dang / yang dge slong zhig gi brang khang gi gdung rtsa na bya the ba gcig nyal ba'i tshang zhig yod pas bya de mtshan mo nyal ba dang / dge slong des tho rangs 'phags pa sdud pa zhal 'don mdzad pa bya thi ba'i rna bar thos pa la der sdud pa res phyed thon tsam na nam langs/ res sum nyis thon tsam na nam langs nas 'phur 'gro bas/ 'phags pa sdud pa'i chos kyi sgra rna bar thos 108

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa tsam gyis bya thi ba de'i sgrib pa srab nas bya de shi ma thag mi lus thob ste/dkon mchog gsum la dad cing rab tu byung / sngar gyi 'phags pa sdud pa rna bar thos tshad slob ma dgos par shes pa zhig byung ba yin no/ /de ltar dud 'gro'i rna bar chos kyi sgra thos pa tsam la phan yon de lta bu yod na/ rang re mir gyur ba ni/smra shes don go mi yi mtshan nyid yin/ gsungs pa ltar 'chad nyan gyi snod du rung zhing nyams su len byar yod pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang po yin no/ /de'i phyir thos bsam la 'bad par bya dgos te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ skye ba snga mar ma bslabs pas/ /tshe 'dir blun por mthong gyur na/ /phyi mar blun por skye dogs pas/ /tshe 'dir dka' yang 'bad de nyan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar phan yon la bsam nas nyan bsam sgom pa gang gis skabs su yang sngar song bag chags kyi rjes su mi 'brang / ma 'ongs nyon mongs pa'i mdun mi bsu/ da lta'i tshogs drug rkyen khar ma shor bar byas nas sems sgrim lhod ran par byed pa gal che ste/ rgyal srasathogs med kyis/ sngon spyad bde sdug chu yi ri mo 'dra/ /zin pa rjes med yin gyi rjes ma gcod/ /cis kyang dran na 'byor rgud 'du 'bral soms/ /ltos thub chos las 'dug gam ma ṇi pa/ /phyi dzis grab shom grog skam nya rgya 'dra/ /bsam pa'i thog tu mi 'bab 'dod 'dun skyungs/ /cis kyang dran na nam 'chi cha med soms/ /chos min bya long 'dug gam ma ṇi pa/ /'phral gyi bya bzhag rmi lam so tshis 'dra/ /'bad pa don med yin gyi skyur la thong / /chos mthun zas kyang zhen med rgya yis thob/ /bya byed snying po med do ma ṇi pa/ /rjes thob dus gsum rtog pasdo 0༷dul sbyong 'di/ /dran snang thams cad

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchos skur ma shar bar/ /med thabs med do dgos dusadran par gyis/ /zhakhrul rtog yan par ma btang ma ṇi pa/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i man ngag rnams kyis rang rgyud sbyang bar ma byas na/ 'dod pa'i yul lnga la zhen cing chags pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal la shā rgyag pa yin te/ mig shes gzugs la chags pas phye leb mar mer 'chi ba/ rna shes sgra la chags pas ri dwags rngon pas gsod pa/sna shes dri la chags pas bung ba me tog tu 'thum pa/ lce shes ro la chags pas nya mo lcags kyus bzung ba/ lus shes reg bya la chags pas glang bo 'dam du bying ba lta bu yin te/ do ha mdzod kyi glu las/ nya dang phye leb glang chen bung ba dang / /'dir ni ri dwags bzhin du blta bar byos/ /zhes dang / de ltar 'dod pa'i yul lnga la zhen chags spangs te/ thos bsam bsgom pa la brtson na phan yon dpag tu med pa yod de/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ thos pas ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs pa/ bsams pas gnas lugs kyi dgongs pa rtogs pa/bsgom pas chos nyid kyi klong du grol ba/ bshad pas rang gzhan gyi shes rab 'phel ba/ nyan pas blo gros kyi padmo rgyas pa/ bltas pas nyon mongs kyi sdig sgrib 'dzad pa/ dbyad pas thar lam gyi byang chub brnyes pa ste/ yon tan dpag tu med pa'i tshogs chen pos legs par brgyan par gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bshad bya dngos bshad pa la/ thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro/ thun min nang gi sngon 'gro/ nyams len dngos gzhi'i cha lag nye lam 'pho ba'i khrid dang gsum las/ dang po thun mong phyi'i sngon 'gro la/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/tshe mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ las rgyu 'bras/ thar ba'i phan yon/110

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃbashes gnyen bsten pa dang drug las/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba la/ngo bo dal ba la bsam pa/ khyad par gyi chos 'byor ba la bsam pa/ rnyed dka'i dpe la bsam pa/ grangs kyi khyad par la bsam pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ngo bo dal ba la bsam pa ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ bdag ni sems dmyal yi dwags ma skyes shing / /dud 'gro tshe ring lha dang kla klo dang / /log lta sangs rgyas kyis stong lkugs pa ste/ /mi khom brgyad po dag las rab 'das shing / /zhes pa ltar/ dmyal ba dang / yi dwags dang / dud 'gro gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal gyis g.yengs te lus mi khom/ lkugs pa ni tshig don la brda sprod pa'i nus pa med pas ngag mi khom/ chos thos bsam la spyod pa'i 'du shes med pas lha tshe ring po dang / 'du shes yod kyang sangs rgyas kyis stong pa'i chos kyi snang ba med pas mun pa'i bskal par skyes pa dang / snang ba yod kyang de la 'jug pa'i blo med pas kla klo dang / 'jug par 'dod kyang sgro skur gyi mthar lhung ba'i log lta can bzhi ni yid mi khom pa ste/ de dag la chos bsgrub pa'i gnas sam skal ba med pa yin no/ /mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad po de dag tu ma skyes pa ni dal ba phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /lha tshe ring po zhes pa ni 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ste/ sems rtog med kun gzhi'i steng du tshogs drug gi shes pa bkag nas sgom pa goms pa ste/ 'dir nyon yid ma bkag pas 'gog pa dang mi mtshungs te/ 'di la so so'i skye bo rnams 'jug cing / 'phags pa rnams mi 'jug la 'gog par 'phags pa rnams 'jug la so skye rnams mi 'jug go nyan rang 'phags pa rnams 'gog pa la bde bar gnas phyir snyoms 111

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpar 'jug pa dang / byang sems 'phags pa rnams ting nge 'dzin la rtsal sbyang ba'i phyir snyoms par 'jug go/ /lha de'i gnas ni/ 'bras bu che ba'i lha gnas dang grong dang dgon pa'i tshul du yod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi 'byor ba la bsam pa la/ rang 'byor lnga dang /gzhan 'byor lnga'o/ /dang po rang 'byor lnga ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /ces pa ltar/lha chos kyi rten mi lus thob pa dang / chos dar ba'i yul dbus su skyes pa dang /thos bsaspra gyi rten dbang po /ོ lnga tshang ba ṭwāṃtna/ lasakyi~Xtha'amasdugapa dang /༵kṣiṃ spya ༵wa kā/ ༵༵ kṇispya ོ༵ ra/ snas bo bya ṭwāoṃ—/ /— rang rgyud — bsdus shang chos grub gnyis pa gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs/bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ ston pa sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa/ des dam pa'i chos gsungs pa/bstan pa'i gnas tshad ma rdzogs pa/ de'i sgor zhugs pa/ mthun rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa ste/ lnga po 'di ni gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus shing chos sgrub pa'i cha rkyen yin pas na gzhan 'byor zhes bya'o/ /de'ang dal ba ni ngo bo yin la/ 'byor ba ni de'i khyad par gyi chos yin te/ de ltar dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i lus 'di rnyed par dka' bas da res chos la 'bad dgos par 'dug snyam pa blo rtse gcig tu dril bar bya dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag 1sdis dge goms ma byas na/ /'di las

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbaslus pa gzhan med de/ /'di las meongs pa'ang gzhan med do/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang 'phral byung rkyen gyis mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang /ris chad blo yi mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad yod de/ dang po 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom rnam pa brgyad ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ dug lnga 'khrugs dang blun rmongs bdud kyis zin/ /le lo can dang las ngan mtsho chen rdol//gzhan dbang 'jigs skyobs chos ltar bcos pa ste/ /'phral byung rkyen gyis mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /thar lam chos kyi snod min phyin ci log /ces pa ltar/dug lnga 'khrugs pa'i nyon mongs pa shin tu rags pa'i rigs can rnams ni/chos sgrub 'dod kyi blo res 'ga' tsam skyes kyang / rang rgyud kyi dug lnga dbang che bas phal cher de'i dbang du song nas chos yang dag pa mi 'grub/ shin tu blun zhing rmongs pa'i rigs can rnams ni shes rab kyi snang ba cung zad kyang med pa de chos sgor zhugs kyang chos kyi tshig don phran bu tsam yang shes mi nus te/ thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i skal ba med/ lta spyod phyin ci log tu ston pa'i bdud kyi bzhes gnyen gyis zin na rang blo log pa'i lam du bsgyur nas dam pa'i chos dang rgyab 'gal/ chos la slob par 'dod kyang brtson 'grus cung zad kyang med pa'i le lo can ni le lo dang phyi bshol gyis dbang du song ste chos mi 'grub/ chos la brtson 'grus byas kyang rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye ba'i sdig sgrib can las ngan gyi mtsho chen rdol ba ni rang byas kyi las 'bras yin pa mi shes par chos la yi chad skye/ rang la rang dbang med par gzhan gyis bran du bkol ba rnams ni chos byed 'dod kyi blo yod kyang gzhan dbang du song nas 113

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasgrub tu mi ster/ tshe 'di'i lto gos sogs gnod pa gzhan gyis 'jigs nas de'i ched du chos sgor zhugs kyang zhe thag pa nas chos la nges shes med pas sngon gyi bag chags rnying pas 'phro mthud nas chos min la spyod/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrub pa'i chos med btsun pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams ni gzhan snang du chos ltar bcos kyang / chos brgyad kyi bsam pas tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer bas thar ba'i lam dang bral ba dang brgyad po de yang chos sgrub pa'i gnas su mi khom zhing dal ba chud gson pa'i phyir phyin ci log tu gyur ba zhes bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad ni/ de nyid las/ 'ching ba dam ldan kun spyod shin tu ngan/ /'khor bar mi skrag dad pa cung zad med/ /mi dge sdig spyod chos la sems pa bral/ /sdom dang dam tshig 'chal ba zhes bya ba//ris chad blo yi mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /chos las ring gyur thar lam sgron me nub/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshe 'di don du gnyer ba'i 'ching ba dam pos rang rgyud bcing ba rnams ni longs spyod gnyen 'dun sogs kyi don du rtsol sgrub kyis g.yengs pas chos byed long med/ rang rgyud ngan pas mi gzhi til 'bru tsam yang med pa dag ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad kyang dam pa'i lam du bsgyur dka'/ ngan song dang 'khor ba'i nyes pa bshad dam tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal ci lta bu la'ang skrag pa'i blo gtad nas mi skye na chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu nges 'byung gi blo rtsa ba nas mi skye/ yang dag pa'i chos dang bla ma la dad pa cung zad kyang med na bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'gags te thar ba'i lam du mi tshud/ mi dge sdig spyod la dga' bas sgo gsum nye bar ma zhi ba1 ṭwāṃ dam pa'i yon tan dang bral te chos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlas phyir phyogs/ yon tan dge ba dang dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba med pa khyi'i sngon du rtsa bzhag pa ltar gyur na chos la spro ba med pas rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye/ thun mo/nga gi theg pa la zhugs nas sems bskyed dang sdom pa ral na ngan song las 'gro sa med pas mi khom pa'i gnas las mi thar/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs nas bla ma dang mched grogs la dam tshig nyams na dngos grub kyi skal ba chad pa yin te/ brgyad po 'di ni dam pa'i chos las ring zhing thar ba'i sgron me nub pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dal ba'i rang bzhin chos nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / 'byor ba bcu ste sum cu so bzhi po 'di dag tshang ngam mi tshang rang rgyud la legs par brtags/ tshang bar 'dug na dga' ba bsgom zhing da res rten bzang yid bzhin nor bu lta bu rnyed pa 'di chud zos su mi gtong bar rang gzhan la phan pa'i chos yang dag pa zhig bsgrub par bya'o snyam nas sems la dam ༵/shā lda ṭīr/ sbya'o tsha/nga/ bar 'dug na thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas tshang ba'i thabs gsum pa rnyed dka'i dpe la bsam pa ni/ rlabs chen pos rnam par dkrugs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i steng gi gnya' shing gi bu ga dang / zhabs kyi rus sbal gyi mgrin pa 'phrad pa las mi lus thob dka' bar bcom/ ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa yin te/ gang las gsungs na me tog gi tshomi las/ mir gyur ba dang dal ba phun sum tshogs pa 'grub pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka' 'o/ /de'i phyir dpe zhig bstan par bya ste/ shā ri'i bu dper na sa chen po 'di rgya mtsho gcig tu gyur te zhes rgyas par gardirdosdu pa yin no/ /de yang dper na stong

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grolagyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur te/ rgya mtsho'i gting na rus sbal long ba zhig lo brgya brgya na chu'i steng du lan re 'ong ba de dang / mtsho de'i khar rmo glang gi rwa sbrel ba'i shing la gnya' shing du grags pa de lta bu'i shing bu ga gcig pa zhig yod pa de skad cig kyang sa gcig tu mi sdod par rlung gis shar nas nub tu bskyod pa dang / nub nas shar du bskyod pa sogs de gnyis 'phrad de/ rus sbal gyi ma grin pa gnya' shing gi bu gar chud pa srid kyi ngan song du skyes pa las slar mi lus thob pa ni de bas kyang dkon pa yin no/ /yang mi lus thob pa 'di rtsig ngos kyi zhal ba 'jam po la sran ma gtor ba chags pa las kyang dka' ba ni zla ba'i snying ngo 'i mdo sogs las gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du me tog u dum wā ra 'jig rten du 'byung dka' ba las kyang dal 'byor gyi mi lus chos ldan rnyed par dka' ba ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ u dum wā ra 'jig rten 'byung dka' ba/ /de bas chos zhugs yang dag lam 'phrad dkon/ /zhes dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ u dum wā ra'i me tog de ni gnas thams cad du mi skye ste/ mtsho ma dros pa'i byang phyogs ri'i rtse na de'i tshal yod pa der skye zhing dus thams cad du mi skye ste/ nam sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa de'i tshe skye'o/ /skyes nas kyang sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas par 'gyur la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe rnying zhing sa la lhags par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa grangs kyi khyad par la bsam pa ni/ kun mkhyen 'jig med gling pas/ sems can tsam gyi grangs dang rim pa la/ /bsam na sdi1 ḍis thob pa srid mtha' tsam/ /zhes pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃltar/ ngan song gsum gyi 'gro ba ni shin tu mang ste/ sa chen po'i rdul bzhin du mtha' yas shing / mtho ris gsum gyi 'gro ba ni shin du nyung ste/ sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam du gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang 'bru'i phung po chen po spung pa'i rming lta bu ni ngan song gi gnas gsum yin te/ grangs mang la sdug bsngal yang che/'bru sbungs pa'i rtse mo lta bu ni mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gsum yin te shin tu nyung ba dang / de dag gi nang nas mi yi 'gro ba nyung / sgos 'dzam gling gi mi nyung /yang sgos chos dang ldan pa'i mi lus ni srid ma tha' tsam ste/ kun mkhyen pos/mi lus nang nas dad ldan chos kyi rigs/ /de bas dkon phyir sangs rgyas thob dang mtshungs/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rnyed par dka' ba'i lus rten bzang po thob pa'i dus 'dir chos bsgrub dgos te/ dper na gru yod dus chu yi pha rol du bsgrod dgos pa dang 'dra ste/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ 'khor ba'i chu gter pha mtha' yas 'di las/ /rin chen gru bo thob dus ma brgal na/ /gtan tu nyon mongs sdug bsngal rba klong du/ /rab tu 'khrugs tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la brten nas su/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /meongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces so/ /de ltar rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob nas da res thar ba'i lam sna ma zin na/ rin chen gser gling du phyin nas stong par log pa dang 'dra ba la bsam nas chos la 'bad par bya dgos te/ kha rag pas/ dal 'byor mi lus rin po che/ rnyed par dka' ba thob pa la/ /thob pa yal bar ma gtong bar/ /gtan gyi so nam gyis shig e/ /zhes so/ /117

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃganyis pa tshe mi rtag pa'i khrid la/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa/ nang bcud kyi 'gro ba la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa/dam pa'i skyes bu la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa/ skye dgu'i bdag po la bsams te mi rtag pa bsnom pa/ dpe don sna tshogs la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa/ 'chi rkyen nges med la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa/ 'dun pa drag ngo la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang bdun las/ dang po phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ 'di ltar 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las grub pa'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang /ri bo mchog rab dang / gser gyi ri bdun dang rol ba'i mtsho bdun dang / nyi ma dang zla ba/ lcags ris bskor ba dang bcas pa stong gi mthar/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas dang mtho dman mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba ni stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten/ de 'dra ba stong gi mthar/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba la stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten/ de lta bu stong gi mthar/ bsam gtan dang po'i mtho tshad dang mnyam pa'i lcags ris bskor ba ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams zhes gling bzhi lcags ri dang bcas pa re re gcig nas gnyis su bsgrangs na bye ba phrag brgya ste dung phyur bcu yod pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi khams de yang / dang po chags/ bar du gnas/ mthar me bdun gyis bsregs nas thal bar byas/thal ba de yang chus bshal/ rlung gis gtor ba'i mthar nam mkha' gcig tu gyur pa'i dus yod de/ yid bzhin ripyi1 ོ༵ che'i mdzod las/ nyi ma gcig gis

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrtsa shing nags tshal bsregs/ /gnyis kyis lteng ka chu klung ma lus skems/ /gsum gyis chu klung chen po thams cad skems/ /bzhi yis ma dros mtsho chen skems pa ste/ /lnga yis rgya mtsho dpag tshad brgya skems shing / /rim gyis chu thigs gcig kyang med par byed/ /drug gis sa chen gangs ri bcas pa bsregs/ /bdun gyis ri gling gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar/ /thams cad lhag ma med par bsregs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mthar me de dag rab tu 'bar bas me lce gcig tu gyur te/ thur du 'khyil zhing 'bar bas dmyal ba'i gnas thams cad bsregs shing / me lce gyen du g.yos pas tshangs pa'i gzhal yas khang stong pa rnams kyang bsregs pas/ 'od dgasal gyi lha bu gzhon nu rnams skrag cing / 'di lta bu'i me chen po 'bar zhing byung ngo zhes sgrog pa na/ lha rgan po dag gis 'di ni sngar yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du byung nas slar log pa yin gyi skyag mi dgos so/ /zhes dbugs 'byin par byed pa yin te/ yang de nyid las/ me des dmyal ba'i gzhir khyab sreg cing 'bar/ /gyen du rlung gis rab tu bskyod pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang rnams bsregs pa na/ /'od gsal lha yi bu rnams sngangs shing skrag /rgan po dag gis sngon yang byung zhes sgrog /ces so/ /de nas chus 'jig pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar me yis lan bdun bsregs pa'i rjes/ /mkha' las char babs stong gsum khyab pa las/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad zhig par 'gyur/ /bsregs pa'i thal ba chu dang 'dres par gnas/ /zhes so/ /de nas sngar gyi chus sbyangs pa'i skyo ma de dag rlung gis phyogs bcur 'thor zhing ba~Xnee gtan gsum pa man chad zhig ste/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrdul phran cha shas med par song nas nam ma/kha' gcig tu gyur pa ni/ de nas rlung gis phyogs bcur gtor ba yis/ /bsam gtan gsum pa man chad zhig ོ༵ra/ 'a/ gyur/ /rdul phran cha med mkha' dbyings gcig tu 'khyil/ /zhes gsungs gnyis pa nang bcud kyi sems can la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/sems nyid ngal gso las/ snga rabs skye bo grangs med 'das gyur cing / /da lta'i sa steng 'gro ba phal cher yang / /lo brgya'i nang du nges par mi rtag pa/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang de yi rjes su 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar/ srid pa'i rtse mo nas dmyal ba'i gnas yan chad na sems can yod do cog 'chi ba'i gnas las thar pa ni gcig kyang med la/ dper na sa steng gi 'gro ba mi la mtshon na/ de ring gi nyi ma 'di yan chad mi lo brgya'i gong rol na skyes pa'i mi rnams brtsi ba'i tshad las 'das pa zhig byung yang da lta ming gi lhag ma tsam las gcig kyang med la/ de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyang tshul de dang mtshungs pa yin te/ spring yig las/ sa'am 'on te mtho ris su/ /skyes nas la la ma shi ba/ 'ga' ṭwāṃsna ram̐/ོ /kyi/sa mthong ba'am/ /thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /zhes gsungs pa gsum pa dam pa'i skyes bu la bsam te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ da lta'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la sngon gyi dus su byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang / gtsug tor can dang / thams cad skyob dang / 'khor ba 'jigs dang / gser thub dang 'od st+waṃdī dang / shākya thub pa rnams mtshan mo'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃzla ba nya gang ba shar ba lta ra mtshan dpe'i zhal bzang gi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la 'khoranyan thos dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa byon nas/theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ gdul bya'i sems can dpag tu medapa rnam grol la bkod par mdzad pa de dag gis bsod nams brgya las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag par mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa dang /de bzhin du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bka' bsdu ba mdzad pa'i 'od srung chen po la sogs pa'i dgra bcom lnga brgya dang / grags pa la sogs pa'i dgra bcom bdun brgya dang / rtsib log la sogs pa'i dgra bcom lnga brgya dang / ba su mi dra la sogs pa'i btsun pa bzhi brgya dang / byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya dang /gzhan yang 'das rjes thob pa'i paṇa chen rnam bzhi/ ma/chog gi rig 'dzin chen po brgyad/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ slob dpon dpa' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ yon tan 'od/ chos skyong ste chen po bzhi/ zhi ba lha dang /tsant+ra go mi ste rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon gnyis/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa dang / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yang o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas smin grol gyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i skabs su rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yer ba'i grub chen brgyad cu/ yang rdzong gi rtogs ldan nga lnga/ chu bo ri'i 'od lus grub pa'i bsgom chen brgya dang brgyad/ shel brag gi sngags pa sum cu/ 'od skur gshegs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rnal 'byor ma bdun dang / phyis su yang rnying ma'i so zur gnubs gsum/ gsar ma'i mar mi dwags gsum sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon cing /121

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃde dag phal che ba grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes nas mkha' la bya ltar 'phur ba/ chu la nya ltar 'phyo ba/ ri brag la zang thal byed pa/ 'byung bzhi la rang dbang bsgyur ba/ rnam thar sna re thos pas skye bo mang po grol ba/ sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba de dag kyang mthar mi rtag pa'i tshul bstan te/ da lta de lta bu byon zhes pa'i lo rgyus tsam las med na/ rang re mi yi lus rten chu shing gi sdong po lta bu snying po med pa 'di la rtag pa dang brtan pa ci zhig yod de/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ chu shing snying po med 'dra rang gi lus/ /sbru ma'i khang pa 'dra ba cis mi 'jig /zhes dang / mi rtag pa'i tshom las/ mtshan stong gis 'bar bde gshegs snying po'i sku/ /bsod nams brgya las grub pa'ang mi rtag na/ /dbu ba rdos 'dra yid brtan mi rung ba'i/ /rang gi lus 'di nges par cis mi 'jig /'gro ba'i don gshegs rgyal ba nyi ma 'dra/ /dam chos mdzod kyi zla ba nub la ltos/ /rang gi phun tshogs 'khor dang longs spyod kun/ /rtag pa med pa nyid du mkhyen 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / slob dpon dpa' bos/ ji ste sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i/ /rdo rje sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu ṭwāṃ shā lharno rnoo+o/ me/da 'dra ba'i/ /lus can rnams la smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs bzhi pa skye dgu'i bdag po la bsam nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ tshangs dbang bde 'byung 'khor los bsgyur rnams kyang / /'chi bdag bdud las bzur ba'i thabs ma mchis/ /zhes pa ltar/'di ltar skye dgu'i bdag po tshangs pa ༵twe khyab 'jug chen po dang / lha'i dbang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpo brgya byin dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa'i stobs 'byor gzi brdzid dang ldan pa rnams dang / 'jig rten mi yul 'dir stobs dang 'byor bas mngon par mtho ba'i 'khor los basbrur pa'i rgyal po chen po rnams dang / rgya gar shar nub kyi rgyal po mnga' thang stobs 'byor rgyas pa du ma dang / mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar la/ rgyal rabs sa ya gcig dang 'bum khri lnga brgya byung bar 'dul ba lung las gsungs so/ /mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po nas bdag cag gi ston pa'i bar la rgyal rabs 'bum phrag dgu dang sum khri bdun stong lnga brgya so gcig byung bar yang bshad nga 'o/ /bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba chos rgyal chen po rnams rim gyis byon pa rnams kyang da lta de lta bu byon no zhes pa'i lo rgyus tsam las med na/ rang re rnams kyis thog ma med pa'i dus nas las ngan gyi rgyu byas/ rkyen ngan gyi rlung gis ded/ bag chags ngan pas mtshams sbyar ba'i 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i sgyu lus kyi phung po 'di la nam 'jig dang 'dir 'jig gi nges pa med pas myur ba nyid du chos la 'bad par bya'o/ /lnga ba dpe don sna tshogs la bsams te mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ spyir bskal pa'i 'phel 'grib la bsams kyang mi rtag ste/ bskal pa dang po'i dus su mi rnams 'od gsal lha las mched nas/ gzugs mdzes shing blta na sdug pa/ kha tog gsal ba 'od dang bcas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro zhing / lus bong dpag tshad mang po dang ldan pa/ bdud rtsi'i zas za zhing bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod cing / tshe lo yang dpag med thub kyang /123

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnyon mongs dang mi dge ba'i dbang gis tshe dang bsod nams mar bri nas tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du mar 'grib pa dang yar 'phel ba sogs kyi khug pa rnams rdzogs nas mthar me chu rlung gis 'jig pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa dang /bye brag nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog 'a bltas kyang mi rtag pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ sos ka dbyar dang ston dus dgun dang dpyid/ /rim gyi 'gyur bas mi rtag skyo shas 'phel/ /zhes pa bzhin nyin dang mtshan dang chu tshod tsam yang skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba can las rtag pa dang brtan pa ni gcig kyang med de/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ nyin mtshan skad cig thang cig 'gyur bas kyang / /'chi bdag gnas su nye bar gyur ba ni/ /'bab chu'i tshogs rnams rgya mtshor snyegs pa'am/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub rir lhung ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyes pa thams cad mi rtag ste 'chi/ bsags pa thams cad mi rtag ste 'dzad/ 'dus pa thams cad mi rtag ste 'bral/ brtsigs pa thams cad mi rtag ste 'gyel/ mthon po thams cad mi rtag ste lhung / de bzhin du dgra gnyen dang sgyid sdug bzang ngan dang rnam rtog thams cad kyang mi rtag ste/mthon po gnam lta bu/ btsan po thog lta bu/ phyug po klu lta bu/ mdzes po lha lta bu/'phyor bo 'ja' tshon lta bu dang su dang gang la'ang 'chi ba glo bur du sleb tsa na rang dbang skad cig kyang med pa yin te/ dam chos padma dkar po las/ skye ba yod na 'chi ba yod/ /'dus pa yod na 'bral ba yod/ /ces dang / mdo rgya cher rol ba las/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba g.yo ba chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /skyes bu'i tshe 'gro ri sdu/ra 'bab chu 'dra/ /'du byed rnams ni

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgar la blta dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ de ring gi nyi ma 'di la 'khor dang longs spyod nye du 'brel ba can gyi dbus nas rang nyid gcig pur phyi ma'i lam po cher zhugs nas mi 'gro ba'i nges pa med pa yin no/ /drug pa 'chi rkyen nges med la bsams nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon arya de bas/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni shin tu mang / /'tsho ba'i rkyen ni shin tu nyung / /de yang 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ gdug pa'i sbrul dang /gsod par byed pa'i dug dang / srog gcod par byed pa'i mtshon dang / bde ba'i gegs byed pa'i dgra bo dang / gdung bar byed pa'i me sogs glo bur ye 'drog gi 'chi ba'i rkyen mang zhing / gzhan 'tsho ba'i rkyen du rloms pa'i zas dang sman sogs 'chi ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba'ang yod pa yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/kha cig zas kyis brnang nas 'chi/ /la la sman gyis 'chi ba'ang yod/ /mi mthun rkyen lta ci zhig smos/ /de bas nges pa 'ga' med do/ /zhes so/ /tshe la snon pa med cing bri ba dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin can yin te/ mi rtag pa'i gtam las/ltag chu bcad pa'i rdzing bzhin du/ /snon med 'brid pa dang bcas pas/ /kun kyang 'chi ba'i lam zhugs na/ /glo bur tshe la su yid brtan/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur shāong/ // /snon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ zhes bdun pa 'dun pa drag po la bsams nas mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ man ngag rin po che'i mdzod las/ gnyen dang mdza' bshes mgron po'i 'du shes 125

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasgom/ /gar 'dug gnas la mgron khang 'du shes bsgom/ /zas nor longs spyod rtsed mo'i 'du shes bsgom/ /bya ba gang byed rmi lam 'du shes bsgom/ /nye ring gar 'gro 'chi ba'i 'du shes bsgom/ /de dang ldan na zhakhor ba'i gnas las thar / /zhes pa ltar/ dus rtag tu 'gro 'dug sogs bya ba gang byas kyang 'di ni spyod lam gyi tha ma yin no zhes ngag gis brjod cing sems la yang bsgom par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshe mi rtag pa'i khrid la/ bsgom tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang /mdor bsdu na rtsa ba gsum/ rgyu mtshan dgu/ thag bcad pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsgoms pa la/ rtsa ba gsum ni/ nges par 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'chi tshe chos min cis kyang mi phan pa'o/ khyu mtshan dgu ni/ sngar ma shi pa lus pa med pa/lus 'dus byas yin pa/ tshe skad cig gis 'dzad pa/ tshe la nges pa med pa/lus la snying po med pa/ 'chi ba'i rkyen mang ba/ gnyen dang mdza' bshes kyis mi phan pa/ zas dang nor gyis mi phan pa/ rang gi lus kyis mi phan pa'o/ /thag bcad pa gsum ni/ nges par 'chi ba yin pas 'chi khar phan nges kyi chos 'ba' zhig sgrub dgos par thag bcad pa/ nam 'chi cha med yin pas chos da lta nas bsgrub dgos par thag bcad pa/ 'chi tshe chos min gang gis kyang mi phan pas chos kho na sgrub dgos par thag bcad pa'o/ /mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus kyang sang nyi ma shar ba dang tshe phyi ma'i snang ba 'char ba gnyis las gang snga snya ma nas blo sbyangs dgos te/ mdo las/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas/ /sang gi tshes la ma 'bad rma ra / /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nam langs pa'i dus su'ang de ring gi nyi ma 126

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adi la mi 'chi ba'i nges pa ci yod/ do nub slar nyal nas mtshan mo'i snang ba dang phyi ma'i snang ba 'char ba gnyis la gang snga snyam nas dge ba la 'bad dgos te/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /zhes so/ /dbugs kyi 'gro 'ong la bsam na'ang dbugs nang du jub pa las phyir dbyung ba dang / phyir 'byin pa nang du rngub khom pa'i nges pa'ang med de/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyi log pa las/ /sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /mdor na 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khrims la phyir bzlog med pa nyi ma nub kha'i grib so lta bu/ zag bcas kyi lus la snying po med pa g.yang kha'i sdong rgan lta bu/ tshe srog la yid brtan med pa rlung gseb kyi mar me lta bu/ srid pa'i dpal 'byor thams cad ni bar snang gi 'ja' tshon ltar mi rtag pa/ rtsa rtse'i zil ba ltar mi brtan pa/ chu yi lha ba ltar snying po med pa/ sprul gyi pags pa ltar 'dor ba'i chos can du mthong nas da lta nyid nas rang dbang rang la yod pa'i dus 'dir mi tshe stong zad du mi gtong bar 'chi khar phan nges kyi yang dag don gyi snying po'i nyams len zhig byed dgos te/ mdo las/ sang tsam 'chi'am sus shes kyi/ /de ring nyid du bstun te bya/ /'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni/ /khyod gnyis bshes pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / kha rag pas/ mi 'chi sdod pa'i sa phyogs med/ /'chi nges de yang myur du 'chi/ /'chi la cis kyang mi phan gyis/ /long med rgyud la bsten cig ang / /zhes dang / sems nyid ngal gso las/ chu shing snying po med 'dra rang sdi2 ḍis/ /sgyu ma'i khang pa 'dra ba cis mi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'ajig /de phyir nges par 'chi dang nam 'chi dang / /'dir 'chi 'dis 'chi nges pa 'ga' med do/ /ces pa ltar/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom par byas na/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar tu dge ba la brtson pa'i rkyen byed/ tha ma 'od gsal chos sku 'thob pa'i grogs byed pa yin te/ rje mi las/ nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas ri la phyin/ /nam 'chi cha med bsgom bsgom pas/ /'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin/ /da 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bor te thal/ /zhes dang / mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i zhal nas/ dang po 'o nga med du shes pa skyes bu'i gnad la mda' phog nga/ lta bu zhig dgos/ bar du yengs med du bsgom pa bu gcig ngo shi ba'i ma lta bu zhig dgos/ tha ma byar med du shes pa phyugs ma dgras ded pa'i rdzi bo lta bu zhig dgos/ zhes dang /dge bshes pu to bas / 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'di bsgom na/ dang po chos la 'dug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du dge sbyor la bskul ba'i rkyen byed/ tha ma/ chos mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgom na/ dang po tshe 'di'i gdos thag chod pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du 'khor ba mtha' dag la zhen pa ldog pa'i rkyen byed/ tha ma mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam du 'jug pa'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgom na/ dang po dad pa skye ba'i rgyu byed/ bar du brtson 'grus rtsom pa'i rkyen byed/ tha mar shes rab skye ba'i grogs byed/ yang mi rtag pa 'di bsgom zhing rgyud la skye na/ dang po chos 'tshol ba'i rgyu byed/ bar du chos sgrub pa'i rkyen byed/ tha ma chos mthar phyin pa'i grogs byed/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom paX phan yon ni 'dul ba lung las/ nga'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'akhor bum pa bzang po lta bu dge slong shā ri'i bu dang / mo'u 'gal gyi bu dang 'dra ba brgya la gdugs tshod yon dang bcas pa byin pa bas/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa skad cig ma gcig dran pa mchog yin no/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi khrid la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang re thog ma med pa'i dus nas tha ma da lta'i bar du khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su rdza mkhan gyi 'phang 'o 'am/ zo chun gyi khyud mo'am/bum nang gi bung ba bzhin gcig nas gcig tu 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe sems can thams cad phan tshun pha ma dang dgra gnyen btang snyoms ma byas pa gcig kyang med pa yin te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ pha ni bu nyid ma ni chung ma nyid/ /skye bo dgrar gyur ba yang bshes gnyen dag /bzlog pa nyid du mchis pas de slad du/ /'khor ba dag na nges pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ dge slong dag srid pa'i khams la skyo bar gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba gang gi tshe/ grogs 'i ra du skyes te dor ba'i lus kyang gcig tu bsdoms te phung por byas na ri'i rgyal po ri rab bas kyang ches mtho zhing / ngus pa'i mchi ma'ang rgya mtsho bzhi'i chu las lhag go/ /dmyal ba yi dwags su gyur pa de'i tshe lan grangs dpag tu med pa zhig 'thung pa'i zangs zhun khol ma dang / khrag dang chu ser dang / rnag dang / ngar bsnabs kyang 'di ltar gling bzhi'i nang nas rgya mtshor bab pa'i chu klung chen po bzhi bas mang zhing / 'dod pa dag gi phyir mgo dang mig dang yan lag dang nying lag bcad pa'ang gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snye~X gi 'jig rten gyi khams na sa dang / chu

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / me dang / rlung gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed las 'das pa'i grangs dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ 'di ltar 'jig rten snga phyi'i las bsam na/ /skyo ba bas kyang shin tu skyo ba 'phel/ /rang nyid grogs sbur gyur pa'i lus rnams kun/ /gcig pur bsdoms te phung por byar yod na/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi bas ches mtho zhing / /ngus pa'i mchi ma rgya mtsho bzhi bas lhag /sems dmyal yi dwags gyur tshe 'thung gyur ba'i/ /zangs zhun rnag khrag mi gtsang khu ba rnams/ /phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i chu klung char mi phod/ /de bzhin gzhan rnams dpag yas nam mkha' 'dra/ /'dod phyir mgo spya~X ṅgiwa~Xpy-i mee shārsha rno /ོ /gra/ngas/ /'jig rten rdul phran snyed kyis char mi phod/ /gnyis pa rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bye brag tu bsam pa la/ dmyal ba dang / yi dwags dang / dud 'gro dang / mi dang / lha min dang / lha'i sdug bsngal dang drug las/ dang po dmyal ba la tsha dmyal dang / nye zhabor dang / grang dmyal dang / nyi tshe ba dang bzhi/ dang po tsha ba'i dmyal ba la yang sos dang /thig nag dang / bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod che ba dang / tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa dang brgyad yod de/ ji skad du/ yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms dang / /ngu 'bod ngu 'bod po dang / /tsha ba rab tu tsha ba dang / /mnar med ces bya tsha dmyal brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/dang po yang sos ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ yang sos lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i steng / /phan tshun 'dus nasdu ḍitshon gyis srog dang bral/ /yang sos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsgra yis sngar bzhin sdug bsngal ba/ /las zad bar du de ltar myong 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar/ de'ang lcags kyi mdag me 'bar ba'i steng du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa las kyi dbang gis lhan cig tu 'dus te/ de dag phan tshun dgra mi sha bo mthong ba bzhin du zhe sdang skyes pa'i tshe lag tu mtshon cha sna tshogs pa rang byung bas gcig gis gcig la brdeg nas shi ba las/ nam mkha' nas yang sos par gyur cig ces sgra byung ma thag slar sos nas sngar bzhin 'thab pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i nyin zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba gcig /de bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu brtsis pa'i/ rang lo lnga brgya ni yang sos pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya'i bar du sdug bsngal myong dgos so/ /gnyis pa thig nag ni/dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gang phyir de la shing bzhin du/ /thig nag btab nas sog le dang / /'bar ba yi ni gshog byed de/ /de phyir thig nag yin par bshad/ /ces pa ltar/ dmyal ba'i sems can de'i lus mgal dum ltar bskyel nas thig nag po mang po btab pa'i steng du lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas dra bar byed cing / bcad zin pa na yang 'byar nas sngar bzhin sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ /mi'i lo brgya la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i lo stong thig nag gi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo stong thub pa'o/ /gsum pa bsdus 'joms ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ bsdus 'joms brag ri rta dang rnga mong dang / /stag dang seng ge la sogs 'dra ba'i bar/ /rdul phran bzhin 'joms gyes pas sngar bzhin ༵rdo/ /lcags kyi ljongs su tho bas rdul

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbazhin 'thag /ces pa ltar ri brag seng ge 'dra ba la sogs pa'i bar nas rdul phran bzhin 'joms pa dang / brag ri dkar po rang gi sen mo'i mdog 'dra ba gnyis phan tshun 'thab pa'i bar du lus rdul phye ma ltar 'thags pa dang /lcags kyi ljongs su tho bas rdul bzhin 'thag pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal ba'o//tshe tshad ni/ mi lo nyis brgya lha 'thab bral gyi zhag gcig byas lo nyis stong bsdus 'joms kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo nyis stong thub pa'o/ /bzhi pa ngu 'bod ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ der ni drag po me dag gis/ khyun mi 'chad par bsregs par byed/ /gang phyir skad ni drag 'byin pas/ /de phyir de dag ngu 'bod yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ lcags kyi khang pa sgo med la me 'bar bar bsregs pas sdu ga bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo bzhi brgya la lha dga' ldan pa'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i lo bzhi stong la ngu 'bod kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis nas rang lo bzhi stong thub pa'o/ /lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ ji skad du/ ngu 'bod chen po lcags khyim nyis rim du/ /'bar ba'i mes bsregs sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ /zhes pa ltar/ gshin rje'i las mkhan rnams kyis dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa ded nas lcags kyi khang pa nyis rim gyi nang du btsud nas tho bas brdeg pa dang / 'bar ba'i me sogs kyi gdung bas sdug bsngal drag po myong ba yin no/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo brgyad brgya la lha 'phrul dga'i zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod chen po'i zhag gcig tu bgrangs pa'i rang lo brgyad stong thub pa'o/ /drug pa tsha ba ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ tsha ba mdag me 'bar bdī 2sa gzhi la/ /pags pa bshus te phur

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃbus rgyong ba dang / /zhes pa ltar lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi me 'bar ba'i steng du lus kyi pags pa bshus te phur bus brgyang nas tho bas brdung ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ mi lo stong dang drug brgya la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i de yi lo khri drug stong tsha ba'i zhag gcig tu byas te rang lo khri drug stong thub pa'o/ /bdun pa rab tu tsha ba ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ rab tu tsha ba lcags khyim nyis rim nang / /'bar ba'i me dang mdung rtse gsum pas bsnun/ /spyi bo phrag pa gnyis phyung leb mas dkris//zangs chen khol mar 'tshod pas sdug bsngal ba/ /ces pa ltar/ lcags khyim nyis rim gyi nang du 'bar ba'i me yis gdung ba ni/ phyi nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis kyi me dang / nang nas glo snying la me 'bar bas me'i phung po bcu gcig gis bsreg pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pas lus la bsnun pa dang / lcags kyi leb ma 'bar bas lus dkris pa dang / lcags kyi zangs chen stong gsum tsam gyi khro chu khol mar bskol ba'i nang du dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa 'tshod pas pags pa dang sha khrag 'thor nas rus gong dkar por gyur nas shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ bar gyi bskal pa phyed thub pa ste/ mi lo'i grangs kyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das pa'o/ /brgyad pa mnar med pa ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ mnar med lcags khang me lce 'bar ba'i nang / /sems dmyal ku co smre sngags 'don pa las/ /me dang sems can so sor mthong ba med/ /mar me 'bar ba snying po la zhen bzhin/ /srog gi zung tsam me nang dbus gnas pa/ /zhes pa ltar/ lcags khyim me 'bar ba'i 133

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnang du las mkhan rnams kyis lcags bsregs kyi dum bu ri rab tsam du spungs pa'i dbus su dmyal ba'i sems can grangs med pa bcug nas/ stag gzig gi spud pa bus pas me lce lus dbyer mi phyed par gyur nas me'i phung po gcig gi klong na 'o dod 'bod pa'i sgra tsam las lus mi mngon pa dang / gzhan yang gshin rje'i tho bas brdungs pa dang / sog les gshog pa dang / gtun du 'thag pa dang / zangs chen khol mar 'tshod pa dang / mdung dang rtse gsum la sogs pa'i mtshon gyis 'bigs pa dang / lcags leb me 'bar bas lus kyi mgo mjug thag pas bcing pa ltar dkri ba la sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med do/ /sdu ga bsngal de dag gi ngo bo dbal tsha zhing / rnam grangs mang ba/ bar dang mtshams med pas na mtshams med dam mnar med ces bshad pa yin no/ /de dag phal cher gyi lus tshad kyang / rab zhi rnam nges kyi mdo las/ bskal pa dag ni du mar yang / /lus ni dpag tshad lnga brgyar 'gyur/ /de la mgo yang lnga brgya ste/ /mgo rnams re re dag la yang / /lnga brgya'i lce las nyung mi 'gyur/ /lce gcig la yang thong gshol ni/ /lnga brgya'i tshad de mi nyung ba/ /rab tu 'bar bas meo byed de/ /skur 'debs sdig pa'i las kyis so/ /zhes dang / mdo sde myang 'das las/ mtshams med pa brgyad byas pa la lus dpag tshad brgyad khri ba'i lus yod pa dang / theg pa chen po'i chos dang gang zag la skur pa 'debs pa'i lce dpag tshad 'bum du gsungs pa yin no/ /tshe tshad ni/ kun mkhyen pos/bar bskal gnas pa'i yun gcig brnag dgos te/ /de las che ba'i sdug bsngal gzhan med do/ /ces dang / las rnam 'byed las/ mnar med pa'i sgo 134

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃn lcags kyi ri dpag tshad stong drug khri zhig yod de/ de nyid sems can dmyal ba dag gis dor bas zad pa na de dag gi tshe 'phos pa yin te/ dpag tu med do zhes gsungs pa ni chos spang gi las byas pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa las sgrib shin tu che ba rnams kyi tshe tshad yin par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa nye 'khor ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las / nye zhabor mnar med khang pa'i phyi rol bzhir/ /me ma mur dang ro myags mtshon cha'i thang / /chu bo rab med bzhi bzhi bcu drug go/ /zhes mnar med kyi phyogs bzhi po na/ me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gri'i thang / ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal dang bzhi yod la/de yang shar na bzhi/ lho na bzhi/ nub na bzhi/ byang na bzhi ste bcu drug/mtshams bzhi na/ lcags kyi shal ma ri'i sdong po re re dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po me ma mur gyi 'obs ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ mnar med sgo phye snyam las phyir 'thon pas/ /'obs bzang grib ma mthong nas phyin ma thag /mdag me 'bar ba pus mo nub brgal bas/ /sha kun tshig nas rus pa kunda'i mdog/yang sos sngar bzhin shin tu sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ro myags kyi 'dam ni/ yang ni bsil ba'i 'dam mthong zhugs ma thag /ro myags rul dri nga ba'i 'dam bying nas/ /lcags zangs gser gyi mchu can srin bus 'bigs//zhes so/ /gsum pa spu gri'i thang ni/ slar yang thang nyams dga' mthong phyin ma thag /skru gri 'bar bas dum bur gtubs shing 'tsho/ /zhes so/ /bzhi ba ral gri lo ma'i nagasatshal ni/ /nags 'dab yid 'ong gang du phyin pa las/ /ral gri'i nags tshal las rlung zhakhrigs disdu bcom/ /zhes so/ shal ma ri'i sdong

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpo ni/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ mdza' gcug dam bca' dran nas bsnyegs pa'i lam/ /tsher ma rnon pos tshabs cher phug pa'i lus/ /'bar zhing rtsubs pa'i lcags kyi bud med kyis/ /'khrud mthar khā dang bya rgod mig la 'dru/ /zhes pa ltar/ lcags kyi shal ma ri gnod pa'i rang bzhin can de nyid ri bo rab tu nyams dga' ba mthong nas/ de'i rtse mo na sngon chad zhakhrig pa'i chos brten pa'am/ mdza' bar gyur ba dag gis 'bod par mthong nas der phyin pa'i lam du lcags kyi tsher ma rnon po sor bcu drug dag gis kha thur du bltas pas sha khrag gzag pa dang / de'i drung du sleb pa'i tshe sngon mdza' bar gyur pa de ma yin par lcags kyi bud med 'jigs su rung ba lus sog le lta bur rtsib la me stag 'phro bas 'byud cing dam por 'dzin pa dang / khā dang bya rgod la sogs pas mig 'byin/ rgyu lto 'dren pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba dang /de bzhin du thur du babs pa'i tshe na lcags kyi tsher ma rnams gyen du kha bltas pas sngar bzhin sdug bsngal ba yin te/ slob spring las/ thur du babs tshe lcags tsher gyen du kha bltas pas/ /rtsib la rno ba mang pos lus phug dran pa nyams/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa grang ba'i dmyal ba bshad pa la/ spyi mthun gyi sdug bsngal bstan pa dang / so so'i rang bzhin bshad pa dang gnyis las/ dang po spyi mthun gyi sdug bsngal bstan pa ni/ grang ba'i dmyal ba pa rnams kyi yul de na sa yi dkyil 'khor rdog pa bzhag sa tsam yang mi mngon par gzhi dang 'khor yug thams cad gangs ri dang chab rom/ kha char dang rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i gnas mun pa 'thibs por/ dpes mi mtshon pa'i lhag pa'i reg 136

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbya rno ngar can gyis lus la btab nas rus pa'i gting phug pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal ba'o/ /gnyis pa so so'i rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ /mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo bcu las/ a chu kye shud so 'tham pa/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdo' / /padma pad ltar gas pa/ /ātpal ltar gas grang dmyal brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ grang bas nyam thag pas a chu chu zer bas a chu zer ba dang / kye spyod kyi sgra tsam las mi thon pas kye spyod zer ba dang / skad mi thon pas so 'thamasapas so 'tham 'tham pa dang / lus la chu bur byung bas chu bur can dang / chu bur rdol nas mer song ba ni chu bur rdol ba can dang / lus kyi lpags mdog sngon por song ste bzhi tshal du gas nas pad ma ltar gas pa dang / sha'u dmar po phyir thon te rma de dag phyi nang log nas pad ma chen po ltar brgyad tshal du gas pa'o/ /tshal ba bcu drug gam sum cu rtsa gnyis sam brgya stong du gas nas rma de dag chu rgyus kyi gzugs phra mos sbrel bas utpal ltar gas pa'o/ /de dag gi tshe tshad ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ /tshe tshad khal brgya shong ba'i til sbyang nas/ /lo brgya til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can tshe lhag ma nyi shus 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ grong khyer ko sa la'i khal brgya shong ba'i til sbyang nas til 'bru ma re lo brgya brgya song dus phyir bor bas til sbyang zad pa ni chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin la/ lhag ma rnams ni nyi shu 'gyur gyis ring bar 'dod pa yin te/ mdzod las/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur ba/ /chu bur can gyi tshe tshad de/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bzhi ba nyi rdo 3ṭwāṃ'i sdug bsngal ni/ sems nyid ngal

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgaso las/ nyi tshe ri dang ljon shing nam mkha' dang / /brag bar me chu nges med gnas rnams su/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnas nges med ri dang / ljon shing dang /nam mkha' dang / brag dang / me dang / chu la sogs pa'o/ /gzugs ma nges pa gtun lta bu dang / thag pa dang / phyag ma lta bu dang / mgal dum ste sdong dum lta bu'i gzugs tha dad pa mang po 'dus pa gcig pur gnas pa'ang yod do/ /sdug bsngal nges med brag bar du bcar ba dang / gangs dang chab rom gyi nang du 'khyags shing rengs pa dang / chu tshan gyi nang du 'tshed pa dang / me nang du tsha zhing bsregs pa dang / shing dang lo ma'i zhabs su 'thum pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rnams nyams su myong ba'o/ /tshe tshad ni nyin mtshan phyed ma dang /yud tsam dang / lo mang por sdug bsngal gyis gdung bas na nyi tshe ba zhes bya ba yin no/ /kha cig gi tshe nyi ma re las med pas nyi tshe ba zhes 'dod kyang mi 'thad de/ lcags kyi khyim du skyes pa'i rabs las/ da dung yang ni mang po zhig /phyir yang dmyal ba 'dir gnas so/ /zhes so/ /kha cig gi gcig pur grogs med pa'i phyir nyi tshe ba'o zhes 'dod pa'ang mi 'thad de/ sngon gro bzhin skyes rna ba bye ba ri phyin pa na/ gtsug lag khang yid du 'ong bar dge slong lnga brgya tsam gnas pa nyin gung tsam la gaṇḍi brdungs nas gdugs tshod la 'dus tshe gtsug lag khang lcags bsregs kyi khang pa dang / lhung bzed dang phor ba sogs mtshon char gyur nas rdeg res 'ba' zhig byed/ gdug tshod yol ba'i tshod la sngar bzhin gyes te gnas pa/ sngon 'od srung gi dus su dge slong mang po gung tshigs kyi skabs tshig gis rtsod pa byas pa'i rnam smin yin par bshad pa la sogs pa 138

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrnams yinano/ /gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/ yi dwags phal cher 'dzam gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa na yod pa dang / kha 'thor ba ni sa gzhi ri klung thams cad la khyab pa ltar yod de/ de'ang yi dwags kyi rigs sum cu rtsa drug gsungs kyang / bsdu na kun mkhyen chen pos/ phyi yi sgrib can bzang dgu mthong na'ang skam/ /nang gi sgrib can glo snying me 'bar zhing / /sbyi mthun sgrib pa zas skom yid la btags/ /bcu gnyis lor yang chu yi sgra mo thos//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi yi sgrib pa can ni/ zas skom kyi gdungs shing lus skam zhing rid pa/ mgrin pa dang yan lag phra ba/ rgyangs ring po nas zas kyi phung po dang / chu klung dang / ljon shing 'bras bu can la sogs pa mthong yang /der phyin pa na chu klung rnams skam pa'am rnag khrag tu gyur/ ljon shing rnams la 'bras bu med cing sdong dum skam po tsher ma can tu gyur pa dang / yang na skyes bu mtshon cha thog pa mang pos bsrung ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod pa yin no/ /nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ nang gi sgrib can lto bar me 'bar zhing / /kha nas me lce dud par bcas pa 'thul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kha khab mig ltar dog pa/ mgrin pa rta rnga ltar phra ba/ lto ba rgya mtsho ltar yangs pa/ rkang lag gro sog ltar phra zhing zas skom mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal/rnyed kyang khar mi shong ba'i sdug bsngal/ khar shong yang mgrin par mi thar ba'i sdug bsngal/ mgrin par chud kyang lto ba mi khengs ba'i sdug bsngal/ lto ba cung zad re khengs kyang glo snying sogs la sdi sdubar bas na nang khrol kun bsreg cing

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkha nas dud pa me lce dang bcas pa 'thul ba dang / tshigs bar gyi rus pa brdar bas me 'bar ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ba'o/ /spyi mthun gyi sgrib pa can ni/dbul zhing phongs pa dang / bkres shing skom pa dang / gzugs mi sdug pa dang /dbang po ma tshang ba dang / rtag tu gzhan gyis 'tshe ba dang / zas skom myong ba lta ci/ tha na lo grangs brgya phrag mang po'i bar du chu yi ming tsam yang thos ma myong bas shin tu sdug bsngal ba'o/ /de dag rnams la dus rtag tu bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bzod blag med cing tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myang dgos te/ bshes spring las/ yi dwags rnams la sos ka'i dus su ni/ /zla ba tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang / /zhes pa ltar/ bye tshan dang rdo bsregs kyi char 'debs pa dang / sos ka'i dus su ni zla ba tsha la/ dgun gyi dus su ni nyi ma'ang bsil bar 'gyur zhing / tsha bas gdung ba'i tshe bu yug grang ba'i reg pa can de yang dro bar 'gyur la/ grang bas nyam thag pa'i tshe na me yang drod dang mi ldan pa'i grang reg can tu 'gyur ba yin te/ slob spring las/ tsha bas nyen la bu yug kyang ni tsha bar 'gyur la/ lhag pa'i nyam thag pa la me yang grang bar 'gyur/zhes so/ /de dag gi tshe tshad ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ tshe tshad mi yi lo brgya yi dwags zhag /rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal myong ba yin/ /zhes mi rnams kyi lo brgya la yi dwags kyi zhag gcig tu brtsis pas rang lo lnga brgyar sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang / mngon pa mdzod las/ mi yi zla ba gcig la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub par gsungs pa dang / bshes spring las/ yi dwags la la'i tshe tshad lo lnga1 ṭwāoṃng dang / yi dwags kha cig gi tshe tshad

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃstong phrag bcu thub par gsungs pa yang yod do/ /lus kyang nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ yi dwags che ba la dpag tshad stong dang / chung ba la mtho gang ba gsungs so/ /gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bshad pa la/ bying na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba gnyis las/ dang po bying na gnas pa ni/ mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i nang na gzugs dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba chang dar ma'i sbang ma bzhin tu yod la/ spyir lus chung ba la sgra'i rtse mo bgos pa'i cha tsam dang / nyi zer gyi rdul tsam dang / rgya shug gi tshig gu tsam dang / che ba la dpag tshad khri yod pa dang / glang po che kha cig gi lus la dpag tshad bdun yod pa dang / chu srin che ba la dpag tshad nyis stong bdun brgya yod pa dang / klu 'ga' zhig ri rab dang mnyam pa la sogs pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi khyad par yang phan tshun gcig la gcig za ste/ che bas chung ba mid pa/ chung bas che ba'i lus phug ste za ba dang / klu kha cig gis gnas su nyin re bzhin bye tshan gyi char babs pas sha dang rus pa bsreg pa dang / la la gcig pur grogs dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ba dang / mkha' lding gtum pos za ba dang / gling phan tshun gyi lcags ri'i bar ni gling bar mun pa'i khrod ces bya ste/ nyi zla'i snang ba med cing rkang lag bskyang bskum tsam yang mi mthong ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ba dang / gnyis pa kha 'thor ba ni/ ri dang / chu dang / thang dang / brag dang nam mkha' la sogs pa na gnas pa'i srog chags 'bu sbrang dang / bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa rnams la tsha grang dang bkres skom dang 'jigs skrag dang / gcig gis /sag za ba la sogs pa'i sdu ga bsngal

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdapag tu med pa yod de/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ gcig la gcig za shin tu mi zad 'byung / /kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ mu tig gi ched du nya phyis gsod pa dang / bal gyi ched du lug sogs gsod pa dang / sha khrag gi ched du rkyang 'brong gsod pa dang / pags pa'i ched du stag gzig la sogs pa gsod pa sogs rang rang gi lus nyid kyang rang nyid gsod pa'i rgyur gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / bkol zhing spyod pa'i sdug bsngal sogs pha mtha' yas pa yin de/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ kha 'thor mi yul bya dang ri dwags sogs/ /rngon pas gtses shing rang rang gnod pas nyen/ /rta glang rnga mong ra dang bong bu sogs/ /bkol spyad rdeg 'tshag sdug bsngal mtha' yas shing / /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /tshe tshad ni/ nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ tshe thung bas yud tsam dang / ring bas bskal pa'i bar du myong bar gsungs pa dang / kun mkhyen pos/ kha cig tshe ni yud tsam dang nyin gcig la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la sogs pa ni bar gyi bskal pa thub pa'ang yod par gsungs pa dang / mdzod las/ 'jog po bskal pa'o/ /zhes dang / rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ kho bo ni rgya mtsho'i gnas 'dir bar gyi bskal pa gcig gnas pa lags na/ zhes so/ /de ltar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la bsam na da lta rang re rnams kyi me nang du lag pa bcug pa tsam dang / dgun gyi dus su gcer bur sdod pa dang / nyin zhag gcig la bza' btung med pa tsam yang bzod par dka' na/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro rnams kyi sdug bstusdu ji ltar bzod de/ bshes spring las/

g.yu khogabla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdamyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklag dang gzugs su bgyi rnams kyang / /'jigs pa skyed par 'gyur na mi bzad pa'i/ /rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar rtsig pa la sogs pa la bris pa mthong ba dang / gzhan gyis bshad nas thos pa dang / sngon nyams su myong ba dran pa dang / dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni 'di lta bu'o zhes yi ger bklags pa dang /'jim pa la gzugs brnyan byas pa rnams kyang 'jigs pa skyed par 'gyur na shin tu mi bzad pa'i rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci dgos/ sngon kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis kyi le lo byas te chos la ma brtson pas mo 'gal gyi bus khrid de dmyal ba bstan pas de phyin chad shin tu skrag te thugs rgyud la nges 'byung skyes te/ snga dro dmyal ba dran na gung tshigs za mi thub pa dang / phyi dro dmyal ba dran na zos pa rnams slar skyugs pa yin no/ /bzhi ba mi'i sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo bcu las//sdug bsngal gyi ni sdug bsngal dang / /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya dang /khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal gsum/ /rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum zhes bya/ /skye rga na 'chi sdug pa bral/ /mi 'dod thog bab 'dod mi rnyed/ /nyer len phung lnga sdug bsngal ba/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad du gsungs/ /zhes rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal chen po gsum/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal gyi chu bo chen po bzhi/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad kyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ gnyen byams pa dang bral gyi dogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ 'dod pa thog tu mi khel ba'i sdug bsngal ba'o/14/spya yang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsdug bsngal snga ma ma sangs bzhin du phyi mas non pa mdze'i thog tu phol byung ba/phol thog tu me gtugs pa/ pha shi ba'i steng du ma shi ba/ dgras ded pa'i steng du mi gces pa shi ba lta bu'o/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ mdo las/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni skye ba na bde/ gnas pa na bde yang 'gag na sdug bsngal ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar 'gyur ba'i tshe na sngar gyi bde ba nyid yid gdung ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba ni/ bu shi ba'i mya ngan lta bu ste/ bu ma byung na de shi ba'i mya ngan yang mi 'byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du da lta bde bar yod 'phro la sdug bsngal ba ste/ dper na rje btsun mi la'i a khu lta bu/ snga dro bag ma bsus te skyid pa'i ston mo byed pa la phyi dro khang pa bsdibs te sdug bsngal gyi smre sngags bton pa la sogs pa'o/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ zag bcas kyi phung po mtha' dag srid pa nye bar len pa'i rgyu yin pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / sems can zhabrul ba'i snang ngo la gang ci tshor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin te/sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ni/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang 'brel/ bde ba'i tshor ba ni/ thengs gcig bde bar zin kyang phyis sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur bas na 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'brel/ bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba ni ma rig pa'i chos dang ldan pas na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang 'brel ba'o/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'di ltar 'dzam bu gling nga 'i mi rnams ni/ mngal nas skye ba yin pas/ pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam shes zhugs pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ ma rig rnam shes rlung sems thig ler 'dus/ /ṭwāṃ/ nur ltar mkhrang gor nya rus sbal

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adra/ /rim bzhin bdun phrag bdun du chags pa'i lus/ /ma yi ngal dub bkres skom tsha grang sogs/ /cung zad tsam la'ang sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /mun nag dog cing nyam nga dri mi zhim/ /'khums pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad brnag dgos so/ /zhes pa ltar/ zhag bdun phrag dang po la mer mer po zhes pa ni dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bu/ bdun phrag gnyis pa nur nur zhes pa ni snabs kyi rnam pa lta bu/ bdun phrag gsum pa ltar ltar po zhes pa mtheb mdzub kyi rnam pa lta bu/ bdun phrag bzhi ba mkhrang gyur zhes sgong nga'i rnam pa lta bu/ bdun phrag lnga ba gor gor zhes padma'i 'dabs ma lta bu/ bdun phrag drug pa khyab 'jug zhes pa nya yi rnam pa lta bu/ bdun phrag bdun pa rus sbal gyi rnam pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar yan lag nying lag dbang po thams cad rdzogs pa'i tshe ma'i mngal gyi nang dog cing / mun nag gi nang dri nga ba btson khang lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong /mas kha zas tshan mo zos pas me nang du bsregs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ grang mo zos pas chu grang du bskyur ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ nyal ba na ris non pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ 'grangs pa na brag gi bar du bcar ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/bkres pa na g.yang la lhung ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ 'gro 'dug bsgul bskyod byas pa na rlung gis khyer ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal sogs yod/ de nas zla ba'i grangs rdzogs nas btsa' ba'i dus srid pa las kyi rlung gis mgo mjug bsgyur te/ rus pa'i zhabrul zhakhor gyi bar nas 'byung ba'i tshe/ lcags kyi 'jur mig nas drangs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal dang / btsas nas kyang stan gyi steng du lhung dus tsher ma'i dong du lhung ba lta bu'i sdusdu ༵sngal/ rgyab kyi phru ma bzhu dus gson

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpor pags pa bshus pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ mi gtsang ba byi dor bya dus tsher ma'i lcag gis brab pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ ma'i pang du blangs dus bye'u phrug khras khyer ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/ spyi bor mar byug dus bkyigs nas dong du 'phang ba lta bu la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal myong pa'o/ /de nas rga ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ rgas pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /lang tsho nyams pas kun gyi yid mi 'ong / /stod smad mi theg 'bar ba la brten cing / /lus kyi drod nyams zas kyang 'ju bar dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus kyi bkrag mdangs nyams pa/ mgo yi skra dkar ba/ lus skur zhing yan lag 'khyog pa/ sha skam pa pags pa lhod pa/ gdong byad gnyer mas gang ba/ mal nas ldang dka' zhing 'gro na 'khyol ba/ 'dug na bun pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod de/ rje mi las/ brtod phur 'don pa'i ldang lugs dang gcig /bya la 'jab pa'i 'gro lugs dang gnyis/ /sa do chad pa'i sdod lugs dang gsum/ /gsum 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /a phyi sgyu lus rgud pa'i yid pham ma/ /phyi pags pa 'dus pa'i gnyer ma dang gcig/nang sha khrag zad pa'i 'bur gob dang gnyis/ /bar glen lkugs 'on long thom yor dang gsum/ /gsum 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /a phyi mi sdug ston pa'i khro gnyer can/ /lci la hrul ba'i dug po dang gcig /grang la nyob pa'i bza' btung dang gnyis/ /pags pa bzhi sbyor gyi mal sa dang gsum/ /gsum 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod na/ /a phyi mis 'gom khyis 'gom gyi rtogs ldan ma/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ldang ༵ḍi tshe rang bzhin gyis 'phral du ldang mi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnusapar lag pa gnyis ka sa la btsugs nas sa sra ba las brtod phur 'don pa ltar ldang / 'gro ba'i tshe rked pa rgur bas mgo bo bteg mi nus shing gom pa'i'adegs 'jog kyang myur du byed mi nus par dal bus byis pa bya la 'jab pa ltar 'gro/ sdod pa'i tshe rkang lag gi lhu tshigs thams cad na bas dal bus sdod mi nus par lus kyi ldid phab ste sa do chad pa bzhin sdod/ lus kyi sha zad pas pags pa'i skyi 'dus te lus dang kha ngo thams cad gnyer mas gang / nang gi sha khrag zad pas rus pa'i tshigs thams cad mngon te 'gram rus sogs lhu mgo thams cad phyi la 'bur/ yid kyi dran pa nyams pas glen lkugs dang 'on long du gyur nas sems mi gsal zhing thom yor re sdod/ lus stobs dang mdzes 'dod nyams pas gos thams cad lci zhing hrul/ lce yi ro rnams mi tshor bas bza' banyung thams cad grang la nyog /lus lci bas gang ltar byas kyang bde ba'i dus med pas phyogs bzhir brten pa byas/ phyi'i sgru lus rgud pas nang du yid pham/ bzhin mdzes kyi bkrag mdangs nyams nas bsags pa'i gnyer ma ma/nga bas mi sdug pa'i khro gnyer ston/ kun gyis brnyas bcos byed cing mgo thog tu 'goms nas song yang gtsang btsog med par rtogs ldan ltar sdod pa la sogs sdug bsngal dpag du med pa yod de/ slob dpon ka ma la shī las/ rgas pas nyam thag gzugs kyi phung po de/ /me long grib ma mthong na 'dre bas 'jigs/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs nad sna tshogs kyis gzir bas sdug bsngal zhing / g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab gang du nyal yang baspya zlo'i dus med/ zas skom yid khar mi

gci khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'ong / nyin par nyin ring / mtshan mo mtshan ring zhing / na ba la brten nas 'chi ba glo bur du 'ong snyam pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs yod de/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ na ba'i sdu ga bsngal shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur dang yid mi bde/ /yul gyi longs spyod yid du mi 'ong zhing / /srog dang bral bar dogs pas mya ngan skye/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ rje mi las/ mi sdig can shi ba mthong tsa na/ /las rgyu 'bras ston pa'i slob dpon yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'chi ba'i dus su longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod kyang 'khyer dbang ni med/ blos ni mi thong / rjes su ni mi 'brang / sngar byas kyi sdig pa dran pas 'gyod pa skye/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal dran nas 'jigs shing skrag /'chi ba glo bur du slebs pas nyam/ nga / rang la rang dbang yod pa'i dus su 'chi khar phan pa'i chos zhig ma bsgrub snyam du 'gyod pa skyes nas sems sdug bsngal gyis non/ mig mchi mas gang / 'chi khar brang lag 'thab cing brang sen rjes kyis bkang nas 'chi ba yin te/ srog chad pa'i tshe 'chi ba la snying mi dga' zhing / dran pa ni nyams/ 'du shes ni zhabrul/ yid kyi dbang po ni 'gags/ dbugs kyi rgyu ba ni chad/ che 'di'i snang ba ni nub/gshin rje'i bsu ma ni sleb/ bar do'i snang ba ni shar/ mgon dang dpung gnyen ni med/ phyi ma'i lam du zhugs nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag po dag gis gzir ba na gnyen nye ba rnams kyi lag pas brang brdung mig nas mchi ma 'thor zhing / sems mya ngan gyis gdungs shing ngag nas 'o dod 'bod pa las ci bya gtol med du song nas gces pa'i bu chung yin kyang lus tha gus bcing yol 148

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbs bsgribs/ rdo sogs kyis sngas byas/ phor ba sngas mgor sbubs/ zhag kha shas nas phung po dur khrod du bskyal te bya khyi la sogs pas zos shing / rus pa de dag rlung dang nyi char sogs kyis so sor byas te phyogs phyogs su 'thor ba dang / yang na me la bsregasapa dang / dong du sba ba la sogs pa yin no/ /de lta ༵ḍi /༵ ra debya ṭwāoṃm/ 'o/ nga nges pa med pas dus da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos la lnga pa lha min gyi sdug bsngal bshad pa ni sems nyid ngal gso las/ lha min rnams la'ang bde ba'i skabs med de/ don med 'thab rtsod 'brugs shing zhe sdang la/ /lha yi dpal la mi bzod phrag dog ldan/ /g.yul ngor sdug bsngal brgya phrag bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha min ni lhun po'i chu mtshams man chad kyi ri rab kyi khong gseng nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du yod de/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ lha min ri rab chu mtshamasaman chad kyi/ /khong gseng nang nas rim pas sgra gcan dang / /skar phreng mgul phreng thag bzang ris rnams te/ /zhes pa ltar chu mtshams nas 'og nas 'og tu sgra gcan dang /dkar phreng dang / mgul phreng dang / thag bzang ris rnams rim bzhin gnas pa'o/ /de yang lus dang rdzu 'phrul dang longs spyod dang 'dod pa'i rang bzhin lha dang 'dra yang rigs dang skal ba lha dang mi 'dra ba'i phyir lha ma yin zhes bya ba'o//'di dag la rigs kyang lnga ste/ tshe dpa' lha'i rigs ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang tshe lus dang skal ba mnyam/ stobs chen gnod sbyin gyi rigs ni rgyal chen sde bzhi pa dang longs spyod mnyam/ rtsub /rdzur bdud kyi rigs ni nag po'i phyogs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃl dga' ba thag bzang ris la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang longs spyod rnams 'dra zhing tshe sum cu rtsa gsum dang mnyam// gsod byed srin po'i rigs ni sems can gyi srog la 'che zhing mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags dang phyogs mthun/ gdug pa klu'i rigs ni phyed mar gyur pa'i lus dang / longs spyod dang bde sdug 'dres shing blun par gnas pa'o/ /kha 'thor ba ni/ mi yi yul dang /rgya mtsho dang / kha cig dud 'gro dang mnyam pa'o/ /de dag gis lha yi dpal dang 'byor ba mthong nas phrag dog gi rlung 'tshubs shing / zhe sdang gi me 'bar bas lha rnams dang 'thab pa'i tshe/ mgo dang yan lag gcod pa la sogs pa'i sdu ga bsngal drag po 'byung 'ing / lha rnams ni mgo dang rked pa ma chad na gnad du phog kyang slar 'tsho ba dang / lha min rnam sa ni mi dang 'dra ste gnad du phog na 'chi ste/ shi ba'i gzugs brnyan yang gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du kun snang zhes pa'i mtsho la shar bas dmag rang yul du ma thon pa'i gong nas nye du rnams mya ngan gyi gdung ba la sogs pa'i sdu ga bsngal dpag tu med pa yod do/ /drug pa lha yi sdug bsngal bshad pa la/ 'dod khams kyi lha dang / khams gong ma'i lha dang gnyis las/ dang po 'dod lha rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ bag med 'dod pas myos dang 'tshi 'pho lhung / /me tog rnying dang stan la nyams mi dga'/ /grogs kyis spong dang phyi ma'i gnas la 'jug /tshor ba mi bzad lha yi zhag bdun 'byung / /zhes pa ltar/ri rab bang rim bzhi'i steng ma la/ rgyal chen bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas te gnas pa dang / dbus kyi ri dbang lhun po'i ༈༵ na dbang po dang nye dbang gi gnas ma

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adres pa dang / nor bu snying po dang / yongs 'dus gnas pa dang / rnam mdzes gnas pa dang / dga' ba'i tshal la sogs pa lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum na gtso bo nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang sum cu rtsa gsum yod pas sum cu rtsa gsum dang / de'i steng du rim bzhin 'thab bral dang /dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed dang drug yod de/lha de dag bde ba ltar snang yang / bde ba de yang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa yin te/ 'chi 'pho ba na lus kyi mdog mi sdug pa/ stan la nyams mi dga' ba/ me tog gi phreng ba rnying ba/ gos la dri ma chags pa/ lus la rngul chu 'byung ba yin te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang / /gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni/ /sngon chad med pa'i rngul 'byung zhes bya ba/ /mtho ris 'chi 'pho sbron byed snga ltas lnga/ /zhes pa ltar/ 'chi 'pho'i snga ltas lnga lha yi zhag bdun gyi gong du 'byung ba yin te/ de'i tshe rang nyid kyis kyang 'chi bar shes te sdug bsngal/ lha zla bo rnams dang lha'i bu mo rnams kyis kyang de 'chi bar shes nas drung du nye mi nus shing / rgyang ring po nas me tog 'thor te/ khyod 'di nas shi 'phos te mi yul du skyes/ las dge ba la spyad de slar yang lha yul du skye bar shog cig /ces smon lam btab nas 'gro/ rang gcig pur lus pas shin tu sdug bsngal zhing phyi ma gar skye lha'i mig gis bltas pa'i sdug bsngal ba'i gnas su skye bar mthong nas ni 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal ma sangs pa'i gong du lhung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis non ṭwāṃnee 'o dod 'bod bzhin lha'i zhag bdun

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rangagrol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdu sdod dgos te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyi zhag bdun te mi lo bdun brgya yin/ de'i bar du sngar gyi bde skyiod dran kyang sdod dbang med pa 'pho ba'i sdug bsngal/ phyi ma'i gnas ris mthang bas nyam nga ba lhung ba'i sdug bsngal dang gnyis kyi sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba la sogs pa yod de/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni/ /las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng lhung / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa khams gong ma'i sdug bsngal bshad pa ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ tshangs ris la sogs gzugs khams bsam gtan lha/ /snga ma'i las zad srid pa 'og mar lhung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzugs khams kyi gnas ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi steng gi nam mkha' la steng nas steng du brtsegs te gnas pa yin la/ de yang bsam gtan dang po na/ tshad med bzhi la gnas pas tshangs ris zhes bya ba'i lha dang /tshangs pa chen po'i mdun na 'don byed pas tshangs pa mdun na 'don dang /'khor yin pas tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs pa chen po'i bya ba 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa'i grogs su phan pas tshangs lha nye phan zhes bya ba'i lha dang / 'og ma bas lus bong che bas tshangs chen gyi lha dang gsum/ bsam gtan gnyis pa na/gong ma bas 'od zer 'phro ba chung bas 'od chung gi lha dang / lus 'od tshad med pa yod pa'i phyir tshad med 'od dang / kha dog dang 'od zer shin tu gsal bas 'od gsal gyi lha dang gsum/ bsam gtan gsum pa na/ gong ma bas dge ba chung ngu spyad pa'i 'bras bu grub pas dge chung / dge rtsa 'bring du spyad pa tshad med pa'i 'bras bu las byung bas tshad meṭwāṃ pyege dang / dge ba rgya cher rgyas pa'i
