g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'abras bus bskyed pa'i phyir dge rgyas dang gsum/ bsam gtan bzhi pa na/sprinamedapa'i nyi ma'i snang ba dang 'dra bas na sprin med 'od dang / tshad med bzhi bsgomapa'i bsod nams las gtso bor skyes pa'i phyir na bsod nams skyes dang / so so'i skye bo'i bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i 'bras bu rnams kyi mchog tu gyur bas 'bras bu che ba dang gsum/ de ltar tshangs ris nas 'bras bu che ba'i bar bsam gtan gyi lha rnams kyang 'chi ba'i tshe rang gi bde ba de nyid 'gyur bas srid pa phyi mar 'jug pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ tshangs ris la sogs bsam gtan lha rnams kun/ /'od dang kha dog gzi brdzid mtha' yas kyang / /bdag rtog bag la nyal ba ma gzigs pas//shi nas dmyal bar skye ba kyi med dam/ /zhes so/ /gzugs med pa'i khams bzhi ni/ lhag mthong gis ma zin pa'i zhi gnas kyi ngang du nam mkha' ltar dngos po med par bsgoms pas nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi lha rnams bskal chen nyi khrir gnas pa dang / byung tshor gyi rtog pa bkag pa'i rnam shes tsam du bsgoms pas rnam shes mtha' yas kyi lha rnams bskal chen bzhi khrir gnas pa dang / ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du yul dang bral bar bsgoms pas ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams bskal chen drug khrir gnas pa dang / yod med gnyis char ma yin pa'i ro myong la zhen nas bsgoms pas yod min med min gyi lha rnams ting 'dzin de'i ngang du bskal chen brgyad khri'i bar du gnas pa'o//'phags pa rnams ni sems de dag la mngon du byas te bsgom yang der mi skye ba dang / so skye rnams la de lta bu'i ting 'dzin yod kyang zhabor bar 'khyams pa ni 153

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbadag rtog bag la nyal ba'i cha kun gzhi la yod pa rang bzhin med par shes pa'i shes rab kyis ma rtogs pas ting nge 'dzin gyis myos pa ltar gyur bas so so'i skye bo rnams yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba med cing ting 'dzin nyams kyi bde ba la yid brtan med par nam mkhar 'phangs pa'i mda' bzhin du zag bcas kyi dge ba'i 'phen shugs zad pa na slar ngan song du lhung bar 'gyur ba yin te/ bshes pa'i spring yig las/ tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar/ /mnar med me yi bud shing gyur ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /dper na me che chung ci yin kyang cha ba las ma 'das pa ltar/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa ste/ gnas gang du bsdad kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi grogs yin te/dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams/ /lha rnams bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / mgon po byams pas/ 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /mi gtsang khang par dri zhim med/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi ba las rgyu 'bras kyi khrid la/ spang bya mi dge ba'i las/ bsgrub bya dge ba'i las/ thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po spang bya mi dge ba'i las ni/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ mi dge'i las bcu ngan 154

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsong sdug bsngal rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin len pa dang / log par g.yem dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma byed pa dang / tshig rtsub mo dang / ngag 'khyal ba dang / brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang /log par lta ba ste mi dge ba bcu'o/ /lus kyi mi dge ba gsum ni/ mdzod las/srog gcod pa ni bsam bzhin du/ /ma nor pa ni gzhan bsad pa'o/ /ma byin len pa gzhan gyi nor/ /mthu dang 'ardzab bus bdag gir byed/ /bsgrod min bsgrod par 'dod la sogs/ /log par g.yem pa rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes so//ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi ni/ rdzun tshig 'du shes gzhan bsgrur bas/ /tshig don mngon par go ba'o/ /phra ma pha rol dbye ba'i tshig /mi snyan brjod pa/ rtsib mo ste//nyon mongs can kun kyal ba yin/ /zhes so/ /yid kyi mi dge ba gsum ni/bsam chos ngan zhing brnabs sems ni/ /log pas gzhan gyi nor la chags//gnod sems sems can la sdang ba/ /dge dang mi dge med lta ba/ /log par lta ba yin 'di la/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i mi dge ba de dag gi 'bras bu la/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang / rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu dang / bdag po'i 'bras bu dang / skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu dang bzhi las/ dang po rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ las bcu chung ngus dud 'gro 'bring yi dwags/ / pos dmyal bar sdug bsngal rnam smin 'bras/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rnam par smin pa 'di dag gi chung ngus ni dud 'gro rnams su skye'o/ /'bring gis ni yi dwags rnams su skye'o/ /chen pos ni dmyal ba rnams su skye'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa rgyu mthu/ 5ṭwāṃ 'bras bu la/ myong ba rgyu mthun dang /

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbyed pa rgyu mthun dang gnyis las/ dang po myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ srog bcad pas tshe thung ba/ brkus pas longs spyod dbul ba/ log par g.yem pas dgra zla mang ba/ rdzun smras pas skur 'debs mang ba/ phra mas grogs dang bral zhing kun dang mi mthun pa/ tshig rtsub kyis rtag tu mi snyan pa thos pa/ ngag 'khyal gyis ngag mi btsun pa/ brnab sems kyis yid la re ba mi 'grub pa/ gnod semasakyis rtag tu 'jigs shing sgrag pa/ log par lta bas glen zhing gti mug par 'gyur ba yin te/ rin phreng ba las/ srog bcad pas ni tshe thung 'gyur//ma byin blangs pas nor dang bral/ /byi bo byas pas dgra dang bcas/ /rdzun du smra bas skur pa mang / /phra ma yis ni bshes dang 'bral/ /tshig rtsub pas ni mi snyan thos/ /kyal ba yis ni ngag mi btsun/ /brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms//gnod semasa'ajigs pa sbyin par byed/ /log par lta bas lta ngan nyid/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ byed pa rgyu mthun byed las mthun par skyes/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngar srog gcod byed pa zhig yin na da lta yang srog gcod la dga'/ sngar ma byin len pa zhig yin na da lta yang rku ba la dga' ba sogs yin no/ /gsum pa dbang gi 'bras bu'am bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ yul la smin pa ste/ srog gcod kyis sa phyogs nyams mi dga' ba sogs srog la gnod pa can du skye ba/ ma byin blangs pas lo tog la sad ser ldang ba sogs mu ge yod pa'i sar skye ba/ log par g.yem pas mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab la sogs pa yid du mi 'ong bar skye ba/ rdzun gyis 'byor ba mi brtan zhing sgrag pa'i yul rkyen dang 'phrad pa/ phra mas yul ngam 'brog 166

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsogs bsgrod par dka' ba/ tshig rtsub kyis rdo gseg dang tsher ma la sogs sa phyogs yid mi bde ba/ ngag 'khyal gyis zhing las so nam byas kyang 'bras bu 'byung dka' ba/ brnab sems kyis lo tog nyes shing sdug bsngal mang po 'byung ba/ gnod sems kyis rtag tu 'jigs pa dang 'tshe ba mang ba/ log ltasa'abyor ba nyung zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen med par skye ba'o/ /bzhi pa skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu ni/ 'a/sa gang byas pa de mang po 'phel nas skye ba tshe rabs mang por sdug bsngal myong nas 'khor ba mu mtha' med par 'khyams dgos pa yin te/kun mkhyen chen pos/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu mi dge ba/ /gang byas de nyid 'phel bas sdug bsngal bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bsgrub bya dge ba'i las bcu ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ srog mi gcod dang rku spangs dang / /gzhan gyi chung ma spang ba dang / /log dang phra ma rtsub nyid dang / /ma 'brel smra ba yang dag sdoms/ /chags dang gnod sems med pa la/ /nyid kyis lta ba yongs spangs la/ /'di dag las lam dkar bcu ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan gyi srog bskyab pa/ spyin pa gtong ba/ tshangs par spyod pa/ drang por smra ba/ ldabon pa bzlum pa/ chos mthun gyi gtam brjod pa/ tshig snyan par smra ba/ gtong sems la goms pa/ byamasapa dang snying rje bsgom pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba rgyud la bsten pa'o/ /de dag gi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ chung ngus mi dang 'bring gis 'dod pa'i lha/ / pos bsam gtan gzugs med ting 'dzin 'brel/ /gong ma'i khams gnyis bde ba 'dzin par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ chu~X ḍibring du spyad pas 'dod pa'i mi dang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlhar skyes la/ chen po nas bsam gtan bzhi dang 'brel nas goms na gzugs khams su skye ba dang / ches cher goms pa tshad du phyin pas skye mched mu bzhi thob pa'o/ khyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la/ byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ skye ba nas tshe rabs kun tu dge ba byed pa la spro ba dang / myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ srog bcad spangs pas tshe ring nad med cing / /ma byin len spangs 'byor ba phun sum tshogs/ /log par g.yem spang khyim thab dgra zla med/ /rdzun du smra spangs gzhan gyis bstod pa dang / rtsub mo rnam spangs snyan par smra ba'i bde/ /phra ma rnam spangasamathong na mi mthun med/ /'khyal ba rnam spangs tshig bzung 'os par 'gyur/ /brnab sems spangs pas re ba 'grub pa ste/ /gnod sems spangs pas yid 'ong mthong na zhi/ /log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang po ste/ mtho ris bgrod pa'i shing rta dge ba bcu/ /mngon mtho bde 'dod rnams kyis dang du long / /zhes so/ /bdag po'am dbang gi 'bras bu ni/yul la smin pa yin te/ sa phyogs thams cad me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis 'byor bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu ni/ dge ba'i las gang byas pa de mngon par 'phel nas bsod nams rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar dge sdig gang byas kyang gong nas gong du 'phel ba ni/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ ji ltar sa bon yungs 'bru tsam pa'i shing / /a sho ta yi 'bras bu lo dus su/ /yal ga re la'ang dpag tshad tsam 'phel bas/ /dge sdig gzugs brnyan 'phel ba'i dper mi phod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa disdus cad las kyi rang bzhin du bstan pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃni/ 'di ltar mtho ris lha mi'i bde ba dang / ngan song gi sdug bsngal rnams ni rang rang gi sngon bsags pa'i dge sdig gi las kho na las byung ba yin te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ de ltar srid pa'i bde sdug mtho dman rnams/ /sngon bsags las las 'byung bar thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / mdo sde las brgya pa las/ lus can rnams kyi bde sdug ni/ /las rnams yin par thub pas gsungs/ /las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs la/ /de yis 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas//zhes dang / e ma ho/ 'jig rten thams cad las las skyes/ /bde dang sdug bsngal las kyis bris/ /rkyen rnams tshogs nas las 'byung zhing / /las kyis bde dang sdug bsngal byed/ /ces dang / padma dkar po las/ las ni kun byed ri mo mkhan 'dra zhing / /las ni 'du byed gar mkhan nyid dang 'dra/ /zhes dang /las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdo las/ bram ze'i khye'u nee tsos gsol ba/ kyai go ta ma rgyu mthun rkyen ni gang gis/ sems can rnams tshe thung ba dang / tshe ring ba dang /nad mang ba dang / nad nyung ba dang / mdog sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa dang /dbang che ba dang / chung ba dang / rigs btsun pa dang / dman pa dang / longs spyod che ba dang / chung ba dang / shes rab che ba dang / chung bar 'gyur bar ji ltar lags/ bka' stsal ba/ bram ze'i khye'u sems can rnams ni las gyur ba/zhes dang / las nag pos ni sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dwags dang / dud 'gro rnams kyi nang du skye'o/ /las dkar pos ni lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de ltar las rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag 'di la yid ches rnyed par byas nas dge sdig gi lasdu9 phra mo la'ang blang dor byed pa ni shin tu

sayu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃngo mtshar ba yin te/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ chos rnams stong pa nyid shes nas/ /dge ba'i las 'bras brten byed pa/ /ngo mtshar bas kyang 'di ngo ma/tshar/ /rmad byung bas kyang 'di rmad byung / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang gdugs zhabs kyi bla ma/ rgyal khams kyi bya btang / ri khrod kyi chos pa/ dbu tshad 'chad pa'i dge bzhes/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i mkhan po/ nges med kyi gcod pa/ gto yas la 'byams pa'i grong chog pa la sogs mchog dman su yin kyang las rgyu 'bras la spang blang mi byed pa ni dkon mchog gi bla btsong /bstan pa'i rkang 'dren yin te/ ji skad du/ /ngur smig gos can zhi tshul mdzes gyur kyang / /byi la bzhin du bsam pa ma rung pa'i/ /dam pa'i gzugs brnyan gso ru med pa ste/ /ma mo rnams kyi kha ru gdab bya yin/ /khri phrag dgu yi gtso bor 'dug gyur kyang / /khyab 'jug bzhin du rang rgyud ma thul ba'i/ /chags sdang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba de/ /gshin rje gshed kyi zhal du gdab bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ngan song gi rgyu bsgrub pa las ltar snang du ji ltar mdzes kyang gzhan bslu ba'i tshul 'dzin tsam las snying po yod pa min te/ sa paṇa gyis/ ri dwags rnga ma ma bstan na/ /bong sha 'tshong bar mi nus ltar/ /de bzhin bzang spyod ma bstan na/ /log pa'i chos kyis bslu mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ las kyi 'bras bu med ces pa/ /bsod nams ma yin ngan song ba/ /zhes dang / 'brom ston pas/gson tshe dge sdig gnyis po gang byas pa'i/ /'bras bu phyi ma'i dus su 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/16/0de yang rdzu 'phrul la dbang 'byor ba'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmo 'gal gyi bu mu stegs pas brdungs nas 'das pa dang / dgra bcom pa rgur chung gis thal skyo gsol nas 'das pa dang / rgyal po bde spyod kyi bu rab nus kyis mgon po klu sgrub kyi mgul la ku sha brgyab pas dbu sa la brul te 'das pa dang / yang sngon kha che'i dge slong ra ba ti zhes bya ba mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul thob pa/ slob ma mang po yod pa zhig nags gseb na chos gos ngur smig cig 'tshod cing yod tsa na/ de dang nye ba'i khyim bdag gcig gis be'u stor nas btsal du phyin pas/ nags gseb na du ba cig 'dug nas der bltar phyin pas dge slong zhig me gtong gin 'dug /khyed ci byed pa yin byas pas chos gos 'tshod pa yin zer/ tshos phru kha phye nas bltas pas sha ru 'dug pa zer/ khong rang gis kyang sha ru mthong / der khong khrid nas rgyal po la gtad de/ 'dis bdag gi be'u brkus pas chad pa chod cig byas pas/ rgyal pos de dong du bcugade nas zhag 'ga' na kho'i ba rang gis be'u rnyed nas/ dge slong des be'u brkus par mi gda' bas gtong bar zhu ba phul na yang / rgyal po yengs nas zla ba drug tu gtong ba ma byung / der khong rang gi slob ma rdzu 'phrul thob pa mang po yod pa nam mkha' nas 'phur te rgyal po'i drung du 'ongs nas/ dge slong 'di yang dag pa zhig lags pas gtong bar zhu zhus pas/ rgyal po dge slong gtong du byon pas/ dge slong 'o brgyal ba gzigs nas shin tu 'gyod de ngas bya ba de 'gyangs ches/ sdig chen po bsags 'dug zhus pas mi skyon/ nga rang gis lan pa yin gsungs/ las ci 'dra bsags zhus pas/ sngon rkun po zhig tu skyes/ de dus be'u zhig brkus pa bdag pos despya 1nas nags gseb na rang sangs rgyas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃzhig mnyam par bzhag 'dug pa'i mdun du bskyur nas bros pas/ des rang sangs rgyas khrid nas zhag drug dong du bcug de'i rnam smin gyis skye ba mang por ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong / tshe 'dir yang sdug bsngal myong ba 'di rnam smin gyi tha ma yi na gsungs so/ /gzhan yang kha cig gis stong nyid rtogs pas chog mod/ dge sdig la blang dor byed mi dgos so zhe na/ de 'dra'i log rtog nam yang smra bar mi bya ste/ kun mkhyen pos/ stong skad had pos rgyu 'bras khyad bsad nas/ /byar med chos kyi mthar thug yin snya ma yang / /tshogs gnyis spang bas nyams len skal ba chad/ /zung 'jug bsgoms pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /zhes dang / grub chen bir wa pas/ 'khor ba dag la dogs pa'i sems med 'jigs bral yang / /sdig pa'i las rnams phra mo dag la 'dzem par bya/ /zhes dang / 'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams stong pa nyid du rtogs mod kyang / /las kyi rnam par smin la yid ches mdzod/ /ces dang / jo bo rjes/ rnam rtog ma zad bar du las yod pas/ /las kyi rnam par smin la yid ches mdzod/ /ces so/ /kha cig gis stong nyid rtogs na snying rje mi dgos zhes smra ba dang / kha cig gis a bu tsho bsam pa bzang po'i sgo nas snying rje re bsgoms dang / stong nyid bsgoms pa don med yin no zhes smra ba sogs yod kyang / de dag gis thabs snying rje chen po dang / shes rab stong pa nyid de gnyis zung tu 'jug pa'i lam yang dag pa rnyed pa min te/ dpal sa ra ha pa'i zhal nas/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid gang zhig /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ /'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang / /'khor ba 'dir gnas 162

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtharab thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar thar 'dod skye bo rnams kyis mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams 'khor ba las sgrol bar 'dod pa'ithabs snying rje chen po dang / chos rnams bdag med du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob byed kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin pa shes par byas nas nyams su blangs par bya'o/ /lnga ba thar ba'i phan yon la bsam pa ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsum gyi go 'phang gang thob kyang / zhi ba bsil ba/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'phrang las thar pa can yin pas nga re dga'/ de'i nang tshan las kyang da res theg pa chen po dang mjal bas dge ba bcu dang tshad med bzhi dang phar phyin drug dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med bzhi dang / zhi lhag gnyis la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs pa 'i byang chub kho na 'dong pas bskrub par bya snyam du sbyor ba sems bskyed/dngos gzhi dmigs pa med pa/ rjes bsngo smon gyis rgyas thebs pa'i dam pa gsum gyis zin pas nyams su blang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /drug pa bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul la/ gang zhig bsten bya slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ gang gis bsten pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul dang / de'i phan yon bshad pa'o/ /dang po gang zhig bsten bya slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid la/ spang blang gnyes las/ dang po spang bya'i slob dpon ni/ bram ze bzhin du cho rigs bsrung ba'am/ rang nyid gang du bsti ba'i dgon gnas sogs nyams par dogs nas tshe 'asditwe ched du thos bsam cung zad byas pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrnams ni rang rgyud las su ma rung bas gzhan rgyud 'dul bar mi nus pa 'bras bu'i rigs gang yang mi chod pa'i shing gi rang 'thag lta bu'i lam ston dang /rnyed dang bkur sti tsam gyi rang rgyud nga rgyal gyi khengs shing dam pa'i yon tan mi mthong ba khron pa'i sbal ba lta bu'i bshes gnyen dang / thos pa nyung zhing rgyud tshod so skyes las dma' yang grub pa'i mdzad spyod ltar byed pas kun spyod gnam du gshegs pa/ khong khro dang zur za che bas byams dang snying rje'i dpyang thag chad pa'i smyon pa'i lam mkhan lta bu'i bshes gnyen dang / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bral yang / rgyan chos gzi byin la sogs pa'i grags pa che yang long ba'i ded dpon lta bu'i lam mkhan spang bar bya dgos te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ byams dang snying rje shes rab thos pa chung / /le lo snyoms las mi shes nga rgyal che/ /ko long gdug rtsub nyon mongs dug lnga rags//tshe 'di don gnyer phyi ma rgyang ring 'phangs/ /chos ltar ston yang chos min zog po'i rigs/ /mi gtsang phung po lta bu'i bla ma ni/ /gdul bya'i bung ba mang yang ring du spang / /dad ldan log lam ngan 'gror 'khrid pas na/ /thar lam 'dod pas nam yang bsten mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa blang bya'i slob dpon ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi gnang bkag gi gnas la 'gal ba ma song bas rgyud gtsang ba/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi gzhung la ma rmongs pa'i thos pa che ba/mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i snying rjes rgyud brlan pa/ phyi sde snod gsum dang / nang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi'i cho ga la mkhas pa/ don nyams su blangs pa la 1sdusten nas rang rgyud la spangs rtogs kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyon tan khyad par can mngon du gyur pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis skal bzang gi slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag gi zab gnad ston pa'i bla ma ni/ rgyud sde rin po che nas bshad pa'i smin byed dbang gi chu bo zam ma chad pas rgyud smin pa/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i gnas la 'gal ba med pa/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog chung bas rgyud zhi zhing dul ba/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rgyud don thams cad khong du chud pa/ yi dam lha'i zhal ma/thong ba la sogs bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags rdzogs pa/ gnas lugs kyi don mngon du gyur nas rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba/ thugs rgyud snying rjes gang bas gzhan don 'ba' zhig gnyer ba/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i zhen pa spangs pas bya ba nyung zhing / phyi ma dang du len pas nan tan chos la sems pa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du mthong bas thugs skyo shas che zhing gzhan yang de la bskul ba/gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa/de'i steng du bla ma'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag la dam sel gyi g.ya' yis ma gos shing byin rlabs kyi na bun 'thibs pa zhig dgos pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ dbang dang sdom pa dam tshig gtsang ldan zhing / brgyud ldan man ngag rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor phrin las mnga' brnyes shing / /lta bsgom spyod 'bras nyams rtogs drod tshad thob/ brtse thabs mkhas gdul bya smin grol 'god/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung ma yal ba/ /sde6 ḍidra'i mkhas grub dpal ldan bla ma

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasten/ /zhes so/ /de yang shes rab zab cing rgya che ba'i bla ma rnams la 'dus pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma ni/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru bo che/ /lam mchog 'khrul par mi 'gyur ded dpon dngos/ /las nyon me tshogs 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i char/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i nyi zlar mtshungs/ /theg pa shin du che bas sa gzhi 'dra/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing / /chos kyi mdzod ldan bum pa bzang po ste/ /kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag /kun la snyoms par byams pas pha ma yin/ /che zhing myur ba'i snying rje chu klung mtshungs/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i dga' ba ri dbang 'dra/ /zhabrugs pa med pa'i btang snyoms char sprin bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho po las sgrol ba'i gru bo che lta bu/ ma rig pa'i mun pa stug po sel zhing chos kyi snang ba 'byed pa nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu/ log sgrub dang skyo ngal bzod cing lta spyod kyi shong yangs che bas sa gzhi lta bu/ tshe 'dir phan pa dang phyi mar bde ba'i yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pas dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu/ theg pa dang grub mtha'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod du gyur ba bum pa bzang po lta bu/ gang la ci 'dod pa'i las bzhi'i phrin las rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas su bzhugs pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can kun la nye ring dang chags sdang med par snyoms pa byams pa pha ma lta bu/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la dmigs pas rgya che zhing /sdug bsngal mgon med kyi sems can sdu6 lhag par myur ba'i snying rje chu klung lta bu/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃphrag dog gis 'pho 'gyur med cing bden 'dzin gyi rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i dga' ba ri dbang lta bu/ chags sdang gis rgyud mi 'brugs pa'i btang snyoms char sprin lta bu yin no/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ srid mtsho sgrol ba'i gru chen mnyan pa ste/ /lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon bla na med/ /rgud pa sel bas yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /las dang nyon mongs me 'jil bdud rtsi'i chu/ /ches cher bsil bas char sprin bzang po ste/ /'gro kun dga' bskyed lha yi rnga bo che/ /dug gsum nad sel sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ /ma rig mun sel sgron ma 'od po che/ /skye dgu'i bde 'byung dpag bsam shing chen te/ /'dod dgu lhun 'grub rin chen bum pa bzang /byams chen nyi ma 'od zer dpag med de/ /gdung sel zla ba phan bde'i 'od dkar can/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa las/ kye rigs kyi bu/ gzhan yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru bo che lta bu'o/ /thar pa'i lam du zhugs pa rnams kyi ded dpon lta bu'o/ /srid pa'i rgud pa rnams sel bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ /las dang nyon mongs pa'i me 'jil bas chu bo lta bu'o//chos kyi char chen 'bebs pas sprin bzang po lta bu'o/ /'gro ba rab tu da ga' bas lha'i rnga bo che lta bu'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i nad sel bas sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ /ma rig pa'i mun nag thams cad sel bas sgron ma lta bu'o/ /'dod dgu'i re ba rdzogs pas dpag bsam gyi shing lta bu'o/ /ci bsam pa thams cad 'grub pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o/ /byams pa tshad med pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i gdu~X ḍi sel bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbu'o/ /yon tan gyi 'byor pa ster bas rnam thos bu lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i bla ma ni thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi ngos nas sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam zhing / bzang 'brel tshe gcig sangs rgyas/ ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can tu 'gyur ba yin te/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ de 'dra'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /gnod pa byas kyang bde ba'i lam 'brel na/ /zol med dad ༵༵ batrīste/na/ rnobye galha/ ḍi zloo////mngon mtho nges legs yon tan char bzhin gnyis pa gang gis bsten pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid la spang blang gnyis las/dang po spang bya'i slob ma ni/ rgyud klong gsal las/ snod dang mi ldan slob ma ni//shes chung kha gsag gdong ltas che/ /kha mkhas lag dam g.yo rgyu che/ /bla ma'i gsung bcag drin la rtsod/ /yon tan mi mthong skyon la rtog /rigs brgyud ngang rgyud ngan pa dang / /bka' drin khyad gsod rang la bstod/ /don dam dam tshig nyams len 'chal/ /slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skal ba ngan pa'i slob ma nyes pa du ma'i snod du gyur pa dad pa dang ngo tsha med pa/ byams pa dang snying rje chung ba/ le lo dang rnam g.yeng che ba/ rgyud nyon mongs pas gang zhing / kun spyod ngan pa/ sdom dang dam tshig mi srung ba/ khong khro dang tshig rtsub che ba/ chos min bya ba la brtson pa/ g.yo rgyu che zhing shes rab chung ba la sogs pa'i chos 'chad pa'i snod du ma gyur ba'i skal ngan snyob ma rnams ni spang dgos pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ gzhan du skal ngan slob ma nyes kun gzhi/ /dad dang ngo tsha ldasdu med snying rje chung / /rigs dang rang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbazhin kun spyod skal ba ngan/ /sems dang las dang nyon mongs dug lnga rags//chos dang chos min dge sdig bslab pa 'chal/ /sdom dang dam tshig mi bsrung gnyen po med/ /ces dang / bla ma ri dwags chos la gla rtsi dang / /rang la rngon pa nan tan mda' 'phen dang / /chos grub 'bras bu gzhan tu 'tshong ba'i tshul/ /'du shes lag pa lnga yis bsten pa ni/ /darme tshig med pas 'di phyir sdug bsngal 'thob/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa blang bya'i slob ma ni/rgyud rig pa rang shar las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che/ /shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med/ /phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod/ /rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med/ /dam tshig ldan zhing sgrub la brtson/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen po nas/ bskal bzang slob ma dad dang shes rab che/ /brtson 'grus bag yod dran dang shes bzhin ldan/ /bka' las mi 'da' sdom dang dam tshig bsrung / /sgo gsum dul zhing snying rje phan sems che/ /khong yangs spro ring gtong phod dag snang che/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ khams 'dus dad pas gso nus shing / /rkyen ngan gnyen pos thub pas na/ /ci snaṭwāṃdrishā rdo kā // no ba/sgru/ba pa la/ /las can gyi slob ma mi zer ram/ /zhes gsum pa ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus srog la mi blta bar gzhon nu nor bzang gis 'phags pa byams pa bsten pa'i tshul dang / byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang sems chos 'phags bsten pa dang / paṇa chen nā ོ༵ ༵sa grub chen te lo ba bsten pa dang /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrje btsun mi las lho brag mar pa bsten pa lta bu zhig dgos pa yin te/ de yang gzhon nu nor bzang gis 'phags pa byams pa bsten pa'i tshul ni/ sngon grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi tshong dpon nor rab tu bstan pa'i bu nor bzang gis lho phyogs kyi rgyud nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud kun tu song ste rtag tu chos 'tshol bas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sogs pas lung ston cing byin gyis rlabs pa'i bla ma lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ de dag gis gdams pas rjes su bstan pa'i bla ma lnga bcu rtsa bzhi ste brgya rtsa brgyad bsten pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus byang sems chos 'phags bsten pa'i tshul ni/ byang sems rtag tu ngus sher phyin 'tshol ba'i tshe bar snang las/ shar phyogs su song zhig ces thos pa na/bdag ji srid shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa ma thob kyi bar du ngal dub dang bkres skom dang gnyid rmugs dang nyin mtshan la sogs pa yid la mi byed par gnas par bya'o snyam nas de bu gcig pu shi ba'i ma bzhin du yid la byed pa gzhan med par shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa nam thos snyam du shar phyogs nas shar phyogs su song nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i yo byad kyi ched du rang gi lus sha khrag btsong ba dang / tshong dpon gyi bu mo 'bor lnga brgya dang bcas pa shar phyogs su song nas grong khyer spos ngad ldan pa na byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la mchod pa'i yo byad rnams kyis mchod nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / byang sems de nyid lo bdun gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te chos ston par gyur pa'i tshe/ sa phyogasda ṭwāṃ'i dpag tshad gcig tshun chad phyags

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdar byas nas rdul mi ldang ba'i ched du chag chag gdab par rtsom pa na bdud sdig can gyis chu thams cad mi snang bar byas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus rang gi lus kyi rtsa thams cad phug nas khrag gis chag chag btab pas tshong dpon gyi bu mo 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pas kyang rang rang gi lus kyi rtsa thams cad phug ste khrag gis chag chag btab pa na lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis khrag de thams cad lha yul gyi tsan dan dmar por byin gyis rlabs/ rtag tu ngu 'khor dang bcas pas/ der seng ge'i khri bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bshams pa la byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags byon nas bzhugs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa bstan pas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong phrag drug cu thob/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa'i zhal myo/thong / de nas bzung ste rmi lam na yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang ma bral zhing / da lta yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi zad pa sgrogs pa'i drung na bzhugs par gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du nā ro paṇa chen gyis te lo ba bsten pa'i dus su yang dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad pa yin te/ de yang nā ros te lo ba sprang po'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal nas rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas 'ong gsungs pas/ khong rang gar 'byon pa'i phyi bzhin tu khrid/ chos ni ma gsungs/ nyin gcig mkhar thogs brtsegs dgu yod pa zhig gi rtse mor khrid nas bla ma'i bka' bsgrub phyir mkhar 'di'i rtse nas mchongs nus pa yod dam gsungs pas/ 'di na mi gzhan ni su mi 'dug /nga rang la gsung ba yin snyam/mkhar gyi rtse nas mchongs pas lus1 ṭwāṃms cad brdab ste/ na tsha dang sdug

g.yu khog bla ma chos dgings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasngal dpag tu med pa byung / bla ma byon nas na'am gsungs pa la/ na bas ma tshad ro bzhin thal zhus pas byin rlabs mdzad nas lus sngar bzhin sos te khrid nas song / yang nyin gcig nā ro pa me thong zhig gsungs/ me bus tsa na khong gi smug gshags ring po mang po la snum gyis byugs/ me la bsros nas ngar btags te/ bla ma'i bka' bsgrubs phyir 'di lta bu'i dka' ba yang spyad dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ smyug ma gshags pa rnams rkang lag gi sen bar nas drangs pas lus kyi lhu tshigs thams cad brgyang / na tsha dang sdug bsngal bzod blag med pa zhig byas nas bla ma ga shed byon song / zhag shas song 'phral bla ma byon nas smyug ma rnams blangs pa'i shul nas khrag dang chu ser la sogs pa mang po byung / yang byin rlabs mdzad nas khrid de byon/ nyin gcig nā ro pa nga ltog gi 'dug /za ma zhig slong la shog gsungs/ zhing las byed pa'i mi mang po za ma za sar phyin nas bslangs pas thug pa bskol ba thod phor gang byin/ phyir 'ong nas bla ma la drangs pas zhim zhim ltar gsol/ shin tu thugs dgyes pa'i tshul bstan pas/ nā ro ba'i thugs dgongs la ngas sngar bla ma'i zhabs phyi de tsam bsgrubs kyang da res 'dra ba'i thugs mnyes po ma byung / da dung slong du phyin na cung zad rnyed dam snyam nas yang thod phor khyer te phyin pas/ khong rnams las byed pa la song / sngar gyi 'thung lhag de gar bzhag 'dug pa 'a / da 'di kar brkus pa drag snyam nas khyer te bros pas khong rnams kyis mthong / rjes ded nas bzung ste 'chi la thug par brdung / na tsha dpag tu med pa byung ste de nas ldang ma nus par zhag mang por lus/ ༵ḍi bla ma byon nas byin rlabs mdzad de

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkhrid nas song / nyin gcig nā ro pa nga la nor rdzas mang po dgos pa yod pas nus la shog gsungs/ phyug po zhig la rkur phyin pas tshor nas bzung ste yang shi la thug par brdung / zhag kha shas nas bla ma byon te na'am gsungs pa la sngar ltar zhus/ byin rlabs mdzad nas yang khrid de byon pa sogs de lta bu'i dka' chen bcu gnyis dang / dka' phran bcu gnyis te dka' ba mi 'dra nyi shu rtsa bzhi sku lus gcig gi steng du spyad pa yin/ de ltar dka' spyad thams cad rdzogs nas nyin gcig nā ro pa khyod song la chu longs shog dang ngas me btang nas 'dug gis gsungs/ nā ro pas chu blangs nas byon tshe khong gis me bus nas 'dug pa bzhengs te phyag g.yon pas nā ro'i thong rtsa nas bzung nā ro pa thod pa ston gsungs te/ phyag g.yas pas mchil lham phud pa blangs nas dpral bar brgyabs pas nā ro pa nag thum gyis brgyal song / brgyal sangs ba dang bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi yon tan thams cad nā ro pa'i rgyud la skyes nas dpon slob gnyis dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur nas 'dug /de ltar paṇa chen nā ro pas dka' ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi spyad pa de dag kyang don tu bla ma'i bka' lung yin pas sgrib pa sbyang ba'i thabs su gyur pa las/ rnam pa rang bzhin don med pa'i ngal ba kho na las 'di chos su 'dug snyam pa gcig kyang mi 'dug cing bla mas kyang chos tshig gcig kyang ma gsung / slob mas kyang phyag rdog gcig btsal ba lta bu'i chos la nyam sa len ma byas kyang grub thob kyi bla ma dang mjal nas/ dka' ba khyad du bsad de ci gsung gi bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas sgrib pa dag stobs kyis rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa yin/ sdosdu na bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa las

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlhag pa'i chos kyi nyams len bya ba logs na ci yang med par bla ma'i bka' bsgrub pa de tsam du phan yon che ba yin no/ /rje btsun mi la ras pas lho brag mar pa bsten pa'i tshul ni/ yul mnga' ris gung thang gi mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi sras mi la thos pa dga' zhes bya ba rje btsun mi la yin te/ nor rdzas sogs gang yod khu bo g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis 'phrog pa'i tshe/ thos pa dga' gtsang gi g.yung ston khro rgyal dang / lha rje gnub chung las mthu dang ser ba bslabs te khu bo'i bu dang mna' ma la sogs mi mgo sum cu so lnga khang ba zhig nas bsad/ yul mi spyi'i sdang po byas pas ser ba gyang rim gsum yod pa zhig phab nas sdig pa po bsags/ de la 'gyod nas chos bsgrub pa'i thugs blo skyes te g.yung ston gyi bka' bzhin rong ston lha dga' zhes bya ba'i drung du song nas sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib tu zhus pa'i tshe/ bla mas nga la ma bsgom par sangs rgyas pa'i chos rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa yod pas khyod la ster gsungs/ zhag 'ga' song ba'i tshe rong ston lha dgas khyod sdig po che yin zer ba bden par 'dug /ngas chos kyi kha pho de yang cung zad ches pas da ngas khyod mi 'drong bar 'dug da khyod rang lho brag gro bo lung zhes bya ba'i dgon pa na/ rgya gar gyi grub thob nā ro pa'i dngos slob/ skyes mchog sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo tsā zhes bya ba sngags gsar ma'i grub thob/ sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig bzhugs/ de dang khyod rang tshe snga ma nas las 'brel 'dug pas der song zhig gsungs/ der sgra sgyur mar pa'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis sems la smra mi shes pa'i dga' ba da~X 4/ lus la ba spu kun g.yo ba'i bde ba

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / mchi ma zhabrugasapa'i mos gus tshad med pa zhig zhakhrungs te/ bla ma dang mjal te zhal mthong ba zhig nam 'ong na bsam zhing phyin pas/ bla ma yab yum la gzims lam khyad par can mang po byung nas rje btsun 'byon par dgongs pa dang / bla ma mjal ba'i tshe zhabs spyi bor blangs te bla ma lags/ bdag nyi ma la stod kyi mi sdig po che gcig lags pas/ lus ngag yid gsum kyang 'bul/lto gos chos gsum kyang bla ma la zhu/ tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba cig zhu zhus pas/sdig ngo/ che yin pa'i yus nga la mi 'gro/ nga'i ched du sdig gsog tu btang ba ni min/ khyod kyis sdi ga pa ci byas gsungs/ rgyu mtshan rgyas par zhus pas/ 'dug gang ltar yang lus ngag yid gsum 'bul ba de bzang / ltos gos chos gsum kun mi 'ong / yang na lto gos ster/ chos gzhan nas tshol/ yang na chos ster/lto gos gzhan nas tshol/ de gnyis 'doms/ ngas chos ster ba 'dom na tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya mi rgya khyod rang gi snying rus la rags las gsungs/ 'o na bla ma'i drung du chos la gtad nas 'ongs pa lags pas lto gos gzhan nas tshol bar zhus/ de nas rim bzhin shar gyi ri sna zhig tu mkhar zlum po/ nub tu zla gam/ byang du gru gsum ste mkhar gsum brtsegs su bcug nas thams cad phyed tsam long skabs bka' bkyon dang bcas pas bshigs nas sa sa mal dang /rdo rdo mal du bskyel bcug pa dang / shar lhor mkhar gru bzhi skya bo dgu thog gaphyir dang bcu thog yod pa zhig brtsigs skabs bla ma'i thugs sras bu chen gsum gyis sku rtsed la rdo chen po zhig bsgril byung ba yang rming du bcug nas thog sa gnyis tsam 'byongs pa na bla ma byon te gzigs nas sngar gyi rdo de la 175

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adi gang nas byung gsungs/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ nga'i bu slob rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa rnams kyis khyod kyi g.yog mi 'ong / rdo 'di thon la rang gnas su skyol gsungs/ yang mkhar rtse nas bzhig te rdo blangs nas rang gnas su bskyal/ yang khyod rang gis longs la zhog gsungs/ blangs nas sngar ltar bzhag ste brtsegs pas mkhar bdun thog longs pa'i tshe sked pa la sgal pa zhig byung / da khyod kyis mkhar gyi rtsig 'phro zhog la khyams kyi rnam pa'i zhol ka ba bcu gnyis gtsang khang dang bcas pa zhig brtsigs gsungs/ brtsigs pas khyams longs pa'i tshe yang tshang ra la snal mig zhig byung / de nas sku rgyab thams cad mer song na sa sgal mig gsum ka nas rnag khrag zag pa dang / na tsha sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byung yang / da dung bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs kho na mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /mthar bde mchog gi dbang bskur ba'i tshe lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyir 'khor mngon sum du bstan nas/ gsang mtshan bzhad pa rdo rje zhes bstsal/ dbang dang gdams ngag thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang / dka' spyad drag pos nyams su blangs nas bsgrubs pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i sngon byon pa'i rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyis bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te/ ci gsung gi bka' bzhin du bsgrubs nas dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa yin no/ /gzhan yang dpe du ma la bsams kyang bsten par gdams pa ni/ kun mkhyen chen po nas/ dka' thub dpung gnyen dpa' bo rgyal po dang / /slob dpon sman pa phan 'dogs grogs kyi 1spyapes/ /dge ba'i bzhes gnyen bsten

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlabartson par bya/ /des ni 'di phyir bde legs chos 'grub bo/ /zhes dusartag tu g.yel ba med par gces spras dang mos gus kyis bsten pa'i gdams ngag ni/ phyi ro' pa'i don med pa'i dka' thub me lnga bsten pa la sogs pa la'ang 'bad pa drag po byed na/ bdag gis don yod pa bde ba nas bde bar 'khrid par byed pa'i bla ma la mos gus dang / bsnyen bkur ci'i phyir mi bya snyam pa dang /'jig rten pa rnams dpung gnyen gyi don du rje dpon la sogs pa bkur zhing mchod na/ bdag gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las skyob pa'i bla ma la ci'i phyir mi mchod snyam pa dang / dar cig gi 'jig pas skrag pa rnams dpa' bo bsten na/ bdag gis gtan gyi 'khor ba dang ngan song las thar bar byed pa'i bla ma ci'i phyir mi bsten snyam pa dang / rgyal po la'ang rin po che dang /rol mo/ dang gdugs la sogs pas smu/chod na/ bdag gis yun gyi don srid chen po ster ba'i bla ma la mos gus dang bsnyen bkur ci'i phyir mi bya snyam pa dang /bzo la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi rig pa slob pa'i slob dpon la'ang bsnyen bkur byed na/ sems can la sangs rgyas sgrub pa ston pa'i bla ma la mos gus dang bsnyen bkur ci'i phyir mi bya snyam pa dang / 'du ba snyoms pa'i sman pa'ang mchod na/ dug lnga'i gcong nad 'don pa'i bla ma la mos gus dang bsnyen bkur ci'i phyir mi bya snyam pa dang / nyin re'i 'jigs pa skyob pa'i skyel ma la'ang gces spras kyis mchod na/ bdud bzhi'i dgra las skyob pa'i bla ma la mo/sa gus dang bsnyen bkur ci'i phyir mi bya snyam pa dang / zas gos dang nor la sogs pa'i chas cung zad phan 'dogs pa de spya/ gi phyir srog kyang gtong bar nus na/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdagos 'dod kyi nor bu ster ba'i bla ma la mos gus da—ri bsnyen bkur ci'i phyir mi bya snyam nas bsten pa'i tshe yang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bya ba dang spyod pa thams cad bla ma'i thugs dang bstun nas sgrub cing / thugs dang 'gal ba'i las mi 'byung bar bsrung ba la mkhas pa dang / bka' bkuon drag pos tshar bcad kyang khro ba dang 'khon 'dzin med pa rta mchog lta bu/ bla ma'i mngags gzhugs sogs kyi phyir du 'gro 'ong gi gnas la skyo ba med pa gru lta bu/las bzang po dang ngan pa ci dang ci lta bu bka' stsal kyang mi theg pa med pa zam pa lta bu/ dka' tshegs dang tsha grang thams cad bzod pa mgar ba'i bzo stegs lta bu/ ci gsung gi bka' nyan pa bran khol lta bu/ nga rgyal spangs nas dman sa 'dzin pa phyag dar ba lta bu/ dregs pa spangs nas thams cad la gus pa khyu mchog rwa chad pa lta bus bla ma bsten dgos par mdo sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa las gsungs pa yin te/ yon tan mdzod las/ bla ma shin du srung bas mdzangs pa dang / /bka' bkuon dag la mi khro rta mchog bzhin/ /gru ltar 'gro 'ong gnas la skyo ba spang / /zam pa lta bur bzang ngan thams cad theg /bzo stegs bzhin du tsha grang gang yang bzod/ /bka' bzhin nyan pa bran khol lta bu dang / /nga rgyal spangs pa phyag dar lta bu dang / /dregs pa spangs pa khyu mchog rwa chad ltar/ /bla ma bsten zhes sde snod dag las gsungs/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bye brag la/ bsam pa'i sgo nas bsten pa dang / sbyor ba'i sgo nas bsten pa'o//dang po bsam pa'i sgo nas bsten pa ni/ rang re so so'i skye bo blo mig ma dag pas skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogadī 8kyi bdag nyid du mthong bar dka' ste/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃbadag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi mdzad spyod la'ang dge slong legs pa'i skar ma dang lhas sbyin sogs kyis g.yo sgyur mthong ba'i tshul dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyis mi pham mgon po khyi mo khog smad 'bus g.yeng bar gzigs pa la sogs pa yod de/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ sde snod bcu gnyis blo la chub pa yi/ dge slong skal bzang sdig pa'i mthus btab nas/ /ston pa'i mdzad pa g.yo sgyur mthong ba'i tshul/ /legs par bsams pas rang gis rang nyid 'chos/ /zhes dang / mdzad spyod gang yang log par mi blta ste/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi dbang phyug phal mo che/ /gdol ba g.yung po sdig spyod phal ba'i tshul/ /nyam/sa pa las kyang shin tu nyams par yod/ /ces pa ltar/ grub thob me tri bas sha ba ri pa phag gsod pa sogs mi 'tshams pa'i las byed pa mthong ba dang / nā ro pas te lo pa nya gson bsregs mdzad pa mthong ba dang / tshems bu pas rdo rje phag mo mdze mor mthong ba dang / rdo rje dril bu pas rdo rje phag mo phag rdzi mor mthong ba dang / gzhan yang bram ze chen po dgra gcan 'dzin bram ze rnams kyi snang ngor rang gi rigs las nyams shing gnas brtan gyi spyod pa spangs nas snyag mkhan mo dang lhan cig tu spyod pa la zhugs pa dang / bya da li ba grong khyer rnams su bya sna tshogs gsod pa'i tshul dang / sgeg mo rdo rje chang tshong ma 'dod chagasacan du 'bod pa dang / rigs ngan yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag rdzi mo dang lhan cig spyod la/ khro zhing brdeg pa'i ngang tshul la zhe sdang can du smra ba dang / slob dpon lā ba pa la gti mug chos su smra ba dang / ga ya ba ti grong khyer du glu ba'i las byed pa dang / dza lan ṭwāṃ7 ḍi ba byis pa'i spyod pas dus 'da' ba

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / tan ti ba thag mkhan du spyod pa la sogs mdzad spyod la nges pa med pas dag snang sbyangs ba gal che ste/ rgyud don mdor bsdus las/ bla ma'i mdzad pa thams cad la/ sangs rgyas mdzad pa nyid du bsams/ /gal te gzims sam bzhengs pa ni/ /'od gsal sgyu mar snang bar blta/ /phyag dang bskor ba gang mdzad kyang / /sangs rgyas rol pa nyid du ston/ /gar dang rnam 'gyur bzhad pa na/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa'i mdzad pa can/ /khro dang chags pa cir ston yang //sangs rgyas byang chub nyid du bsams/ /mi brgya dus gcig bsad na yang //sangs rgyas 'gro la phan mdzad nyid/ /btsun mo brgya dang rol na yang / /bde chen ye shes phyag rgya che/ /'dod pa 'dun pa ciratshosnang yang / /sangs rgyas 'dod pa bral ba yin/ /thams cad sangs rgyas mdzad pa ste/ /ci mdzad mthong ba legs pa'i lam/ /ci gsung thos pa dam pa'i chos/ /ci dgongs thams cad ma/khyen pa'i dpal/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang ji skad du/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin chen 'dis/ /gang mdzad thams cad legs pa yin/ /ci mdzad thams cad yon tan yin/ /mi gsod shan pa mdzad na yang / /de gas 'tshengs shing de ka legs/ /sems can thugs rjes 'dzin par nges/ /log g.yem 'chal ba'i tshul ston yang / /yon tan 'phel zhing yon tan 'byung / /thabs shes zung 'jug yin pa'i brda/ /rdzun gyis gzhan mgo bskor na yang / /brda' thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro kun thar ba'i lam sna 'dren/ /sku 'phrog chom po mdzad na yang / /gzhan gyi yo byad tshogs su bsgyur/ /skye bo'i phongs pa zhi ba yin/ /don la 'di 'dra'i bla ma yisda8/0/bka' baspyon mdzad na drag sngags

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyin/ /rkyen ngan bar chad sel bar nges/ /brdung brdeg mdzad na byin rlabs yiṭwāṃ/ /darshosdu sdiob thams cad de las 'byung / /mos gus can tsho nyams re da /ṅge/nyi/bye dī byeo/ra /ba'i sgo nas bsten tshul ni/ rang shar gyi rgyud las/ dang po skuyi dam tshig ni/ /dang po lus kyi bsrung bya bcu/ /bla ma'i gdong nas 'gro mi bya/ /ci phyir khrel nas rgyab phyogs 'dra/ /chos med dud 'gro'i gnas su skye//bla ma'i gzhug nas 'gro mi bya/ /ci phyir zhabs rjes gnon pa'o/ /skyabs med mgon dang bral bar skye/ /bla ma'i g.yas nas 'gro mi bya/ /ci phyir brdeg pa'i stabs su'o/ /tshe thung nad mang dmyal bar lhung / /dbu yi grib ma mnan mi bya/ /ci phyir khyad du bsad pa yin/ /ngu 'bod po'i dmyal bar lhung / /dbu skra rdog pas brdzi mi bya/ /ci phyir sangs rgyas gshung ba 'dra/ /thig nag 'dra ba'i dmyal bar skye/ /dbu sngas bzhugs gdan brdzi mi bya/ /ci phyir sangs rgyas bla med smad/ /shal ma ri la 'dzegs pa skye/ /sku la mtho yis gzhal mi bya/ /ci phyir lag gis brgyab dang mtshungs/ /mdung thung sum brgyas 'joms par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i bzhengs phyag tshur mi blang / /mtho ris thar ba'i lam sna 'gag/'du shes med pa'i dmyal bar skye/ /zab mo'i man ngag drig gsum yang //mnyan nas de yi gong du min/ /shes rab 'chal ba'i 'dam du 'dzud/ /bla ma'i zhal du ma gsol bar/ /longs spyod zas la phud bcad na/ /sha khrag 'bar ba'i lus su skye/ /gzhan yang bzhengs tshe bsdad pa na/ /mgo lus bral ba'i dmyal bar skye/ /bzhugs tshe stegs la1 sdusdad pa na/ /dmyal ba mgo 'phyang lus

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsu skye/ /de rnams sku yi dam tshig bcu/ /nyams na bskal pa po gcig /tsha grang las kyi dmyal bar skye/ /nyams pa skong na mchod rten bzhengs/ /bum par bla ma'i sku gzugs bzhengs/ /mchod cing bskor ba rgyun mi bcad/ /ces dang/ngag gi sgo nas dam bcu bsrung / /bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /de la rtog bcas bya mi rung / /rgyab nas 'phya gtam zer ba de/ /sangs rgyas rgyab kyis phyogs pa yin/ /'bras bu med par ngan song lhung / /lus rul mgul 'gag nad kyis 'debs/ /bla ma blun zhes brjod mi rung / /brjod na bskal pa phra mo gcig /byang chub lam dang phrad mi srid/ /bla ma zog che bya mi rung / /ral gri so mas lce gtubs nas/ /lkug pa'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ /zhe la 'bab pa'i tshig mi smra/ /smras nas ri 'thab bar du skye//legs par gsungs pa'i bka' mi bcag /bcag na mnar med gnas su skye//ngag tshig brlang pos zhe 'gems na/ /'o dod 'bod pa'i gnas ngan du//bskal pa stong phrag drug tu gnas/ /smras pa'i tshig la mi gnas pa/ /sdug bsngal las la yun ring spyod/ /sgro skur mang po 'dogs pa de/ /dge slong 'bum phrag bsad dang mnyam/ /mnar med dmyal ba kho nar lhung / /khyod bas nga bzang zer ba de/ /dmyal bar bskal pa yun ring gnas/ /dmod pa'i g.yo sbru sna tshogs smra/ /rtag tu rke bcad dmyal bar lhung / /de yang sku yi dam tshig yin//nyams pa skong na gzungs sngags 'bum/ /bris la mchod rten nang du gzhug/dril bu zung 'brel mang du btag /ces dang / yid kyi sgo nas dam bcu bsrung /bla ma'i dkor la brnab sems byed/18/shu dwags gnas su bskal pa gnyis//

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbaspres skom mi bzod myong bar 'gyur/ /bla ma dag la 'gran sems byed//stobor ba'i gcong rong thar med du/ /chos spyod brtson yang skye bar 'gyur/ /zhe 'gras pa yi sems byed na/ /ral gris gcod pa'i dmyal bar skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'dod chags che/ /sems na ngan song kun tu skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon zhe sdang che/ /sems na dmyal ba drug cur 'tshod/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'du shes chung //sems na ngu 'bod dmyal bar skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon grod pa che/ /sems na mnar med dmyal bar skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon nga rgyal che/ /sems na mtha' 'khob gnas su skye/ /rdo rje slob dpon khas zhan du/ /sems na bla med lam mi rnyed/ /rdo rje slob dpon rkyen bzhir rkyen bzhi ni/ bla ma 'di 'jig rten gyi bya ba la mi mkhas snyam pa dang / rang bas na tshod gzhon snyam pa dang / bza' tsho nye 'brel yin snyam pa dang /rang bas rigs dman pa yin snyam pa ste/ log pa'i 'du shes bzhi'am/ sems/ /rtag tu bsam ngan mtshang 'bru ba/ /lha klu gdug pas srog bcad nas/ /myur du dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung / /'di yang sku yi dam tshig yin/ /nyams pa gso na mtshan gyi mthar/ /gsol 'debs bstod pa bris pa 'bum/ /bshags pa'i tshig bris 'bum ther gzhug /lo zla dus mchod rgyun du bzung / /zhes so//gzhan yang rmi lam du bla ma'i kun spyod la ma dad na'ang gnyid sad ma thag tu bshags dgos te/ 'khor lo chub pa rol pa las/ gal te rmi lam nang dag tu//bla ma'i skyon dag mthong gyur na/ /sad ma thag tu bshags par bya/ /gal te bshags par ma byas na/ /'di yang mnar med rgyu 'phel 'gyur/ /zhes so//nyin par byung na skad cig gam thang cig gam nyin mtshan ma 'das pa la 183

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbashags dgos so/ /bla ma la gzhan gyis mi snyan pa brjod na'ang de nyid thabs kyis bzloog cing / nus pa med na bla ma'i yon tan bsam zhing rang gi rna ba mdzub mos bkag nas/ mi de la bsten 'dres dang bag phebs par mi bya ste/bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las/rdo rje slob dpon smod pa na/ /zhu ba'am mngon spyod las kyis bzlog /nus pa yod par ma gyur na/ /rna cha ran pas dgab par bya/ /bsten par mi bya gtam mi bya/ /gal te de dang 'dres gyur na/ /ngan song dag tu 'tshed par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /sku 'das pa'i rjes la'ang / tshes grangs gang la thugs 'phos pa de'i nyin mtshan la mchod pa sogs bka' drin dran pa'i sgo nas byed dgos pa yin te/ gal te ma byas na/ rang shar gyi rgyud las/gshegs nas 'das mchod mi 'bul na/ /rtsa ba'i nyams pa chen po ste/ /ngan song gnas nas thar mi srid/ /de dag nyams na bla ma'i sku/ /brgya rtsa bzhengs la mchod pa gsum/ /rgyun mi chad pa zla drug 'bul/ /sku yi mchod pa phyag 'tshal 'bum/ /gsung gi mchod pa bshags pa stong / /thugs kyi mchod pa mar me brgya/ /dang po zla ba drug tu 'bul/ /phyin chad dus kyi mchod pa bzung //zhes so/ /spyir smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa nas byung ba'i dam tshig ste/ sa ma ya 'bum sde yod kyang dgos su dgu gsum nyer bdun du phye ba yin la/ de yang bsdu na sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum du 'dus te/klong gsal las/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig tu/ /dam tshig thams cad 'dus par bshad/ /ces pas/ sku yi dam tshig tu rdo rje slob dpon dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sdo8 ṭwāṃm mkha' 'gro mched lcam rdo rje spun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / sems can thams cad dang 'byung ba lnga la sogs pa thams cad dang /rang gi lus la ma gus pa dang / srog gcod rku 'phrog brdeg btsog ngan smras la sogs pa dang / dag snang log cing mi dge ba'i las sdig par gyur pa thams cad mi bya bar/ phyi nang snod bcud rang lus thams cad yi dam lhar ma gyur pa med pas/ sku yi rigs su gyur pa thams cad la phyag mchod bstod pa la sogs pas dag snang phyogs med du bya'o/ /gsung gi dam tshig tu rdo rje slob dpon gyis ci gsung pa las mi 'da' zhing sangs rgyas nas gang zag phal pa'i gsung rab yan chod la brnyas par mi bya/ 'byung ba dang 'gro ba'i sgra skad thams cad la zhe sdang dang khong khro mi bya bar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung du bsam te dag snang dang mos gus bya'o/ /thugs kyi dam tshig tu mi dge ba'i rtog pa skad cig ma yan spangs la dge ba byang chub kyi sems dus rgyun chad med par 'gro ba thams cad la ci phan du bya'o/ /sku yi dam drig tu yi dam lha yi bskyed rim bsgom zhing /gsung gi dam tshig tu bzlas brjod ma bral ba/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu rdzogs rim gyi zhabor lo las mi 'da' bar bya'o/ /de ltar sku yi dam tshig bsrung ba'i gnas skabs su lus la nad med cing sems can la phan thog pas mthong na yid du 'ong zhing mthong reg thams cad dge ba la 'khod la/ mthar thug lus la rdo rje'i rten 'byon zhing gang bzhugs sa der gzhan la phan pa / skye ba 'phos nas sprul pa dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don du byed cing / mtshan dang dpe byad du 'bar ba'i skus 'gro ba'i don tu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa chen po la mnga' brnyes par 'gyur ro/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams na/ 'khor lo rin chen rnam 185

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpar brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ sku yi dam tshig las 'das na/ /sangs rgyas sku zhes tshig dang bral/ /'di ltar khams gsum sems can rnams/ /srog ni dus gcig bcad pa bas/ /phas pham pa ni sdig mtha' yas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/gnas skabs su tshe thung zhing nad smya/nga la/ mi 'dod pa thams cad 'byung zhing mthong reg thams cad ngan song du skye la/ mthar thug rdo rje dmyal bar lus kyi sdug bsngal las thar ba'i dus med do/ /gsung gi dam tshig bsrung na gnas skabs su ngag snyan zhing thams cad kyis bden par 'dzin pas lha 'dre mi gsum gyis bka' nyan pa/ rgyud lung man ngag thams cad shes shing chos kyi tshig sna tshogs rang rdol nas/ snyan ngag bstan bcos thams cad rtsom par nus shing /gsung thos pa thams cad kyi gnod 'tshe zhi nas bsam pa thams cad 'grub cing skye ba gcig gis grol ba/ mthar thug gsung gi sprul pas 'gro ba'i don byed cing chos kyi zhakhor lo dri ma med par bskor bar 'gyur ro/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams na/ de nyid las/ de bzhin gsung ni zhig pa na/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi tshig mi gnas/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /lce yi dbang po dus gcig la/ /bcad pa'i sdig pas 'di mtha' yas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/gnas skabs rtse 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa dang mi kha ldang zhing gtam gyi nyes pas rang gzhan thams cad la gnod la/ de'i tshig thos pa thams cad kyang bkra mi shis shing ngan song du skye/ mthar thug lce la meo dor lnga brgya btsug nas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /thugs kyi dam tshig bsrung bas gnas skabs su thugs kyi sprul pas 'gro ba 'dul zhing / ting nge 'dzin skye zhing yul phyogs de'i sems 186

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃcan thams cad bde ba can tu skye'o/ /mthar thug sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'khod cing thugs rdo rje dang gnyis su med pa'i ngang du mya ngan las 'da' 'o/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams na/ de nyid las/ gal te thugs nyams gyur pa na/ /khams gsum gang ba'i bsam gtan pa'i/ /don la gnas pa'i dge slong rnams/ /dus gcig sems dmigs sems sun byung / /sdig pa 'di ni pha mtha' yas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas skabs su rgyu mi dge bas rang gzhan kun la gnod cing des gang yid la byas pa de yi bsam pa mi 'grub la bkra mi shis shing nad gdon dang snying rlung la sogs pa 'byung / mthar thug ngan song las thar pa'i skabs med do/ /mdor na smin byed dbang gi sdom pa rgyud la gnas pa la/ dam tshig bsrung dgos pas/ mi dge ba mtha' dag las log nas dge ba 'ba' zhig sgrub par bya'o/ /de ltar dpal mgon bla ma de nyid bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas bsten par byas nas dgongs spyod bslab pa ni/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ /rdzing bu mchog la bsten pa'i ngang pa dang / /bung bas me tog bcud la ro myong bzhin/ /rtag tu 'grogs pa'i spyod pa ngo mtshar can/ /snyo ngal med pas bla ma'i thugs bzung nas/ /dad pas nye bar len pas yon tan myang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na rdzing bu mchog la bsten pa'i ngang pa rnams kyis rdzing bu'i chu mi rnyogs par dal gyis rtse zhing longs spyod pa dang / bung ba me tog gi tshal du rgyu ba'i tshe/ me tog gi kha dog dang dri la mi gnod par me tog gi bcud myang nas 'gro ba 'dra bar/ skyo ba dang ngal ba med par ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas bla ma'i thugs bzung ste/187

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdad pa dang snying rus kyi nyer len la brten nas/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i thos bsam bsgoms pa'i yon tan thams cad bum pa tshad ldan nas tshad ldan du byo ba bzhin du rang rgyud la 'pho bar bya dgos so/ /bzhi pa de ltar bsten cing mchod pa'i phan yon ni/ dgongs 'dus las/slob dpon dag la ma bsten par/ /sangs rgyas nam yang mi 'byung ste/ /'byung bar yang dag ngas ma mthong / /byung na dam pa'i lung dang 'gal/ /zhes pa dang /'khor lo bde ba'i rgyud las/ de phyir chos kun rtsa bar ni/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin par bshad/ /bla ma dag las ma byung ba'i/ /dngos grub rnyed par 'gyur mi srid/ /bla ma nyid las ma byung ba'i/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya 'byung mi srid/ /srid pa'i kha lo gyen du ni/ /bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pas sgrur/ /zhes dang / dgongs 'dus las/ gang 'dir mun par 'khyams pa la/ /bde chen snang ba'i lam ston pa/ /skyabs chen bla ma de nyid las/ /gzhan gyis skyobs par nus ma yin//zhes dang / bskal pa stong gi sangs rgyas pas/ /bla ma gnyan par shes par bya//ci phyir bskal pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /bla ma dag la bsten nas 'byung / /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen po nas/ dge sdig spang blang zab mo'i gnad ston cing //sdug bsngal nad sel ma rig thibs po sel/ /shes rab mig 'byed thar lam snang bar byed/ /bla ma las gzhan med phyir rtag tu bsten/ /zhes dang / sdong po bkod pa las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni bya ba dang mi bya ba thams cad ston pa/'jig rten gyi gnas 'dor ba/ sdig to dang bag med pa'i gnas thams cad las bzlog pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnardo8 pyar sbyong ba/ 'khor ba'i grong khyer nas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adon pa/ bdud kyi zhags pa gcod pa/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba/ lta ba'i 'ching ba gcod pa/ sdug bsngal gyi zug rngu 'byin pa/ mi shes pa'i thibs po sel ba/ srid pa'i chu bo las sgrol ba/ 'dod pa'i 'dam nas 'byin pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam ston pa/ zhes dang / yang rnam par grol ba'i lam ston pa/snying rje chen po bskyed pa/ shes rab kyi mig sbyong ba/ byang chub kyi sems spel ba/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ston pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i gdams pa ston pa/sa bcu'i gnas la 'god pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la gnas par byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de yang bla ma'i bya ba la yul tha dad par bang gyi mngag gzhug bya ba dang / 'phral nye bar mkho ba'i g.yog gang dgos su bya ba dang / bzhugs sar stan 'ding ba dang / gshegs sar zhabs 'bring bya ba dang /lam phyags pa dang / rang gi gos sam dar lam la sogs pa bya ba dang / spos kyis bsu zhing bskyal ba dang / dris chag chag bya ba dang / gzims khang la sogs pa'i nye 'khor du phyags dar byas pa sogs la phan yon mtha' yas pa thob pa yin te/ ye shes rgya mtsho las/ gang gis bla ma'i bya ba la/ /mkhas pa'i skal ldan gang yin te/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /bskal pa bye ba drug 'bum du/ /phyag byas pas ni 'di don che/ /bla mas bsgo ba bzhin bsgrub na/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / /bsod nams dpag tu med pa thob/ /ces so/ /bla ma la yo byad sna tshogs kyi mchod pa byed dgos te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ chos kyi tshig 'bru re'i yon bskal pa re'i bsnyen bkur byas pas mi rdzogs na bla ma 1ṭwāṃpye kyi drin lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃso/ /mchod pa'i phan yon yang / me lce phreng ba'i rgyud las/ gal te rnal 'byor blo ldan gyis/ /rang zas gos la gyong bskur nas/ /bla ma rdo rje mchod pa ni/ /zhing gi 'khor yug rgyal khams na/ /dge slong dpag tu med pa la/ /ston mo lan stong byas pa bas/ /zas sam yang na gos kyang rung / /bla ma lan cig mchod pa na/ /bsod nams brgya phrag brjod mi rdzogs/ /zhes pa dang /rdo rje ro langs kyi rgyud las/ gang gis bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /bza' btung phud kyis rtag tu mchod/ /'di yang bza' btung 'phel ba dang / /'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bkod pa po las/ rta dang glang po nor gyi dbyig/rgyal srid bu dang chung ma dang / /gser dngul zangs lcags rin po che/ /bza' bca' dga' ston na bza' dang / /snying po sman 'bru me tog dang / /chos dang zang zing longs spyod rnams/ /bla ma mnyes phyir yon tu 'bul/ /des ni dngos grub ma lus pa/ /da lta nyid du thogs med 'grub/ /gal te de ltar ma 'byor na//yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rang gi lo grangs tsam phul na/ /'dis kyang bsod nams sngar dang mtshungs/ /zhes dang / gsang ba 'dus pa las/phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che'o/ /zhes dang / yes shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/de ltar dngos grub las kyi mtha'/ /bla ma bsten pa nyid las byung / /gzhan gyis dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /des na dngos grub kun gyi dngos/ /gal te tsan dan ga bur ram/ /dri yis bla ma mnyes byas na/ /bskal pa brgya phrag gzhal med la/ /rin chen lnga yis /sdu pa bas/ /bla ma'i skra'am ba spu zhig/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrin chen lnga yis brgyan pa na/ /'di ni bsod rnams pha mtha' yas/ /ji ltar dge slong khrims ldan pa/ /'bum phrag drug cu rtsa gnyis la/ /ston mo lan bdun bcug pa bas/ /bla ma'i zhal du 'bras chan 'bru/ /rdog ma bdun drangs bsod nams la/ /brgya stong khri 'bum char mi phod/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar phul kyang gzhan la ngom pa dang bgrang ba sogs mi bya ste/ ye shes dri med las/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i phyogs dag tu/ /bkur sti rim gro sus byas pa//yongs su sgrog dang bgrang mi bya/ /gal te de ltar sus byed pa/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar bla ma mchod pa tha ma zang zing gi 'bul ba dang / 'bring lus ngag yid gsum gyi zhabs tog bsgrub pa dang / rab bsgrubs pas mnyes par byed pa dang gsum yin la/ de yang rang gi bya ba gang byed pa'i sngon du bla ma la zhus te bya dgos la/ des ni legs pa ston cing nyes pa thams cad 'gog pa yin no/ /rang nyid nyal ba'i sngas kyang bla ma bzhugs pa'i phyogs su ston pa dang / bza' btung ci za ba na bla ma dran pas phud 'bul ba dang / bya ba gang byed kyang bla mas gsungs 'byon pa yin no snyam na/ shes bzhin gyis don bsgrubs la 'bad par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa thun min nang gi sngon 'gro la/ lam thams cad kyi rming rdo skyabs su 'gro ba/ theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal/ bdud bzhi cig char du gcod pa ku su la'i tshogs bsags/ rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyuspya pya bya ba'i thabs kyi mthar phyin pa bla

mu g.yukhogablam chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃma' /swā byio+o ༵ ṭwāṃ dī ṭwāṃkā ༵lda/ kyi rming rdo skyabs su 'gro ba'i khrid la/ skyabs 'gro'i sgo dbye ba dad pa/ kun slong gi khyad par/ skyabs su 'gro tshul/ bslab bya dang phan yon bstan pa dang bzhi las/ dang po skyabs 'gro'i sgo dbye ba dad pa ni/ spyir chos thams cad kyi sgo dbye ba skyabs 'gro yin la/ sbyabs 'gro'i sgo dbye ba ni yul dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pa'i dad pa yin la/ spyir dad pa la kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos rnam pa drug tu gsungs pa yin te/ yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/ 'dod pa'i dad pas rgyu 'bras blang dor byed//mos pa'i dad pas yul mchog sems rab gzhol/ /gus pa'i dad pas bag yod mchog dang ldan/ /dang ba'i dad pas yon tan sems rab dwangs/ /yid ches dad pas chos la the tshom zad/ /nges sems dad pas thos bsam bsgoms pa yi/ /chos mchog rnams la lhag par dad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs kyang / bsdu na gsum du 'du ba yin/ dang ba'i dad pa bu chung gis ma mthong ba lta bu/ 'dod pa'i dad pa bkres pas zas 'dod pa lta bu/ yid ches pa'i dad pa thi bya tshang la zhugs pa lta bu'o/ /de yang dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ dad pas sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad srung zhing 'phen bar byed//dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshoni byed yin/ /zhes dang / yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes dang /yid bzhin rin po che'i mdzod las/1rdi nas mi 'gyur ri rgyal lta bu dang //

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'aphel 'grib gnyis med nyi mkha' rgya mtsho la/ /thang lhod gnyis med gzhu mo'i rgyud dang mtshungs/ /skyo dub med pa gru zam lta bu la/ /rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhud chen bzhin/ /mnyen lcug ldan pa dar thag lta bu la/ /rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs nam mkha' lta bur brtan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gyur ldog med pa'i dad pa ri rgyal lta bu/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i dad pa nyi ma lta bu/ kha gting med pa'i dad pa rgya mtsho lta bu/ byas yus med pa'i dad pa ma lta bu/ mtha' dbus med pa'i dad pa nam mkha' lta bu/ thang lhod med pa'i dad pa gzhu dung ba'i rgyud lta bu/ gzhan gyis bsgyur ram bka' bkuon la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa nam mkha' lta bu/ skyo dub med pa'i dad pa gru zam lta bu/rgyun chad med pa'i dad pa chu bo'i gzhung lta bu/ gus shing mnyen lhag dang zhe sas brgyan pa'i dad pa dar thag lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i dad pa gang la yod pa de'i rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ dad pa'i rang bzhin sa gzhi bzang po 'dra/ /chos kun gzhir gyur dge tshogs rnam 'phel byed/ /dad pa gzings 'dra srid pa'i chu bo sgrol/ /skyel ma dang 'dra bdud dang nyon mongs skyob/ /zhon pa dang 'dra thar pa'i gling du 'dren/ /nor bu'i rgyal bzhin ci bsam 'grub pa ste/ /dpa' bo dang 'dra sdig to zil gyis gnon/ /tshogs bsags dam pa rnams kyi nor mchog lags/ /zhes dad pa zhing sagashin po dang 'dra ste/ byang chub kyi myu gu rgyas par 'khrungs pa/ rgya mtsho'i gzings ltar dad pas 'khor ba'i chu bo las sgrol ba/ skyel ma bzang po dang 'dra bar dad pas nyon mongs kyi dgra las skyob pa/ dad pa bzhon pa bzang sduo 3dang 'dra ste thar pa'i gling du 'dren pa/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdad pa 'dod pa'i re ba 'grub pa'i nor bu dang 'dra ba/ dad pa dpa' bo dang 'dra bar mi dge ba tshar gcod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /des na bla ma dkon mchog gsum la thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang / de rang rgyud la 'jug par byed pa ni dad pa dang mos gus kho na la rags las pa yin pas na/ rang la dad pa mos gus rab cig yod na bla ma dkon mchog gi thugs rje dang byin rlabs yang rab cig 'jug /de bzhin du dad pa dang mos gus 'bring zhig yod na byin rlabs dang thugs rje yang 'bring zhig 'jug /dad pa dang mos gus tha ma zhig las med na/ byin rlabs thugs rje cung zad las mi 'jug cing / dad pa dang mos gus rtsa ba nas med na byin rlabs dang thugs rje gtan nas mi 'jug pa yin/ rang la dad pa med na sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal nas rjes su bzung yang mi phan te/ o rgyan chen po nas/ dad med brag phug byang bltas lta bu la/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma nam yang 'char dus med//ces dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la//dkar bo'i chos ni mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ skal med rnams la dad pa cung zad med/ /de yi skyon ni shin tu mtha' yas ldan/ /mtsho gting rdo 'dra thar pa'i skam dang bral/ /mnyan med gru 'dra srid las sgrol dus med/ /lag rdum phyin 'dra dge ba'i bgo skal med/ /sa bon tshig 'dra byang chub myu gu med//long ba dang 'dra chos gzugs snang ba med/ /'khor dong chud 'dra gtan du 'khor bar 'khyams/ zhes so/ /de phyir chos thams cad kyi nang nas yod na 194

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdes chog yid khyed shes kyi dad pa yin te/ o rgyan chen pos/ yid khyed shes kyi kāod/ /pas byin rlabs 'jug /blo the tshom dang bral na ci bsam 'grub/ /ces gnyis pa kun slong gi khyad par ni/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs shing skrag nas mtho ris lha mi'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer bas skyabs su 'gro ba ni skyes bu chung ngu'i skyabs 'gro dang / 'khor ba'i gnas mtho dman thams cad sdug bsngal du shes nas rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar nas zhi ba myang 'das kyi go 'phang tsam don du gnyer nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni skyes bu 'bring gi skyabs 'gro dang / khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i ched du skyabs su 'gro ba ni skyes bu chen po'i skyabs 'gro yin te/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma las/ chung dang 'bring dang mchog gyur pa/ /skyes bu gsum du shes par bya/ /gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis/ /zhabor ba'i bde ba tsam dag la/ /rang nyid don du gnyer byed pa/ /skyes bu de ni tha mal shes/ /srid pa'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing / /sdig pa'i las las ldog bdag nyid/ /gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer/ /skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya/ /rang rgyud rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod/ /skyes bu de ni mchog yin no/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa skyabs su 'gro tshul la/19gi nang gsang gsum las/ dang po phyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyi dkon mchog gsum ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum ste/ sangs rgyas zhes pa'i nges tshig ni ngo bo ye stong ka nas dag cing glo bur gyi 'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs thams cad sangs pa dang / thugs rje ye shes phyogs med du rgyas shing gang 'dul gyi sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /chos la yang gsum ste/ bstan pa'i chos/ bsgrub pa'i chos/ zhi ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos te/ mdor na ngo bo rnam par dkar zhing / rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid stong par 'dzin pa/ dbye na rgyu 'bras gnyis sam/ sde snod gsum mam/ theg pa dgu'o/ /dge 'dun la yang gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gsum du gsungs kyang / mdor na don la ngo bo mi dge bas dben pa/ nges tshig dge ba la 'dun pa/ dbye na phyi gzugs brnyan rtags kyi dge 'dun/ gzhan don sems bskyed kyi dge 'dun/ yang dag don gyi dge 'dun no/ /de ltar yang lung ṭwāṃ~Xs/ ṭwāṃ dī/ོrgya/sa/ce ktoonag ༵ /ོ༵ ོ༵/ la/ma dang ni/ /dge 'dun grogasakyi tshul du gnyis pa nang gi dkon mchog gsum ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum las/ de yang bla ma ni rang rgyud grol zhing gzhan rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid ldan pa rnams dang / khyad par da lta rang re rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las drangs shing zhi bde thar gling du khrid pa'i ded dpon rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas pa ste/gzhan yang skyon zad yon tan rdzogs rdoX sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon padma

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃ'abyung gnas ni byin rlabs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas so/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams bsgrub pa bka' brgyad/ gzhan yang rgyud sde drug gi lha tshogs ma lus pa thams cad dang khyad par 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal khro bo dbang chen rta mgrin dngos grub thams cad kyi bdag nyid gcig pu'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum ni/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum las/chos sku kun tu bzang po la 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/bde gshegs thams cad bskyed pa'i yab yin no/ /longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum la 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan don gyi lha'o/ /sprul sku rdo rje 'chang la zhabor sprul pa'i sku'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ thugs rjes 'gro la brtse ba'i bdag nyid can yin no/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi dkon mchog gsum ni/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum las/ ngo bo ka dag spros pa dang bral zhing grol ba chen po bzhi dang ldan pa/rang bzhin lhun grub yon tan phun sum tshogs shing rang gsal 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa'o/ /thugs rje ma 'gags kun la khyab cing sna tshogs rang grol 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /yang na phyi yi dkon mchog gsum ni/ sangs rgyas ni don gnyis kyis bsdus pa/ skye med kyi cha nas bdag don chos sku/ 'gags med kyi cha nas gzhan don gzugs sku'o/ /chos ni lung rtogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa/ lung gi chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ rtogs pa'i chos boslab pa gsum/ dge 'dun ni/ ldan grol gyis bsdus pa/ sde snod gsum gyi dan rigs pas thas bsam bsgam gsum dang ldan pa/ bslab pa gsum gyis 197

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrgyud grol ba'o/ /nang gi dkon mchog gsum ni/ sems nyid spros mtha' dang bral ba bla ma/ rang rtsal 'gags med du 'char ba yi dam/ gnyis med bde stong gi rnam rol mkha' 'gro/ gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum ni/ gzhi ka dag spros bral gyi lta ba/ lam lhun 'grub 'od gsal gyi sgom pa/ 'bras bu sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du 'dod pa'ang yod do/ /de ltar skyabs yul gyi rgyu mtshan yang dag par shes par byas nas/ tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ rang nyid 'dug pa'i sa phyogs 'di dag thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba la 'bar 'bur gshang gshong gi rnam pa med pa gzhon nu ma'i lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ legs par phyis pa'i me long gi ngos ltar dag pa/ dar gyis 'bol gdan ltar reg bya 'jam pa/ tha gru che zhing rgya shin tu yangs pa/ dri ma med pas 'od gsal zhing / gser gyi drwa bas khebs pa/ 'od zer brgya phrag mang po 'phro ba/ de'i dbus su rang gi mdun du dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lnga pa/ lo 'dab dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa phyogs kun tu rgyas pas shar lho nub byang gi nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa/ yal 'dab thams cad la rin dril g.yer 'phyang 'phrul sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i dbus kyi yal ga cung zad mtho ba'i steng du seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan gsum brtsegs kyi steng du ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang hūm̐spya po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmadangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsdigs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na ka pa la 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam ljon shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ sku la zab ber dmar smug dang / dar mthing ga'i phod ka/ dar dmar gyi chos gos gser gyi pa drwa can gsol ba/ dbu la pad zhu gsol ba/yum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/ de lta bu zhig rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar zhal rang la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsgom/ mdun gyi yal ga'i steng du bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la bskal pa bzang po'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/thams cad kyang mchog gi sprul sku tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad can/ dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo sogs mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje sgyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga /sku la 'od dang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro bar gsal/ g.yas kyi yal ga'i steng du byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs te rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon po gtso bor gyur ba'i nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar gser dmar ljardo sduthing ga /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rgyan

g.yu khog bla ma chos daphyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchas bcu gsum gyis mdzes shing / zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ g.yon gyi yal ga'i steng du shā ri bu dang mo'u 'gal gyi bu ste nyan thos mchog gnyis la nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ phyag na 'khar bsil dang lhung bzed bsnams pa zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyab kyi yal ga'i steng du 'ja' 'od kyi drwa mig gi klong du chos dkon mchog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can la ā li kwa li'i rang sgra sgrogs pa/ rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng ma byas te thams cad kyang gdong dar rang la bstan te bzhugs pa/ o rgyan chen po'i dbu gtsug tu 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje paṇḍi ta'i chas can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin rdo rje dang bcas pad sdong rtser bum pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag dril bu bcas pad sdong pod ral/ g.yas su o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo paṇḍi ta'i chas can/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can phyag gnyis las gyes pa'i pad sdong rtser ral gri glegs bam/ g.yon du 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rang mdangs mtsho byung bzhad pa'i ge sar paṇḍi ta'i chas can/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad las gyes pa'i rtser ral gri dang glegs bam/ gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa dkar chas glegs ral can zhabs phyed skyil phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/g.yon gdan brten pad sdong pod ral/ g.yas su 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu rdo rje slob dpon gyi chas can/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na gser gyi 'khor lo/ g.yon du 'jigs med phriṭwāṃ0 sdus 'od zer dkar chas glegs ral

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃcan/ phyag g.yas rdo rje sdig 'dzub dang bcas mkha' la phyar ba/ phyag g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa/gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba klong chen ram 'byams paṇḍita'i chas can/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung / phyag gnyis su sa gnon ngal bso'i phyag rgya las gyes pa'i pad sdong pod ral/ g.yas su mkhas grub dge legs rgya mtsho dang / g.yon du slob ma bzang po gzhon nu sangs rgyas paṇḍi ta'i chas can/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya las gyes pa'i pad sdong dang pod ral/gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tu chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan 'khor lo sgyur rgyal chas/phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag las gyes pa'i pad sdong dang pod ral/ de'i g.yas su lo bai ro tsā na paṇḍi ta'i chas can/ phyag g.yas skyabs spyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag po ti/ rgyal po'i g.yon du ye shes mtsho rgyal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas can/ zhabs btsun mo rol stabs/ phyag g.yas mchog spyin/ g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsi'i gang ba dkur brten pa/ rgyal po'i spyi bor o rgyan rin po che padma 'od 'bar ltar/ dri med bshes gnyen phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ dzña na su dra phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag pu sti/shrī seng ha phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas bsdig 'dzub nam mkhar gtad de/g.yon ka pā la dkur brten pa/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen chos 'chad phyag rgyas pu sti/ bzhi ka he ru ka'i cha byad/ dga' rab rdo rje sku mdog dkar po sangs rgyas sprul sku ji lta ba phyag gnyis chos 'chad/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyi ltar/kun tu bzang po rgyan med yab rkyang /sdusna so so'i gong ma'i gdan khri la 'og

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃma'i dbu ma reg tsam du ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa dang bcas tho brtsegs su bzhugs par bsgom/ o rgyan chen po'i sku'i mtha' bskor du steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam lha tshogs/ 'og gi cha la ma dang mkha' 'gro/ de dag gi bar mtshams kun tu ye shes dang las la grub pa'i chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad zhal phyir phyogs nas dam chos byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bzlog pa dang phyi'i bar chad nang du mi gtong ba'i phrin las mdzad pa/ chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad zhal nang du phyogs pas dam chos byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrung ba dang / nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba'i phrin las mdzad pa/ de dag thams cad kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag nyid la rjes su brtse zhing / 'dren pa'i ded dpon po gcig tu bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi g.yas su skye ba da res kyi pha/ g.yon du ma/mdun du rang nyid la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs gnyis kyis thog drangs khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad mi yi gzugs su gyur nas sa gzhi'i ngos na khrom tshogs pa bzhin du 'khod de/ lus gus pas phyag 'tshal/ ngag gus pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro brjod/ yid gus pa'i sgo nas mtho ru gtong ngam/ dma' ru gtong ngam/ sgyid sdug legs nyes ci mdzad rung nyi ma de ring nas bzung ste/ blo pha la mi 'dri/ gros ma la mi byed/ thag rang gis mi bcad/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po khyed la bsten/ khyed cig bsgrub snyam du gdung2 sdu drag pos ci mdzad khyed shes blo gtad
