g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃling bskyur bcas te/ dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs zhes thun re la ci nus su bsags shing tha na'ang skyabs 'gro 'bum phrag gcig ma thub kyi bar du/thun du bcad nas 'gro nges dang / rgyun du yang skyabs 'gro la yi dam bya/mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe skyabs yul gyi lha tshogs las 'od zer gyi rnam pa grangs med pa spros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la phog pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las nyon bag chags sdig sgrib dang bcas pa mun khung du nyi ma shar ba bzhin du sangs sangs dag nas bdag dang sems can thams cad bya khyu 'ur rdos dkrogs pa ltar 'ur dir gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs rnams la thim/yang na 'od zer byung bas sems can rnams dag pa'i zhing du drangs/ gang ltar yang skyabs yul rnams kyang rim par 'od du zhu nas mdun gyi sangs rgyas thams cad shākya thub pa la thim/ g.yas kyi byang sems thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la thim/ g.yon gyi nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad shā ri'i bu la thim/ de dag thams cad rgyab kyi chos la thim/ chos dkon mchog thams cad kyang o rgyan chen po la thim/ mtha' bskor gyi bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang o rgyan chen po la thim bla ma yang mtha' nas rim par 'od du yal te chos sku spros bral gdod ma'i ngang la dus gsum gyi 'khrul ba dang bral nas yun ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang ba na snang srid thams cad skyabs yul lha tshogs kyi skur bkra lam gyis gsal la bsngo ba dgos te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dkon mchog gsum po 'grub gyur nas/ /'aṭwāoṃ ༵ gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'agod par shog /zhes sogs bsngo smon bya/bzhi pa bslab bya dang phan yon bstan pa las/ dang po bslab bya la/dgag sgrub cha mthun gsum las/ dang po dgag pa'i bslab bya ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ /nam du yang ni lha gzhan la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs 'gro ba/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs 'gro mi bya/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la gnod 'tshe mi bya/dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mu stegs can la mi bsten pa'o/ /de yang bod 'dir mu stegs dngos su mi 'byung yang / sdig can gyi grogs rgyu 'bras la bskur pa 'debs pa'i mi dang mi 'grog go/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i bslab bya gsum ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas sangs rgyas kyi sku rten dang thugs rten satsā'i chag dum tsam la yang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi 'du shes bzhag ste gus pas mchod dgos te/ pad dkar las/ sku gzugs rnam pa mang po der sprul nas/ /'gro ba dge la spyod pa'i don byed do/ /ces so/ /chos la skyabs su song nas yi ge 'bru gcig yan chad la chos dkon mchog gi 'du shes bzhag ste ma gus pa spang zhing gus par byed dgos te/ snyan gyi gong rgyan du/ lnga brgya'i tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid yi ge'i gzugs su gnas/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus par gyis/ /zheX 0ṭwāṃsungs so/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsong nas rab byung gi rtags ska rags ser po bcing ba yan chad dang tha na lhan pa dmar ser tsam yang dge 'dun dkon mchog gi 'du shes bzhag ste gus par byed dgos pa ni/ yang de skad du/ ma 'ongs thub pa'i bstan pa nub pa'i tshe /dmar dang ser po gos kyi ras ma kun/ /lha rnams kyis bsdus dad pa'i rten du khyer/ /ri rab rtse ru mchod rten byed par gsungs/ /zhes dang / sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ sngon rgyal pos gsod pa la thug pa'i mi dur khrod du bor ba na/ srin mo chen mo rnams kyis de'i mgul du ngur smig gi tshal bu thogs pa mthong nas gus pas phyag 'tshal te/ skyes bu khyod ni ma bsnyengs bde bar bzhugs/ /khyod la bdag cag gnod pa mi bgyid do/ /skra breg chos gos gyon pa khyod mthong nas/ /bdag cag sangs rgyas rjes su dran par gyur/ /zhes bstod pa'o/ /gsum pa cha mthun gyi bslab bya gsum ni/ rang la blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag nas mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsnyen bkur bya zhing / sku'i grib ma tsam yang mi 'gom/ des bka' bstsal ba'i gsung rnams la dam chos dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag ste ci gsungs tshad mar 'dzin zhing bka' zur tsam yang mi bcag/bla ma'i 'khor grwa slob rnams la dge 'dun dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag ste sgo gsum gus pas bsten te mi mnyes pa skad cig tsam yang mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang dus rtag tu dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa dang / tha na'ang ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod cing dus rgyun du skyabs su 'gro ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba sogs dad pa dang dag snang mos gus thang lhod med pa la bslab par bya'o//205

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adi la mkhas pa kha cig gi cha mthun gyi bslab pa gsum du bzhed pa'ang yod do/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum po yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang rgud pa ma lus pa la dbugs 'byin pa yin te/ mdo rgyal mtshan dam pa nas/ 'jigs pa'am bag tsha ba'am skru zing zhes byed par gyur na sangs rgyas rjes su dran par gyis shig /gal te mi dran na chos rjes su dran par gyis shig/gal te mi dran na dge 'dun rjes su dran par gyis shig /des 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /lha min gyi g.yul nye bar gnas par gyur pa la/ brgya byin gyis lha rnams la smras pa/ khyed cag g.yul du 'jug pa'i tshe nga'i rgyal mtshan mchog rnam par rgyal byed rjes su dran par bgyis na des 'jigs pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes ston pa de bzhin du dkon mchog gsum dran par bya bar gsungs pa dang / de las bsod nams tshad med pa thob pa ni smos ci dgos/ gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam thos pa'i phan yon yang / za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa 'di thos pas de dag ni/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su padma la brdzus te skye nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas las chos nyan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang grong khyer 'khor mo 'jig tu byon nas bshang gci dag gi 'dam rdzab chen po'i khrod na srin bu'i rigs brgya stong phrag du ma gnas pa'i drung du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bung ba'i gzugs su sprul nas za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las yi ge drug pa'i sgra byung ste/sduḍis rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo chos la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃphyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ngo / /sem sa can de dag gis sgra de thos pa dang dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran nas de rnams kyi las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ kha nas tsandan gyi dri ngad ces bya ba'i byang chub sems dpar gyur nas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes par gyur to/ /zhes dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ /bdud rnams bye bas bsad par mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni zhabrugs gyur kyang / /de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /zhes dang / sa yi snying po zhabor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ khams gsum kun la bde skyid pa/ /de yang dkon mchog gsum las byung / /de bas bde zhing skyid 'dod pa/ /rtag tu dkon mchog mchod par bya/ /ces pa dang / phag mo'i rtog brjod las/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song na/ /'jig pa med par thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig gsum la skyabs song na/ /mi de ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing / /mi yi lus dag bor nas ni/ /de ni lha yi lus thob bo/ /lha yi lus dag bor nas ni/ /des ni sangs rgyasabyang chub 'grub/ /ces pa dang / ngan song gsum dang thabs min dang / /'jigs tshogs lta ba dman pa las/ /skyobs phyir skyabs kyi dam par 'dod/ ces pa dang /kun dga' bos zhus pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa gsum/ /'jig rten kun gyi skyabs yin te/ /su zhig 'phags par 'dod pa rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dod/ ces dang / skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ gang zhig dkon mchog gsum ༷ 0/bas 'gro ba/ /de yis myur du sangs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrgyas thob/ /ces dang / dri ma med pa'i mdo las/ skyabs su song ba'i bsod nams gang / /gal te de la gzugabasamachis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang nas/ /de ni de las lhag par 'gyur/ /zhesaso/ /de yang 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyobs shing bde chen thar gling du 'dren pa'i ded dpon mi bslu nges pa gtan gyi snyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum kho na yin te/bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab tsa na/ /su dag skyabs su mi 'gyur te/ /lang tsho ma yin stobs kyang min/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du 'gro/ /zhes pa dang / lung las/ gshin rje'i pho nya byung ba'i tshe/ /pha ma khyod kyi skyabs ma yin/ /gnyen 'dun rtsa lag kun kyang min/ /de dag kun rom̐/sa /khyod bor nas/ /rang nyid gcig pu phyi mar 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa yin gnyis pa theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i khrid la/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med rnam bzhi bshad pa/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug bshad pa/ de dag gi phan yon bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa la/ blo stobs kyi sgo nas dbye na gsum yod de/ kun mkhyen chen po nas/ rgyal sras de yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rang nyid grol nas 'gro ba sgrol 'dod pa/ /rgyal po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang dang 'gro ba mnyam du thar 'dod pa/ khru ba lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'gro ba bsgral nas rang nyid zhi 'dod pa/ /rdzi ོ༵ 8lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' gsum///

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrim bzhin grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum dang / /bdun dang gsum gyisagrol ba 'thob pa ni/ /dbang po'i rim pa lags par mdo las gsungs/ /de'ang byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chen po'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ rang nyid thog mar sangs rgyas nas phyis 'gro ba sgrol ba ni/ dper na rgyal pos rgyal srid thob nas rgyal 'bangs bde ba la 'god par 'dod pa ste/ 'phags pa byams pa lta bu'i sems bskyed du mdo du ma las bshad do/ /rang dang 'gro ba mnyam du grol bar 'dod pa ni ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ mnyan pa dag gru'i 'grul pa dang rang nyid mnyam du chu bo'i pha rol tu phyin par 'dod pa'o/ /thog mar sems can bsgral nas gdod rang nyid grol bar 'dod pa dpe med pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ ra lug dang ba lang gi rdzi bo dag gis 'phrang la sogs pa dog cing nyam nga ba'i gnas mthong ngam/ gzhan du'ang rang gi mdun du de dag bcug nas/ gcig kyang phyi la ma lus par byas te 'gro ba ni 'jam dpal dang shākya thub pa lta bu'i sems bskyed yin no/ /de dag kyang dbang po rtul po rnams kyis grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'bring po bdun dang /rnon po gsum gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba'o/ /zhes dang /dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ de la 'dod chen po'i sems bskyed pas ni grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum gyi 'khor ba las thar ba yin no/ /ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed pas ni grangs med bdun gyi tshad phyin pa yin no/ /dpe med pa'i sems bskyed pas ni grangs med pa gsum gyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na2/0ḍims stobs chung ngu dang / 'bring dang /

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchen por gyur pa'i phyir te/ 'di dag dper bya na/ 'khor los sbrur ba'i rgyal po dang / gru'i kha lo ba dang / skyong byed lta bu'o zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /sa mtshams kyis dbye na/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam na mos pa spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la lhag bsam rnam dag gi sems bskyed/ dag pa'i sa gsum na rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi yod/ sems bskyed rang gi ngo bos dbye na kun rdzob dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod/ kun rdzob sems bskyed la yang nang gses kyi dbye ba gnyis te/ smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ de yang spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes dang / padma'i snying gur las/ sems can don la smon byed pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur ba'i lam/ /zhes dang / gzhan dag srid par grol bar brtson/ /sems dpa' 'gro ba'i don la brtson/ /pha rol phyin drug spyod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin la/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam de lta bu'i sems bskyed la bsten nas yun ring por blo sbyangs pa'i mthu las/ mthar mthong lam du chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid/ spros pa thams cad bral ba'i ye shes stong pa nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin no/ /de lta bu'i kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las thob dgos pa dang /don dam sems bskyed sgom stobs kyis thob par 'dod la/ 'dir las dang po 210

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃba'i dbang du byas te/ cho ga ltar len tshul ni sems bskyed 'bog chog ltar shes par bya zhing / de ltar thob pa'i sems bskyed de mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir rgyun du nyams su len dgos pa yin te/ de yang mdun gyi nam ma/khar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad sems bskyed kyi dpang por skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing ji lta ba bzhin gsal gdab nas/'di ltar nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med par shes par byas nas/ snying rje'i mthus mkha' khyab kyi sems can dmigs shing /shes rab stobs kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs te bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas sngon gyi rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad spyod rlabs po che la bslab cing 'khor ba na sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam mo snyam pas/ho/ sna tshogs snang ba sogs zhes ci mang du brjod pa'i mthar tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs rnams la mos gus dung dung ba zhig byas pas/ lha tshogs thams cad mtha' nas rim pa bzhin du yal te dbus kyi bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus la thim/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis skyabs yul lha tshogs de dag gi thugs rgyud na bzhugs pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang rgyud la lhang gis skye bar bsam/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa ༷༷sa pa med par yang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces sogs bsnga smon bya'o/ / 211

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃganyis pa smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med rnam bzhi bshad pa ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ byamasapa'i sa gzhir snying rje'i me tog bkram/ /dga' ba'i grib bsil btang snyoms chu gtsang gis/ /'gro la phan phyir rang gi sems sbyang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba dang mi ldan pa'i sems can la dmigs nas de bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa byams pa dang / sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i sems can zhig la dmigs nas de sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa snying rje dang / sdug bsngal med la bde ba dang ldan pa'i sems can zhig la dmigs nas de dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dga' ba/ chags sdang can la dmigs nas bde sdug gi rgyu nye ring chags sdang dang bral bar shog cig snyam pa btang snyoms yin no/ /mdor na ldan 'dod bral 'dod mi 'bral zhi bar 'dod pa bzhi'i sgo nas tshad med bzhi 'byed pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ kun mkhyen chen po nas/ byams pas zhe sdang med cing longs spyod rdzogs/ /me long ye shes rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snying rjes 'dod chags med cing chos kyi sku/ /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byed/ /ces dang /dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul pa'i sku/ /bya grub ye shes dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / btang snyoms nga rgyal meongs med ngo bo nyid/ /mnyam nyid chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byed/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bda~X 2gzhan brje ba zhes pa'i don ni gtso

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbor rang gces par 'dzin pa dang / gzhan yal bar 'dor ba'i blo gnyis brjes nas/ gzhan la rang ltar gces par 'dzin zhing / rang la gzhan ltar yal bar 'dod pa'i blo skyed pa yin te/ yang de nyid las/ bdag nyid gzhan la gtang ba dang / /gzhan rnams bdag bzhin bzung bar bya/ /zhes dang /'chad ka bas/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang / /de gnyis rlung la skyon par bya/ /ces dang / jo bo rjes/ chags sdang zhabrul ba'i nyes pa 'byung nye bas//bdag gzhan brje ba'i bsam pa goms par mdzod/ /ces dang / bde skyid byung tshad gzhan la byin/ /sdug bsngal byung tshad rang la longs/ /zhes dang / spyan snga bas/ 'jig rten pa rnams gzhan bas rang gces par 'dzin te/ 'o skol rang bas gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ sdug bsngal ma lus bdag bde 'dod las byung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs/ /de phyir bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes dang /gzhan phan rtsa ba yin pasabadag gzhan brje ba sgoms/ /zhes dang / bdag 'dzin dgra ru shes nas 'dul rgyu'i dgra gzhan spangs/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ /'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa/ /de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen des ko bdag la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / sems can mi srun nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis yong mi lang / /khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ /dgra de thams cad bcom dang dīṭwāṃ3/ /sa steng 'di dag ko g.yog tu/ /de

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsnyed ko bas ga la lang / /lham mthil tsam gyi ko bas ni/ /sa steng thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug bshad pa ni/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo bcu las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab phar phyin drug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan te/ thabs smiod pa'i phyogs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga/ shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs dang drug yan te/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/ dang po lnga ni bsod nams dam pa'i tshogs/ /phyi ma gcig ni ye shes tshogs chen te/ /gnyis la ma bsten sangs rgyas yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /dang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ chos kyi sgyin pa/mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang gsum las/ zang zing gi sbyin pa de la gtong ba dang / gtong ba po/ shin tu gtong ba dang gsum yod de/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ zas gos rta dang shing rta glang po sogs/ /mkho dgu'i yo byad dpag med gtong ba ste/ /bu dang bu mo la sogs gtong ba che/ /mgo dang mig sogs shin tu gtong ba ste/ /zhes dang / yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/zang zing la yang rnam pa gsum yin te/ /gtong dang gtong ba che dang shin tu gtong / /gtong ba zhes bya zas gos shing rta dang / /glang po yul khams gzhan la sgyin pa'o/ /gtong ba po bu dang bu mo dang / /khyim thabs gtong yin shin tu gtong ba ni/ /bya dka'i gnas te mgo dang yan lag gtong / /zhes dang /mdo las/ gtong ba zhes bya ni/ zas dang / gosadang /shing rta dang / glang po 214

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃche gzhan la sbyin pa'o/ /gtong ba chen po zhes bya ba ni/ bu dang bu mo/ khyim thabs sbyin pa'o/ yīn tu gtong ba zhes bya ba ni/ bya dka' ba ste/ mgo dang /mig dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa la sogs pa gtong ba'o/ /zhes so/ /chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ chos bsgrub pa'i yo byad mthun rkyen gang la gang 'os su sbyin pa dang /khyad par du smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi sadam sa pa'i sgo nas yang dag pa'i don ston par byed pa dang / mdor na lung dang / bslab pa 'bogs pa la sogs dbang bo dang 'tshams pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos gang 'os su ster ba ni/ sbyin pa rnams kyi nang nas chos kyi sbyin pa mchog tu gyur ba'o/ /mdo las/smyu gu dang / snag tsha dang / glegs bam sbyin pa ni chung ngu'o/ /skal pa ji lta bzhin du nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / bla na med pa'i chos ston pa ni chen po'o/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dzin du 'jug cing / nam mkha' ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos ston pa ni shin tu chen po'o/ /zhes so/ /mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa ni/ gzhan dag nad gdon me chu mtshan mo dang /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mu ges nyen pa sogs mdor na 'jigs pa mtha' dag la rang la stobs nus ci yod kyis skyob pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba thams cad las/ sems can gyi srog bskyabs pa phan yon che bar gsungs pa yin no/ /rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ byang chub 'dod pas lus kyang gtong dgos na/ /phyi rol dngos po rnams la smos ci dgos/ /de phyir lan dang rnam smin mi re ba'i/ /sbyin pa gtong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa tshul khri~Xṭwāṃ kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la/ nyes spyod

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsnom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum yod pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ sdom dang chos sdud sems can don byed de/ rgyal sras rnams kyi tshul khrims gsum rtag bsrung / /zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni mi dge ba las sems bsrung ba yin no/ /dge ba'i chos srung ba'i tshul khrims kyis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par bsgrub pa yin no/ /sems can kyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni gzhan la phan pa lhur len pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang gsum yin te/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ gzhan don du mi 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba thams cad dug bzhin du spang ba'o/ /dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrim ni/ dge rtsa mtha' dag rang rgyud la sgrub par byed pa'o/ /sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ rang 'dod rtsa ba nas zad pa'i dus bsdu dngos bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa yin te/mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo bcu las/ sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /don spyod don mthun bsdu dngos bzhi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag gi gnang bkag gi khyad par ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ so sor thar ba'i sdom pa'i rang dus brtsis na mi dge ba bcu rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba yin pas gnang ba'i skabs med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' la ni bdun gzhan don du gnang ba dang / sngags la mi spong bar thabs kyi char bsten te shing las me ltar ye shes skye ba'i rgyur lam zab pas khyad par ṭwāṃ ḍis pa yin te/ he ru ka gal po las/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgazhi la spong bar byed pa ni/ /skye bo'i lhum ra'i dug sdong 'dra/ /sbyong bar byed pa'i lam pa ni/ /'tshe byed mkhas pas mthong ba 'dra/ /sgyur bar byed pa'i gsang sngags pa/ /bram ze rigs sngags grub pa 'dra/ /dbang du byed pa'i nang pa ni/ /rma byas zas su mthong ba 'dra/ /rang sar 'jig pa'i rdzogs pa/ /'byung chen ltos kyi sa gzhi 'dra/ zhes dang / kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/theg pa'i don 'dus shes pa'i chos drug ni/ nyon mongs rang khar tha mal skyon shes dgos/ /nyon mongs spong ba nyan rang lam shes dgos/ /nyon mongs sbyong ba rgyal sras lam shes dgos/ /nyon mongs bsgyur bar gsang sngags lam shes dgos/ /rang bzhin yongs shes rang byung ye shes dgos/ /blang dor grol bya btsal med shes pa dgos/ /de dag ldan na nyon mongs gos pa med/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ni/ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i cha tha dad yod do/ /yul 'dom na gong ma bsrung ste 'og ma'i cha der 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /'og ma dang rnam pa 'gal ba ltar snang yang ngo bo ma shor bas 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /dper na gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa'i skabs su chang 'thung ba la ni nyan thos pas lhung ba dang / byang chub sems dpas phyogs mthun gyi nyes par bshad kyang / nyes par mi 'gyur te/ de'i tshe yul bdag nyid dge slong ngam byang chub sems dpa' yin dgos pa la/ de'i tshe lhar bskyed pas gzhi gzhan du gyur/ dngos po myos byed chang yin dgos pa las/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur zhing longs spyad par gsungs pa dang / bsam pa'i 'du shes gzha/ 7ma gyur pa dgos pa las/ lha dang /

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdakyil 'khor dang / bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i 'du shes su gnas gyur pas nyes pa med pa'i steng du lha mchod pas tshogs rdzogs pa dang / lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i grogs su gyur bas yon tan yar ldan du yod par gnang ste/ting 'dzin rgyal bo las/ngo bo nyid stong rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /bdag med chos rnams de yis rnam rig na/ /de la sdom pa nam yang med mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo bcu ba'i mdo las/ don dam pa'i dge slong ni khyim na gnas shing skra dang kha spu ma breg /chos gos kyang ma bgos/ tshul khrims kyang mnos pa med kyis 'phags pa'i chos nyid dang ldan pa de ni don dam pa'i dge slong zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'dul ba lung las/ rab tu byung ba de lta bu la ni darshapa ṇi stong rin pa'i gos dang / mi lnga brgya shong ba'i tsanda gyi khang brtsegs dang / ro brgya dang ldan pa'i zas rnams kyang rjes su gnang ngo gsungs pa'o/ /tshul de bzhin du bslab pa'i cha shas kun la'ang shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/phyi nang gnod pa sna tshogs sdug bsngal la/ /ji mi snyam dang snying rje'i chos la sems/ /dmigs med bzod pa gsum yang bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa/ chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa/ zab mo'i don la mi sgrag pa'i bzod pa dang gsum las/ gzhan gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/ gzhan gyis rang la dngos su rdung rdeg dang /'phrog bcom tshig ngan smra ba sogs dang / lkog nas mi snyan par brjod pa sogs la zhe sdang dang khong khro mi bya bdī ṭwāṃr la byams pa dang snying rje bskyed nas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃde dag la phan 'dogs dgos pa yin la/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ snying rje rgya la ma skyes na/ /khro bar gyur pa ci'i tha tshig /zhes so/ /gal te khros nas gnod lan byas na/ sde snod las/ khong khro ba zhes bya ba ni/ bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'joms pa'o/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /spyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs//legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang / /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par 'gyur//zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa 'ga' med la/ /bzod mtshungs dka' thub bsod nams gzhan med pas/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis bzod la nan tan du/ /khro ba'i me chen 'jil la brtson par bya/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras thogs med kyis/rang rgyud gyong po thul na dpa' bo'i mthar thug yin/ /khong khro'i dgra bo thul na rgyal ba'i mthar thug yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa'i bzod pa ni/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i ched du dka' tshegs tsha grang thams cad khyad du bsad nas sdug bsngal dang du len pa ni ci mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'o//zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa ni/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs bya rtsol dang bral ba'i gnad dge sdig rgyu 'bras las 'das pa'i rdo rje gad mo bcu gnyis dang /ngo mtshar ba'i tshig chen brgyad la sogs pa thos pa na/ de dag la log lta mi skye zhing de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa lon pa'i thabs la 'bad par 219

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbya'o/ /bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ gang la brtson pa'i rang bzhin dge la spro/ de la dge chos mi zad sprin bzhin 'du/ /dri zhim padma'i tshal du bung ba bzhin/ /zhes dang / dbye na dge ba bsgrub cing bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i rgyu go cha'i brtson 'grus dang / lam lnga sa bcu rdzogs par byed pa'i rgyu sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus las/ rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa'i rgyu sems can don byed kyi brtson 'grus so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/dge ba'i gnas la spro ba'i sgo nas nan tan gyis 'jug pa ni brtson 'grus te/de la bsam pa ma zhus pa go cha'i brtson 'grus sam gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang / sbyor ba mi 'gong bar rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus dang / sems can gyi don byed pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs pa la chog par mi shes pa'i brtson 'grus dang gsum du dbye ba la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag mang du yod pa yin no/ /de yang rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ rang don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'i nyan rang yang / /mgo la me shor bzlog ltar brtson mthong nas/ /'gro kun don du yon tan 'byung gnas kyis/ /brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes dang lung las/ brtson la byang chub 'di gnas kyi/ /mi brtson pa la gnas ma yin/ /brtson pas dge ba thamasacad sdud/ /brtson pas yon tan rnam par 'phel/ /zhes so/ /brtson 'grus ma brtsam pa'i nyes pa ni/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ nyon mongs rnams kyi gzhi gcig ni/ /le lo yin te gang la yod/ /gang la le lo gcig yod pa/ /de la chos kun med pa yin/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ brtson 'grus med pa'i gang zag la/ /shes rab dang 220

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃni dbang 'byor stobs/ /gang gis skyob par mi nus te/ khru gzings yod pa'i ded dpon la/ /skya bas rdugs pa ji bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brtson 'grus med na le lo'i dbang du song nas chos bsgrub pa'i dus med de/ kun mkhyen chen po nas/ de yi mi mthun phyogs gang le lo gsum/ bya ba ngan zhen sgyid lug bdag nyid brnyas/ /legs pa mi 'grub nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi//phun tshogs nyams la rgud pa skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / tshong so nam yig rtsisal sogs pa dam pa'i chos la bar du gcod pa'i bya ba la sems g.yeng ba ni bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo dang / dka' ba mthong nas mi 'grub nges snyam du sbyor ba btang ba ni sgyid lug pa'i le lo dang / bdag 'dra bas mi nusazhes sems zhus pa ni bdag nyid brnyas pa'i le lo yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lnga pa bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis las/ dang po 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng thams cad spangs nas gnas dben pa zhig ma bsten na/bsam gtan rgyud la skye mi nus te/ dge bshes po to bas/ mi gseb la dga' zhing bya byed mang ba la dge sbyor mi 'ong / de'i nang nas bsam gtan mi 'ong /zhes dang / dgon pa bas/ bsam gtan gyi rtsa ba dben pa bsten pa la thug/zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ ji srid semasal brtan pa ma thob par phyi rol yul gyis rab tu bslu bas na/ /dben pa'i nags su spro bas gnas par bya/ /zhes dang dbeen pa'i gtam las/ ji srid skyes bu bzhi yis lus/ /khyogs la btags par ma gyur bar/ /de phyir dgon par rab phyogs te/ /zhi ba'i ting 'dzin bsgrub par bya/ /zhes dang / jo sduo2 rdes/ yang ma lam du mi tshe zad pas da

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃni mnyam bzhag bya bar ran/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa bsam gtan dngos ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ der ni stan la skyil krung rab bcas nas/ /rtse gcig sems la mi g.yo mnyam par bzhag /byis pa nyer spyod don rab 'byed pa dang //de bzhin gshegasadage'i bsam gtan dam pa bsgrub/ /ces dang / lang kar gshegs pa las/ byis pa nyer spyod bsam gtan dang / /don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan dang / /de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan te/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan/don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan/de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan dang gsum las/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams la zhen nas/ de nyid la ched du gnyer te nyams zhen gyi rtsi dang bcas par bsgom pa'i dus na byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya/nyams kyi zhen pa dang bral nas bsam gtan gyi ro myong med kyang stong 'dzin gnyen po'i phyogs la zhen nas bsgom pa'i dus na don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya/ stong 'dzin gnyen po'i blo dang bral te/ chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs dge'i bsam gtan zhes bshad pa yin te/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ lam du zhugs pa'i rgyud kyis ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan gzugs med pa rnams la byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /lam du zhugs pa tshogs sbyor gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis thar pa'i lam du byed cing don rab 'byed pas na don rab tu 'byed pa'i bsam spru—/nyen ges bya'o/ /sa dang po yan chad 'phags pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams la zag pa med pa'am de bzhin gshegs dgesdo2 ༵sam gtan zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃso/ /rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ /bsam gtan med par chos nyid mi mthong bas/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma med pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /zhes dang / kha rag pas/las dang po ba yi rtog pa la/ /gsal cha yod de brtan cha med/ /rtog pa'i rlung la ma skur bar/ /dran pa'i thag pas chongs shig ang / /zhes gsungs so/ /drug pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan rin po che'i mdzod las/thos dang bsam bsgom pa las byung ba yi/ /shes rab gsum gyi lhag mthong yang dag 'grub/ /nyon mongs tshogs 'joms chos dang chos can shes/ /srid pa'i grong las mya ngan med par 'da'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos pa'i shes rab/bsam pa'i shes rab/ bsgom pa'i shes rab dang gsum yin te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ 'di ltar chos rnams kyi rang bzhin nam gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin shes par byed pa ni thos pa yin la/ de yang bsam pas nges par byas nas sgom pas srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa ni shes rab kyi rang bzhin du 'dod pa yin gsungs/ de yang rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i shes rab ni kun rdzob rtogs pa'i shes rab/ bdag med pa'i don don spyi'i sgo nas sam mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas 'jal ba'i shes rab ni don dam pa'i shes rab/ sems can rnams kyi 'di phyi'i don kha na ma tho ba med pa bsgrub tshul shes pa ni sems can don byed tshul rtogs pa'i shes rab tu bshad pa'ang yod/ de yang shes rab la ni lhag mthong zhes brjod pa yin te/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin gzhan rnams las ches cher lhag pa yin te/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ shes rab med na pha rol phyin lnga yis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par mi nus pas//223

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthabs dang ldan zhing 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i/ /shes rab bsgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin/ /zhes gsungs par ltar/ khyad par bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab med na sbyin pa la sogs pa'i phar phyin lnga yang mig dang bral ba ltar yin te/ mdo sdud pa las/ dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams/ /lam yang mi shes grong khyer 'jug par ga la 'gyur/ /shes rab med na mig med pha rol phyin lnga 'di/ /dmigs bu med pasabyang chub reg par nus ma yin/ /gang tshe shes rab kyis ni yongs su zin gyur na/ /de tshe mig rnyed gyur cing 'di yi ming 'thob po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na mig med pa'i dmus long lam du khrid mkhan gyi dmigs bu med pa zhes mig med pa bye ba khrag khrig rnams lhan cig tu tshogs par gyur kyang / rang gi mdun na gnas pa'i lam yang mi mthong zhing mi shes na/ lam der zhugs nas grong khyer gzhan du 'gro bar mi nus pa yin no/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa mig dang ldan pa lta bu 'di med na long ba'i tshogs lta bu'i sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di yis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du bgrod mi nus pa yin no/ /sbyin sogs phar phyin lnga po de dag 'khor gsum bden grub tu rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis zin na de yi tshe de dag mig rnyed par gyur nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du bde blag tu phyin pa yin no/ /de yang pha rol phyin pa de dag tshur bsdu na/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ sbyin pa'i mchog ma chags pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi mchog sems zhi ba yin/ bzod pa'i mchog dman sa bzung ba yin/ brtson 'grus kyi mchog bya ba thong ba yin/ bsam tan gyi mchog 224

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃblo ma bcos pa yin/ shes rab kyi mchog gang la yang der 'dzin med pa yin/zhes dang / yang rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas/ /chog shes la snyin pa'i phar phyin gnas/ /de yi ngo bo gtong sems yin/ /dkon mchog gis ma khrel na tshul khrims yod/ /dran rig ma nyams pa bzod pa'i mchog /kun gyi grogs su brtson 'grus dgos/ /snang zhen lhar bsgom bsam gtan te/ /'dzin zhen rang grol shes rab po/ /de la bsam dang bsam byed med/ /tha mal ma yin nges shes bral/ /mya ngan 'das zhi dam pa'o/ /'di ni kun la brjod mi bya/ /sems kyi dam par zungs shig gu/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ bdag 'dzin spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /sbyin pa bya ba logs na med/ /g.yo rgyu spangs pa'i pha rol na/ /tshul khrims bya ba logs na med/ /don la mi skrag pha rol na/ /bzod pa bya ba logs na med/ /nyams len 'bral med pha rol na/ /brtson 'thus bya ba logs na med/ /ngang la gnas pa'i pha rol na/ /bsam gtan bya ba logs na med/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i pha rol na/ /shes rab bya ba logs na med//byas tshad chos kyi pha rol na/ /thabs zhes bya ba logs na med/ /bdud bzhi bcom pa'i pha rol na/ /stobs zhes bya ba logs na med/ /don gnyis 'grub pa'i pha rol na/ /smon lam bya ba logs na med/ /nyon mongs rang mtshang rig pa na/ /ye shes bya ba logs na med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ chos kun yongs su 'dzin pa dang bkag pa med par spyod pas sbyin pa/ de bzhin du mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas skyon gang gis kyang gos pa med pa dang bla na med pa tshul khrims/'brugs pa med pa dang ye shes skyo mtshan yongs su rdzogs pas bzod pa/225

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnyams pa med pa dang byed spyuod tshogs su 'gyur ba brtson 'grus/ dbang bo yul kun la 'jug kyang mnyam nyad las mi g.yo zhing chos kun gyi rang bzhin mthong ba la gnas pa bsam gtan/ rang bzhin phyin ci ma log pa rtogs pas chos kun ma bkag par gsal zhing dngos po'i mtshan ma las yongs su 'das pa shes rab/ bdag gzhan gyi don rtsol ba med par byed pas thabs/ zhing dang spyod yul yongs su dag pas smon lam/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis yongs su mi brdzi ba stobs/ don ji lta ba rtogs pas gnyis chos kyi 'dzin pa kun dang bral te gnyis su med pa ni ye shes su gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ de yang zab mo'i lam gyi nyams rtogs khyad par can rang rgyud la skye ba la bar du gcod pa ni sdig sgrib bag chags yin la/ sgrib pa de dag sbyong ba'i thabs grangs med zhig rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs pa yin kyang de dag thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas yin te/ rgyud las/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yang snying 'dis/ /mtshams med nyes byas rnam smin byang / /gsang sngags dam tshig sor du tshud/ /mi dge phal ba smos ci dgos/ /gang zhig nad kyis nyen gyur kyang / /sdug bsngal de las nges par grol/ /'go ba'i nad rims 'byung ba'i tshe/ /bdag nyid yi dam gsal ba yis/ /snying po 'di brjod des mi tshugs/ /gang zhig ngan sngags mtshon brdeg kyang / /snying bo 'di brngod phar la bzlog /don gnyer lam 'gro 'di brngod na/ /'jigs pa'i dgra las nges par grol/ /gdon 'jigs bgegs kyis 'tshe ba'i tshe/ /rig pa 226

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adi brngod gdon de 'jil/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang phyi ltar na rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bskom pa/ nang rgyud ltar na snying gar/ gsang ba rnal 'byor rgyud ltar sems dpa' sum brtsegs sogs gsungs kyang / yang gsang bla med ltar 'khyer so gsum ldan du gsung pa yin te/ de yang rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa 'i spyi bor mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkhar pad dkar zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig dkar po 'od zer bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa gcig bsgom/ de nas skad cig gis hūṃ yig de nyid gnas 'gyur nas ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas rig snyong gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs gar gtod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon snang stong gi dril bu dku la brten pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i sgyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis spras pa/ de yang dar gyi chas gos lnga dang / rin po che'i rgyan brgyad las/ dang po dar gyi chas gos lnga ni/cod pan dang gcig /stod g.yogs dang gnyis/ dar dpyangs dang gsum/ ska rags dang bzhi/ smad dkris dang lnga'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan brgyad ni/ dbu rgyan dang gcig /snyan rgyan g.yas g.yon gcig tu brtsis pa dang gnyis/ mgul rgyan dang gsum/ dpung rgyan gnyis gcig tu brtsis pa dang bzhi/ do shal dang se mo do gnyis gcig tu brtsis pas sdu// phyag gdub gnyis gcig tu brtsis

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpas drug /sor gdub rnams gcig tu brtsis pas bdun/ zhabs gdub gnyis gcig tu brtsis pas brgyad do/ /yum snyems ma dkar mo dang gnyis med du 'khril ba/ sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa snang stong chu zla lta bu/ snang cha nas spyan gyi dkar nag rgyan gyi bye brag ba sbu'i bu ga tshun chad ma 'dres par gsal zhing / stong cha nas dngos po gdos bcas kyi rnam par ma grub dwangs ba'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang mgon po rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin thugs ye shes kyi mkhyen cha dang bcas pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su dgongs te rang nyid kha lta phyogs su zhal gyu nas bzhugs par gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung ste dus da lta la thug gi bar du/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu/mtshams med pa lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad/ phyi so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba/ nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba/ gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba la sogs pa ngo tsha 'jigs skrag 'gyod pa dang bcas te bshags dgos pa yin te/ a: bdag nyid tha mal sogs nas/ byang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de ltar rdor sems yab yum gnyis su med pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yungs dkar glebs pa tsam gyi steng du hūṃ yig dkar po spus bris pa lta bu zhig gsal la/ hūṃ gi mtha' skor du yi ge brgya ba'i sngags phreng rnams gcig la gcig ma reg tsam du g.yas bskor du bskor bar bsam la2/2ḍi ma rdo rje sems dpa' skyabs gnas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkun 'dus kyi rang bzhin du shes nas rang nyid byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa rten gyi stobs/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thamasacad la 'gyod sems byed pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid snyam pa'i sdom sems ni nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs/ sngar byas kyi gnyen por bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byed pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs yin te/de lta bu'i stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas thugs ka'i sngags phreng la sems gtad de/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus mchi ma zhakhrugs pa tsam du bskyed nas yi ge brgya ba gsol 'debs kyi tshul du brjod pas/ yi ge brgya ba'i sngags phreng gi yig 'bru rnams las thugs rje ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang chub sems dkar po 'o ma'i rgyun ltar babs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas thon rang gzhan sems can thams cad gyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu go nas zhugs te/ lus kyi nango thamos cad boklus/nad thams cad rnag khrag gdan thams cad nya sbrul sbal lcang sdam sdig grags bur/ sdig pa thams cad dud khu sol khu thal du sgrin pa rlangs pa'i rnam pa 'og sgo gnyis dang rkang mthil ba spu'i sgo rnams nas thon te/ rang gi 'og tu dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi kha gas pa'i 'og tu 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po la lan chags bu lon sha mkhon gyi bdag po bdag mo thams cad kyis bskor te kha lag sbar gsum rang la zed nas yod pa'i kha lag sbar gsum du song bar bsam nas yi ge brgya ba bzla/ mthar thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lan chags bu lon sod/ sha mkhon byang /2rdoḍi sgrib dag /mthar de thams cad kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkha lag sbar gsum yang zum/ sa gzhi gas pa'ang sos/ rang gi lus phyi nang thams cad shel bum dri ma med pa ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du gyur pa'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis thur du lta ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs bcu drug gyen du lta ba/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dabs brgyad thur du bstan pa/ lte ba sprul pa'i zhalor lo'i rtsa 'dabs drug bcu rtsa bzhi gyen du lta ba ste/ slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun sngar bzhin bab pas rtsa 'khor bzhi'i nang thams cad bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis skya ltems kyis gang / bum dbang / gsang dbang /sher dbang /tshig dbang rin po che ste dbang bzhi thob/ las kyi sgrib pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ shes bya'i sgrib pa/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa ste sgrib pa bzhi dag /dga' ba/mchog dga'/ khyad par gyi dga' ba/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ sprul sku/ longasasku/ chos sku/ngo bo nyid sku ste sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par bsam/ de nas mgon po bdag ni sogasanas/ mdzad du gsol/ zhes gnong tshig brngod ma thag tu/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dgyes bzhin zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyams chags thams cad dag pa yin no/ /zhes gnang ba byin te 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid sngar bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' snang stong me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yungs dkar glebs pa tsam gyi steng du/ dbus su hūṃ mthing ga /de'i mdun o dkar po/ g.yas su badzra ser po/ dzwa~X0 tu sa dmar po/ g.yon tu twa ljang gu

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrnams gsal nas/ o badzra sa twa hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pa dang mnyam du yig 'bru lnga po las/ 'od zer kha tog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga yar 'phros pa'i rtse la sgeg sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo rnams kyi phyag na bkra shis pa'i mchod rdzas du ma thog te/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas/ rang la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam pa ni rang don chos sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin la/ yang yig 'bru lnga po las 'od zer 'phros khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas las nyon bag chags sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag /snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga lnga'i rang bzhin tu gyur te de dag thams cad kyi zhal nas yo badzra sa twa hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyi sgra 'ur di ri ri sgrogs par bsam la bzlas pa ni gzhan don gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas nas rtog sgrib sbyangs/ /zhes pa ltar yin no/ /thun bsdu khar phyi snod kyi mngon dga'i zhing thams cad nang bcud kyi rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la thim/ nang bcud kyi rdo rje sems dpa' thams cad kyang rang gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' la thim/ rang nyid kyang mtha' nas rim par 'od du yal te thugs ka'i o la 2sdo// oṃ badzra la/ badzra sa la/ sa twa la/

gaku khog bla ma chos daphyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtwa hūṃ yig la/ hūṃ yig kyang zhabs kyu 'a chung ha khog /mgo bo zla tshes thig le na da'i bar bsdus nas nā da yang nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang ba na slar yang snod bcud thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i zhing rten dang brten par bkra lam mer gsal btab la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /zhes sogs bsngo smon bya/de ltar stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang nas mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ sdig lhung bshags pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ don dam pa la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ lha'i bu padma dkar pos gsol ba 'jam dpal las kyi sgrib pa ji ltar sbyang bar bya/ smras pa/ lha'i bu/ las kyi sgrib pa ni las nyid ye nas dngos po med par shes na tshegs med par 'dag par 'gyur te/ dung la sol bas gos pa na ras kyis phyis pa dang mdzodas so/ /zhes dang / thar ba po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig 'gyod tshangs byed 'dod na/ /drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol/ /'di ni 'gyod tshangs mchog cespobya/ /zhedku ri dang / mkhas pa klong chen pas/ gang zag mchog kha cig gis ni skyil mo dza/nga pacas te/ thog mar sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'i tshul gyis nyes lhung gang yin pa'i ming nas brjod de/mdun gyi nam mkha'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la bshags pa'i rjes la/nyes pa de nyid nang dang phyi rol dang de gnyis ka'i bar du ngo bo ngos bzung dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa'i brtags pa byas pas/ gang nas kyang ma byung /gang du'ang mi gnas / gar yang mi 'asduo2 ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du shes

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnas de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ nyes lhung thams cad las rnam par grol ba yin no gsungs pa dang / yang thar pa chen po phyogasabacur rgyas pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i las thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ chos rnams 'ong ba med pa'i phyir dang / chos rnams mi skyes bar shes pa'i phyir dang / chos rnams mi 'gag par mthong ba'i phyir dang / chos rnams rgyu dang rkyen las rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i phyir ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa ste/ bzhi po de dang ldan na tshul khrims nyams pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/sems can gcig ste gnyis su med par shes na sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ste/ dper na me long gi steng du lo stong rdul chags pa gos kyis phyis pas rdul med pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang 'di lta ste/ dper na khang stong gi mun pa mun nag lo stong lon pa yang mar me gcig gis med par byed pa bzhin du sems la ngo bo nyid med pa yang dag pa'i bden pa shes pas bskal pa grangs med pa'i sdig pa skad cig ma la byang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de ltar stong nyid kyi lta ba dang byang chub sems dang 'brel ba'i gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags na mi 'dag pa'i sdig pa med de/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la/ /phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur pa de/ /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes gcung dga' bo bud mespya pya shin tu chags pa dang ldan pa zhig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyin la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa bstan nas skrag pa bskyed de/ chos bstan pas dgra bcom thob pa lta bu dang / zhe sdang can sor mo'i phreng ba can bram ze'i khye'u zhig ste/ rang gi slob dpon gyis mi stong bsad de sor mo'i phreng ba byas na khyod mkha' spyod du 'ogro zhes smras pas bslus te mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa dgu bsad pa las bcam ldan 'das kyis rab tu byung ste chos bstan pas dgra bcom thob pa lta bu dang / mthong ldan ni ma skyes dgra ste sdig pa'i grogs po lhas sbyin dang 'phrad de chos dang ldan pa'i pha rgyal po gzugs can snying po bsad pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa byas pa las phyis su ston pa la dad pa thob pas sdig pa'i 'bras bu las thar pa lta bu dang / bde byed ni gzhan gyi chung ma la nyal po byed du 'gro ba la rang gi mas bzlog pa'i tshe ma bsad pa yin te/ phyis su gnas gzhan zhig tu phyin nas dge 'dun du ma bsdus te chos kyis tshul bzhin du bskyangs pa'o/ /de nas tshe 'phos nas dmyal bar dar kyi pho long sa la brdab pa tsam du skyes shing / de nas shi 'phos te lhar skyes nas rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa yin no/ /de yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags byung yang nyin re bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom nas/ yi ge brgya ba nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzlas na/ des lhung ba byin gyis rlabs pa 'es bya ste/ lhung ba byung ba'i rnam smin gong nas gong du 'phel 'gro rgyu med pa dang / yi ge brgya ba 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na lhung ba thams cad rtsa ba nas dag par snying po rgyan las gsungs te/ pad dkar zla ba'i gdan2 sdunas pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdamigs te/ /yi ge brgya ba cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa re bzlas gyur na/ /lhung sogs byin gyis brlab 'gyur phyir/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ khrub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /rtag par du ni nyams su blang / /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas gyur na/ / rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇḍal gyi khrid la/ maṇḍal 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ maṇḍal gyi rgyu tshad/ tshom bu'i khyad par/ maṇḍal gyi dbye ba/phan yon bstan pa dang lnga las/ dang po maṇḍal 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/slob dpon chen pos/ lha dang bla ma nam dran dus nyid dam/ /tshogs pa rgya mtsho'i dbus na chos spel tshe/ /chos spyod kun gyi thog mar maṇḍal dbul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na/dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs med/ de bzhin du tshogs gnyis yongs su ma rdzogs par/ stong pa nyid kyi don ma nor ba de yang rgyud la skye mi nus te/ mdo las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma dzoogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed/ /ces gsungs/ de bzhin du gzhan yang / don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang / /rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan bsten pa rmongs par shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ stong nyid mngon du rtogs nas kyang / da dung ji srid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar lam gong nas gong du bgrod dasduonee pas na/ bsod nams dang tshogs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃganyis bsags pa la 'bad dgos te/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug te lo ba'i zhal nas/ bu snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /don skye ba med par ma rtogs par/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo dang / /'bral bar ma byed na ro pa ces so/ /gnyis pa maṇḍal gyi rgyu tshad bshad pa ni/ rab gser dngul sogs rin po che las grub pa'i maṇḍal dbyibs zlum po/ 'bring mkhar ba dang / lcags la sogs rin chen phal ba las grub pa/ tha ma rdo dang shing la sogs pa'i maṇḍal khru gang las mi chung ba dgos par gsungs pa'o/ /gsum pa tshom bu'i rgyu ni/ bla ma chos sku'i tshogs la sman gyi maṇḍal 'bul/yi dam longs sku'i tshogs la rin po che'i maṇḍal 'bul/ sprul sku dang mkha' 'gro rnams la 'bras bu'i maṇḍal 'bul bar gsungs kyang / 'dir rang la ci 'byor gyi dngos po dang bstun nas rab rin po che'i rigs/ 'bring sman gyi rigs/ tha ma nas 'bras gro sogs la dri bzang pos sbags pa'o/ /bzhi pa maṇḍal gyi dbye ba la/ bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang / mchod pa'i maṇḍal dang gnyis las/ dang po bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal ni/ tshom bu lnga bkod la dbus kyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la bhuddha'i rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/mdun nam shar gyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' la rdo rje'i rigs gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ lho'i tshom bu de sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan 94 rin chen rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub kyi tshom bu de sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la padma'i rigs kyi lha ṭwāṃṭwāṃs kyis bskor ba/ byang gi tshom bu de

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃsangs rgyas don yod grub pa la las kyi rigs kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor bar gsal btab/ yang na dbus kyi tshom bu de rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan chen po la rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi tshom bu la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la 'khor bskal bzang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong gis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi tshom bu de byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad la byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ g.yon gyi tshom bu de nyid nyan thos mchog zung la nyan rang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis bskor ba/ rgyab kyi tshom bu de dam pa'i chos dkon mchog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can de skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing ltar gsal btab/ gang ltar yang sgrub pa'i maṇḍal de mchod stegs la sogs par dgod/ ma 'byor na sgrub pa'i maṇḍal med kyang rung /tshogs zhing yid kyis gsal 'debs dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni/ lag g.yon me tog dang bcas te maṇḍal yo 'khyog med par bzung / g.yas pas maṇḍal lan gsum gyis phyi zhing yi ge brgya ba bzlas pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag par bsam pa'o/ /de nas g.yas pa'i mtheb 'dzub kyi bar du me tog cung zad sor mo lhag ma rnams brgyang la dri bzang dang ba byung gi sbags dgos pa yin la/ de yang ba byung lnga zhes pa ni/ ji skad du/ dgon pa'i rtsa zos gtsang ma yin/ /ba yi mar dang 'o ma zho/ /bshang ba gcin dang bcas pa la/ /ba byung lnga zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de'ang snying rje byang chub sems kyi rang rgyud brlan pa'i brdar maṇḍal gyi mtha' skor nas gdīoṭwāṃ skor du byas la rim par byug cing /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃngag tu/ yo badzra bhu mi ā hūṃ/ gzhi yongs su dag pa sogs zhes brngod pa na/maṇḍal de'i steng du 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi dkyil 'bor gyi steng du dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi rgya khyon tshad las 'das par bsam/ o badzra re khe ā hūṃ/ phyi lcags ri sogs/ brjod pa dang mnyam du sngar dri'i thig le byugs bzhin pa'i lag pa ma bteg pa'i 'phro las srin lag gis maṇḍal gyi mtha' bskor zhing /lcags ri dang po 'god/ dbus su hūṃ zhes brjod pa dang / g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub na yod pa'i me tog dbus su bzhag pas bgegs bsal bar bsam pa'am/ lugs gcig tu hūṃ las zhes pa ltar na ri rab bskyed pa'i sa bon yin par bshad pa'ang yod/ slar yang de ga'i steng du tshom bu che ba gcig 'god pa dang mnyam du ri'i rgyal po ri rab ces brjod cing tshul bzhin du bsam/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du rim par dgod cing / shar lus 'phags po/zhes shar du 'god cing gling dbyibs zla gam chu shel gyi rang bzhin tu bsam/lho 'dzam bu gling / zhes brjod pa dang lhor 'god cing gling dbyibs sog kha beeḍūrya'i rang bzhin tu bsam/ nub ba glang spyod/ ces nub tu 'god cing dbyibs zlum po padma rwa ga'i rang bzhin du bsam/ byang sgra mi snyan zhes byang du 'god cing gling dbyibs grub bzhi gser gyi rang bzhin du bsam/ shar gyi g.yas su lus dang / g.yon du lus 'phags/ lho'i g.yas su rnga yab dang /g.yon du rnga yab gzhan/ nub kyi g.yas su g.yo ldan dang / g.yon du lam mchog 'gro/ byang gi g.yas su sgra mi snyan dang / g.yon du sgra mi snyan gyi zla rnams rang rang gi gling dbus ma dang ༵rdobs mtshungs pa/ shar gling gi nang du

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrin po che'i sna tshogs kyi ri bo/ lho gling gi nang du rin chen sna bdun las grubo pa'i dpag bsam gyi ljon shing dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rang bzhin/ nub gling gi nang du 'dod 'jo'i ba dmar ser gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug pa/ byang gling gi nang du ma rmos pa'i lo tog ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa/ rin po che'i ri bo'i mdun du 'dzam bu'i chu gser las grub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsib stong dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gi mdun du nor bu rin po che'i beeḍārya zur brgyad pa dpag tshad brgya'i bar gyi khor yug gi mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog par byed cing yon tan phun sum tshogs pa/ 'dod 'jo'i ba'i mdun du btsun mo rin chen gzugs mdzes shing blta na sdug pa bud med kyi skyon lnga dang bral zhing yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa/ ma meos pa'i lo tog gi mdun blon po rin chen gzi byin bzod par dka' ba rgyal po'i thugs kyi gang 'dod thams cad skad cig gis bsgrub nus pa/ shar lhor glang po rin chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan spyi gtsug dmar zhing dpangs mtho ba nor bu'i dra bas g.yogs pa/ lho nub tu rta mchog rin chen spu mdog rma bya'i mgrin pa ltar mdzes shing 'dzam gling nyin gcig lan gsum bskor nus bang 'gros mgyogs pa/ nub byang du dmag dpon rin chen snying stobs che zhing sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa/ byang shar du gter chen po'i bum pa kha dog mthing ga dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i rang bzhin/ 'khor lo rin po che'i mdun du sgeg mo ma dkar mo dar dang rin po che'i brgyan cing sneg pa'i rnam 'gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston zhing me long bsnams pa2/3spyor bu rin po che'i mdun du phreng ba ma

g.yu khog bla ma cholodabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃser mo rin po che'i phreng ba thog pa/ btsun mo rin po che'i mdun du glu ma dmar mo gling bu snyan pa'i sgra 'gyur khug dang ldan pa sgrogs pa/ blon po rin po che'i mdun du gar ma ljang mo sna tshogs gar gyi rtse 'jo byed cing gar gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ glang po rin po che'i mdun du me tog ma dkar mo me tog 'chang ba/ rta mchog rin po che'i mdun du bdug spos ma mthing ga rin po che'i spos phor bsnams pa/ dmag dpon rin po che'i mdun du snang gsal ma dmar mo rin po che'i sgron me bsnams pa/ gter gyi bum pa'i mdun du dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung phor bsnams pa/ sgeg mo ma'i mdun gyi nam mkhar me shel las grub pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig dang ldan zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/glu ma'i mdun gyi nam mkhar chu shel las grub pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dpag tshad lnga bcu dang ldan zhing dwangs shing gsal ba/ gar ma'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa/ phreng ba ma'i mdun gyi nam mkhar lha rdzas las grub pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan drang zhing ldem pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis phyur bur bkang la/ de ltar gling bzhi ri rab lcags ri dang bcas pa stong phrag gcig la stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten/ de gcig tu brtsis nas de 'dra ba stong la stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten/ de gcig tu brtsis nas de 'dra ba stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ste gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya de dag na lha dang mi'i longs spyod rdo/ snyed yod pa thams cad blos blangs te

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni thun mong sprul sku'i maṇḍal yin no//rang lugs sku gsum gyi maṇḍal ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes dri bzang gi chus byugs shing /lcags ri dgod/ dbus dang gling phran brgyad gong ltar tshom bu bkod/ yang na dbus dang phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ste tshom bu dgu bkod la/ stong gsum sogs brjod nas/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa bla ma sprul sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni thun mong sprul sku'i maṇḍal/ de'i steng du lcags ri gnyis pa bgod nas/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu lnga bkod de/ 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing na rang snang longs sku'i zhing gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sgegs sogs 'dod yon gyi lha mo grangs med pa dang bcas pa blo yis blangs te/ 'og min bde chen sogs5 brjod nas/ bla ma longs sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni thun min longs sku'i maṇḍal/ de'i steng du lcags ri gsum pa bzhag la tshom bu gcig bkod de/ chos dbyings skye ba med pa maṇḍal gyi gzhi'i tshul du bkod nas snang zhen la sogs rtog tshogs gang shar thams cad tshom bu'i tshul du byasate/ snang srid rnam dag sogs brjod nas/ bla ma chos sku'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni khyad par chos sku'i maṇḍal yin no/ /de ltar grangs bsogs pa'i skabs sku gsum gyi maṇḍal 'bul mi nus pa dag gis/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu lnga dang shar dang nub tu tshom bu re re bkod de/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa gzhi thams cad spos chus byugs shing me tog gis rnam par bkram nas ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mu med pa la phul bas/ ༵sdi kun rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkhyad par can la spyod par shog cig ces smon dgos pa yin gsungs pa ltar/sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing sogs brjod nas/ tshom bu bdun kho na phul kyang chog gsungs pa yin no/ /mthar thun bsdu khar skyabs yul gyi yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgro nas tshad med pa'i dad pa dang mos gus mchi ma 'khrugs pa tsam du bskyed nas tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs thams cad gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dpal mgon bla ma dam pa de nyid rang gi spyi bor byon/ tshad med pa'i thugs rjes rang bzhin 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye spyo~X/ la/sa byung ba/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon lnga ba phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba 'khor gsum yongs rdzogs su phul ba'i bsod nams gzhal du med de/ bkod pa po las/ rnam dag sems ldan maṇḍal ni/ /phul ba'i bsod nams gzhal du med/ /ces dang / rgyud las/ sangs rgyas zhid khams thams cad la//stong gsum zhing khams ma lus pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan brgyan pa yi/ /mchod na sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /lnga pa bdud bzhi cig char du gcod pa ku sa sī'i tshogs bsags pa'i khrid la/ bdud bani ni/sproos bral don gsal chen po'i rgyud las/phyi yi bdud bzhi ni/mi chosabla 242

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃma'i bdud/ bsogs 'jog ser sna'i bdud/ ngar 'dzin pas a thas kyi bdud/ the tshom yid gnyisakyi bdud/ nang gi bdud bzhi ni/ dbang po thogs bcas kyi bdud/yul sdus thogs med kyi bdud/ dga' brod nyams zhen gyi bdud/snyem byed bdag gi bdud/ gsang ba' bdud bzhi ni/lta ba phyogasalhung gi bdud/sgom pa yid dpyod kyi bdud/spyod pa btang snyomasakyi bdud/ 'bras bu yid smon gyi bdud do/ /maman/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po spyir bshad pa la/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyis khog phub pa/ mtshon pa dpe drug gis che ba brjod pa dang gsum las/dang po brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi grub chen dam pa sangs rgyas nas byung ba yin te/ grub chen de nyid kyis slob dpon irnya bhi ti/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi bsten nas de dag gi gdams pa mnga' zhing / yi dam gyi lha bcu gnyis sogs dang / mkha' spyod kyi bla ma sum/ cu rtsa drug gi zhal gzigs te byin gyis rlabs pa dang / ral gri dang mig sman bcud len sogs thun mong gi grub pa brgyad brnyes pas dgung lo lnga brgya dang bdun cu bzhugs/ de nyid bod du lan lnga phebs pa yin la/ gsum pa'i dus su bal bo nas gtsang du byon nas/skyo shākya ye shes dang / yar klungs sma ra ser po sogs rjes su bzung nas mdo lugs rang rkang gi gcod ārya de ba'i gzhung chung lnga bcu pa'i don gdams ngag brul tsho drug pa zhes bya ba gnang / skyo shākya ye shes kyis rang dbon skyo ston bsod nams bla ma la gnang / skyo ston bsod nams bla mas ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma la brul tsho bzhi gnang ba dang / yar klungs sma ra ser pos nye gnas 24 3

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsmyon pa be te la gnang / de las brgyud pa la pho gcod du grags pa'o/ /pha cig dam pa de nyid lan lnga pa bod du byon pa'i dus su mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul bya nag bzhi 'phur zhid 'ong ba gzigs pa las/ g.ye'i ma cig lab sgron/ gnyal stod kyi ma jo byang chub/ gtsang gi zhang mo rgyal mthing / lha sa'i mkha' 'gro spyon ma bzhir gyur pa las/ ma cig lab sgron ni sher phyin bklags pas stong nyid kyi lta ba rgyud la skyes/ pha cig dam pas snying gtam tshig gcig gsungs pas rgyud grol te grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs/ sher phyin gyi dgongs don ma cig nyid kyis dgongs nyams las zhabrungs pa'i dam chos gcod yul zhes yongs su grags pa'i lam srol rgya chen po byas te gzhung gdams ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa la mo gcod zhes bya ba grags so/ /ma cig rang gi lta ba ni/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi lugs ltar dbu ma thal 'gyur yin par bshad pa'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa la pha rgyud thabs kyi brgyud pa/ ma rgyud shes rab kyi brgyud pa/ gnyis med don gyi brgyud pa/ mkha' 'gro nyams kyi brgyud pa dang bzhi/ yang na dbon sras rgyal ba don grub/ stong sde ngag gi dbang phyug /grol sde rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ khu sgom chos kyi seng ge ste thugs sras bzhi/ 'brog tsha rgyan/ dpal ldan rgyan/ bsod nams rgyan/ rin chen rgyan te sras mo bzhi/skye med dga' yan/ pho smyon seng ge/ spyon pa rang snang / dol pa zangs thal/zhig po khur thon/ skal ldan seng ge/ rgya sgom har thon/ rje btsun zil gnon te mkha' 'gro rang dang mnyam pa brgyad/ de ltar zhal slob bu chen bcu drug gtso bor gyur pa'i grub thob pho mo brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bod gangs can gyi 244

g.yuṭwāoṃgablamachosaXbyingasarangagrol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyul ṭwāṃ snizlo /ོ ṭwāṃ bye ༵ sna ༵ ṭī ṭwāṃ/ spyios/ /khog phub pa ni/ zhu ba po'i gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na pho brgyud dang mo brgyud gnyis/ngo bo'i sgo nas phye na gzhung khrigs can dang kha 'thor gnyis/ byon tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis/ ring brgyud dang nye brgyud kyi sgo nas phye na bka' ma dang gter ma gnyis te zung bzhi ya brgyad du byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang zung brgyad la ya bcu drug tu bshad pa'ang yod de/ pho gcod dang mo gcod/ bka' ma dang gter ma/ rgya gcod dang bod gcod/ mdo lugs dang sngags lugs/ sras brgyud dang don brgyud/ gnam chos dang sa chos/ khrigs can dang khrigs med/ kha 'thor dang le lag go/ /dang po pho gcod ni/ pha cig dam pa nas brgyud pa brul tsho drug pa dang / la bzla skor gsum la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa mo gcod ni/ ma cig nas brgyud pa phag mo'i skor ṭika che chung la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa bka' ma ni/yum chen mo dang bstan pa'i gtso bo nas zam ma chad par byon pa rnams so//bzhi ba gter ma ni/ dam pas bya rgod phung po'i ri nas spyan drangs pa u dusbra ra dang / 'bras skrungs mchod rten nas spyan drangs pa phyag rgya che gcod la sogs dang / khros mas gter du sbas pa ma cig gis gter nas drangs/ ma cig gis sbas pa brgyud 'dzin rnams kyis gter nas bton pa'o/ /lnga ba rgya gcod ni/bram ze ārya de ba'i rgya gzhung che chung dang / grub chen te lo pa'i ro snyoms gzer lnga dang / paṇa chen nā ro pa'i gsang spyod la sogs pa'o/ /drug pa bod gcod ni/bod du byung ba'i gcod skor rnams sduo5/ /bdun pa mdo lugs ni/ yum gyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdagongs pa chos tshan sum cu la sogs pa'o/ /brgyad pa sngags lugs ni/ sgrol ma'i rgyud bzhi la brten pa'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'o/ /dgu pa sras brgyud ni/ rgyal ba don grub dang / thod smyon dang / kham bu ya le/ rgyan ne bzhi las brgyud pa'o/ /bcu ba don brgyud ni/ khu sgom chos kyi seng ge las brgyud pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa gnam chos ni/ thog ser gza' srung gi rigs la sogs pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa sa chos ni/ sa dpyad klu gnyan sa bdag gi gcod skor rnams so/ /bcu gsum pa khrigs can ni/ zab don thugs snying lta bu'i man ngag yin no/ /bcu bzhi ba khrigs med ni/ rgya mdud ma dang tshig gsal la sogs pa'i khrigs su ma bsdebs pa rnams so/ /bco lnga pa kha 'thor ni/dmigs 'bum 'thor bu'i rigs rnams so/ /bcu drug pa le lag ni/ rtsa ba ṭwāṃṭwāṃ/ ༵ṭwāṃ // sdu/༷// thu/na mong dang thun min/ khyad par gyi le lag nyams kyi gsum pa mtshon pa dpe drug gi che ba brjod pa ni/ bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'i man ngag 'di gangs dkar gyi ri bo dang 'dra ste gangs la kha ba bab kyang dkar la ma babs kyang dkar ba bzhin/ gcod mkhan rnal 'byor pa la thos pa'i shes rab de yod kyang legs la med kyang chog pa'o/ /gcod kyi man ngag 'di seng ge dkar mo dang 'dra ste thams cad zil gyis gnon la gcig pur nyams nga med pa bzhin/ gcod byed rnal 'byor pa grogs mang po dang 'grogs kyang chog la gcig pur 'grims kyang chog pa yin no/ /zab chos kyi man ngag 'di lha yi rnga bo che'i skad daṭwāṃ ḍidra ste rnga chen la rol mo gzhan gyi sgra

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃyod kyang chog la med kyang chog pa bzhin/ gcod mkhan rnal 'byor pa de la dge sbyor gyi grogs gzhan yod kyang chog la med kyang chog pa yin no/ /gcod kyi man ngag 'di dngos grub kyi chu mig dang 'dra ste grub chu la mi mang nyung gi tshod dang 'tshams par 'byung ba bzhin/ 'dir gang zag gi blo tshod dang 'tshams par bslab tu yod pa'o/ /gcod yul gyi gdams pa 'di gser g.yu chag pa'i dum bu dang 'dra ste che na rin thang che la chung na'ang de dang 'tshams pa'i rin thang yod pa bzhin/ rnal 'byor bas gcod skor rgya chen po shes na yon tan dpag tu med pa yod la cung zad tsam shes pas kyang rang gzhan la phan thogs pa yin no//gcod yul gyi gdams pa 'di rta bzang po'i spu dang 'dra ste rta mchog gzugs 'gros legs pa la spu mdog la khyad par med pa bzhin/ gcod yul mthar phyin pa'i gang zag de mchog dman gang yin kyang gzhan las byin rlabs che bar gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bye brag rang lugs la/ gcod kyi ngo bo/ sgra don/ dbye ba/ phung po mchod sbyin byed pa/ de'i phan yon bstan pa dang lnga las/ dang po gcod kyi ngo bo ni/ ji skad du/ pha ni pha rol phyin pa dang / /ṭa ni gsang ba sngags kyi lam/ /de gnyis zung du 'brel bas phaṭa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa sngags dang rjes su mthun pa dam chos bdud kyi gcod yul 'dis 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi bdud bzhi po sems kyi snyems rtog ngar 'dzin kho na'i steng du gcod par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sgra don ni/ gdams pa'i byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa yin twe4/7ji skad du/ byang chub sems kyis rang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdon yid byed gcod/ /stong nyid lta bas 'khor ba'i zhabrul rtog gcod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis rang don yid byed gcod pa dang / stong nyid kyi lta bas khams gsum 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig bden 'dzin gyi zhabrul ba'i rtog pa skye med kyi dbyings su gcod pa yin no/ /gsum pa dbye ba ni/ rje mi las / gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim pa phyi yi gcod/ /phung po gzan du bskyur ba nang gi gcod/ /nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod//ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyi yi gnyan sa ni/ 'khrul snang gdon gzugs su shar ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi bdag tu bzung ba'i dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su brtul zhugs la chas pa'i rnal 'byor pa rgyu ba yin te/ ma cig gis/ gnyan sar song la rig pa klod/ /rkyen dang sprod la nyams su long / /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /nang phung po sgyu lus kyi gnyan sa ni/ rang lus ri gnyan gyi brag phug na/ /bdag gzhan 'dzin pa'i 'dre rgod gnas/ /gnyan sa de ru chod mdzod cig/nye ring rtsa ba rbad kyis chod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gsang ba kun rtog zhabrul ba'i grong khyer 'dzin pa sems kyi gnyan sa ni/ brag srin mos/ rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ 'dre sems kyi rtsa ba ma shes na/ /'dre nga bas mi tshad gzhan yang yod//khyod song zhig byas pas nga mi 'gro/ /zhes dang / rje mi las/ 'dre 'dre ru bzung na gnod pa yin/ /'dre sems su shes na grol ba yin/ /'dre stong bar rtogs na chod pa yin/ /zhesadang / ma cig gis/ sems kyi rtsa ba chod gyur na/ /'dre rnams rang sar yal ba yin/ /zhes dang / bdud rnams ma lus sems su bcad/ /sems ni skye med dbyings su sdusdu/ /zhes sogs phyi nang gsang gsum

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsnyi ṭwāṃṭwāṃ /༵ dro/ pa/ shlaun ༈ོ/ rna/ma dbye sogs gang zag gi khams dang mthun par bzhi ba phung po mchod sbyin byed pa ni/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge glang chen rma bya shang shang rta mchog rnams kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri rkang nyi zla padma sogs dang dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi steng du zhing lngags kyi gdan la drin rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid he ru ka pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas can phyag g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing /g.yon bhaddha bcud ldan dku la brten zhing / zhabs gnyis rol stabs su bzhugs pa dang / gzhan yang pad nyi bam ro la sogs gdan gyi bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams la/ steng na brgyud gsum gyi bla ma/ bar na yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ 'og na ma dang mkha' 'gro/ 'dab 'khor na chos skyong srung ma/ 'og na khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can dang bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron rnams 'khod par bsam la/ rang nyid bskyed rim la goms po yod na/phaṭa: lus gces 'dzin bor bas lha bdud choms/ /zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du rang gi rnam par shes pa dbu ma'i lam nas spar te spyi gtsug tu 'thon pa dang mnyam du skad cig gis ma cig khros ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag g.yas pas dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar zhing /g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra sgrogs pa khro mo'i cha byad can de lta bu zhig bsnyed nas/ phyag g.yas kyi gri gug gis rang gi lus bam ro che ba2 ṭwāṃ ba snum pa stong gsum gyi rgya khyon dang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmanyam pa de nyid kyi dpral bar tshad tsam byas pas thod pa ling gis gog /stong gsum gyi rgya khyon dang mnyam par gyur ba de nyid phyag g.yon pas blangs te mi mgo'i snyed pu ri rab dang mnyam pa gsum gyi steng du dpral ba rang la bstan te bkod/ de nas phyag g.yas kyi gri gug des bam ro de nyid ling gis blangs te/bhaddha'i nang du bzhag /de'i 'og tu a thung dmar po me'i rang bzhin reg bya tsha ba dang / steng du ha yig dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gnyis bsgom/ de nas/ o āXhūṃ zhes brjod pa'i tshe a thung las me 'bar thod pa'i nang gi bam ro de nyid bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du mer gyis zhu ste ma dag pa'i 'bag rtsog thams cad sbu ba dang spris ma'i rnam par phyir lud/ me'i drod kyis haṃ yig zhu ba las bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun bab nas gnyis med du 'dres shing / haṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'od zer mthing ga'i rnam par thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim/ mthar haṃ yig kyang 'od du stem gyis zhu ste thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can tu gyur par bsam nas/ lko ā hūṃ/mang du brjod nas/ o gyis kha dog dri ro la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad sbyangs/ā yis mang por spel/ hūṃ gis gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos por bsgyur te/zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod rgu yid bzhin gyi sprin 'phro ba'i rol pa dang rang bzhin du gyur ba'i rlangs pa la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bla bre/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong / dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba sogs mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te yar 250

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmachod yul rnams la mchod pa phul/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa rnams la rang rang dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas dang brten rdzas/ bskang rdzas dang bsgrub rdzas la sogs pa'i mthun rdzas su gyur te mchod pas mnyes par byas pa'o/ /yang mar mgron rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la rang rang gang la gang 'dod ci la ci 'dod kyi yo byad thams cad char bzhin du babs pas thams cad dga' mgu tshims shing yi rang / khyad par rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bzung ste tha ma da la thug gi bar du/ bsad pa tshe thung ba'i lan chags/ 'phrogs pa nor dbul ba'i lan chags/ brdung ba nad mang ba'i lan chags/ gong mas bskyabs pa'i lan chags/ 'og mas bkur ba'i lan chags/ bar ma mdza' ba'i lan chags/ mtho ba mkhar gyi lan chags/ dma' ba sa zhing gi lan chags/ gnyen grogs srid sde'i lan chags/bu tsha phyugs kyi lan chags/ bza' ba zas kyi lan chags/ bgo ba gos kyi lan chags/ bu lon 'brel gyi lan chags/ bzhon bzhos pa'i lan chags/khal bkal ba'i lan chags/ meo meos pa'i lan chags sogs tshe lan srog lan sha lan sogs chags pa'i lan chags bu lon sha mkhon bdag po bdag mo thams cad snod bzung ste bu lon bsnyags pa ltar du 'dus pa la/ de dag thams cad la rang rang gang la gang 'dod ci la ci 'dod zas 'dod pa la zas/gos 'dod pa la gos/ longs spyod 'dod pa la longs spyod/ skyed tshal 'dod pa la skyed tshal/ bzhon pa 'dod pa la bzhon pa/ gnas khang 'dod pa la gnas khang / gnyen grogs 'dod pa la gtswa~X grogs la sogs 'dod rgu'i longs

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃspyod zad pa med pa'i gter du gyur nas char ltar babs pa la/ rang rang gis longs spyad nas lan chags 'khor/ bu lon sod/ sha mkhon byang / sdig sgrib dag thams cad kyang ngoms shing tshimasate dga' bar bsam/ yang de dag gis lhag ma khas zhan pa/ dbang chung ba/ zha bo/ long ba/ 'on pa/ lkugs pa la sogs rigs drug gi sems can sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba nyam thag pa thams cad la rang rang gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos po/ skyabs med pa la skyabs/mgon med pa la mgon/ dpung gnyen med pa la dpung gnyen/ gnyen grogs med pa la gnyen grogs/ srid sde med pa la srid sde/ nad pa gso ba'i sman/'chi ba bslu ba'i bdud rtsi/ zha bo la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba/ long ba la ye shes kyi spyan/ 'on pa la zag med kyi rna ba/ lhags pa la shesarab kyi lce la sogs par gyur te longs spyod pas thams cad ngoms shing tshims/ rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags thams cad dang bral te/ pho thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang / mo thams cad rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang thob ste/ khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par bsam pa ni khra 'gyed yin no/ /de nas steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs pa de dag gis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing drims/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rang rang gi phyag mtshan rdo rje 'khor lo padma rgya gram gyi sbu gu can gyis gsol/ rang gzhan rnams kyi tshogs rdzogasasgrib pa dag mchog thun mong gi dngodī sbyib thams cad thob par bsam/ thod

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa'i kha'i bar snang la me shes dang las la grub pa'i chos skyong rnams kyis ljags nyi zer gyis sbu gu can gyis gsol/ rang gi dam chos byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bsrungs par bsam/ de nas las byed kyi mkha' 'gro grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa sems can gyi grangs dang mnyam pa spros te/ de thams cad la snod me shes kyi ka pā la bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i gang ba re re byin pa'am yang na rang nyid khros ma'i phyag gi ka pā la de nyid kyis bdud rtsi bcus shing gtor bas de dag thams cad dga' mgu tshims zhing yi rang ste rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par bsam nas/ yar mchod yul mgron gyis sogs gshis rdzogs pa chen po ma bcos a zhes brjod cing / mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa ni bdud rtsi dkar 'gyed yin no/ /de yang dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron rnams la mchod pa ni rgyal po chen po la 'khor 'bangs kyi mchod pa lta bu'i tshul dang /mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rnams la rang dang mnyam pa'i grogs la mgron byed pa'i tshul dang / rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams la ston mo'i tshul du sbyin pa dang / bgegs rigs lan chags kyi mgron rnams la bu lon 'jal ba'i tshul du sbyin dgosapa yin no/ /spyir gcod gzhung rnams las/ dkar 'gyed dang dmar 'gyed khra 'gyed nag 'gyed de 'gyed chen bzhi bshad kyang /'dir dkar 'gyed dang khra 'gyed gnyis las dmar 'gyed dang nag 'gyed med pa yin no/ /de yang gcod ces bya ba2 spya/ ma cig gi zhal nas/ thog ma med
