g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa'i dus nas las ngan gyi rgyu byas/ rkyen ngan gyi rlung gis ded/ zhabrul snang dang sdug bsngal kho na la khor mo yug tu spyod/ shi tsam na ngan song gi gting rdo las 'gro sa med pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can de dag ngas snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung ste/ rang gi sha dron mo dang khrag dron mo zas su byin nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis snang ba bsgyur te/ rang gi 'khor du bsdus pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na gcod pas 'dul rgyu'i lha 'dre de ni/ phyi na su yang med par nang na yod de/ phyi 'khrul snang lha 'dre'i gzugs su snang ba thams cad kyang nang nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i snyems byed kyi rtsa ba ma chod pa las byung ba yin te/ ji skad du/ 'dre mang po bya ba 'du shes yin/ /'dre ngar ma bya ba ngar 'dzin yin/ /'dre rgod po bya ba rnam rtog yin/ /'dre de dag chod na gcod pa zer//zhes dang / ma cig gi zhal nas/ thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud//dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud/ /de yang snyems byed bdud la thug/ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'dre zhes bya ba bdag 'dzin snyems byed kyi bdud yin pas skye med kyi dbyings su gcod dgos pa yin te/ ji skad du/ re sa med pas sangs rgyas gcod/ /dogs sa med pas 'khor ba gcod/ /nyams nga med pas 'dre bdud gcod/ /'gos 'dzems med pas nad pa gcod/ /gcod bya med pas chos kun gcod/ /ces dang / /lha med 'dre med lta ba'i gdeng / /yengs med 'dzin med sgom pa'i gnad/ /blang med dor med spyod pa'i gnad/ /re med dogs med 'bras bu'i gnad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mal sa gnyan sa / rdzuod/ lta ba lha med 'dre med/ bsgom pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrig pa gcer nyal/ spyod pa ro snyoms thog brdzis/ rim gro sha khyer khrag khyer/nyaṭwāṃsduṭwāṃ/ṭwāṃXkāX ṭwāṃ sdiste / ༷rnyi snroṭwāṃ phung po gzan bsgyur/ 'bras bu re med do /ru ༵ dīspu phawo ༵na ༵/wa ska ༵ rno/ ༵༵/ la/ gces 'dzin bcad de mchod sbyin bya ba ni/ dngos po gzhan gyi mchod sbyin bya ba las lhag par yang phan yon che ba yin te/ ji skad du/ rta dang glang po brgya 'gyur yin/ /bu dang chung ma stong 'gyur yin/ /lus kyi mchod sbyin 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes dang / ma cig gi zhal nasachags med lus spyin byed pa de/ /tshogs gnyis yin par ma shes nas/ /phung po gces 'dzin byas pa de/ /ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ /zhes dang /ma cig gis/ nad pa 'dre la gtad pa na/ /nad med bde ba thob pa yin/ /zhes dang / mi mthun grogs su khyer ba de/ /a ma jo mo'i chos lugs yin/ /srungs shig skyobs shig brgya byas pas/ /zo shig khyer cig gcig gi dga'/ /lus srog gzan du bor ba na/ /srung 'khor btags rgyud med pa yin/ /zhes dang /ku su lu yi tshogs bsags te/ /tshogs bsags brgya yi do zla min/ /nyams len dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed de/ /ston mo brgya yi do zla min/ /phung po sha khyer khrag khyer de/ /rim gro brgya yi do zla min/ /'dug gnas gnyan sa ri khrod de/ /dgon pa brgya yi do zla min/ /yon bdag snang srid lha 'dre de/ /yon bdag brgya yi do zla min/ /lta ba ka dag mtha' bral te/ /dam chos brgya yi do zla min/ /dam ṭwāoṃs bdud kyi gcod yul te/ /man ngag brgya yi do zla min//zhes gsungs pa yan no/ / 255

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rari grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdrug pa rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la bya ba'i thabs kyi lam mthar phyin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la/ dad gus kyi sgo nas bla ma bsten nas tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ yan lag bdud pa 'bul ba/ phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa/ dbang bzhi blang ba / de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon bstan pa dang lnga las/ dang po dad gus kyi sgo nas bla ma bsten nas tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ de yang mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa zhig btsal te/ des ci gsungs bsgrub pa dang sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni gal che ste/mdo las/don dam pa ni dad pas rtogs par bya ba yin no/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla ma las/ rang byung nyid kyi don dam ni/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /zhes dang / dge bshes kha rag sgom chung gis/ sde snod gsum shes kyang bla ma la mos gus med na phan pa med gsungs/ rje mi las kyang / rje la gsol ba mi 'debs pa'i/ /mi rtogs ye shes 'dod pa de/ /byang bstan phug par nyi skug 'dra/ /snang serme sa 'dres dus de la med/ /ces gsungs/ khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad ni/ bla ma kho na gal che ba yin pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa yang rgyud sde thams cad nas gsungs shing / de nyid bskyed rdzogs sgom pa thams cad las kyang lhag par gsungs pa yin te/ 'bri gung skyobs pa rin po ches/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la/ /mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'bebs pas/ /sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/25/byes na gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrtogs pa rgyud la skye ba ni/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la brten nas rgyud la skye ba ma gtogs thabs gzhan gang gis kyang rtogs mi nus pa yin la/yang dgos rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po 'od gsal rdo rje'i theg pa 'di ni/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dang mjal/ de la rtse gcig gi dad 'dun drag pos yid khyed shes kyi blo khel gsol ba 'debs shes na rkyen mos gus kyis byas te bla ma'i rtogs pa slob ma la 'phos nas rang bzhin brngod bral rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs rtogs par bzhed pa yin no/ /de phyir ci snang bla mar shar ba'i bskyed rim dang / thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i rdzogs rim gyi man ngag lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ e ma ho rang snang lhun grub sogs brjod pa dang chabs gcig /'di ltar nam mkha' yis gar khyab thams cad rang gi snang bas khyab cing / snang bas khyab tshad kyi zhing khams thams cad la/ tha mal ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa las/rang byung lhun grub tu shar ba'i dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing gi rgyan dang bkod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'og min padma 'od kyi pho brang chen po gsal ba'i dbus su/ rang nyid kyi gzhi lus dbang gi snod du rung ba dang / rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel dang o rgyan chen po'i bde stong gi ye shes bskyed pa'i grogs yin pas ngo bo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin pa la/ rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum spyi bor bla ma'i thugs kar rengs pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ma rig gti 257

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmug gi gnyid las slong bar byed pa'i thod pa'i ḍā ma ru nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i gri gug skur brten pa/pad nyi bam ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing / g.yon cung zad bskums pa'i 'dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ me tog gi 'phyang 'phrul can snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal btab/ de'i spyi bor mda' gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i padma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du zla ba'i gdan te sum brtsegs kyi steng du/ ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig/phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing /g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba tshe'i bum pa 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba dpag bsams shing gis kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ mchan khung g.yon na yum lha lcam sbas pa'i mtshon byed kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin pa ste/ de yang ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum mtshon pa'i yar rtse gsum/ sku gsum mtshon pa'i thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum/ ye shes lnga mtshon phyir dar tshon sna lnga/ theg pa rim pa dgu mtshon pa'i rwa la lcags lung dgu yis brgyan pa dur khrod chen po brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bskyangs nas ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus ༵sbya brdar shi skra dang gson skras brgyan pa/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdabu la pad zhu 'dab ldan rigs lnga mnabs pa/ sku la nang du byang sems theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags rdo rje'i gsang gos dkar po dang / de'i steng du 'dung ma dmar po/ sngags kyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags su phod chen mthing ga /so thar gyi theg pa rdzogs pa'i rtags chos gos dmar po gser gyi ha ris can dang /theg pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags za 'og ber chen dbang gi mdog can rnams brtsegs mar gsol zhing khro 'dzum mtshan dpe gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol ba'i stabs su bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol du 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub cing 'od lnga'i zer thag gi drwa ba mig mang ris su shar ba'i nang khongs 'ja' 'od zlum 'khyil gyi dbus su/ rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin brgyad/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ bod kyi grub chen rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs rgya bod kyi paṇa grub rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs pa rnams dang / rgyud sde chen po drug dang 'brel ba'i yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa ltar bzhugs shing / de dag thams cad kyang sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal stong 'dzin med chu zla ltar gtso 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi tshul du tha mal gyi snang ba rang 'gags su 'gro ba zhig gsal gdab la mos gus gdung dbyangs snyan pos/ hūṃ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams sogs nas gu ru padma sirnyihūṃ: zhes brjod ma thag tu zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi pho brang rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gis bskyed dīsdo 9dam tshig pa dang dbyer med ro gcig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃtu 'dres par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba la/ phyag 'tshal ba mchod pa 'bul ba/ sdig pa bshags pa/ rjes su yi rang ba/ chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba/mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa/ dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba'o/ /dang po nga rgyal gyi gnyen po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/hrī bdag lus sogs brjod pa dang mnyam du/ rang lus grangs med par sprul nas g.yas su skye ba da res kyi pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du rang la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs gnyis kyis thog drangs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams mi yi gzugs su gyur te khrom tshogs pa bzhin du gsal gdab la/ rkang pa'i long bu gnyis gshib/ lus drang por bsrangs nas lag gnyis snying gar thal mo sbyar dgos te/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pas/ bab col goms pa min pa'i lus btud nas/ /snying gar gus bcas mngon rtogs ngoms pa las/ /me tog dogs pas rab bzung snyim pa'i snod/ /ga bu chung gi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de nasathal mo spyi bo'i gtsug tu sbyar dgos pa yin te/ thar ba chen po'i mdo las/ padma kha 'bus phye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyisaspyi bor thal sbyar te/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen chen pos/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /'char ka'i padma kha 'bus phye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs byas/ /lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thal mo spyi bosdu ḍijog pa'i dus su rgyal ba sras dang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbacas pa'i sku'i yon tan dran te/ bla ma'i sku sprul sku la phyag 'tshal bas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi sgrib pa dag /mthar thug sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbu'i gtsug tor bltar mi mngon pa thob par shog cig snyam pa dang /thal mo mgrin par 'jog pa'i dus su rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsung gi yon tan dran te bla ma'i gsung longs spyod rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi ngag gi sgrib pa dag /mthar thug gsung chos kyi dung zhes phyi dbyibs dung gi ri mo lta bu yod pa ste/ de la brten nas gsungs tshangs pa'i dbyangasayan lag drug cu dang ldan pa thob par shog cig ces smon pa dang / thal mo snying gar 'jog pa'i dus su rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi yon tan dran te thugs chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bas/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi yid kyi sgrib pa dag /mthar thug rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir thugs ka na dpal gyi be'u'i ri mo yod pa ste de la brten nas ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par shog cig /de nas lus kyi ma lnga sa la phab pa zhes bya ba/ dpral ba dang gcig /lag mthil gnyis/ pus mo gnyis dang lnga bo sa la phab ste phyag byas pas/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag /mthar thug sku lnga'i go 'phang thob nas ma dag 'gro lnga'i sems can dag pa sku lnga'i zhing du 'dren nus par shog cig /ces brjod cing bsam nga 'o/ /de ltar gnas gsum du thal mo sbyar nas lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba/ ngag gis phyag 'tshal dang gsol 'debs kyi tshig 'don/ yid kyis ci mdzad khyed shes dang blo gtad lidī ༵skyur gyi mos gus dang bcas/ bdag

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang sems can thams cad lhan gcig tu lo yag gi snye ma rlung gis phyogs gcig tu bskyod pa bzhin du phyag 'tshal ba'i dmigs pa sogs lus ngag yid gsum chun gcig dril du byed pa ni gal che ba yin no/ /de ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ sa 'di'i rir bcas rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du/ /bsod nams de 'dra 'jig rten gsum na med/ /lus btud dbang chen bar gyi rdul rnams dang / /mnyam pa'i grangs snyed 'khor los bsgyur 'gro zhing / /mthar thug zhi ba mchog gi go 'phang 'gro/ /zhes dang / 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong dag /khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la dad pas phyag 'tshal ba de'i rnam par smin pa ni/ ji srid du tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la khong khro ma skyes pa de srid du gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ོ༵'i/ rgya/ la po bde ba myong zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du phyin par 'gyur ro zhes gnyis pa ser sna'i gnyen po mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag la/ dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa/ yid kyi sprul ba'i mchod pa/ ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mchod pa dang gsum las/ dang po dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa la/ bdag pos yongs su bzung ba'i mchod pa/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa dang gnyis las/ dang po bdag pos yongs su bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas chu/ /bla re 'phan lding gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rgyasdu6 neetshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang //

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃlus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar phul ba'i tshe phul yul gyi zhid sa dag pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum po'am yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/phul ba po'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don du/ phul rgyu'i dngos po dag pa log 'tsho dang sdig zas kyi ma gos shing nga rgyal dang ngoms chos su ma song bar/ser sna dang 'jur 'gegs kyis ma bcing ba'i rgyu bzang zhing bkod legs pa/mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod rdzas rnams 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas legs par mchod dgos pa yin te/ rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog manda ra dang padma dang //utpal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang / /phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /spos mchog yid 'ong dri ngad khyab pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la 'bul/ /zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi /lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi/ /gser gyi padma tshar du dngar ba yi/rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes pa dang / rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng pa yang / /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/sems nyid ngal gso las/ rin ri bo nags tshal padma'i mtsho/ /ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang / //ṭwāṃ sogs dri zhim ngad ldang dpag bsam

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃshing / /me tog 'bras bu dud pa'i tshogs kyi mchod/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ mtsho dang rdzing bu padmas brgyan pa dag /ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang / /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /zhes dang / yang kun mkhyen chen pos/ ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin/ /gza' bral rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba dang / /nyin byed 'od stong dra bas mdzes 'bar ba/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shar na nyi zla'i mar me/ lho tsandan nags kyi bdug spos/ nub gangs dkar mar gyi lha bshos/ byang rdza chab sngon mo'i ོ༵rshokā kāonā/ sdursha kāswā kā sbyi ོ༵/ ga/zhi'i me tog /steng g.yu 'brug sgra yi rol mo la gnyis pa yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod pa ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ lha sogs 'jig rten kun na yid 'ong ba'i/ /gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen drwa ba can/ /glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bab cing / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyis mchod/ /zhes dang / sgeg mo phreng thog rin chen glu sdu ༵ ོ༵kārnyi/sa/ ṭwāṃṭwāoṃ tā lha'i/ ṭwāṃ samo so sna/ tsho/gas sprin 'phro bas/ /rgyal ba sras dkus gsum pa ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mchod pa ni/ kun mkhyen pos/ ting 'dzin yid kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /dngos bshams yid sprul sogs ces brjod pa'o/ /de ltar mchod pa'i ༵/ yon ni/ mdo las/ 'jig rten dag

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃn bde zhing skyid pa gang / /de kun dkon mchog mchod las byung bas na/ /rtag tu dkon mchog mchod la brtson par gyis/ /zhes dkon mchog gsum yid la byas nas gsol 'debs lan gcig byas pa dang / phyag gcig 'tshal ba dang /me tog gcig tsam phul ba dang / g.yeng ba'i yid kyis mtshan lan gcig brjod pa dang / sems zhabrugs bzhin du rtsig ngos la bris pa'i sku gzugs mthong ba la thal mo sbyar ba la sogs pa la phan yon tshad med pa yod de/ dam chos padma dkar po las/ bde gshegs sku ni rtsig ngos bris pa la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis thal mo sbyar byas te/ /me tog gcig tsam gyis ni mchod pa dang /zhabrugs bzhin pa yi sems kyis mchod na yang / /de dag rim gyi sangs rgyas byed par mthong / /zhes dang / byis pa rtsed mo dga' dang de bzhin du/ /bye ma la ni mchod rten byed pa dang / /rtsig ngos shing bu sen mos gzugs bris pa/ /de dag rnams kyang byang chub mchog 'di thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa zhe sdang gi gnyen po sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ lci ba bzhi/ log pa brgyad/ dkon mchog gi dkor 'phrog pa la sogs pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rang gi byas pa'am/ gzhan la byed du bcug pa/ byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba byas pa sogs kha na ma tho ba'i las ci bsags pa thams cad gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol lo bshags so/ /slad chad mi bgyid do snyam pa la sogs rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi dus su bshad ༵ 5ltar/ gnyen po stobasabazhi'i dag pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdran pa'i ngang nas bshags pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad rang gi lce thog tu nag phung gis 'dus pa la/ tshogs zhing lha tshogs kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer byung ba phog pas dri ma bkrus pa bzhin dag par bsams nas/ sgo gsum mi dge'i las rnams kun/ /'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du bshags/ /zhes brjod/de ltar bshags na sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i shes byed ni/ byams pa seng ge sgra pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ mi shes pas ni gang byas pa'i/ /sdig pa'i las ni bshags par bgyi/ /mkhas pas nyes pa bshags nas ni/ /las dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /zhes pa dang / lung rnam 'byed las/ gang gis sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge ba yis ni mthar byed de/ /nyi zla sprin las 'byung ba bzhin/ /'jig rten 'dir ni de snang 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas mdzod kyi mdo las/ pha ma dang rang sangs rgyas bsad pa yang stong pa nyid bsgom pas rnam par grol lo/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa phrag dog gi gnyen po rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams phung po mtha' yas la/ /rtag par bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba rnams kyis sems can gyi don du chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa rlabs po che dang / sems can rnams kyi bsod nams dang thar ba cha mthun gyi dge ba la sogs pa rnams la rjes su yi rang byas na de'i dge rtsa mnyam du thob pa yin te/ mdo sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal bas tshad gzung rung / 2/ṭwāṃs su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min//

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃzhes dang / bzang po spyod pa las kyang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /zhes gsungs pa snaṭwāṃ /baṭwāoṃ/ kā dri py-itrom̐/sa/ kyi bsdus pa yi/ /dge tshogasakun la rjes yi rang //lnga pa gti mug gi gnyen po chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ni/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te bdag gis rtogs pa'i chos zab mo 'di ni gzhan gyi khong du chud par dka' ste/gal te bdag gis gzhan la bstan par byed kyang / de mi rtogs pas bdag nyid tsam du zad kyis/ de bas na bdag nyid gcig pu dgon pa ru gnas par bya'o snyam du dgongs te/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig bdag gis rnyed/ /su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas/ /mi smra nags 'dabs nyid du gnas par bya/ /zhes chos mi gsungs par bzhugs pa la tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la nyan thos dang / rang rgyal dang / byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa gsum las brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs dgos pa yin te/ rigs can gsum gyi gdusdu ḍi la/ /theg gsum chos 'khor bskor

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbar ṭwāṃ/ kā/ lo/shās / /ོ rsha kta/ mee+o ོ༵/ nga/na las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag ni/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ deng nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par gsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa la dge bsnyen tsun tas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du/ zhing khams 'di dang gzhan dag tu bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sems can gyi don mdzad zin nas mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa dag gi mdun du/ bdag gis lus grangs med pa sprul nas gsol ba btab pas 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes par bsam nas/ ji sditāo / shāoṭwāṃ zlo'o ma/ sto/nga bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /zhes bdun pa the tshom gyi gnyen po bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/ 'bri gung skyobs pa rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshogs gnyis kyi yid bzhin nor bu la/ /smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na/ /dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ /mjug bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ da ltar gyi dge bas mtshon nas rang gzhan gyi dus gsum du 'brel bar bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jam dpal gzhon nu la sogs pas yongs su bsngos pa bzhin du bdag gis kyang bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam nas/ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa kun/ /byang chudī rten po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes brjod par

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbya'o/ /gsum pa phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'di ltar thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa ni/ rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs pa la rag las shing / rtogs pa skye ba bla ma'i byin rlabs la rag las pa dang / byin rlabs rang rgyud la 'jug pa mos gus kyi rten 'brel kho na la rag las pa yin la/ des na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid yon tan gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas dang mnyam zhing / bka' drin gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas las kyang ches cher lhag par thag bcad/ ngesashes bskyed/ glo snying brang gsum ling gis gtad la/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang khyed kho na mkhyen no snyam pa'i re ltos ling bskyur gyi tshul gyis lus ba sbu g.yo ba/ mig nas mchi ma 'khruganasapa/ blo sna bla mas phrog pa/ bsam rgyu bla ma las med pa/ lus sems tshugs mi thub pa'i mos gus gdunganasashugs drag po dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ dang po dngos grub bsgrub pa'i dus su/ rje btsun gu ru rin po che/ /sogs nas rje btsun chen po pad 'byung mkhyen/ /zhes brjod nas/gsol 'debs rgyud bskul gyis 'dzab badzra gu ru kho na la 'bad nas/ dngos grub bskul ba'i dus su/ bsnyen pa phreng skor re mtshams su/ bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /sogasanas/sgrib gnyis sbyongs shig mthu can/ yan chad tshar re bya/ de nas gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debs sogs nas bsam don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod nas/ snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i rang bzhin du gsal te/ phyi spyopye kyi 'jig rten dpal ri padma 'od kyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpho brang / nang bcud kyi sems can o rgyan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshom bu/ sgra grags pa thams cad grags stong sngags kyi rang sgra/ gsang ba sems kyi rtog tshogs thams cad rang shar rang grol chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin du rang yal rjes med du 'byams klas pa'i ngang nas rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi yon tan dang bka' drin dran bzhin du/ e ma ho/ rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba'i zhing khams nas//sogs nas rten 'brel mngon gyur sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces smon lam dang bcas pa mos gus gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas 'khor rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo sku gzi byin 'od du 'bar zhing ye shes kyi dbang mchog bskur ba'i bdag nyid chen por bzhugs par gsal 'debs dgos pa yin no/ /bzhi pa dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ dngos grub zhu ba'i dus zhes dbang bzhi blang ba'i dmigs pa ni/ gu ru'i smin mtshams nas sku'i ngo bo ye shes kyi o yig dkar po chu shel lta bu 'tsher ba las 'od zer dkar po 'phros nas/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi las dang rtsa ba'i sgrib pa dag /sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ bskyed rim gyi snod du gyur/ dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon theb/ lus snang stong zung 'jug tu grol/ 'bras bu sprul sku'i go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'o/ /yang bla ma'i mgrin pa zhes mgul gyi bum pa nas/ gsung gi ngo bo ye shes kyi ā yig dmar po padma rā ga ltar 'bar ba las 'od zer dmar po 'phros nas/ rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/༵ḍi gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃgasung rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ bzlas brjod kyi snod du gyur/ mchog dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon theb/ ngag grags stong skye med du grol/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'o/ /yang bla ma'i thugs ka dpal gyi be'u nas thugs kyi ngo bo ye shes kyi hūṃ yig mthing ga nam mkha'i mdog can las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros nas/ rang gi snying ga nas zhugs/ yid kyi las dang thig le'i sgrib pa dag /thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bde stong tsaṇḍa li'i snod du gyur/ dga' bral gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ phyag rgya rig 'dzin gyi sa bon theb/ sems bde stong ye shes su grol/'bras bu chos sku'i go 'phang gi skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'o/ /slar yang sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor ye shes gsum gyi rang bzhin du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ yig gnyis pa zhig skar mda' 'phang ba bzhin du chad/ rang sems dang tha dad med par 'dres/ kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ tshig gis mtshon pa don dam gyi dbang thob/ ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i snod du gyur/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi sa bon theb/ sems rig stong 'od gsal du grol/mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du bsres te rig stong rjen pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de yang dbang la rnam pa mang du yod kyang / don dam pa'i dbang 'di yin pas/ yid gnyis the tshom 271

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmed par dad gus mos pa'i sgo nas ma yengs par rtse gcig tu byin rlabs kyi nus pa thob pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du yang yang 'bad par bya'o/ /mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ nam zhig tshe yi dus byas tshe/ /sogs nas/ rje btsun padmas dbugs dbyung gsol/ /zhes brjod/ bla ma de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor nges shes bskyed nas skyon rtog gi blo ngan spangs te/ yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas tshad med pa'i dad pa dang mos gus mchi ma 'khrugs pa tsam du bskyed pa'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid la thugs brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas lhag par dgongs te/ zhal 'dzum pa dang spyan rjes chags su g.yo ba'i ngang nas thugs ka nas 'od zer drod tsha lam pa zhig wal gyis 'phros nas/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying gar reg pa tsam gyis rang gi sgo gsum 'od dmar gyi gong bu sran ma tsam du gyur/ de nyid mthar thag sgra dang bcas te me stag ya' ba bzhin du bla ma'i thugs kar thim nas bla ma yang mi dmigs spros bral chos sku'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ /de las ldang ba'i tshe/ dwangs pa'i mtsho la nya ldang ba bzhin du gzhi lus zhing khams kyi bkod pa dang bcas pa sngar bzhin snang srid thams cad bla ma'i rnam rol du gsal nas/ rnam dkar dge tshogs bsod nams snying po 'di/ /dmigs mtha' bral ba'i sems can kun la bsngo//yang gsang rdo rje'i theg pa'i don rtogs nas/ /rigs bdag bla ma'i go 'phang thob par shog /ces dang / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /sogasanas bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog /ces dang / zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam sogs 'don par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor de yang 272

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃ'agro ba'i tshe phrag pa g.yas kyi nam mkhar bsgom/ de bskor ba byed pa'i rten yin/ 'dug pa'i tshe spyi bo'i gtsug gi nam mkha' la bsnom/ de gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten yin/ za 'thung byed pa'i tshe mgrin pa'i dbus su bsgom/ de ci za ci 'thung gi phud mchod pa'i gnas yin/ nyal ba'i tshe snying gi dbus su bsgom/ de rmi lam 'od gsal du 'char ba'i man ngag yin/ 'chi ba'i tshe thugs yid dbyer med bsres nas mnyam par 'jog /de 'pho ba kun gyi rgyal po yin/mdor na dus dang rnam pa kun tu gang du 'dug pa'i gnas dpal ri padma 'od kyi pho brang / snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor/ sgra grags gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rtog thugs kyi ro la ba ste 'khyer so gsum gyi rnal 'byor la bslab par bya dgos so/ /de ltar byas na snang ba thams cad lha dang bla mar 'char zhing / spyod lam thams cad dge bar 'gyur ba yin te/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ nga 'gro na snang ba lam du 'khyer/ /tshogs drug rang grol gyi 'gro lugs yin/ /sdod na ma bcos rnal mar sdod/ /snying po don gyi sdod lugs yin/ /za na stong nyid kyi zas la za/ /gzung 'dzin spangs pa'i za lugs yin/ /'thung na dran shes kyi chab la 'thung / khyun chad med pa'i 'thung lugs yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'brug pa rin po ches/ sdod na ka dag zang thal gyi lta ba dgos/ /'gro na snang ba lam khyer gyi gdams pa dgos/ /nyal na rmi lam 'od gsal gyi man ngag dgos//zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms pas byin rlabs rang rgyud la zhugs pa'i rtags ni/ rab snang srid chos skur 'char/ 'bring snang srid bla mar 'char/ tha ma 'khor ba las blo ldog 2ṭwāṃsdu bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos mthong

gi g.yuoXgablamachosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ 'gra shes / kta dṛ ṭwāṃ ṭwāo+oṃm/ /pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ rgyud las/ gang gis bskal pa bye ba rtswa /lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa las/ /bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog /ces dang / yid bzhin mchog gi rgyud las/ gang gis bla ma 'dun pa'i lha/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom pa yis/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor stong phrag nyid/ /lag mthil bzhag nas stong gsum bskor/ /snying khar lan stong bstim byas na/ /brgya stong rgyu dang char mi thob/ /des na rtag tu dran pa yis/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan nyid du/ /dpal ldan bla ma bsam par bya/ /zhes dang /dgongs 'dus las/ gang gis bskal pa 'bum dag tu/ /lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa las/ /bla ma gcig pur bsgom pa mchog /ces dang / dam tshig bkod pa'i rgyud las kyang / mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ /bskal pa 'bum du bsgom pa las/ /bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog /bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan gcig mchog /ces dang / a ti bkod pa las/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil//yan lag mthil du gang bsgoms pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dngos grub kyang //gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa na/ /skyon zad yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bskyed rim sgom pa mang lags kyang / /bla ma sgom pa'i gong na med//rdzogs rim bsgom pa mang lags kyang / /blo khel ling bskyur gong na med//ces dang / rgyud las/ gang gis rdo twe7 spyob dpon nyid/ /bkur zhing spyi bor

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃhā~X ༵/ོsna/ pa/zhe/sa/ shā byi /sna so ba/sa/ byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de gsum pa nyams len dngos gzhi'i cha lag nye lam 'pho ba'i khrid la/rab chos sku lta ba rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba/ 'bring longs sku bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi 'pho ba/ tha ma sprul sku tshad med thugs rje'i 'pho ba/ gshin po rjes 'dzin thugs rje lcags kyu'i 'pho ba/ tha mal pa 'du shes gsum ldan gyi 'pho ba/de dag gi phan yon bstan pa dang drug las/dang po rab chos sku lta ba rgyas 'debs kyi 'pho ba ni/ tshe 'dir gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i lta ba ma nor ba rgyud la skyes shing goms 'dris byed pa rnams/ 'chi ba'i tshe ka dag khregs chod kyi gsang lam nas dbyings dang rig pa'i gnad la brten te chos sku'i klong du 'pho ba de yin/ gnyis pa 'bring longs sku bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi 'pho ba ni/ bskyed rdzogs dbyer med kyi rnal 'byor la goms 'dres byas shing sgru ma lta bu'i lha sku la rtsal 'byongs pa dag 'chi ba'i tshe bar do 'brul ba'i snang ba 'char ba dang mnyam du zung 'jug ye shes kyi skur 'pho ba de yin/ gsum pa tha ma sprul sku tshad med thugs rje'i 'pho ba ni/ gsang sngags smin byed kyi dbang thob cing / dam tshig la skyon ma zhugs/bskyed rdzogs la mos pa byed cing bar do'i gdams ngag dang ldan pa rnams/ ji skad du/ mngal sgo dgag nas ru log dran par bya/ /snying rus dag snang dgos pa'i dus gcig yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ma dag pa'i mngal sgo ngan pa bkag cing / snying rje chen pos 'phe/ sdu dang / skye ba sprul ba'i lam khyer la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbarten nas zhing dag pa'i skye gnas su 'pho ba de yin/ bzhi ba gshin po rjes 'dzin thugs rje lcags kyu'i 'pho ba ni/ rtogs pa mchog ldan gyi gang zag snang sems las su rung ste/ bar do'i shes rgyud mkhyen pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhan 'chi ka ma'am bar do na yod pa la/ 'pho ba 'debs pa de yin/ de yang spyir gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs pa la/ mthong lam thob pa zhig nges par dgos te/rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang / mthong lam gyi bden pa ma mthong bar/ /gshin po la 'pho ba ma 'debs shig /ces gsungs/ 'on kyang 'pho ba gdab pa'i dus ma nor ba de phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i dus de yin te/ de lta bu'i dus nges pa can dang 'phrad na 'pho ba'i man ngag la cung zad goms 'dres yod pa gang rung rung gis 'pho ba btab na yang phan thogs che zhing ngan song gi skye gnas la sogs pa dgag par nus te/ mgron po lam du zhugs pa la grogs kyis sgyur ba dang 'dra/ de lta ma yin par lus sems bral tshar nas ni 'pho ba dka' ste/ de 'dra de la 'pho ba 'debs pa la bar do'i skye gnas mkhyen pa zhig dang / sems la dbang thob pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa zhig yin na bar do gdos bcas kyi lus dang bral ba de rkyen gyis bsnar bar sla ba yin pas/ bar do rang nas 'pho ba btab na rnam/ shes dag pa'i zhing du spar nus pa yin gyi/ shi tshar nas kyang phung po la rnam shes bkug ste 'pho bar rlom pa la ni snying po ci yang med gsungs/ de bas na da lta bla ma'am sprul sku la sogs pa'i ming btags pa phal mo ches gshin po la 'pho ba 'debs pa ni/byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas slangs te rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba 276

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrtsa ba nas med na ni/ byang chub sems kyi kun slong las gshin po la phan thog shas che zhing rang la sgrib par mi 'gyur mod/ de'ang ma yin par rang gi rnyed 'tshol gyi ched du ngag 'don tsam shes pa la brten nas 'pho ba 'debs shing /gshin po'i 'pho rta sogs len pa ni shin tu tha chad pa yin te/ ji skad du/ rang thar ba'i skam sar ma phyin par/ /mi gzhan gyi 'dren ston byed pa de/ /de gnyis rnodme // parwapye nasno /ma/ mthun/ /dpe chus khyer mi la mis 'jus 'dra/ /zhes lnga ba tha mal pa 'du shes gsum ldan gyi 'pho ba'am/ rnam shes bla ma'i 'pho ba zhes bya ba ni/ dri med bshags rgyud las/ 'da' ka 'od kyi gong bu sgra yi 'pho/ /zhes dang / o rgyan chen pos/ bsgoms te sangs rgyas kun la yod/ /ma bsgom chos ni nga la yod/ /ces dang / paṇa nā ro pas/ sgo dgu 'khor ba'i skar khung can/ /sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i sgo/ /sgo dgu bcad nas sgo gcig phye/ /thar pa'i lam la the mi tshomi/ /zhes dang / lho brag mar pa lo tsā'i zhal nas/ngas da lta'i dus su 'pho ba sbyangs/ /sbyangs shing sbyangs shis yang yang sbyangs//tha mal 'chi yang nyam nga med/ /sngar 'dres byas pa'i gdeng zhig yod/ /ces dang / rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjes/ bsre 'pho mtshams sbyor gyi gdams ngag 'di/ /gnad bar do 'joms pa'i lam mkhan yin/ /lam 'di dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam/ /srog rtsol dbu mar tshud pa'i mi re bde/ /chos kyi dbyings su slebs pa 'di e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i gdams pa de la dang por sbyong ba dang / las la sbyar ba gnyis 2ṭwāoṃḍi/ dang po sbyong ba ni/ da lta rang nyid

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkyis 'pho ba'i khrid zhus te yang dang yang du sbyang zhing rtags ma thon gyi bar du sbyang dgos so/ /de yang da lta rang nyid lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i cha thams cad ma nyams shing / dar ba'i dus na 'pho ba la brten nas dngos su 'pho ba cung zad dka' zhing / 'chi kha'i dus la bab pa'am/ shin tu rgas 'khogs pa'i dus na ni 'pho sla ba yin te/ dper na shing tog dang 'bras bu sogs dbyar kha dar la babs pa'i dus na ni btu dka' la/ ston ka smin nas lhung la nye ba'i tshe gos 'dabs tsam reg kyang lhung 'ong ba dang 'dra ba yin no/ /de nas las la sbyar ba ni/ rang nyid la 'chi ltas byung ste cis kyang mi bzlog par shes shing thim rim la sogs pa byung ba'i tshe bya dgos kyi/ de las gzhan du mi rung ste/ rgyud las/dus la babs na 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang sbyong pa dang las la sbyar ba gang gi tshe yin yang 'dra ste/ 'pho ba'i gdams pa dngos bsnom pa'i rim pa ni/ stan bde ba la rdo rje'i sgyil mo krung la sogs pa bca' zhing / lus drang por bsrang / sngon 'gro bla ma rgyang 'bod nas bzung ste bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bsdu rim dang bcas yongs su rdzogs par bya/ de nas dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid sdod pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing gi rgyan dang bkod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su/ rang gi gzhi lus kyi phung po skad cig gis gnas 'gyur nas pad nyi'i gdan la ngo bo mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i 'dor stabs can/ zhal cung zad zhi ma khro'i nyams 278

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchags shing / spyan gsum nam mkhar ye re gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ma rig gti mug gi gnyid las slong ba'i thod pa'i ḍa ma ru nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khrol ba/ g.yon dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i gri gug dkur brten pa/ sku gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan dang me tog gi chun 'phyangs can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu zhig gsal ba ni phyi lus kyi stong ra yin no/ /de'i lus dbus su rtsa dbu ma khrag dang chu ser gyis ma gos pa khang stong du ka ba btsug pa lta bu/ chos sku 'gyur ba med pa mtshon pas mthing gi shun pa ltar sngo ba/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa srab pa'i brdar padma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal ba'i brdar til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ lam dman pa dang lam log par mi 'gro ba'i ched du chu shing gi ldem bu ltar drang ba ste/mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i lam mtshon pa'i ched du yar sne spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga na rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar har por yod pa/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sgo 'gegs pa mtshon pa'i mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad na rtsa phug rdugs su kha zum pa/ de lta bu gsal ba ni nang rtsa'i stong ra yin/ de nas rtsa dbu ma de'i nang snying gi thad na snyug ma tshigs kyi 'gags pa lta bu'i tshigs zhig yod par bsam/ de'i steng du rlung gi thig le ljang skya 'gul 'phrigs kyi rnam pa can gyi steng du rang gi sems rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge hrī:yig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa dar lcog rlung gis brdabs pa ltar 'dar phri li yi yod par dmigs pa rig pa sems kyi rten gzhi yin/ de nas rang gi spyi bor khru gang tsam gyi steng gi nam mkhar me rdi ṭwāṃn po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃche'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan sum brtsegs kyi steng na/ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter mdzod dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po padma rā ga'i lhun po la nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin pa mchog gi sprul sku tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo la sogs mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer mu mtha' med par 'phro ba de lta bu zhig gsal/de'i g.yas su rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba 'dren pa/g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i me tog gi 'dabs ma snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/ 'od dpag med kyi g.yon du rgyal ba thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing ga phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol stabs su 'dzin pa/ de gnyis ka'ang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis spras pa/ de yang 'od dpag med srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i brdar/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang / sems dpa' gnyis 'gro don rdoo8 shāb dang bral ba'i brdar zhabs gnyis

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpad zla'i gdan la bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo de gsum gyi mtha' skor du lam zab mo 'pho ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dwangs pa'i mkha' la sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs nas/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad la brtse ba'i zhal gyis phyogs/ 'dzum pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral te/ bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bzhugs par bsam la/ rang nyid gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /sogs nas/ mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i phung po gsal/ /zhes gsal gdab/ de nas mtshan ci mang brjod mthar/ e ma ho/ gnas rang snang don gyi 'og min na/ /sogs nas/dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ yid mos gus man chad tshar gsum/ dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin par shog /ces lan gsum brngod/ de dag gi tshe bla ma dang mgon po 'od dpag med la mos gus mchi ma 'khrugs pa lta bu'i ngang nas rig pa sems kyi rten gzhi hrī:yig kho na la sems bzung / de nas spar chog gi tshe rkan phug nas hrī:hrī:zhes lnga tshar brjod pa dang mnyam du rig pa sems kyi rten gzhi yi ge hrī dmar po de rlung gi thig le ljang skya g.yo ba'i rnam pa can des btegs te 'dar phri li li byed cing je mtho je mthor song / spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar thon pa dang mnyam du hig ces brjod pas/ dpag chen gyi mda' 'phangs pa ltar yar te sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim par bsam/ yang snying gar hrī:yig gsal la/ dmigs pa sngar ltiṭwāṃ bcas hig sgra bdun nam nyer gcig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsogs brjod/ lugs ka gzhan la hika brjod nas spar zhing ka brjod pas mar 'babs pa'i dmigs pa bya srol yod kyang / 'dir ka brngod nas mar 'bebs srol med/ gzhan yang mtshan byin rlabs can dang / gter ston nyi zla sangs rgyas kyi 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs dang / gnam chos kyi 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs sogs brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar yang dang yang du sbyangs pa song nas mthar 'jog khar/ sku lnga'i dbyings su rgyas gdab pa'i ched du/ phaṭa lnga phrugs su brngod cing / gnas lugs spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de nas spyi gtsug gi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad gtso bo gsum la thim/sems dpa' nyid kyang 'od dpag med la thim/ 'od dpag med 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i tshe bum dpag bsam ljon shing gi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa/sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis spras pa de lta bu zhig tu bsgom la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzrī wanta ye swā hwa/ zhes brgya rtsa dang tshe gzungs sogs 'don/ des tshe la mi gnod cing rten 'brel bden pas tshe gegs kyang zhi ba yin/des na gzhan shi bo dang 'chi ka ma la gdab pa dang / rang nyid 'chi ba'i tshe las la sbyar ba'i dus 'di mi dgos/ de ltar sbyangs pa 'byongs pa'i rtags kyang gzhud las/ mgo na chu ser zil ba phrom/ /'jag ma dal gyis tshugs sogs 'byung / /zhes pa lta bu'i rtags ma tho/8 ni bar du nan tan gyis sbyang dgos pa

'i g.yukhogablam chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyan ṭwāoṃ/ga /pa phan yon ni/ de lta bu'i man ngag dang ldan na ci tsam du sdig po che yin kyang ngan song gi skye sgo khog nges la/ mtshams med pa'i las ngan bsags pa lta bu mar gyi zang thal du 'gro ba rnams kyang gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad na/ngan song gi skye gnas su 'gro mi/ dgos nges pa yin te/ rgyud las/ nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa yang / /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhesapa dang / bu ga dgu yi steng phyogs su/ /yid kyis bsams te 'pho byed na/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur te/ /dag pa'i zhing du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang ji skad du/gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /pha mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /rtsa dar dkar gyi lam la 'gro shes na/ /mtshams med lnga bo byas kyang grol/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ nyin bzhin bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga po byed pa yang / /gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad gyur na/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ zab mo 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'di ni ma bsgom par sangs rgyas pa'i chos/ sdig po che btsan thabs su grol ba'i gsang lam man ngag khyad par can yin pas da lta nas rang nyid kyi 'pho ba'i 'khrid zhus te/ yang yang du sbyang zhing rtags ma thon gyi bar du sbyang dgos pa yin no/ /nam zhig rang nyid la 'chi ltas byung nas cis kyang mi bzlog par shes shing thim rim la sogs pa byung ba'i tshe las la sbyar nas 'pho tshul sogs da lta nas shes dgos pa sdiṭwāṃ no/ /mjug dge ba bsngo zhing / bde

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃb can tu skye ba'i smon lam la sogs pa 'don par bya'o/ /de yang bsngo ba la/gang bsngo bar bya ba'i rgyu/ gang du bsngo ba'i yul/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i cho ga dang gsum yod la/ dang po gang bsngo bar bya ba'i rgyu ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ste rnam smin bde ba bskyed pas dge ba/ de'i rtsa ba byed pas rtsa ba zhes gsungs pa yin la/byed pa po gang zag gis dbye na bdag gis byas pa'i dge ba/ gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba/ gnyis kasabyas pa'i dge ba dang / byas pa'i dus kyis dbye na/'das pa'i dge ba/ da ltar gyi dge ba/ ma 'ongs pa'i dge ba dang / byas pa'i tshul gyi dbye na/ lus kyi dge ba/ ngag gi dge ba/ yid kyi dge ba/ bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po la dbye na/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i dge ba/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i dge ba/ bsgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba/ rnam par smin pas dbye na/ 'jig rten pa'i dge ba/ thar ba cha mthun gyi dge ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dang mthun pa'i dge ba'o/ /gang du bsngo ba'i yul ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba dang / ji ltar bsngo ba'i cho ga la/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo ba dang / rjes mthun gyi bsngo ba dang gnyis yod de/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo ba ni/ mdo sdud pa las/gal te mtshan mar byed na de ni bsngo ba min/ /ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ /dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/ bsngo bya bsngo byed bsngo ba rnams/ /rang bzhin gyis ni mi dmigs pa/ /dmigs pa med par bsngo ba ni/ /basbyo8 sdu bla na med pa'o/ /zhes dang / dkon

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmachog ta la'i mdo las/ gang la bya ba mi dmigs pa/ /ji ltar byed pa mi dmigs pa/ /yongs su bsngo ba mi dmigs pa/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i mdo las/ de la 'khor gsum yongs su chad pa gang zhe na/ gang 'das pa la sems mi 'jug /ma 'ongs pa la rnam par shes pa mi 'jug pa dang / da ltar byung ba la yid la byed pa mi 'jug ste/sems dang / yid dang / rnam par shes pa la mi gnas pas 'das pa la mi rtog /ma 'ongs pa la rlom sems su mi byed/ da lta byung ba la spro bar mi byed/'di ni dus gsum mnyam pa nyid 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa yin na/sems can rnams kyi khong du ma chud pa chud par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsngo ba mtshan nyid pa so so'i skye bo'i sa 'dir 'ong dka' ba yin la/ de phyir rjes mthun gyi bsngo ba byed dgos pa yin te/ de yang rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du ji ltar bsngos pa bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang de bzhin du bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam nas bsngo dgos pa yin no/ /de ltar bsngos na dge ba'i rtsa ba mi zad cing gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin te/ ji skad du/ bsngo ba mi zad lam yin te/ /spel dang bsgyur ba'i chos can no/ /zhes dang / blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar twe /ma mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yin

no/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /glo bur 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun byang nas//rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa 'di'ang rdo rje'i mched po du

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༄༅/ /sngon 'gro kun bzang zhal lung gi skabs su mkho ba'i bar ldeb phyogs bsdus/rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba'i rang lugs ltar la/ rgyal ba sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rang snang rig pa'i dbyings su sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa'i brgyud de rig 'dzin sems dpa' mchog rnams la brda' thabs tsam gyis bstan nas brgyud pa'i zab lam rnams rim bzhin gang zag mi yis 'gro ba las skal ba rab bam mchog tu gyur pas dam pa gong ma'i rjes su zin te don gnyis mthar phyin par gyur pa rnams la snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa ste de lta bu'i brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma rnams la gnyis med lta bas gus pa chen po'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo ka dag chos zad chen po'i klong du chos sku'i dgongs pa brnyes te chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba mngon du byas shing / rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub 'bras bu rin po che'i dbyings snyi rang snang longs sku'i zhing snang gi bkod pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa gzigs te/ skal ldan gdul bya 'i snang ngor thugs rje rig rtsal sprul skur snang nas 'gro ba'i don mdzadwa pa'i kun mkhyen chos skyu rgyal po dri med 'od zer gyi zhabs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang so so rang rig pa'i ye shes mkhyen pa chen po shes byu 'khor 'das kun gyi de kho na nyid gsal bar gzigs nas/ thusduṭwāṃ brte ba'i ye shes kyi 'od zer skal

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbazang gdul byu rnams kyi dpal du shar te/ zab lam theg pa thams cad kyi ñtsā mo a ti yo ga yang gsang bla na med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan pa rin po che nyid snyigs dus su gzhir bzhengs su gsal bar mdzad pa rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i zhabs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul bzung nas kun mkhyen phyi ma'i bstan pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung gyi snang ba re res kyang 'brel tshad thams cad kyang rim bzhin thar lam du dgod par mdzad cing gdul bya sems can rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzadu pa byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod yul mtha' yas pa mnga' ba'i drin chen rtswa ba'i bla ma 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa theg dgu yongs su rdzogs pa'i kun mkhyen bla ma snga phyi las brgyud pa'i gzhung bzang po man nga ga snying gi thig le bcud kyi yang bcud chen po tshe gcig la bcu drug ye shes bla ma'i sa mchog la sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba'i zab chos kyi rim pa nyams su len pa'i lam sgyu dngos gzhi'i sngon du 'grwo ba'i thun mong phyi yi sngon 'gro dang thun min nang gi sngon 'gro dang / gdams ngag dngos gzhi'i cha lag nye lam 'pho ba'i khrid dang bcas pa/ tshig gsal la guo bde bas don zab la rmad du byung ba ston par byed pa'i mtshungs med bla ma'i bka' lung ma nor ba /'jigs med chos kyi dbang po rang gi blor ji ltar nges pa bzhin tu sngon 'gro'i krizhung 'di ltar bshad kyis/ lha dang bla mas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlob sa shag / 288

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ༈don gcig na yang ma meongs dang sogasakyi don/ 'od gsal snying po las/ shes rab kyi ma meongs pa'i khyad par dang / gnas lugs myur du mthong ba'i thabs kyi khyad par mang ba gnyis kyis 'phags la/ de la brten nas lam bde zhing myur bas dka' ba med pa dang / /rten gyi gang zag rgyu'i theg pa kho nas gdul bya rnams las dbang po rnon por gyur pa dag gi spyod yul yin pas khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dbang rnon zhes pa/ spyi ra rnam byang bskyed pa'i dbang po lnga po khyad par can gyi 'phags pa dang / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lta ba zab mo rtogs nus pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po dang / spyod pa rlangs po la mi skrag cing dad pa'i dbang po'o/ /de yang rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas pas/ rgyu'i theg pas bskal pa grangs med gsum mam bdun la sogs par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu bsags nas tshogs chen pos mthar thug gi 'bras bu la sbyor bar gsungs pa gang zhig /gsang sngags bla med kyi rgyud 'dir dka' tshegs chung ngus tshe gcig gis mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang de nyid mngon du thob pa'i rgyu mtshan yang ci zhig yin snyam pa la 'dod tshul mang yang / mdor na dge mi dge lung ma bstan dang gsum du yod pa las/ mi dge ba'i las 'bras dge bar bsgyur ba'i thabs ni gsang sngags kyi gzhung kho na las gzhan du ma bshad la/rgyu mtshan 'di la dgongs nas thabs shes khyad par can gyis mtshan rtog sdom pa nyid sngags sdom gyi ngo bor bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes dang / o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang pos/ zhabor ba'i ṭwāṃ ḍibras kun 'byung dang sdug bsngal gyi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbaden pa gnyis dang / mya 'das kyi rgyu 'bras 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa gnyis po dbyer med pa ni lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bum dbang gi lta ba dngos yin te/ de yang snang srid snod bcud thams cad gzhi gnas lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du rtogs pas sdug bden 'khor ba'i snod bcud 'gog bden sku dang ye shes su dbyer med cing / nyon mongs dug lnga ye shes lnga'i rnam rol du 'char zhing / thabs kyis zin pa'i sbyor sgrol gyi dge ba'i rnam pa can la lam du byed pas kun 'byung las nyon gnyis po lam bden dang dbyer med du lta ba yin no/ /zhes dang / mkhan chen gyis mdzad pa'i bden bzhi'i rnam bshad las/ gsang sngags bla na med pa rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la yang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras 'a sa log ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i /rmi 'bras la zhugs nas/ rnam mkhyen mngon du byed pa yin pas/ spyir bden bzhi las mi 'da' yang / nyams su len lugs la khyad par 'di yod de/ sdug bden 'khor ba'i snod bcud 'di rnams la/ gnas lugs dang snang lugs gnyis su phye nas/ gnas lugs kyi ngos nas 'jal na sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral rang byung gi ye shes snang stong bden gnyis dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen por bzhugs pas gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/ des 'dam rdzab kyi nang gi nor bu bzhin du rang ngo rnam dag tu yod cing / sdug bden gyi rang bzhin 'gog bden du gnas pas 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya'o/ /de nyid gzhi rgyud dam sbyang gzhi yin no/ /de ltar rtogs pa la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'am/ grub mtha' zer ba yin no/ /snang lugs kyi ngos nas 'jal na so so'i 290

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃskye bo tha mal rang rgyud du zhen pa'i snang ba la ji ltar snang ba'i phyi nang gi dngos po 'di rnams la ma rtog zhabrul ba'i snang ba zer te sbyang bya yin no/ /de nyid sdug bsngal gyi bden par bzhag go/ /las nyon kun 'byung gi bden pa la yang /rang bzhin shes pas lam du 'gro tshul dang / rang gar shor bas kun 'byung du 'gro tshul gnyis las/ lam du 'gro tshul ni nyon mongs gang skyes kyang dgag sgrub med par kho rang gi thog tu glod nas bzhag pas rtsal gzhi thog tu grol ba chab rom chur zhu ba'am/ rlabs rgya mtshor thim pa bzhin nyon mongs pa kho rang gi ngo bo spros bral gnyug ma'i ye shes su lhang nger 'char/ de tsa na gnyen por gzhan ma dgos par nyon mongs nyid ye shes su shar bas kun 'byung lam bden du song bas nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa zhes bya'o/ /lus ngag gi las rnams kyang ngo bo lung ma bstan yin cing / de dge sdig tu sgyur ba'i byed pa po sems yin pas/ sems nyid gzung 'dzin a 'thas su ma zhen par gang shar gyi ngo bo ma bcos chos nyid stong pa'i rang 'gros kyi ngang du grol ba shes rab dang /sbyor ba sems bskyed khyad par can dang / dngos gzhi lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi byed pas tha mal gyi snang zhen dag snang du 'char ba/ rjes su tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nye lam du song ba ni thabs te/ thabs shes khyad par can de lta bus zin na las kyang lam du 'gro ba'o/ /rang gar shor bas kun 'byung du 'gro tshul ni/ thabs shes khyad par ba dang bral nas bsam sbyor gnyis ka tha mal rang rgyud du shor na las bsags nas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'phen pas kun 'byung gi bden par 'gro ba yin no/ /des2 ṭwāṃ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gnad ji lta ba

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbazhin shes nas rtogs goms kyi gdengs dang ldan na sdug bden gyi rang bzhin 'gog bden du shes nas kun 'byung lam bden du 'khyer nus pas/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras myang 'das kyi rgyu 'bras su 'gyur te spang bya gnyen por song nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /༈ dpal sprul rin po che'i bla ma rgyangs 'bod dang 'grel ba las/dbyings rig dbyer med sangs rgyas dgongs pa yi mthar thug /dag chen dbyings de dam chos rgya mtsho yi brngod bya/ /dgongs pa de rtogs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun du bzhugs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /chos zad dgongs pa chos sku'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ /tshad phebs rig gdangs longs sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'char gzhi/ /mngon sum/ gong 'phel sprul sku'i snang ba la rol pa'i/ /sku gsum dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /thabs mkhas rnam rol dus gsum bla ma kun dbyer med/ /zung 'jug klong na dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi khyab bdag /chos nyid mkha' la dgongs pa'i rtsal shugs kyis 'gro ba'i/ /rtsa gsum kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma de mkhyen no/ /zhes dang / dbyings stong pa ka dag gi ngo bo dang rig pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin yul dang yul can gnyis med chu la chu bzhag pa ltar 'dres pa'i dbyer med de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin cing / dag pa chen po'i dbyings de dam pa'i chos sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i brjod bya'i don mthar thug pa yin la/ dbyings rig dbyer med dag pa chen po'i dbyings de ni sangs rgyas dang chos gnyis ka yin la/ dgongs ༵9 spya rtogs pa ni 'phags pa'i dge 'dun

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃyang yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /zhes pa ltar mchog gsum ngo bo gcig pa'i dgongs pa dang ldan pas na/ bla ma ni dkon mchog gsum ka 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin la/yon tan mdzod las/ rgyu yi yul ni dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /sngags su de yi ngo bo bla mar 'dus/ /zhes pa ltar dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid kyang bla ma yin no/ /spyir 'od gsal gyi snang bzhi la/ thod rgal du lugs 'byung dang / khreg chod du lugs ldog gnyis dang / rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs su sku gsum lam snang du bzhed pa la'ang / rang snang ye shes kyi lam du lugs ldog dang / gzhan snang thugs rje'i ngos nas lugs 'byung gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma gnyis ltar bshad na/ spros bral rig pa'i ye shes chos nyid zad pa'i dgongs pa rang gnas ka dag gi gnas lugs ye ji bzhin pa'i rtogs pa ni chos sku'i ye shes yin la/ de nyid bsgom med ngang gnas kyi bsgoms pas tshad la phebs te rig gdangs ye shes kyi rnam rol lhag par rgyas pa ni/ me long lta bu la sogs pa ye shes bzhi'i ngo bo yin pas longs sku'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'char gzhi yin/ rtogs pa mngon sum gyi ye shes de nyid thugs rje'i rtsal dzoogs te/cir snang ye shes kyi ngang las mi 'da' bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pas 'gro ba 'dul ba ji lta dang ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo sprul sku'i snang ba yin la/ des na bla ma dam pa ni khreg chod kyi lam nas snang bzhi lugs ldog tu rdzogs pa'ang yin la/ gzhan snang thugs rje'i lam du sku gsum lugs 'byung du 'char ba'i dgongs spyod la gnas paXdī yin pas sku gsum dbyer med pa'i ngo

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbo yin no/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing byon pa'i bla ma/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'gro ba'i lam ston du byon pa thams cad kyang gnas skabs gdul bya 'dul tshul dang bstun pa sku'i rnam rol du mar bstan pa yang ngo bo dbyer med pa yin te/ dper na zla ba'i ngo bo gcig nyid tshes kyi dbang gis che chung mi 'dra ba du mar yang yang 'char ba bzhin no/ /zung 'jug gi ye shes kyi klong na khyab bya yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khyab byed rigs kyi bdag po'ang bla ma nyid yin te/ gzhi'i ngos nas kyang rang bzhin dbyer med pa yin la/lam rnal 'byor pas bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i gnas skabs na yang /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ji snyed pa yang bla ma'i rnam rol du shes dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes ni nang dbyings don gyi nam mkha' yin la/ dbyings de'i chos nyid dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis mngon du mdzad pa ni chos nyid kyi mkha' la 'gro ba'i don te/ des na rtsa ba gsum dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid kyang bla ma nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /༈ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang chos tshig bzhi re'i phyir sogs kyi skabs/ sngon gyi tshe bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir rgyal po kan shi ni pa li zhes bya bar gyur pa'i tshe/ bram ze le'u du tsi bya ba la chos nyan 'dod pa na/ bram zes smras pa/gal te chos thob 'dod na/ rgyal po khyod kyi lus la mar me stong btsugs te mchod pa byed nus na bstan no zhes smras so/ /rgyal po dga' nas/ rang gi lus phug tu bcug ste mar me'i snying po snum gyis bskus pa stong byas nas/ rgyal pos bram ze la bdag la chos ston cig /sdu pa dang / bram zes smras pa/ rtag pa

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grolagyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthams cad zad par 'gyur/ /mtho ba de yang mthar lhung ngo / /'du ba yod na bral bar 'ong / skye ba yod na 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa 'di smras so/ /rgyal po de dga' bzhin du phyis mngon par sangs rgyas pa na ye shes kyi 'od kyis gti mug gis mdongs pa rnams shin tu snang bar gyur cig ces dam bcas ma thag tu/'jig rten gyi khams rab tu g.yos/ me tog gi char kyang babs so/ /brgya byin gyis bsngags pa brjod/ rgyal pos bden tshig brjod nas lus snga ma bzhin du sos so/ /yang sngon gyi che bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid bram ze'i khye'u chos 'dod ces bya bar gyur pa na/ bram ze zhig de la phrag dog skyes te khyod me'i dong du mchong nus na bdag gis legs par bshad pa bsgrag par bya'o/ /zhes smras pa la dga' nas me dong sta gon byas te bram ze la chos bsgrags par gsol ba btab pa na/ bram ze des/ sbyin pa la ni rtag tu dga' bar gyis/ /rtag tu tshul khrims yongs su rdzogs par spyod/ /brtson 'grus mchog gi gnas ni brtsam par gyis/ /shes rab kyis ni chos mchog dam pa thob/ /ces smras pa legs par bzungs te/ me dong du mchong bas me shi ste/ padma'i rdzing bur gyur pa'i padma'i steng du 'dug nas tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan gyi chos bstan to/ /'phags pa'i lam 'di ni gzhan mu stegs sags dang ma 'dres pa dang /khams gsum gyi nyan mongs mtha' dag spang bas spang ba yongs su rdzogs pa dang / lam de rnam par dag pa zag med kyi rang bzhin yin pas yongs su dag pa dang / glo bur gyi dri ma bsal nas sems zag med kyi rang bzhin du byed pas yongs su byang ba ste/ de yang tshangs pa ni myang 'das dang / de thob byed kyi lam la tshangasapar spyod pa zhes tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi ldan du 'dod do/ /mchan/ bram ze de ni lus thams cad la me 'bar te sems ca~X 5dmyal ba chen por lhung ba la/ chos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adod kyis smras pa/ slob dpon ma bsnyengs shig /bdag gis khyod bskyab par bya'o zhes smras nas/ bram ze de dmyal ba las thar bar byas so/ /༈ sngon gyi tshe 'dzam gling 'dir rgyal po tshangs pa'i lha zhes pa'i bu rgyal tshab da ma gam zhes bya bar bcom ldan 'das nyid skye ba bzhes te/ des dam pa'i chos phyogs kun tu btsal kyang ma rnyed pas yi mug pa la/ lha dbang brgya byin bram ze zhig tu sprul te rgyal po'i pho brang gi sgor sdod cing chos yod do/ /zhes smras pa dang / des chos ston pa la ci bzhed pa gtong bar khas blangs pa la/me'i dong zabs su khru bcu pa'i nang me mur gyis bkang la de'i nang du mchongs te mchod pa byas na chos bstan to zhes smras pa de bzhin du khas blangs te me dong chen po byas so/ /de nas rgyal bu me dong gi khar 'greng nas bram ze la smras pa/ston pa chen po bdag la sngar dam pa'i chos ston cig /gal te tshe'i dus byas na chos mi thos so/ /zhes gsol ba dang / bram ze des tshig bcad 'di smras so/ /byams pa'i sems ni goms par bya/ /zhe sdang khro ba'i 'du shes spangs/ /snying rje chen pos sems can skyobs/ /kun la snying brtses mchi ma gzags/ /dga' ba chen po goms par bya/ /gzhan la'ang bdag dang mthun pa'i chos/ /byang chub sems kyis bskyab pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par ldan/ /zhes 'di smras ma thag tu me dong du mchongs so/ /me dong de yang me tog gi rdzing bur gyur te rgyal bu de padma'i steng du 'dug pa la lha rnams kyis me tog gi char pus mo nub tsam du phabs so/ /༈ yang sngon 'dzam gling 'dir bo~Xṭwāṃ ldan 'das nyid rgyal po chen po bying

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃling gar li zhes bya bar gyur pas/ dam pa'i chos ston pa btsal ba na/ bram ze le'u du cha zhes bya bas khyod kyi lus la lcags gzer stong gis btab na chos sbyin no zhes smras pa bzhin khas blangs pa dang / bram ze des/ 'du byed thams cad mi rtag ste/ /skye ba thams cad sdug bsngal bcas/ /chos kun stong pas bdag po med/ /bdag gi ba yang yod ma yin/ /zhes smras pa la mgu zhid lus ༵ /rdo/ rto /rde/ra/ stong btab pa'o/ /de nas bden tshig brjod pas lus snga ma ༈drang nges ldem dgongs kyi gsung sna tshogs sogs kyi skabs/ drang nges kyi khyad par ni/chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ston pa nges don/ sems can gang zag dang skyes bu la sogs par ston ba ni drang don/ drang nges kyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba brgyad ni/ji skad du/ lam la 'jug pa drang don dang / /'bras bu la 'jug nges pa'i don//kun rdzob sgrub byed drang don dang / /don dam sgrub byed nges pa'i don/ /las kyi bya ba la 'jug drang / /las dang nyon mongs zad ston nges/ /kun nas nyon mongs bstan pa drang / /rnam byang bstan pa nges pa'i don/ /'khor bar skye byed drang don la/ /'khor 'das gnyis med nges pa'i don/ /tshig 'bru sna tshogs ston pa drang / /zab cing brtags dka' nges pa'i don/ /tshig mang sems can mgu byed drang / /tshig nyung bzung bde nges pa'i don/ /bdag sogs gtsor bshad drang ba'i don/ /bdag med bstan pa nges pa'i don/ /zhes so/ /ldem por dgongs pa zhes phal cher sgra ji bzhin du bzung bya ma yin par rnam pa gzhan du 'khyogs por bsgyur ba'i hūm̐X can bzhi ni/ gzhug pa ldem por

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdagongs pa nyan thos pa bstan pa la rim gyis gzhug pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med kyi gzugs sogs kyi chos yod par gsungs pa ni/ gzugs yod do zhes smos pas/ nyan pa pos don la grub par go nas 'jug la/ 'chad pa pos snang tshod la rmi lam ltar yod pa la dgongs pa bzhin no/ /mtshan nyid ldem por dgongs pa ni/ mtshan nyid gsum la dgongs nas sam/ don dam pa la dgongs nas ngo bo nyid med pa dang gdod nas mya ngan las 'das pa sogs su gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de'ang kun brtags la mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med de don du nges par ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan dbang la skye ba ngo bo nyid med de mu bzhi las skye ba ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /yongs grub la don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /don dam pa yin zhing bdag nyid la ma dag pa la sogs pa spros pa'i ngo bo med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyen por ldem por dgongs pa ni/ gdul bya gang gi rgyud kyi spang bya bsal ba'i phyir brjod pa ste/ ji ltar tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su byon pa'i shākya'i rgyal po ni sku tshad chung zhing sku tshe yang brgyad cu las ma bzhugs pa dang / snod kyi zhing yang ma dag la gdul bya sems can rnams kyang snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs dus bzang bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus su byon pas de dag ni mchog la/ bdag cag gi ston pa ni de las dman no snyam du sangs rgyas la brnyes pa'i gnyen por nga de'i tshe de'i dus na sangs rgyas rnam gzigs su gyur ro zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyan pa pos rnam gzigs kyang ston pa nyid yin no snyam du mchog dman med par 'dzin zhing / 'chad pa pos/ tshogs rdzogs par mnyam/ chos sku thob par mnyam/ 'gro don mdzad 298

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpar mnyam pa gsum la dgongs pa'o/ /mdzod las/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don spyod pa/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang / /rigs dang sku bong tshad kyis min/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /bsgyur ba ldem por dgongs pa ni/ mu stegs sogs kha cig gis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rtogs par sla'o zhes dman par 'dzin pa sogs ldog pa'i ched du brda gzhan du bsgyur bas shin tu rtogs par dka' bar bstan pa rnams te dper na/ snying po med la snying por shes/ /nyon mongs pas ni rab nyon mongs/ /phyin ci log la legs gnas na/ /byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste/'di ci la dgongs pa'i don bshad na/ sems rnam g.yengs snying po yin la de med pa la snying por shes pa/ gtsang bde rtag bdag tu rtog pa bzhi ni dngos po la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa yin la/ de las phyin ci log tu gyur pa ni/ mi rtag sdug bsngal mi gtsang bdag med pa yin la/ de rtogs pa'i sgo nas legs par gnas pa dang / gzhan don dka' spyad yun ring po'i nyon mongs pas ni rab tu nyon mongs par byas pa des byang chub dam pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa lta bu dang / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las kyang / pha dang ma ni bsad bya zhing / /rgyal po gtsang sbra can gnyis dang / /yul 'khor skor bcas bcom pa na/ /mi de dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu sogs de 'dra ba'i rigs thams cad la bsgyur ba ldem/ dgongs zhes bya'o/ /dgongs pa bzhi las/ mnyam pa nyid la dgongs nas ston pa nyid kyis nga de'i tshe sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs su gyur to zhes gsungs pa dang / don gzhan sdu9 dgongs pa chos thams cad ngo bo nyid

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmed do zhes dang gzugs med/ tshor ba med zhes sogs gsungs pa tha snyad tsam du ni ma yin gyi don dam par dgongs pa'o/ /dus gzhan la dgongs pa sangs rgyas gang gi mawo bzung ba tsam gyis de'i zhing du skye bar gsungs pa tshe 'di brjes ma thag tu skye ba'i nges pa med kyang dus nam zhig skye nges pa la dgongs pa'o/ /gang zag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa ni sbyin pa tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa'i bsam pa can la/ snyin pa la dman par brjod cing tshul khrims la bsngags pa lta bu'o/ /de yang don gyis sbyin pa las tshul khrims 'phags pa nyid kyang yin no/ /dgos pa ni rang rang gi don can no/ /dgongs pa brgyad las/ sangs rgyas la mchog dman du bzung nas brnyas pa spang phyir gong du bshad pa ltar nga sangs rgyas rnam gzigs su gyur to zhes pa lta bu dang / 2chos la brnyes te bram ze rnams kyi cho rigs 'byed pa'i bram ze dang rgyal rigs la sogs rigs bzang bas gdol ba sogs kyis sbyang bya yin la sangs rgyas kyi chos ni rigs ngan gdol ba tshun chad kyis spyod du rung bas rnyed sla'o snyam du brnyas pa'i gnyen por/ gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas la bsnyen bkur byas na gzod theg pa chen po'i chos khong du chud par 'gyur zhes tshogs bsags pa de lta bu dang mi ldan na rtogs dka' bar bstan pas chos rnyed sla'o snyam du brnyas pa spong bar byed do/ /3 bdag gis lam la slob mi nus snyam du le lo can gyi ched du bde ba can du smon lam btab na der skye bar 'gyur zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i zla ba'i mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis bla med byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes dang / gzungs gang zhig bklag pa tsam 300

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgyis mtshams med pa lnga'i las sogs dag par gsungs pa ltar le lo can dag kyang / smon lam de lta bu 'debs pa dang / mtshan 'dzin pa dang / gzungs bklag pa'i sgo nas dge rtsa bsags pa'i rgyu des nam zhig ji skad gsungs pa ltar bde ba can du skye ba dang 'tshang rgya ba sogs su nges par 'gyur ba dang / rgyu de tsam la brten nas gong nas gong du brtson par yang 'gyur pa le lo spong bar byed do/ /4 dge rtsa cung zad tsam gyis chog par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por dper na spyin pa kho nas chog 'dzin can la/ tshul khrims bsngags shing sbyin pa de las dman pa'i don gyis smad pa'i rnam par bstan pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i dge ba zag bcas las zag med kyi dge ba khyad par du bsngags pa lta bu dang / 5rigs gzugs 'byor pa sogs kyi nga rgyal can la zhing gzhan dang sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi sku la bsngags pa brjod pas rang la dman par 'du shes par mdzad pa dang / 6 zag bcas kyi yul 'dod yon lnga la 'dod chags pa'i gnyen por/ sangs rgyas kyis zhing yongs su dag pa rnams kyi bde ba'i longs spyod tshad med pa 'di dang 'di lta bu yod ces bsngags pas zag bcas sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'khor ba'i 'dod yon la ngan skyug ltar mthong nas yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa dang / 7 sems can la las yul dam pa la gnod pa sogs sdig pa'i las byas nas/ phyis de dran nas bdag gis shin tu mi rigs pa zhig byas te bdag ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro snyam du 'gyod pas sems dkrugs nas dge ba la tshul bzhin 'jug pa'i gegs su gyur pa la/de'i gnyen por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas na yangaci 301

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmatho ris su 'gro zhes gsungs pas 'gyod pa gtong bar byed do/ /de dag la gnod pa byas na yang mtho ris su skye na phan pa byas na lta ci smos snyam du dad cing dge rtsa rim par 'phel ba byed de/ sangs rgyas byang sems la gnod pa byas pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong ba yod mod kyi/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi smon lam gyi mthus nam zhig mtho ris sogs kyi bde bar 'brel ba la dgongs nas gnyen po'i phyir de skad gsungs pa'o/ /byang sems ma nges pa'i rigs can rnams sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa las/ phyis nyan thos la sogs pa'i bshes gnyen gyis nyan thos kyi theg pa spyod du bcug nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa btang na theg pa chen po las ldog pa nyid 'dod pa'i gnyen por nyan thos rnams kyang mthar sangs rgyas 'thob ces theg pa gcig tu bstan pas nyan thos kyi theg pas mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa rnams kyang theg pa chen po la gzhol bar byed do/ /༈ bod 'dir o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs kyi skabs/bdud mo chen mo bzhi ni/ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gangs kyi yum rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /zhes dang / gnod spyin chen mo bzhi ni/ gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang / /me ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /zhes dang / sman mo chen mo bzhi ni/ kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman //ḍi ma/ /sman btsun skyegs chos rdo rje

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃgayar mo gsil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /zhes gsungs/de dag gi cho rigs ni/ mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi zab gter sogs nas bstan pa ltar bshad na/ pha gnam gyi rdzi skan dang / ma nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo bzhi/ pha gnam gyi glog chen dang / ma dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod snyin mo bzhi/ pha gnam gyi skya 'od dang / ma dkar sham bzhin bzang ma'i bu mo sman mo bzhi/ zhes gsungs/ spyir slob dpon chen po bod yul du ma byon pa'i gong nas grub chen nag po spyod pa sogs las dbang dang gdams ngag nod de rim gnyis kyi lam gyis rgyud yongs su dag zin par mi la'i mgur 'bum sogs kyis shes pas/ phyis su slob dpon rin po cher tho brtsams pa sogs ni gu ru'i che ba 'don pa'i ched tsam mo/ /bye brag slob dpon chen pos/ rgya bal gyi sa mtshams a su ra'i brag phug tu ma mo 'di rnams zhing lpags kyi stan la bkod/lag du rdo rje gtad/ rdo rje bod khams skyong sogs rdo rje'i ming gis dbang bskur nas bsil ljongs 'di'i snod bcud gnyis ka gnyer gtad mdzad pa yin no/ /sman mo'am dkar mo rnams shwa na ma/ bdud mo'am nag mo bzhi bdag nyid ma/ gnod sbyin mo'am dmar mo bzhi bse mo ste phur srung bcu gnyis kyang 'di dag go/ /zhes gsungs/ brtan ma zer ba'i sgra bshad la/ brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten skyong ma zhes pa ra brtan gyi steng nas dang / bod du mu stegs mi gtong bar rgyal bstan srung ba mo zhes sa bstan gyi bshad tshul sogs 'di dag blo gsal dga' ba'i rol mo las gsungs pa'o/ /༈ bod gangs can gyi yul sogs kyi skabs/ kong jos spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi 303

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsteng nas brtsis pas/ kha ba can gyi yul 'di srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba lta bur 'dug pa las/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag /dmar lcags kyi ri 'di snying gi rus pa'i rnam par 'dug na'ang / mtsho'i steng du shākya mu nee bzhugs pa dang / ri'i rtser rgyal po'i pho brang yod pas non cing / de dag gi mtha' skor na sa dpyad skyon yon gnyis las/ yon tan ni/ shar na mchod sdong btsugs pa 'dra ba lho na rin po che'i mchod rten 'dra ba/ nub na mazhi'i steng na dung phor bzhag pa 'dra ba/ byang na padma kha phye ba 'dra ba ste/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i ri bzhi/ de'i nang bskor du nyang bran 'phan dkar gyi ri la gdugs/ mal grong gi ri la nya/ mdongs mkhar gyi brag la padma/ grib kyi 'khyags rum la dung /rdzong btsan gyi ri la bum pa/ yug pa'i ri la dpal bersā 'phan dkar gyi ri la rgyal mtshan/ brang phu'i brag la 'khor lo ste bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad/lcags kha ri/ shug pa gdong / ra kha grag /jo mo ze rnams la gser dngul zangs lcags kyi gter kha/ shar kyi stag dga' gdong 'og ma/ lho'i g.yu 'brug gtsang chab/ nub kyi bya rti bu gdong / byang gi rus sbal pha bong kha/ mdor na gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dang / sa la padma 'dab brgyad de gtsug lag khang rtsigs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yod la/ 'on kyang skyon ni/shar bye ma'i ri la srin mo 'doms bzed pa lta bu/ lto na sdig pa gzan la rub pa 'dra ba/ nub shun gyi brag la bdud bya ra byed pa lta bu/ byang nyang dogs kyi bar na glang po che g.yul du zhugs pa lta bu'i ri/ shar lho'i mtshams na btsan gyi rgyu sa/ lho nub mtshams na 'dre'i 'du sdoṭwāṃ / byang na ma mo'i nyal sa/ gzhan yang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃskum pa ri la chu srin dre'u khrid pa 'dra ba/ gnam sgo bye ba gnam ral gri 'dra ba/sa sgo bye ba phag pa'i sna 'dra ba sogs sa dpyad ngan pa rnams gnon par byed pa'i thabs su/ thog mar rgyal po yab yum gsum gyis skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar sgrub pa mdzad nas/ sgrub pa'i rtags thon pa dang / srin mo'i yan lag dang srin lag gnon par byed pa la/ mtha' 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi ni/ g.yo ru khra 'brug /g.yas ru gtsang 'gram/ dbus ru ka tshal/ ru lag gram pa rgyang gi lha khang ngo / /yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi ni/ kong po bu chu/ lho brag mkhon mthing / byams sprin dge rgyas/ byang pra dum rtse'o/ /ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ khams klong thang sgrol ma/ spa gro skye chu/ tshal rigs shes rab sgrol/tshangs pa rlung gnon no/ /sngar bshad pa'i nye skor gyi sa'i dgra ngan pa rnams la mchod rten/rdo'i seng ge/ dbang phyug gi rten/ bya khyung / dung dkar sogs kyis bcos/ de rjes mtsho bsub pa'i steng du gtsug lag khang brtsigs te ston pa dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad shākya mu nee ste rgya bal gyi lha rnams bzhugs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing / phyis dbon sras rnams kyi ring la'ang dge 'dun gyi sde dang mdo rgyud kyi bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas su 'byung bar 'dug gsungs/ ༈ pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi rtser za ma tog gcig bab pa kha phye bas spang skong phyag brgya pa/rdoktoo / // rnakāshādzño nga sngio ba/sko/sa phor/ mdo sde za ma tog yi ge drug pa gser gyi ༈ sad mi bdun ni/ de'ang chos rdisdu5 khri srong gis 'phags yul nas yod
