g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsmra'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs shing mkhan chen bho dhi sa twas mkhan po dang/dā na shī la dang dzi na mi tra gnyis kyis las slob dang gsang ston gzhan bcu pos kha skong mdzad nas rba khri gzigs rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs te mtshan dpal dbyangs dang / de nas rim par rma rgyal snang / ba gor bee ro/ ngan lam spra rnyi dro //rdo /ma kābyo~Xs/ // rma rin chen mchog /'bon klu dbang / la gsum rgyal ༈ da resasangasporgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la sogs kyi skabs/ bstan rtsis rab gsal me long las/ de yang mi mchog sangs rgyas nas/ /zhe drug bar du theg gsum chos/ /bstan rgyas lcags 'brug nag pa'i nyar/ /dpal ldan 'bras spung mchod rten du/ /chos rgyal zla bzang 'khor bcas la/ /rtsa rgyud 'da' kha zhal chems tshul/ /bstan rjes phyi zlar zhi dbyings mnal/ /lo de 'das lo'i thog mar bzung / /des na rab tshes sa bya yan/ /nyis stong bdun brgya dgu bcu 'das/ /de phyir 'bras dus gsum rdzogs nas/ /da lta sgrub pa'i dus gsum las/ /phyi ma tshul khrims le'u yi/ /nyis brgya dgu bcu 'das mtshams yin//ma 'ongs lcags khyi'i lo 'di nas/ /gong lhag nyis brgya bcu dang ni/ /lung gi lnga brgya phrag gsum bcas/ /bstan pa rnal ma chig stong dang / /bdun brgya bcu gnas de yi steng / /rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya 'o/ /de yang da lta'i lcags khyi nas/ /bzhi brgya bcu bdun rdzogs pa'i mtshams/ /rig ldan drag po seng khrir phebs/ /go brgyad kla klo 'dul du byon/ /des na rab tshes lcags khyi nas/ /lnga brgya bcu bzhi 'das pa'i mtshams/ /༷di byung nyer bzhi'i nang tshan gyi/ /shing

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsprel lo la drag po'i dpung / /'byung nges 'jam mgon bla mas bzhed/ /zhes gsungs/ 'phags pa byams pa byon par lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ phyir mi 'ong ba dang / phyir 'ong ba dang / rgyun du zhugs pa rnams thob pa yod kyi bar ni 'bras bu thob pa rnams nub par ma gyur pa yin/ zhes dang / tshul khrims kyi rtsa ba bzhi tsam bsrung ba'i dge slong stong phrag gcig gam/ brgya phrag gcig tsam yod kyi bar ni/ sgrub pa la gnas pa ma nub par gyur pa yin/ zhes dang / ji srid rkang pa bzhi pa'i dzigs su bcad pa gcig 'chad pa/'i mi yod kyi bar ni/lung gi chos nub par ma gyur pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos 'byung nyi 'od las/ bal po me ru tse zhes bya ba rgya skad la mkhas pa zhig byung nas de la bon rnams kyis chos zhus pas/ bal po phar log nas paṇḍi ta phra la ring mo dang / jo bo smi ti gnyis gdan drangs nas 'ong te 'gyur bya bar brtsam pa la/ lo tsā ba bal por pho log gis shi/ paṇḍi ta gnyis pos bod skad mi shes pas dbus gtsang na mar so sor 'khyams te/ smi tis rta nag tu lug rdzi mdzad/ phyis dpyal lo tsā ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sman lung du spyan drangs nas chos zhus/ khams su byon nas 'dan glang thang du mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad pa btsugs/ phyis bod skad la mkhas par gyur te/ gdan bzhi dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ sgeg rdor gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa/ sgrub thabs gsang ldan gyi skor dang / sngags don rnam gzigs la sogs pa rang 'gyur mang po mdzad/ phyis ling chu gser khab tu byon te/ smra sgo mtshon cha brtsams/ de dag rgya cher 'phel bar ma nus so/ /paṇḍi ta shaṃ 0༷ ring mos rong pa chos bzang la grong

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrsharshasngi ༵/sa pas/ rong pas chos mang po rdo'/ shes su byung ba yin no/ /zhes ༈ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la bas ma te mi rtag pa bsgom pa'i skabs/ snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags pa yin te/ da lta'i 'jig rten chags pa'i mgo rtsom pa 'a /bskal pa 'di'i sems can rnams kyi spyi mthun gyi bsod nam/sa kyis/ 'og gzhi yid mkha' rnam dag gi nam mkha' chos 'byung gi dbyibs can kha dog mthing gsal gyi mu khyud can zhig chags/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor shar rlung nub la 'thab/ nub rlung shar du 'thab/ lho rlung byang du 'thab/ byang rlung nub tu 'thab pa rgya gram gyi rnam pa zhes/ kha dog ljang nag gi mu khyud can/ de'i steng du sprin chu'i gser gyi snying po can las char bab pas chu 'i dkyil dkar gsal zlum po kha dog dkar gsal gyi mu khyud can/ de'i steng du khams rab 'byed pa'i rlung gis ri rab/ 'bring 'byed pa'i rlung gis gser ri/ tha ma 'byed pa'i rlung gis gling bzhi rdo sol can gyi lcags ri dang bcas pa chags/bcud kyi sems can rnams yas nas mar chags te srid rtse nas bzung ste dmyal ba'i bar du rtog pa je rags je rags su song ste rim gyis dmyal ba'i sems can gcig dang po skyes pa'i bar du bar bskal nyi shu/ de nas gnas pa'i mgo brtsams nas skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo dang ga tu med pa thub pa nas bcu pa'i bar du 'grib pa ya thog ring mo/ de nas 'phel te tshe lo brgyad khri 'phel/yang 'grib ste bcu pa'i bar du khug pa gcig /de ltar 'phel 'grib bco brgyad rdzogs nas yar 'phel tshe lo dpag med du 'phel/ de nas sacig 'grib pa 308

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃdang mos pa byon nas brgya khrir thug pa ste ma thog thung ngu ste bar skal nyi shu/brgyad khri nas 'jig pa'i mgo brtsam te zhing 'di'i dmyal ba'i gnas su sems can gcig kyang gsar du mi skye ba yin no/ /'jig pa'i go rim ni/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ las zad rnams ni mtho ris skye 'gyur zhing / /dmyal myong las ma zad rnams gzhan dag gi/ /dmyal ba rnams su 'pho bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de bzhin yi dwags dud 'gro rnams mtshungs te/ /ngan song gsum na sems can med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas mi yi 'jig rten gling bzhi 'jig pa'i tshul ni/ de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi gcig gis dben pa la song nas bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sems rnyed nas kye ma dben pa las byung ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba dang zhi ba ni 'di yin no zhes smras pa'i sgra des skad cig yud tsam la 'dzam bu'i gling du tshegs med par khyab bo/ /sgra de thos ma thag tu gzhan dag gis kyang de'i rjes su bslabs pas bsam gtan gnyis pa'i sem sa thob nas 'od gsal kyi lhar skyes so/ /de'i tshe shar gyi lus 'phags gling gi mi rnams kyang 'dzam bu'i gling pa lta ra 'gyur ro/ /de nas nub kyi ba glang spyod kyang 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams ni sum cu rtsa gsum/ gyi lhar skye ba yin te 'dod pa rnams la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /gling gsum ni 'dod pa la rang bzhin gyis skyo bas gong mar skyes so/ /gling phran rnams ni gtso bo'i gling dang 'dra'o/ /de nas 'dod lha rigs drug 'jig pa'i tshul yang / rgyal chen ris bzhi nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bar du lha gcig gis bsam gtan thob pa'i tshul bsgrags pa thos pa las rkyen byas te bsgoms pa las/ snga ma 309

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃltar bsam gtan gnyis pa thob nas 'od gsal gyi lhar skyes so/ /de nas gzugs kyi khams 'jig pa'i tshul yang / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten der sems can gang yang rung bas rang gi chos nyid kyis thob pa'i bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par zhugs nas/ rjes la sngar ltar tshig tu brjod pas kun gyis de ltar bslabs te shi 'phos nas 'od gsal gyi lhar skyes so/ /de nas snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa ni/ thog mar bsam gtan dang po man chad mes bsregs/de nas bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad chus sbyangs/ de nas bsam gtan gsum pa man chad rlung gis gtor ba'o/ /de'ang 'jig pa'i mgo brtsam nas zhig par gyur pa'i bar du bar bskal nyi shu/ stong pa'i bskal pa ni/ yid bzhin mdzod las/ zhig nas stongs te nam mkha' gcig gi ngang / /bar bskal nyi shu'i yun dang mnyam pa'o/ /de yang me bdun pas/ 'thab bral gyi gzhal med khang bsreg go/ /de las me lce chad nas dga' lda na dang / 'phrul dga' nas tshangs pa chen po'i gnas man chad bsreg go/ /de'i me lce rlung gis khyer ba 'od chung gi lha'i 'og nas yar byung ba la/ lha phru gu rnams dngangs par gyur to/ /dang por mes lan bdun 'jig ces pa nyi ma bdun rim bzhin shar bas tshangs gnas man chad bsreg pa la bzhed cing / de'i rjes la mkha' las char gyi rgyun thengs bdun du babs pas bsam gtan gnyis pa'i thog ma man chad 'jig la/ sngar bsreg pa'i thal ba chu dang 'dres par gnas so/ /de yi rjes thog tu rlung drag po lan gcig ldang bas bsam gtan gsum pa man chad dang sngar gyi skyo ma de dag kyang phyogs ༵ḍir 'thor te ci yang mi snang bar byed

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdo/ /de ltar na 'jig thengs gcig la me chu rlung gsum ka 'byung zhing bsam gtan gsum pa man chad 'jig pa'i lugs yin pas mdzod kyi lugs sogs dang gtan mi 'dra'o/ /sa sde dang mngon pa ltar na mes 'jig pa na du ba yang med thal ba'ang med par bsregs nas bsam gtan dang po man chad zhig nas slar yang sngar bzhin chags te/ yang mes 'jig pa sogs me 'jig lan bdun byung ba'i rjes bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad chus 'jig /yang chags nas mes 'jig bdun gyi rjes chu 'jig gcig sogs de 'dra'i tshul du chu bdun thal ba na/ yang chags nas mes lan bdun 'jig cing de nas slar chags pa'i 'jig rten de rlung gis bsam gtan gsum pa man chad 'jig pas na/bsdoms pas mes 'jig pa nga drug /chus 'jig bdun/ rlung 'jig gcig ste/'jig thengs drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad do/ /'o na 'di rang gi dge rgyas pa'i tshe tshad bar bskal drug cu rtsa bzhi de rdzogs mi nus te/ snod ma chags par bskal pa gcig dang / snod 'jig pa'i bskal pa gcig gis kyang phri ba'i lhag par bskal pa brgyad las mi 'byung ba'i phyir zhe na/ spyir cung ma rdzogs kyang mi skyon te/ mngon pa ltar na'ang / tshangs chen gyi tshe tshad las bskal pa gnyis chad cing /'od gsal dang dge rgyas pa'i tshe tshad las bar bskal gnyis re chad kyang de dang nye ba'i sgo nas bzhag pas mi 'gal zhes 'dod pa bzhin yin la/ 'di'i bar khug dang ya thog ma thog yun mi mnyam pas gnas ris rnams kyi tshe tshad de bar khug gis bzhag na ni shin tu rdzogs kyang zhib par gzhung 'dir gsal kha med pas da rung brtag par bya'o/ /rdzurdog dang mi 'jig pa'i sgrub byed ni/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbasam gtan dang po man chad na rtog pa dang dpyod pa ste/ sems dang sems byung gi tshor ba me dang 'dra ba yod pas/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi 'byung ba mes 'jig la/ gnyis pa na bsam gtan gyi dga' bde bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lta bu yod pas chus 'jig pa dang / gsum pa na dbugs 'byung rngub g.yo 'gul rlung lta bu yod pas rlungari gis 'jig pa yin no/ /de yang 'dod pa'i rags rlung ltar med de/ /lus rags pa rtsa 'dab can med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bsam gtan rang bzhin gyis dwangs pa'ang de nyid do/ /'on kyang rnam smin skyes 'byung ba'i rdul phran dwangs pa las thob pa'i cha yod pas de dang mtshungs pa'i dbugs rgyu ba yin no/ /'di'i chos mtshungs par rnal 'byor pa dag la 'byung ba'i dgra gnod pa dang / mi gnod pa yang bsam gtan 'di dag grub pa dang ma grub pa las gyur pa yin no/ /mi rnams tshe lo dpag med nas mar brgyad khri'i bar 'grib pa ni chags par gtogs la/ brgyad khri nas mar 'grib ste tshe lo bcu pa'i bar ni bar bskal dang po yin/ de nas yar brgyad khri'i bar skye ba dang mar bcu pa'i bar 'grib pa ni yar skyes mar 'grib zung re gcig tu bgrangs pas bar bskal bco brgyad/ yang tshe lo bcu pa nas yar brgyad khri'i bar skye ba ni bar bskal gcig ste nyi shu'o/ /thog mtha'i rkyang ba rnams dal gyis 'gro bas bul ba dang / bar gyi khug pa rnams myur bar 'gro ba'i phyir mgyogs pa ste/de'i mgyogs bul ni chos nyid kyi rigs pa yin no/ /tshe mtha'i mdo las/gzugs khams tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad ni bskal pa phyed do/ /tshangs pa mdun na 'don gyi lha rnamarwa 1sngi ni bskal pa'i bzhi cha gsum thub

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ yobo/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyi ni bskal pa gcig thub bo/ /'od chung gi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa gnyis so/ /tshad med 'od kyi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa bzhi'o/ /'od gsal gyi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa brgyad do/ /dge chung gi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa bcu drug go/ /tshad med dge'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /sprin med kyi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /bsod nams skyes pa'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa nyis brgya dang lnga bcu'o/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa lnga brgya'o/ /'du shes med pa'i sems can dang mi che ba'i lha rnams/ kyis ni bskal pa stong ngo / /mi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa nyis stong ngo / /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa bzhi stong ngo / /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa brgyad stong ngo / /'og min gyi lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa khri drug stong thub bo/ /gzugs med pa bzhi'i nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal pa nyi khri'o/ /rnam shes mtha' yas kyi skye mched pa rnams kyis ni bskal pa bzhi khri'o/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched pa rnams ni bskal pa drug khri'o/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min kyi skye mched du nye bar 'gro ba'i lha rnams kyis ni bskal chen brgyad khri thub bo/ /zhes gsungs/༈ ga༈ yang pā la rnam gsum tsan dra so bdun sogs kyi skabs/ tsand+ra nyi shu ni/ rgyal po ha ri tsand+ra ni 'khor bcas 'ja' lus gyur/ de'i tsha bo lakṣa tsand+ra dang / de'i bu dza ya tsand+ra/ de'i bu ni ma tsand+ra/ de'i ༵ pha ṇi tsand+ra/ de'i bu rghaṃ pa tsandha/ de'i bu

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃswā la tsand+ra/ de nas tsand+ra gusta/ de'i bu snying po thig le/ de'i nu bo'i bu shrī tsand+ra/de'i bu dharmā tsand+ra/ de'i tsha bo kame tsand+ra/ de'i bu bṛkṣa tsand+ra/ de'i bu brgyud la bi ga ma tsand+ra/ de'i bu kā ma tsand+ra/ de nas sidha tsand+ra/ de'i bu su la tsand+ra/ de'i bu bi ma la tsand+ra/ de'i bu go bi tsand+ra/ de'i pha tshan gyi spun zlar gyur pa ni la li ta tsand+ra ste tsand+ra nyi shu/ snying po thig le mi bgrang na/ tsand+ra bcu dgu ste/ de dag rnams kyi nang nas/ dbang po akṣu po zla ba dang / rgyal ba'i dza ya zla ba dang / choos kyi dharma zla ba dang / las karma zla ba dang / 'du bral bi ga ma zla ba dang / 'dad pa'i kā ma zla ba dang / dri med bi ma la zla ba ste/ tsand+ra bdun du grags pa yin no/ /de'i steng du zla ba tsand+ra gupta sbas pa dang / phyogs sgrol go bi zla ba dang / rol pa'i la li ta zla ba ste/ tsand+ra bcu zhes rab tu grags pa yin no/ /pā la'i rigs las byung ba ni/ go sa la'i rgyal rigs kyi bu mo zhig dang shing gi lha zhig 'dus pa las zhakhrungs/ sku tshe'i stod la rghaṃ ga la la dbang bsgyur/ smad la ma ga dha yang dbang du bsdus so/ /de nas brgyud pa rgyal po de wa pā la ni rgyal po go pā la 'das pa na de nyid rgyal srid du bskos/ de'i sras rā pa pā la rgyal srid du bskos/de'i sras dharma pā la rgyal srid du bskos te chab srid shin tu che ba'o/ /de'i sras ba na pā la rgyal srid du bskos/ de'i sras ma hi pā las rgyal srid lo lnga bcu nga gnyis mdzad nas 'das pa tsam na/ bod na khri ral yang sku 'das pa tsam gyi dus yin no/ /de'i sras gyal po ma hā pā las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher byas so/ /de'i sras breṣṭi pā la rgyal srid du bskos te lo gsum nas 314

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adas/ ma hā pā la'i bu chung ba bhe ya pā la rgyal srid du bskos/ de'i sras nee ya pā la rgyal srid la 'khod 'phral rdzo bo rje bod du byon pa'i dus so/ /de'i bu a mra pā las rgyal srid bskyangs/ de'i bu hāsdo pā la rgyal srid du bskos/ de'i bu rā ma pā la rgyal srid du bskos pa blo gros shin tu che zhing mnga' thang lhag par rgyas pa zhig go/ /de'i bu yakṣa pā la rgyal srid du bskos/ pā la'i rigs la bcu bzhi'o//de phyin chad pā la'i rigs kyi rgyal rigs phal pa mang du byung zhing / da ltar yang yod mod rgyal srid zin pa ni ma byung ngo / /rgyal dbang lnga pas/ mang pos bkur ba'i brgyud las byung ba'i rgyal po dmag brgya pa zhes bya ba las sras 'phags pas byin rlabs kyi byed pos mi/ las 'das pa zhig bltams te/ mig mas 'gribs su yod pa/ g.yu'i smin ma can/ so dung so zhabor mar yod pa/ lag pa 'khor lo'i yan lag can lta bur yod pa'i mtshan ldan zhig byung ba/ yab kyis lha 'dre'i sprul par dgongs nas spyugs pas/ pad dkar 'dzin pa'i ye shes mchog gi 'od zer gyis snang ba bsgrur nas/ lha ri gyang tho'i rtse la byon nas gzigs pas/ yar klung gi yul ni mtho ris kyi yon tan sa la 'phos pa ltar bzang zhing / yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di lhun po'i mdzes sdug la chags pa'i chu shel gyi dbang po nya gang bas 'khyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha ri rol po'i rtsa la gshegs nas lha skas la babs te/ btsan thang sgo bzhir zhabs zung gi 'khor lo bskyod pas bon po sogs yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis phyugs skyong bas mthong ste gang nas 'ong zhes gtam dris par/ mkha' la mdzub mo ker bas lha las chad par go nas bod khams rdo5 rjer 'os so zhes gnya' bar khri byas

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbateg nas 'ong bas rje gnya' khri btsan por grags la/ rje 'dis pho brang yum bu bla sgang brtsigs/ de'ang gnam mug mug gi sras mu khri btsan po/ de dang sa ding ding gi sras ding khri btsan po/ de dang so tham thams kyi sras so khri btsan po/de dang dog mer mer gyi sras mer khri btsan po/ de dang gdags kyi lha mo dkar mo'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de dang srib kyi lha mo'i sras srib khri btsan po/'di rnams rmu thag la byas nas mkha' la yal bas bang so med par grags shing /gnam gyi khri bdun no/ /srib khri btsan po dang / sa btsun rlung rje'i sras gri gum btsan po/ de dang klu btsan mer lcam gyi sras bya khri'am spu de gung rgyal zer/rgyal po de gnyis bar gyi steng gnyis yin/ bang so g.ya' dang rdza la btab bo/ /spu de gong rgyal dang bom thang rmang mnya'i sras e sho legs/ de dang rmu lcam bra ma na'i sras de sho legs/ de dang klu sman mer mo'i sras thi sho legs/ de dang btsan mo gur sman gyi sras gu ru legs/ de dang mtsho sman 'brang ma'i sras 'brong zhi legs/ de dang sman bu mo'i sras i sho legs/ de rnams sa'i legs drug ste bang so g.ya' spang mtshams su btab bo/ /i sho legs dang rmu ñtsa ma sman legs kyi sras za nam zin lde/ de dang mtsho sman khrid dkar gyi sras lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ de dang se snyan mang ma'i sras se snol gnam lde/ de dang klu mo mer ma'i sras se rnol po lde/ de dang 'o ma ste mo mtsho'i sras lde snol nam/ de dang khri sman rje ma'i sras lde rnol po/ de dang se btsun gnyan rje'i sras lde rgya'/ po/ de dang sman btsun lug sgong gi sras lde sprin btsan/ de dag lde brgyad de bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btasdu 6bo/ /lde sprin btsan dang nyi btsun mang

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃm rje'i sras/ rgyal to ri long btsan/ 'di yan chad kyis lha klu'i bu mo btsun mor bsten pas yum rnams grongs pa'i tshe pur ma byung 'di man nas 'bangs dang gnyen bsres te/ rgyal to ri long btsan dang 'o ma lde bza' 'bri btsun byang ma'i sras su khri btsan nam/ de dang sman bza' khri dkar gyi sras la khri sgra dpung btsan/ de dang sman bza' klu steng gi sras khri thog rje btsan te gdung rabs nyer bdun no/ /khri rje thog btsan dang / ru yong bza' stong rgyal na mo tshe'i sras su lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan zhabrungs/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes te/ tshig la ba' lnga ni/chos 'byung nyi 'odalas/tho tho long ba'/khri ba' nam/khri gung btsan/khrithog rje/khri thog btsan dang lngar gsungs/pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi yang thog gi steng du spang skong phyag brgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa/ tsiddha ma ṇi'i skos phor rnams mkha' las babs so/ /nam mkha'i sgra las gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ba'i lung bstan/mtshan gnyan po gsang ba btags/ rgyal pos mchod de gzhon par gyur nas lo brgya nyi shur bzhugs so/ /de rnams la btsan lngar grags so/ /de dang rno za mang po rje'i sras khri gnyan gzung btsan/ de dang 'brong bza' mo dur yangs gzher la sras 'gro gnyan ldelnga de dang btsun mo mchims bza' klu rgyal ngan bu mtsho'i sras dmus long dkon pa bkra'am stag ri gnyan gzigs rje de dang 'ol gong bza' stong btsun 'gro dkar gyi sras gnam ri srong btsan/ gnam ri phrong btsan dang yum tshe spong bza' 'bi ma thod dkar gyi sras su srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs dbu'i 'od dpag med dar leb brgan gyis dkris/ lo bcu gsum pa 317

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃl rgyal sar zhabod rgya bza' dang bal bza' gnyis la sras ma byung / de dang mon bza' khri lcam bya ba la sras gung ri gung btsan zhabrungs/ de dang 'a zha bza' kho 'jo mo rje khri dkar ri shags la sras mang srong mang btsan 'khrungs/de dang 'gro bza' khra bo khri ma long la sras 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhabrungs/ de dang mchims bza' btsan mo rtog ge'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshoms can zhakhrungs/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lnga'i rtse mo la gser gyi khye'u chung tshon gang ba zhig sprul nas yum gyi lhums su zhugs te bstan pa rin po che la 'di nas cung zad chad dam snyam/ zhugs/ mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan ral pa can gyis dbu skra la dar yug btags pa'i steng la rab tu byung ba rnams bzhugs su 'jug pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba rgya chen byas so/ /glang dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung kyang / sbas stag snas nang blon byas te chos gra chen po sum cu so bdun dus gcig la bshig pa sogs chos bsnub pa'o/ /gzhan las/ sad na legs mjing yon gyi sras ldeng khri/ de la btsun mo gnyis yod pa'i chen ma la sras gsum 'khrungs/ che ba gtsang rme / chung ba dar ma/ bar ba ral pa can/ chung ba la sras lha rje lhun grub gnyis te lnga 'khrungs bar bshad do/ /btsad po 'am glang dar ma'i btsun mo chung ba la sdos shig zhabrungs pa shin tu gces pas mtshan mo mar me'i 'od kyis bsrungs pas gnam lde 'od bsrung du grags/ yum gyi bka' brtan pas khri lde yum brtan du ming chags/ de'i sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/ de 3༵ sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdang / khri skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis zhabrungs/ nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris su byon te chab srid bzung / sras gsum byung ba'i che ba dpal lde rig pa mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar ba bkra shis lde mgon gyis spu rangs bzung / chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / lde gtsug mgon la sras kho re dang /krong nge gnyis byung ba'i/ gcen gyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes 'od du grags/ kho re'i sras lha lde/ lha lde la sras 'od lde/ zhi ba 'od/ byang chub 'od dang gsum zhabrungs/ chung ba dge slong byang chub 'od bya ba'o/ /'od lde'i sras rtse lde/ rtse lde'i sras 'bar lde/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i sras bha nee/ de'i sras nā ga de wa/ de'i sras btsan phyug lde/ de'i sras bkra shis lde/ de'i sras grags btsan lde/ de'i sras grags pa lde la sogs pa byon pa'o/ /jo bo'i rnam thar las bkra shis mgon la sras gnyis/ mnga' bdag kho re dang stong sde'o/ /kho re las sras de ba rā dza dang / nā ga rā dza gnyis/ stong lde'i sras lha lde'o/ /jo bo'i /༵ /༵/ las/ dpal gyi mgon zhang zhung dang / lde gtsug mgon mang yul ༈'jig rten gdags par/ rgyal po 'bum phrag brgyad sum khri bzhi stong lnga brgya sum cu rtsa bzhi yod par bshad/ 'dul ba las/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po nas bcom ldan 'das kyi sras sgra gcan 'dzin gyi bar la/ rgyal rab sa ya gcig dang 'bum khri lnga brgya byung bar gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong song ba na/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa chos rgyal ṭwāṃṭwāṃ po rnams rim kyis byon tshul yang rgya

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgar gyi rgyal po dmag brgya pa la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sprul pa'i sras gcig 'khrungs pa de/ rkang lag thams cad ngang pa bzhin 'brel pa/ spyan bya yi mig ltar yas 'gebs pa/ g.yu'i smin ma can/ so dung so 'khor mar yod pa/ de lta bu zhig 'dug nas yab kyis 'di mi ma yin gyi bu zhig yin 'dug pas sprugs btang pa grags zer nas sras cung zad nar son pa na sprugs btang bas las dbang gis rkang 'khyar te bod yul du phebs/ phyugs rdzi 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad de/ gang nas 'ong su yin dris pas gnam la mdzub mo bsgrengs pas/ gnam gyi lha yin snyam nas thams cad kyis gnya' bar sa do khur nas khri brtsigs te dpon du mnga' gsol ba de rgya' po la snga ba gnya' khri btsan po zhes grags so/ /de'i sras mi khri btsan po/ de'i sras ding khri btsan ngo//de'i sras so khri btsan po/ de'i sras mi khri btsan po/ de'i sras gdags khri btsan po/ de'i sras srib khri btsan po ste 'di rnams 'a/ gnam gyi khri bdun zer/srib khri btsan po'i sras/ gri gum btsan po/ de'i sras bya khri'am spu de gung rgyal zer/ 'di gnyis la stod kyi steng gnyis zer ba'o/ /spu de gung rgyal gyi sras/a sho legs/ de'i sras de sho legs/ de'i sras thi sho legs/ de'i sras gu ru legs/ de'i sras 'brong zhor legs/ de'i sras i sho legs ste de rnam/sa la bar gyi legs drug zer/ i sho legs kyi sras/ za nam zin sde/ de'i sras lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ de'i sras se bsdo' nam sde/ de'i sras se bsno la po sde/ de'i sras lde bsnol nam/ de'i sras sde bsnol po/ de'i sras sde rgyal po/de'i sras lde sprin btsan te 'di ni sa tram̐2 tī brgyad zer/ sde sprin btsan gyi sras/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃkhri btsan nam/ de'i sras khri dgra dpung btsan/ de'i sras khri lde thog btsan/'di gsum la 'og gi btsan gsum zer/ khri lde thog btsan gyi sras/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi ring la pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi steng du/ nam mkha' nas sku'i rten tsinta ma ṇi'i sku dang / gsung gi rten ma/do sde za ma tog bkod pa dang / spang skong phyag brgya pa rnams dang / thugs kyi rten shel gyi mchod rten khru gang ba rnams nyi ma'i 'od zer dang 'grogs nas byung ste/ dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'o/ /lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sras/ khri snyan gzugs btsan/ de'i sras 'brong snyan lde mā de'i sras dmus long dkon pa bkra shis/ gnyan po gsang ba mchod/ sman pa bos nas mig phye bas/ skye shod stag gi ri la gnyan 'gro ba gzigs pas na/ mtshan yang stag ri gnyan gzigs zhes kyang grags so/ /de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ gnam ri srong btsan la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sras zhig 'khrungs/ sras de'i dbu la sangs rgyas a mi de ba bzhugs pa/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan pa/ dbu skra ma thong mthing du yod cing / de nyid nar son pa na blon po rnams kyis sras 'di ni thugs shin tu sgam mo zer bas/ mtshan la'ang srong btsan sgam po zhes grags so/ /chos rgyal 'di nyid kyis jo mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal bza' khri btsan dang / rje btsun sgrol pa'i sprul pa rgya za gong 'jo gnyis khab tu bsus pa'i rdzongs su/ ston pa dgung lo brgyad kyi sku tshad jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad jo bo shākya mu ne gnyis spyan drangs pa la sogs pa rgya' po 'di'i ring la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srol btod/321

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃde'i sras gung srong gung btsun/ de'i sras mang srong mang btsan/ de'i sras 'dur srong mang po btsan/ de'i sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom du grags pa'o//de'i sras 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan 'khrungs te/ dgong lo bco brgyad nas dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa lo lnga'i khong du gegs med par bzhengs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'o/ /chos rgyal de la sras gsum 'khrungs pa ni/ che ba mu ne btsan po/ 'bring ba mu rum btsan po/ chung ba mjing yon sad na legs so/ /mjing yon la/ u rgyan chen pos mtshan btags pa mu tig bcan po dang / yab kyis mtshan btags pa khri lde srong btsan dang / gung blon gyis mtshan btags pa mjing yon sad na legs dang / rgya yis mtshan btags pa mu ri btsan po'o/ /de'i sras ldeng khri ldeng khri'i btsun mo chen ma la sras gsum 'brungs/ sras che ba gtsang ma ni chos la dga' ste rab tu byung / chung ba dar ma ni sdig la dga' ste rje'i 'os min/bar pa gsang bdag gi sprul pa ral pa can la rgyal srid gtad do/ /sdig can rgyal po'i btsun mo chung ba la gdung rgyud yin nges kyi sras mnga' bdag 'od srung /de'i sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i chen ma'i sras skyid sde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/ chun ma'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa'o/ /skyid sde nyi ma mgon la sras gsum/ che ba dpal gyi ma gon/ bar ba bkra shis mgon/chung ba sde btsun mgon ste 'di gsum la stod na bzhugs pa'i mgon gsum zer/sde btsun mgon la sras gnyis te/ ོ༷ 2ṭwāṃ dang krong nge gnyis/ krong nges sku tshe

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsmad la rab tu byung nas/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab la sogs pa blo rno ba nyer gcig chos slob du rgya gar du btang ba las/ rin bzang po dang / legs pa'i shes rab ma gtogs gzhan rnams grongs so/ /'khor res kyi sras lha sde'o/ /lha sde la sras gsum/ che ba la zhi ba 'od/ 'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba 'od sde'o/ /lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi zhal chems ltar rgya gar gyi rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras jo bo rje bod du gdan drangs/ chun ma'i sras bkra shis brtsegs pa la sras gsum/ che ba dpa la sde/ 'bring ba 'od sde/ chung ba skyid sde/'di gsum la smad du bzhugs pa'i sde gsum zer/༈ sngon nyi 'og gi rgyal khab sogs kyi skabs/ 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed las/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal ka lan da ka'i gnas na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe na 'dzam bu'i gling na grong khyer rgyal po'i khab dang sgra sgrogs zhes bya ba gnyis yod de/ grong khyer sgra sgrogs na rgyal po u tra ya na zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ btsun mo dam pa zla 'od ces bya ba dang / bu rgyal tshab gtsug phud can zhes bya ba dang / blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang bhi ru ka zhes bya ba gnyis yod do/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying ngo/ dang u tra ya na gnyis phan tshun ma mthong ba'i grogs po byas te phrin yig dang skyes dag skur bar byed do/ /phyis su gzugs can snying pos skyes lan du/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi 'og tu skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi dag dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis swā~Xs 'byung ldog dang / steng du tshigs su

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbacad pa gnyis po/ brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim na glang bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod gyur ba//skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha ma/ra byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba dag bris nas bskur ro/ /rgyal po u tra ya na sangs rgyas la shin tu dad nas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis lugs su 'byung ba dang lugs las ldog pa dag yid la byas te rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis grong khyer sgra sgrogs na gnas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs/ dge slong kā tyā ya na chen pos gdul bar gzigs nas/ kā tyā ya na chen po 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa grong khyer sgra sgrogs su btang ngo / /kā tyā ya nas yul der gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun par chos bstan/ de'i tshe grong khyer sgra sgrogs na khyim bdag rgyal dang / skar rgyal gnyis rab tu byung ste dgra bcom thob nas phung po lhag med kyi dbyings su mya ngan la sa 'das so/ /de gnyis kyi nye du dag gis mchod rten gnyis byas so/ /de nas rgyal po u tra ya nas gzhon nu gtsug phud can rgyal srid la bzhag /blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang bhi ru ka gnyis bskos/ de nas rgyal po'i khab kyi gzugs can snying pos rgyal po u tra ya na khrid de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du song nas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nas rgyal po gtsug phud can gyis rgyal srid chos ma yin par brtsam pa na/ blon po'i mchog gnyis kyis lan gsum du bzlog pa na 'asdi gnyis yab kyis bskos pa yin pas gsod par mi byed kyis/32ḍi'i mig sngar 'dug par mi bya'o zhes

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oskyon chags pa gnyis blon por bskos so/ /rgyal blon de rnams kyis chos min byas so/ /de ltar tshong pa rnams las u tra ya nas gsan pa'i tshe gtsug phud can sogs chos min gyi spyod pa las bzlog pa'i ched du rang yul du byon pa na/ blon po skyon chags pa gnyis dang rgyal po gtsug phud can gyis rgyal po 'ong ba shes te rgyal po gsod pa'i gshed ma bskos nas btang ngo / /rgyal po gshed ma de dag dang 'phrad nas gtam dris pas/ lha bdag cag khyod bgrongs ba'i gshed mar mngags so/ /rgyal pos rab tu byung ba'i don de ngas da dung ma thob kyis re zhig sdod cig gsung te gros byas/ de nas rgyal po shing drung du skyil mo krung bcas te brtson 'grus brtsam pas dgra bcom pa nyid thob/ de dag gis gal te rgyal po gtsug phud can gyis bdag cag la rgyal po 'chi ba'i tshe ci zhig smras zhe na ji ltar brjod/ rgyal pos/ /rgyal srid phyir ni pha bsad pas/ /bsod nams ma yin mang po bskyed/ /nga ni yongs su mya ngan 'da'/ /khyod ni mnar med 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do/ /gshed mas rgyal po'i mgo bcad nas bsad do/ /de dag gis lhung bzed dang chos gos dang 'khar gsil khyer te blon po skyon chags pa gnyis dang rgyal po la gtad/ gtsug phud can la rgyal po 'chi kha'i tshigs bcad smras pas mya ngan gyis non no/ /mya ngan bsal ba'i ched du blon po skyon chags gnyis kyis gsang ste/ rgya' dang skar rgyal gnyis kyi mchod rten la khung bu gnyis bskos nas der byi la'i phru gu gnyis bzhag ste/ nyi ma re bzhin sha yis gsos te mchod rten la skor ba byed pa bslab pa dang / mas kyang gtsug phud can la khyod skyes pa gzhan /rdo bu yin zhes smras nga dang / rgyal po la

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃblon po skyon chags gnyis kyis/ dgra bcom pa gtan nas ma mchis/ rgyal dang skar rgyal gnyis la dad pas byin pa chud gzan pas byi la'i skye gnas su mchis zhes rgyal po 'khor bcas khrid de mchod rten gnyis kyi drung du song nas smras pa/rgyal dang skar rgyal gnyis nyon cig /bden pa'i tshig 'dis sha 'di long la rang rang gi mchod rten la bskor ba bgyis te rang rang gi khung du zhugs shig ces smras pa dang / de gnyis kyis de ltar byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos dgra bcom pa med par sems so/ /de'i tshe kā tyā ya na 'khor lnga brgya sogs kyi bsod snyoms kyang bcad do/ /kā tyā ya nas gtsug phud can gyis bdag mthong na mi dga' bar gyur na mi rung ngo snyam nas mtha' gcig tu song ste bzhugs so/ /rgyal pos kā tyā ya na mthong nas blon po rnams la rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ blon po skyon chags gnyis kyis/ kho bo pha gsod pa 'di'i rdul gyis mi reg par bya'o/ /zhes mchi'o//rgyal po khros nas nga'i 'khor thams cad kyis dge sbyong mgo reg 'di'i steng du sa spar mo re re thob cig ces thams cad kyis sa spar re gtor ba na rgyal po de dpung che bas 'phags pa'i steng du sa bung chen po gnas par gyur pa na 'phags pas de'i dbus su lo ma ma yin pa'i spyil bu sprul te bzhugs so/ /de nas blon po'i mchog he ru ka dang bhi ru ka gnyis dang phyugs rdzi dag gis sa phung de phyag par brtsam pa na 'phags pa kā tyā ya na chen po byung ba la blon po gnyis kyis dris pa/ 'phags pa 'di ci lags/ 'phags pas/ deng nas nyi ma bdun na grong khyer sgra sgrogs sas non par 'gyur ro/ /de yang nyi ma dang po la rlung mo che byung nas grong khyer sgra sgrogs kyi rdo dadu 6gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par byed

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdo/ /nyi ma gnyis pa la me tog gi char 'bab bo/ /nyi ma gsum pa la gos kyi char/ bzhi pa la dngul gyi char/ lnga pa la gser gyi char 'bab par 'gyur ro//de'i 'og tu las mthun par byas pa de dag thams cad grong khyer sgra sgrogs su 'jug par 'gyur zhing nyi ma drug pa la rin po che'i char 'bab bo/ /nyi ma bdun pa la sa'i char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rim gyis char bab pa'i tshe/ nyi ma drug pa la rin po che'i char babs pa na kā tyā ya na'i bka' bzhin/blon po'i mchog gnyis kyis rin po che dag gis gru bkang nas bros te/ phyogs gzhan zhig tu he ru ka'i rtsal dang bhi ru ka'i rtsal zhes bya ba'i grong khyer re brtsigs te gnas so/ /nyi ma bdun pa la sa'i char bab nas rgyal po gtsug phud can 'bros par brtsam pa dang mi ma yin pa dag gis sgo bcad do/ /de nas kā tyā ya na mnyan yod du phyin nas dge slong rnams la de dag rgyas par bsnyad do/ /dge slong rnams the tshomi skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sngon ri brag zhig na rngon pa zhig 'dug pa des ri dwags dang bya mang 'dzin pa las/ nyin gcig rang sangs rgyas zhig der bsod snyoms byas te/ de nyin mi'i dris ri dwags gcig kyang ma zin nas/ rngon pas rang sangs rgyas mthong nas mda' dug can gyis bsnun to/ /rang sangs rgyas de nam mkhar 'phags nas rdzu 'phrul mang po bstan pas rngon pa shin tu dad nas bzod par gsol/ de'i gdung mchod rten brtsigs nas mchod pa cher byas te smon lam btab bo/ /de dus rngon pa ni dge slong u tra ya na'o/ /rang sangs rgyas la dug mdas bsnun pas dmyal ba mnar ṭwāṃ~X du skyes shing tshe rabs lnga brgyar ri

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdwags su gyur nas dug mdas bsad cing da lta dgra bcom pa thob kyang mchon gyis bgrongs so/ /mchod pa byas nas smon lam btab pa'i rgyus rgyal por skyes nas rab tu byung zhing dgra bcom pa thob bo/ /zhes gsungs/༈ dang po dmyal ba lasogs kyiskabs/ yid bzhin mdzod 'grel las/ ngan song gi dang po dmyal ba ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi sa 'og gangs ri ti se'i thad nas thur du dpag tshad nyi khri na sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa'i gnas yod de/lcags kyi khang pa dpang dang rgyar dpag tshad nyi khri yod pa ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas de'i sa gzhi la thug par bzhi khri yod do/ /de'i steng nyi khri'i cha la rab tu tsha ba dang / tsha ba dang / ngu 'bod po dang / ngu 'bod dang / bsdus 'joms dang / thig nag dang / yang sos rnams gong du brtsegs mar yod do/ /de dag gi bar na dpag tshad nyis stong nyis stong gis bcad pa'o/ /tsha dmyal gyi gnas/de dang 'dab 'byar grang dmyal brgyad po yang / /tsha dmyal rnams la 'gran pa bzhin du gnas/ /yang sos nas byang du dpag tshad nyi shu na chu bur can gyi gnas yod pa ltar de'i 'og nas 'og gi/ chu bur rdol pa can dang / a chu chu zer ba dang / kye rgyud zer ba dang / so tham tham pa dang / utpal ltar gas pa dang / padma ltar gas pa dang / padma chen po ltar gas pa ste/ rim pa ltar/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba 'og ma nas byang du dpag tshad nyi shu nyi shu na yod do/ /zhes dang /yid bzhin ma dzod kyi dka' 'grel las/ tsha dmyal gyi gnas ni mdzod dang mthun la de dang 'dab 'byar du grang dmyal brgyad gsungs pas/ steng 'og gi bar thad dpag tshad nyis stong nyis sto~X gis chod par gsungs te/ sa'i dngos

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgazhi las kyang grang dmyal gyi bar tshad 'di bzhin gsungs shing / de ltar na 'di nas yang sos kyi bar la dpag tshad drug stong yod par mngon no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dmyal ba'am gshin rje'i sde dpon gyi ming / chos kyi rgyal po dang /nyi ma'i bu dang / mthar byed/ gshin rje'i rgyal po sogs zer/ de yang las kyi gshin rje yab yum dang / 'khor lcags mkhar bcu drug gi bdag po gshed chen bzhi la sogs pa yi dwags kyi yul na bzhugs shing dge sdig gi stangs gcod pa'i dmyal ba'i rgyal po lta bu yin la/ phyogs skyong gi nang nas lho phyogs skyong ba yin no/ /༈ de dag gi rnam smin kyi 'bras bu nisogs kyi skabs/ 'dir 'phen rdzogs kyi sgo nas dbye na mu bzhi yod de/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs kyang rdzogs byed sdig pas rngogs pa mi dbul po lta bu/ 'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs kyang rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa klu 'byor ldan lta bu/ 'phen rdzogs gnyis ka mi dge bas byas pa dmyal ba'i sems can lta bu/ 'phen rdzogs gnyis ka dge bas byas pa 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lta bu'o/ /'phen byed kyi las zhes pa ni/ gnas ris gang du skye bar byed pa'i las yin no/ /rdzogs byed kyi las ni/ skye ba de la bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi myong ba ci tsam yod pa skyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i las yin par gsungs so/ /de yang rdzogs byed la nges pa med de/ bde 'gror yang yan lag dang nying lag dang dbang po ma tshang ba dang mdog mi sdug pa dang /tshe thung ba dang nad mang ba dang dbul ba sogs ni mi dge bas byed la dud 'gro dang yi dwags la'ang dpal 'byor phu/ sdum tshogs pa yod pa ni dge bas byed

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpa'o/ /de'ang 'phen byed kyi las gcig gis skye ba du ma 'phen pa yang yod de/tshe dang ldan pa 'phags pa ma 'gags pas/ bdag ni sngon rtsa thun du gyur pa'i tshe rang sangs rgyas zhig la bsod snyoms gcig phul ba'i bsod nams gcig pu de'i rnam par smin pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar lan bdun skyes pa dang 'khor bsgyur du lan bdun skyes nas da lta yang shākya phyug por skyes so zhes pa lta bu dang / las du mas lus gcig 'phen pa'ang yod de/ lhas byin gyis tshe rabs du mar bsags pa'i las kyis dge slong gi gzugs la sdig spyod can du gyur pa lta bu dang / las gcig gis skye ba gcig las mi 'phen pa yang yod de/rang gi bu la snying rje skyes pa'i bud med tshangs par skyes pa lta bu'o/ /de dag gi dge sdig gang yin kyang zhing dang bsam pa dang nan tan gyis rgyun du byed pa sogs rgyu stobs che chung gi dbang gis de ltar grub pa'o/ /rnam smin myur bul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi 'a sa ni/ tshe de la byas pa'i las stobs ldan tshe de nyid du smin pa lhas sbyin gyis bcom ldan 'das la sen mos dug rtsom par gzas pa las de nyid du dmyal ba'i me grub pa lta bu/ 'phen byed ni las/ 'phen bya ni gang zag /'phang 'bras sam 'phang ba ni 'phang bya dang ngo bo gcig pa'i rnam smin yin no/ /'phen byed kyi las so so ba yin te/ ngan 'gro'i srog dbang ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo rdo rje lta bu/ skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las ni/ skye ba 'di'i phyi mar skyes ma thag tu rnam smin myong ba 'gyur ba mtshams med pa dang nye ba'i mtshams med lnga'i las lta bu/ laspya ḍings gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las ni/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃskye ba gsum phan chad nas brgya stong gi bar rnam smin myong bar 'gyur ba'i las lta bu/ myong bar ma nges pa'i las ni/ las bsags kyang so so'i gnyen po sogs kyis bcom nas rnam smin 'byin par ma nges pa ste bzhir gsungs so//byas bsags yin min gyi dbye ba ni/ las dkar po la mtshon na/ byas la bsags pa'i las ni/ dad pas dkon mchog mchod pa lta bu/ ma byas la bsags pa'i las ni/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba lta bu byas la ma bas gas pa'i las ni/ sems g.yeng ba'i bzlas brjod lta bu/ ma byas shing ma bsags pa'i las ni/ kun slong btang snyo mas las rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu 'byin mi nus pas lung ma bstan pa ste mu bzhi'o/ /las nag po la mtshone na/byas la bsags pa'i las ni/ kun slong drag pos bsam bzhin byed pa 1/dngos gzhi'i las de rdzogs par byas pa 2/ rjes su 'gyod pa med cing 3 yi rang ba 4/ de nyid 'joms byed kyi gnyen po med pa 5/ 'bras bu smin nges kyi nus pa yod pa dang drug tshang ba yin no/ /byas la ma bsags pa'i las ni/ gong gi drug po ma tshang pas las byas kyang 'bras bu ji lta ba bzhin smin par ma nges pa yin no/ /gzhan gnyis po gong gi ldog cha las shes so/ /de'ang dge sdig gang la yang bsam pa mnyam par zhugs pa thams cad byed pa po gcig bzhin du 'dra bar thob pa dmag la sogs pa lta bu yin te/ mdzod las/ dmag la sogs pa don gcig phyir/ /thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/ /zhes so/ /dge sdig gang la'ang rjes su yi rang byas na byed pa po dang 'dra bar dge rtsa thob pa dang / rjes su 'gyod pa byas na dge sdoṭwāṃ gang yang 'dzad par gsungs pa dang /

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃthabs la mkhas na sdig pa chen po yang myur du byang ba dang / dge rtsa chung ngu byas pa yang tshad med par 'phel ba la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar 'khor bar skye ba 'grub byed kyi las de yang dang por nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin la/ mthar yang sred pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas gsos ma btab na skye ba'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pas nyon mongs pa ni klu gang du gnas par chu yod pa dang / shing rnams skye ba'i rtsa ba lta bu dang / myu gu skye bar byed pa'i sa bon lta bu dang / me 'bras rnams skyed pa'i ljon pa lta bu 'khor ba skyed byed yin la/ 'khor ba'i rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa ni las nyon gnyis dang / 'khor ba'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni snod bcud gnyis yin no/ /las stobs che chung gis dbye ba ni/ spyir spang bya'i 'bras bus 'phangs kyang gnyen pos bsgyur bar nus pa'i phyir gnyen po'i las stobs che ba'o/ /ji ltar snang tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ snang 'gyur thun mong pa'i las ni/ las mthun snang bsags pa las phyi snod 'jig rten gyi snang ba zhing de'i 'gro ba rnams la phyogs gcig tu 'char ba lta bu/ myong 'gyur thun min gyi las ni/ sems can rang rang gi las snang gis bsgrubs pa'i gnas lus longs spyod so sor tha dad par bde sdug nyams su myong ba lta bu'o/ /rigs mthun mi mthun gyis dbye na/ mtha' gcig tu rnam par dkar ba'i las ni/ bsam sbyor gnyis ka rigs mthun gcig tu dkar ba'i dge ba'i las lam rdzogs pa dad pas bla ma mchod pa lta bu/ mtha' gcig tu rnam par gnag pa'i las ni/ bsam sbyor gnyis ka rigs mthun gcig tu gnag pa mi dge ba'i las lam rdzogs pa gsod sems kyis srog bcad pa lta bu/ dkar 332

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃnag 'dres ma'i las ni/ bsam pa dkar la sbyor ba gnag pas mang po skyob phyir gsod pa lta bu dang / gsod phyir spyin pa gtong ba lta bu bsam pa gnag la sbyor ba dkar ba rnams so/ /de ltar 'dres ma'i las kyis 'dod par bde sdug smrel mar myong bar byed pa'o/ /de'ang las kyi ngo bo dkar nag 'dres ma min kyang byed las las de lta bur bzhag pa'o/ /dkar nag gi las de dag zad par byed pa zag med kyi las ni mi dkar mi gnag pa zhes gsungs so/ /sems pa'i las ni/ sems mngon par 'du byed pa yid kyi las te/ bsod nams/bsod min/ mi g.yo ba'o/ /bsam pa'i las/ lus ngag yid kyi las dge mi dge'o/ /sems dpa' las gyur pa'i las gang zhe na/ gzhan gyis mi 'dod bzhin 'di gyis zhes bsgo ba sems pa las gyur pa mi dge spyod pa lta bu dang /gzhan gyis gsol ba btab pa mi 'dod bzhin 'di byas na la sogs zhes 'dzin bcug nas sems pa las gyur pa dang / skyon yon mi shes pa'i mngon zhen med pa sems pas rang dgar las gyur pa dang / mi dge ba'i rtsa ba la mngon par zhen pa'i sems pa mngon zhen drag po'i mi dge spyod pa las gyur pa dang / chos 'dod kyang phyi mar yid 'ong gi ched mi dge ba spyod pa phyin ci log gi sems pa las gyur pa'o/ /dang po gsum rnam smin nges par myong ba'i nges pa med pas byas kyang ma bsags pa dang / rtsa bar mngon zhen dang / phyin log gi sems pa las byung ba'i las byas shing bsags pa'i rnam smin ni myong bar mi 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /las byed pa ni kun tu spyod pa'o/ /bsags pa ni bag chags kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa la ༵nee par smin pa'i sa bon gsos 'phel

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃba'o/ /'phen pa rnam smin 'phen pa/ rdzogs byed ni skyes pa na/ 'dod mi 'dod myong ba'o/ /las mang po dang ldan pa ji ltar rim gyis smin zhes na/ gang shin tu lci ba sngon la smin pa dang / yang 'chi dus gang mngon gyur dang / gang goms pa'o/ /yang na thog mar spyad pa de thog mar smin par 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams tshe dang / las dang / bsod nams zad pas mtho ris sogs nas 'chi 'pho'o/ /bsod nams zad pa dus min 'chi ba ste/ 'di ltar snyoms 'jug gi ṭwāoṃ myornyi bas bsod nams zad de dus swā ma bab kyang 'chi'o/ /las zad pa ni/༵kā ོ༵sbya byeṭwāṃ /ོḍā sbyi ṭwāṃ 'od/nga/ / sngon gya lan grangs gtī la myong wīr gya ༈ sngon shākya rnams nya par gyur pa'i tshe sosasakyi skabs/shākya rnams gsod par bya'o zhes dpung tshogs bzhi bshams pa dang / ston pas da dung shākya rnams bden pa ma mthong bar 'phags skyes po'i dmag thebs na mi rung bar dgongs nas lam khar shing lo'i gdan bting grib ma chung ngu zhig na bzhugs pas 'phags skyes pos shing bzang po bzhag nas 'di na ci'i phyir bzhugs zhes zhus pas/ 'di ni nga'i nye du rnams kyis skyed bskyed pa yin pas gnyen bshes kyi dri ma 'di ni rab tu bsil lo zhes pas nye du la brtse'o snyam dmag phyir re zhig log /de nas ston pas shākya rnams la chos bstan pas phal cher bden pa mthong / de rjes shākya phal cher 'phags skyes po'i dmag gis bsad pa'o/ /ston pa mnyan yod du gshegs nas 'phags skyes po ma la gnod dang bcas zhag bdun na mes tshig nas dmyal bar skye bar lung brdospya/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i skyed mos tshal du

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃchab kyi nang du khang bzang ka ba gcig pa zhig bgyis te btsun mo'i 'khor dang bcas te gamyos pa tsho5sa btsun mo'i 'khor zhig gis sngas nang tshangs can gyi steng du nor bu me shel bzhag pa las me mched nas khang bzang tshig pa na btsun mo'i 'khor rnams bros shing 'phags skyes po dang ma la gnod gnyis 'bros par brtsam pa ‘mos mi ma yin pa das/ gis sgo bcad de tshig nas dmyal bar skye'o//rgyal byed kyi tshal du zhabs 'a seng ldeng tshal ba zug go gsungs ma thag tshal pa rnon po mtho gang ba zhig byung ba/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus 'dor bar brtsam kyang bskul ma nus nas ston pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du gshegs kyang de yi rjes su 'brangs shing mnyan yod du gshegs de/ phyag g.yas pas zhabs g.yas bzung nas seng ldeng gi tshal pa rtse gzengs ba'i steng bzhag ste phug ma thag stong chen g.yos shing kun dga' bor sngon tshangs pa g.yo can mdung gis bsad pa'i las kyi lhag ma'o zhes gsungs so/ /༈ rgyal po nga las nu sngon dbul por gyur pa'i tshe sogs kyi skabs/ sngon gyi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir tshe lo dpag med thub pa'i dus na/ rgyal po gus pa can nam gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo la sgo nga 'dra ba'i sha rmen zhig byung ste/ de gas pa'i nang nas gzhon nu gser gyi mdog can zhig skyes pa'i tshe btsun mo thams cad kyi nu ma nas 'o ma rang byung ste/ so so nas nga las nus zhes byas pas de'i ming du nga las nu yang zer ro/ /de rgyal srid kyi 'byor ba chen pos dga' zhing rtsed mo rtse ba'i yun du brgya byin drug tshe 'phos so/ /de cher skyes pa na yon tan dang ldan par rig ste/ yab rgyal pos yul gaṭwāṃṭwāṃ gi rgyal srid byed du bcug go/ /de

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrgyal tshab byed pa'i yun la brgya byin drug tshe 'phos so/ /de nas yab rgyal po tshe dus byas/ gzhon nu spyi bo skyes rgyal por dbang skur cig ces gsungs/ de nas rgyal chen bzhis rgyal por dbang bskur/ lha dbang gis rin po che'i cod pan mgo la bcings/ mi rnams kyis khri dang cod pan sogs ma bcings pa'i sngon du lha rnams kyis de ltar byas so/ /de dang mnyam du gser gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rin po che sna bdun kyang der byung ste/ gling bzhi la dbang byed pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen por gyur to/ /bu yang stong tshang bar byung / de nas zas gos dang / rol mo dang / rin ngo/ che sna bdun gyi char phab nas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir lo khri phrag mang por sems can rnams la phan pa rjes su bstan nas brgya byin drug 'pho ba'i yun du gnas so/ /de nas gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che nam mkhar 'phags pa'i rjes su rin po che gzhan dang dpung gi tshogs bye ba brgyad 'bum dang / bu stong dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'phags pas shar gyi lus 'phags gling du phyin nas mi thams cad kyis bsu zhing rgyal po byas te brgya byin drug gi tshe'i yun du gnas so/ /de nas nub ba lang spyod du song ste brgya byin drug gi yun du gnas so/ /de nas byang sgra mi snyan du song nas der rgyal po byas te brgya byin drug gi che'i yun du gnas so/ /de nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas su chas so/ /der ri rab ni gser gyi ri bdun gyis bskor ba yin pas gser gyi ri dang po mu khyud 'dzin gyi ri'i rtse mor bde ba'i yo byad thams cad la longs spyod de gnas pa'i yun la brgya byin drug tshe 'phos so/ /de bzhin du rnam 'dud dang / rta rna dang / lta na sdug /dī / seng ldeng can dang / gshol mda'

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ'adzin dang / gnya' shing 'dzin drug po re re'i rtse mor brgya byin drug re drug re tshe 'pho ba'i yun du bsdad do/ /de nas gnya' shing 'dzin nas steng gi nam mkha' la 'phags te/ ri yi rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du chas so/ /de'i tshe lha rnams sgrag nas sgo thams cad bsdam kyang / rgyal po 'khor bcas der phyin nas gzhu rgyud sbreng zhing dung bus pa tsam gyis lha'i pho brang gi sgo brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gnyis po dus gcig tu phye nas/ brgya byin gyis rgyal ngo nga las nu la stan phyed bstabs shing / brgya byin dang stan gcig la 'dug nas mnga' dbang mnyam par gyur te gnas so/ /de'i tshe lha mi'i rgyal po de gnyis la mig 'dzum/ mi 'dzum dang 'gro na lha'i mgyogs bul tsam gyi khyad ma/ gtogs med do/ /der brgya byin dang skal pa mnyam pas lha 'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la longs spyod de brgya byin sum cu rtsa drug gi tshe'i yun du gnas par byas so/ /de ltar brgya byin sum cu rtsa drug brjes pa'i tha ma de'i ring la/ lha ma yin rnams lha la dmag drangs pa na/ brgya byin gyis ma thub nas/ nga las nu dpung gi tshogs brgyad 'bum dang bcas pa steng gi nam mkhar 'phags nas dung bus shing gzhu rgyud sbreng pa na lha ma yin rnams 'jigs skrag nas g.yul pham ste rang gi gnas su bros so/ /rgyal po nga las nus bsams pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams las bdag lhag go snyam te/ brgya byin dang thun mong du 'dug pa ga la rung / da ni brgya byin gnas 'di nas dbyung la bdag kho nas lha dang mi rnams kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed do snyam ma thag tu 'dzam bu'i gling du phyir lhung zhing sngon gyi pho brang rnying ba'i sgor lhag narwa /ga bsngal myong ba na rgyal po de'i blon

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃpo'i tshogs dang bcas pas ci nyes dris pa na/ rgyal pos smras pa/ karṣa pa ṇa'i char babs kyang / /'dod pa dag la ngoms pa med/ /ces sogs skye bo'i tshogs de rnams la 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs dang / khyim na gnas pa'i nyes dmigs sogs bshad pas srog chags brgya stong mang po rab tu byung ste tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes so/ /de ltar rgyal po chen po nga las nu de ji srid gzhon nu'i sa na rtse ba nas sum cu rtsa gsum du gnas pa de srid kyi yun la brgya byin brgya dang bcu bzhi shi 'phos pa yin no/ /brgya byin re re'i che chad ni mi rnams kyi lo brgya la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i zhag gcig yin no/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba/ zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu brtsis pa'i lha rnams kyi lo stong thub pa yin no/ /de mi'i los bgrangs na lo bye ba phrag gsum dang sa ya drug yod de/brgya byin gcig gi tshe tshad do/ /brgya byin brgya dang bcu bzhi po'i tshe tshad mi'i lor brtsis na ther 'bum bzhi dang dung phyur gcig dang sa ya bzhi yod de/ de tsam du rgyal po nga las nu lha dang mi'i 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'i yun yin no//'dul ba'i dpe 'gar brgya byin brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs yig skyon re zung zhugs pa 'dug go/ /de bzhin skyes rabs kyi skabs 'dir cung zad re'i 'dra min yod pa rnams mdo sde rgyas bsdus bsdur nas bris pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /brgya byin so drug po'i nang gi dang po nga las nu la stan phyed stob pa de ni dge slong 'od srung 'di yin la/ gang gi tshe rgyal po nga las nus brgya byin 'di gnas 'di nas phyung la bdag gis rgyal srid bya'o snyam pa'i brgya byin de ni sangs rgyas 'od srung yin no/ /de'i rdo ṭwāṃ las nu de ni bcom ldan 'daru nyid

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃdo/ /nga las nu des gling bzhi dang lha'i gnas su rgyal srid thob par gyur pa'i rgyu ni sngon de bzhin gshegs pa rnam gzigs 'jig rten tu byon pa/ rgyal po'i pho brang gnyen ldan du bsod snyoms la zhugs pa na/ 'bru tshong ba'i tshong pa zhig gis sangs rgyas de lta bas chog mi shes par mthong nas/ sran ma la spar bas bcus te gtor ba dang / 'bru ma bzhi lhung bzed kyi nang du song / gcig lhung bzed kyi kha khyer la phog /gcig dbu'i rtse mor chags pas gling bzhi dang lha'i ris gnyis su longs spyod kyi dga' ba yun ring myong ba thob po/ /de'i pho brang du zhag bdun du gser sogs kyi char babs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gnon zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ba'i tshe/ tshong dpon gyi bu khyim phub nas ring po ma lon pa zhig gnas so/ /yul de'i chos lugs kyis bag ma btang nas ring po ma lon par bag rdzongs btab ste khyim thab la gtong ba'i bag ma gang yin pa de rin po che sna bzhi las byas pa'i me tog gis brgyan pas khyim thab la gtong la/ des kyang khrid nas rang gi khyim du 'gro bas/ tshong dpon gyi bu des rin po che las byas pa'i me tog thogs nas bzhon pa la zhon te/rang gi khyim du chas pa'i lam du sangs rgyas de nyid tshur ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa mthong nas/ des skyes bu chen po'i mtshan lta bas chog mi shes pa mthong bas/dad pas brlan pa'i sems kyis bzhon pa las babs nas rin po che'i me tog de rnams kyis sangs rgyas de la gtor ro/ /sangs rgyas de'i rdzu 'phrul gyis me tog de dag shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam sha stag tu gyur nas gshegs na phyi bzhin 'ong zhing bzhugs na 'dug pa de ltar ṭwāṃ/ gyis rlabs pas/ de dad pa skyes nas/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsbyin pa rgya chen sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyang brjod do/ /de'i rnam smin gyis rgyal po legs mthong chen po'i dus su yang de'i pho brang yang gser las byas pa dga' dga' ltar 'dug par gyur cing / nga las nu'i pho brang du zhag bdun du gser gyi char kyang babs/ /'di dag thub chog rgyab chos las btus so/ /chos 'byung rin po che'i gter mdzod nyi 'od las / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du 'byung ba'i dus ni/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ni/ sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste/ de nyid tshe lo brgyad khri yan chad la 'byung zhing / de man chad la longs spyod kyi bya ba mi rdzogs pa'i phyir mi 'byon no/ /tshe lo drug khri'i dus stobs kyi 'khor los bsgrur ba'i rgyal po ni/ mchod sbyin nyin gcig tsam byas pa ni/ sngar med pa'i sar rten bzhengs pa tsam gyis thob pa yod do/ /de ni brgyad khri ba de las mar 'gribs kyi dus su'ang 'byung ngo / /de yang gling bzhi ru 'khor los bsgyur ba gnyis mi 'byung gi sangs rgyas dang 'dra'o/ /de yang gang zag gzhan las khyad par du gyur pa ni/ lus ni mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dag gis brgyan pa'o/ /'o na sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dpe dang khyad par ci yod zhe ‘na/ gsal mi gsal dang / rdzogs ma rdzogs dang / gog pa 'jur mi 'jur gyi khyad par yod par bshad do/ /skye bo gzhan la med pa'i khyad par gyi longs spyod mchog tu gyur pa'i rin po che sna bdun ni/ de yang 'khor lo rin po che gser dang dngul las byas pa/ rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ nam mkha' nas lhasdu4 ḍibul bar byed do/ /nor bu rin po che

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃzur brgyad pa tsha grang skyob cing mtshan mo snang bar byed pa klu'i rgyal pos 'bul lo/ /glang po rin po che rab brtan gyi 'khor dang / rta'i rgyal po ba la ha brgya byin gyis 'bul lo/ /blon po ri na po che des/ bang mdzod du bltas pa tsam gyis 'o/ngas spyod kyis gang bar byed pa dang / btsun mo mchog tu gyur pa dus der rang bzhin gyis skye'o/ /dmag dpon gyad stobs po che rang bzhin gyis 'byung ngo / /nye ba'i rin po che bdun ni/ tshal rin po che skyed mo'i tshal der slebs pa tsam gyis lus sems la dga' bde skye'o/ /khang bzang rin po che ni/ rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang du 'dug pa tsam gyis lus sems la dga' bde skye'o/ /mal khri rin po che ni/ rin po che'i khri steng du bsdad pa tsam gyis bde ba skye'o/ /gos rin po che ni/ lha yi gos kha dog bzang zhing reg na 'jam pa gon pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /mchil lham rin po che ni/ gon pas chu la mi bying nam mkha' la 'gro bar nus so/ /klu yi pags pa rin po che ni/ gon pas 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas mi tshugs shing sprugs pas char 'bab bo/ /ral gri rin po che ni/ 'phyar ba tsam gyis phas kyi g.yul 'joms par byed do/ /de yang 'khor los bsgyur ba rang la bzhi yod de/ gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dang /dngul gyi zhabor los bsgyur ba dang / zangs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dang /lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dang bzhi'o/ /de dag ni rim pa bzhin du/ gling bzhi dang / gsum dang / gnyis dang / gcig la dbang byed do/ /dbang byed lugs ni/ gser gyi 'khor lo can/ gling bzhi gang du 'gro ba de 'khor lo nam mkha' la 'phangs pas/ nam mkha' la lam byung nas der phyin pa dang / gling 341

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbazhi'i mis pha ma bzhin bsu zhing bsnyen bkur byed do/ /dngul gyis ni/ rang 'gro zhing drung du phyin pa tsam gyis bsnyen bkur byed do/ /zangs kyis ni/ drung du phyin g.yul bshams pas rtsal gyis 'dul lo/ /lcags kyis mtshon brtsams pas mi rnams dbang du byed do/ /de ltar dbang du byas nas/ gling 'dul zhing mi rnams bde ba la 'god do/ /zhes gsungs/༈ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi mched ya dge slong legs skar sogs kyi skabs/ rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal du rgyal po gzugs can snying pos sangs rgyas la zla ba bzhi'i bar du bsnyen bkur byed pa'i tshe gcer bu pa sdug bsngal du gyur/ ston pas legs skar la/ gcer bu pa 'di ni zhag bdun kha zas kyis sud nas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /shi nas kyang skyug pa za ba'i yi dwags su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ legs skar gcer bu pa'i sar song ste tshe dang ldan pa khyod kyis shes sam/ dge sbyong go'u ta mas ni khyod la da lta zhag bdun nas kha zas kyis sud nas 'chi'o zhes sogs ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin brjod pas tshe dang ldan pa khyod bag dang ldan par gyis shig /go'u ta ma'i de rdzun du smra bar 'gyur ro zhes pas/ gcer bu pas kha zas mi za bar byas te zhag drug gi bar ci yang ma zos zhag drug song bdun pa'i nyin bu ram gyi lde gu zos nas chu grang btungs pas sud de shi nas ro dur khrod du bskyal bas skyug pa za ba'i yi dwags su gyur nas ro'i drung du sdod de/ der legs skar song ste khyod shi'am gang gis shi da lta lus gang yin sogs smras pas gcer bu pas/ legs pa'i skar ma legs par nyon cig /de bzhin gshegs pa ni dge sdu/ gsung pa/ yang dag par gsung pa/

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum oṃdus la babs par gsung pa/don yod par gsung pa/ chos su gsung pa'o/ /khyod ci'i phyir yid ma ches sems can gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa la yid mi ches na de yang kho bo'i lus 'di dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro zhes zer ba'o//ston pas ngas ni/ dge slong legs pa'i skar ma la dam pa'i chosabastan na'ang yid ches shing gzungs su 'dzin pa'i sems 'di tsam yang ma skyes so/ /mdo sde bcu gnyis klog cing bton te bsam gtan bzhi yang thob mod kyi/ chung ngu na tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam mam/ tshig gcig dang 'bru gcig gi don la yang cha mi 'jog ste mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas bsam gtan bzhi yang nyams par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan nyams pas ngan par lta ba skyes te/sangs rgyas kyang med/ chos kyang med/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang med/ dge sbyong go'u ta ma ni mtshan lta ba'i cho ga la shin tu mkhas pa gzhan gyi sems shes snazlo /sbya ṭwāoṃ /ro/ zhes sogs legs skar gyis log lta'i tshul mang ba rgyas par ༈dka' chen bcu gnyis dka' phran bcu gnyisasogs kyi skabs/ dka' phran bcu gnyis ni/ te lo pa la nā ro pas/ nad kyis gzer ba'i lus dang 'bus bshig pa/ /gsod dang rgyu 'dren dri ma bkru ba dang / /rgyal po rngon pa mu to nya ba'i gzugs/ /'tsho med spyod dang 'gal mthun de bzhin 'dir/ /'chi la thug pa lhakto spyo /'di/ lta bur/ /bdag la bslu ba'i cho 'phrul ci phyir mdzad/ /ces zhus pa dka' chen bcu gnyis ni/ gadzwa/sdu pa ston par gsol ba btab pas/

gaku khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃ.o dan ṭa bi ri'i gtsug lag khang thog rim pa bcu gsum pa'i rtse mor bka' bzhin mchongs so/ /sa gzhi la drag tu brdab pas rkang lag rnams chag ste lto ba la zug /tshigs rnamasani zhig /mgo bo chag pas klad pa ni 'thor/ nang khrol phal cher ni phyir byung / srog gi lhag ma cung zad lus so/ /de nas bla ma byon te byin rlabs mdzad/ yang bla ma'i phyi bzhin song ba na/ nags khrod du gshegs te phyogs thams cad mes skor ba'i dbus su bzhag te bud shing mang po steng du spungs/ me sbar bas sha lhags gzhob tu gyur pa sogs dang / 'dam rdzab kyi 'ob kha zhing 'dom phyed tsam la gting zab cing srin bus gang ba la lus kyi zam pa byed du bcug pa'i steng du byon nas 'dam rdzab tu bor/ srin bu rnams kyis lus kyi khrag thams cad 'thung ba dang / smyug ma'i thur ma mang po mdung rtse ltar bzhog nas til mar gyis ngar blud/ de rnams mdun nas rgyab dang rgyab nas mdun/ g.yas nas g.yon dang g.yon nas g.yas su phar thal tshur thal du phug pas lus smyug phung lta bur byas nas gzhan du gshegs so/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo 'gug par gyis shig ces gsungs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i pho brang du byon te btsun mo'i lag pa nas bzung ste khrid pas/ btsun mo bsrung pa rnams khros te bzung nas brdung pas kha la sogs pa'i dbang po'i sko nas khrag 'bab cing / kha sbub tu 'gyel nas brgyal bar gyur pa la de dag gis shi bar mthong nas bor te song ngo / /yang blon po'i chung ma sngar bzhin khrid pa'i tshe blon po sogs khros nas bzung ste yan lag rnams bcag ste rgyogs kyi 'khrul 'khor du bcug nas shin tu rgyang ring por 'phangs pas brag gi ngos la phog ste rus tshigs thams cad 344

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃzhig /chu rgyus thams cad chad/ srog gi lhag ma cung zad tsam lus so/ /yang bag ma khrid shog gsungs pas khrid pa na/ bag ma bsu skyel byed mi rnams kyis shin tu brdung ba sogs dang / mi zhig 'gro bar gzigs nas 'di bzung bar gyis shig gsungs/ myur bar brgyug ste song ba las je ring je ring du gyur nas shin tu thang chad de brgyal bar gyur/ bla ma la gdams ngag ston par sa/sol ba btab pas/ khyed kyis maṇḍal phul cig gsungs/ de nas bye ma'i sa gzhi der rang gi khrag gis chag chag btab nas mtshon chas rang gi rkang pa gnyis dang lag pa g.yon pa dang mgo bo bcad de tshom bur bkod pa na/ lag pa g.yas kyang rang bzhin gyisachad nas tshom bur gyur to/ /ston mo byed pa la bza' btung slong la shog cig gsungs/ der song nas bza' btung bslang ste phul/da dung slong la shog gsungs yang song nas snod zas dang bcas pa khyer nas bros pa na dbyug pa dang rdo char phab cing zas slar phar shor ro/ /lo rgyus zhus/bla mas khyed kyis thabs ma shes te/ bum pa/ thag pa/ me long / ral gri 'di rnams bzung la rim par skyur zhing zas khyer la bros shog gsung / de ltar byas pas mang pos bdas pa na/ bum chu 'pho bas chu bor gyur/ yang sleb pa na thag pa skyur bas chu bor gyur/ yang sleb pa na me long skyur bas mtshor gyur/ yang sleb pa na ral gri skyur bas lcags kyi khang par gyur pas der zhugs/ me sbar bas phyir thon pa na de dag gis rab tu brdung ba dang / bla ma cung zad khros pa'i tshul gyis mchil lham gyis gdong la brgyab/ zhabs kyi rdog thos snying khar brgyab pas zhag gsum du brgyal ba dang / shes rab ma tshol la khrid shog 345

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasungs/ de ltar phul ba na/ shes rab ma des phyir cung zad bltas pa na 'di khyod la dga'o zhes gsungs te smyug thur rdo rje'i sbubs su btsug nas/ de nyid rdo yi steng du bzhag te steng nas rdos brdung pas khrag mang du byung ba'o/ /༈ yang na ro pas dka' phran bcu gnyis dang dka' bcu gnyis spyad tshul ni/ de yang dpal ldan na ro pa 'brungs pa'i yul ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs bha ga la shri na ga ra'i grong khyer 'dzam bu zhes bya bar/ yab ni rgyal po dge ba'i go cha zhes bya ba dang / de'i btsun mo ni dpal gyi blo gros ma zhes bya'o//de gnyis kyi sras su zhabrungs/ cher skyes pa na bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bu mo btsun mor blangs nas rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs so/ /de nas rgyal bus btsun mo la smras pa/ bu mo nges par lha yul bde ba'ang / /rtag pa med de sdug bsngal brgya yis bcom/ /mi yi bde ba smos kyang ci dgos so/ /'di la bden par bzung na 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /ces gsungs nas rab tu byung te/ mkhan po sangs rgyas skyabs dang ye shes 'od/ chos kyi bla ma/ chos kyi ye shes/ chos kyi byang chub la sogs pa las bsnyen par dzoogs shing bshad pa dang bsgrub pa mdzad/ de nas na len ḍa'i byang sgo bsrung te phyi nang gi rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad nas bzhugs pa na/ nyin zhig rgan mo mig dmar la skem pa/ skra kham la gzeng ba/ sna zhom pa/ mdog nag la sngo ba lag pa gyong la skum pa/ ngu zhing mchi ma 'dzag pa/ gom pa 'khyor ba sogs mi sdug pa'i mtshan so bdun ston pa'i rnam pa can zhig byung nas smras pa/ mkhas par grags kyang don la shin tu meongs/ /mang du thos kyang nges pa'i sdusdung ma rnyed/ /rgya cher shes kyang don

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgacig ma rtogs pa'i/ /skye bo kun gyis bskur ba cir mi rung / /zhes sogs dang / tshig don gnyis su med par mchog gi don/ /gang de bdag gi ming po kho nas shes/ /zhes zer ro/ /na ro pas/ khyod kyi ming po de dang kho bo sprod par mdzod cig dang / kho bos kyang don shes par 'tshal lo zhes smras pa dang / de na re/ kho mos de bstan mi dgos kyi/ khyod kyis gsol ba 'debs shing song zhig dang nges par kho mo'i ming po rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mdzes pa'i gzugs bstan nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /na ro pas na chung 'di lta bu'i gzugs phun sum tshogs pa mi sdug pa'i mtshan so bdun ston pa ni 'khor ba'i skyon sum cu rtsa bdun dang ldan no zhes brda ston pa'o dgongs nas/ chos brgyad dang ma bral ba'i thos bsam 'chad nyan kyang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das te/de bas na bdag gi don ston pa'i bla ma btsal bar bya'o snyam du dgongs nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gsungs pa/ 'khor ba dbang po gzhan skyon rtogs/ /'khor ba me dong bzod dang bral/ /zhes sogs 'khor ba'i skyon mtshang so bdun gsungs so/ /de nas bdag gi bla ma dam pa ji ltar btsal bar bya snyam nas byon pa na nam mkha' nas sgra zhig grag /don du dbyer med rang bzhin yang / /kun rdzob rten 'brel sna tshogs pas/ /bde mchog 'khor lo la brten nas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas tshol dang rnyed/ /ces so/ /de nas dur khrod chen po na ga rar byon nas yi ge bdun pa 'bum phrag gsum bzlas pa na nam mkha' la sgra grag pa/rig pa la dga' rigs ldan skyes/ /'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na/ /khyod 'dod bla ma sangs rgyas ni/ /te lo zhes pa yod kyis song / /zhes lung bstan pa 347

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyingasarang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbazhin shar phyogs su song ba na/ brag rong shin tu dog pa'i lam 'phrang zhig na/mdze mo shin tu nyam nyes pa cig dang phrad pa na skyug bro bas sna bkab ste/ de'i gos kyi tha ma la 'gong ste song ngo / /de nyid med par gyur te nam mkha' la sgra grag pa/ rnam rtog 'ching bas dam bcing pa/ /khyod kyi bla ma ji ltar rnyed/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang mtha' gcig tu/ /byis pa rnams kyi btags pa tsam/ /zhes grag /bla ma'i sprul pa yin par ma shesanas 'gyod bzhin song ba na/ lam 'phrang ches dog pa zhig na khyi mo lus kyi smad rul te 'bu shig shig par gyur pa/zhe sdang gis gzhan la zug par byed pa mthong ba yang 'gong ste song ngo / /de nyid mi snang bar gyur te/ nam mkha' la sgra grag pa/ 'gro ba drug tu rnam brtag pa/ /thams cad gdod nas rnam par dag /mchog dman bzang ngan 'dzin pa can/ /khyod kyis bla ma rnyed par dka'/ /zhes grag go/ /sngar bzhin song ste mi zhig dang 'phrad pa na/ te lo gar bzhugasadris pas/ de na re/ 'di nas cung zad 'das pa na/ /khyed kyi bla ma de mthong ba/ /bya min byed par brtson pa yod//grogs po myur du 'gro bar gyis/ /zhes thos pas myur du song ba na mi gcig gis gcig gsad par 'dod pa mthong nas bla ma dris pa na/ des smras pa/thog mar mi 'di mgo gcod pa'i grogs gyis shig dang de nas bdag gis bstan par bya'o zhes smras so/ /ga la rung bsam pa na de nyid mi snang bar gyur te nam mkha' la sgra grag pa/ rtag par bdag tu 'dzin pa'i mgo/ /shes rab mtshon gyis ma btab na/ /bla ma rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ /rnyed kyang don med gzugs can tsam/ /zhes grag go/ /sditwe bzhin 'gyod de song ba na mi gcig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgis mi gcig bsad pa'i rgyu ma lto nas 'dren pa la mchog tu brtson par mthong ste bla ma dris pas/ des smras pa/ bdag gis mi bsad pa 'di'i rgyu lto 'dren pa'i grogs gyis shig dang bstan par bya'o/ /zhes zer/ sdig pa spyod pa'i grogs bya mi rung ngo zhes smras pas de ma thag mi snang bar gyur te/ nam mkha' nas/ 'khor ba'i rgyun thag ma bcad par/ /su zhig bla ma'i go 'phang rnyed/ /theg pa dman la nyer chags pas/ /bya dang bya min sems pa zhabrul/ /zhes grag go/ /yang song ba na mi zhig gis chu 'gram du rgyu lto ljan ldin mang po bkru ba dang 'phrad de bla ma dris pas/ des smras pa/ mthong gis bdag gi grogasagyis shib/ dang de nas ston ces smras pas/ shin tu skyug bro ba 'di bkru mi nus so smras pa/ de nyid mi snang bar gyur te nam mkha' nas/ nyon mongs ljan ldin ma bkrusapar/ /su zhig gis ni bla ma rnyed/ /dri mar ldan pa gzhan dag la/ /dri mar ldan pas smod pa 'khrul/ /zhes pa'i sgra grag go/ /yang sngar bzhin song ba na/pho brang yid 'ong ldan zhes bya bar rgyal po zhig bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar phyin te bla ma dris pa na/ rgyal pos mkho ba'i yo byad dang bdag gi bu mo sbyin gyis re zhig ngal sosashig/ phyi nas 'dod pa'i don de grub par bya/ zhes smras pa ltar nyan te rgyal po'i pho brang du yun ring 'das pa na/ sras pho mo gnyis byung zhing gnas pa'i tshe/ ngan spyod pa kha cig gis btsun mo sras dang bcas pa bsad/ de nas sdug bsngal zhing rgyal po la zhus pas/ rgyal pos khyod kyis bdag gi grags pa nyams par byas so zhes smras pa na/ na ro pa khros te rgyal po ngan pa 'dis bdag la bla ma tshol ba la bar chad byas pas rig sngags kyis bsgral bar bya'o zhes 349

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmyur bar bsgrub khang du zhugs te/ drag sngags bzlas pa la brtson par gnas pa na/ nam mkha' nas/ chags sdang zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /nges par ngan 'gro'i gnas su khrid/ /bla ma rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ /khyod ni sgyu ma'i rgyal pos bslus/ /zhes sgra grag nas thams cad mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas shin tu 'gyod bzhin song song ba las/ ri dwags nyam thag pa zhig khyis ded pa'i rjes su rngon pa byung ba la bla ma dris pas/ 'di gsod grogs kyis shig dang de nas bstan par bya zhes smras pas/ rngon pa'i grogs bya bar mi rung snyam pa'i mod la mi snang bar gyur te/ nam mkha' nas/ sgyu lus zhen pa med pa'i mda'/ /bde gsal nyams kyi gzhu bkang nas/ /gzung 'dzin ri dwags ma bsad na/ /bla ma rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /gsod par dga' ba'i rngon pa nga / /dge 'dun gnas su bsod snyoms slong / /zhes grag go/ /yang sngar bzhin song ba na dge 'dun pa dang 'phrad de bla ma dris pas/ gcig na re/ mu to ba te lo pa zhes bya ba cig snang ste yin nam zhes smras pas/ kho bo la ston cig zhus pas de'i khrid nas song ba na/ lam srang gi bzhi mdo zhig na/ rgad po shin tu mi sdug pa/ 'khar ba dang /slong snod chag po g.yas log na bzhag du ba dang bcas pa'i me cung zad sbyar/sprang zas nyung ngu ni zhim zhim ltar za zhing 'dug pa la phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas bdag rjes su bzung du gsol/ zhes smras pa na/ mu to bas shig spar gang gtad de/ 'di rnams me 'di la bsregs par gyis shig ces so/ khung zad the tshom skyes pa'i tshe de nyid mi snang bar gyur nas nam mkha' nas/ sems dang sems 'byung rnam par rtog /ma bsresdu0 bla ma ga la rnyed/ /gsod la dga'

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbadag nya gsod phyir/ /da ni rgya mtsho che drung 'gro/ /zhes grag go/ /de nas rgya mtsho'i drung du song ba na/ btsun pa pho mo gnyis kyis zhing rmo zhing / de gnyis kyi bu mo rnams kyis nya gsod par rtsom pa mthong ste bla ma dris pa/ thog mar khyim du byon la gro gsol cig ces zer/ khyim du phyin pa na/ nya bdun ma shi bar sder du bzhag nas drangs pas 'di ni bza' ba'i tha ma'o snyam pa na thams cad med par gyur nas/ nam mkha' nas/ 'jig rten snang ba 'di bden na/ /yang dag ye shes ci mi bden/ /mi bden bden rtog rtog ge pa/ /de dag nyams pa las cher nyams/ /bya dang bya min mtha' gcig tu/ /so sor rnam par rtog pa can/ /de dag bla ma rnyed par dka'/ /da ni pha ma gsod du 'gro/ /zhes grag go/ /yang sngar bzhin song ba na/ pha gsal shing la btsug /ma btson khang du bcug te ngan thabs du ma rtsom pa'i mi zhig mthong ste bla ma dris pas/ pha ma 'di gnyis kyis mi rig pa du ma byed pas 'di gnyis gsod pa'i grogs gyis shig dang bla ma dang sprad par bya'o zhes zer/ su zhig gi pha ma gsod snyam du sems pa'i tshe thams cad mi snang bar gyur te/ nam mkha' nas/ gzung 'dzin chags dang sdang ba yis/ /pha dang ma med ma gsad par/ /su zhig gis ni bla ma rnyed/ /da ni ltad mo ltar 'gro'o/ /zhes grag ste/ sngar bzhin song ba las sa phyogs gzhan zhig na mi mang po tshogs nas/ dmus long ltad mo lta ba dang / 'on pasasgra dbyangs nyan pa dang / lkug pas sna tshogs smra ba dang / zha bos rgyug par byed pa dang / ro lang gar byed rnams mthong ba la blta zhing gnas pa las/ mi snang bar gyur nas nam mkha' nas/ mi gcig du mar /ོ 5ṭwāṃcig ste/ dmus long blta ru med pa

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbalta/ /'on pas nyan rgyu med par nyan/ /lkug pas smra rgyu med par smra/ /zha bos 'gro 'ong med par rgyug /dbug bral gar byed bya rtsol bral/ /zhes grag ste/ da ni bdag gi lus 'di dang bcas bzhin du bla ma rnyed par mi 'gyur bas lus 'di bor la bla ma rnyed par smon lam btab par bya'o bsam nas/ gal te bdag lus skye srid na/ /bla mas rtag tu rjes 'dzin 'gyur/ /'di ltar bla mas dbul ba ni/ /phyin chad bdag myong ma gyur cig /ces spu gris mgrin pa breg par brtsam pa na nam mkha' nas/ yang dag don du bla ma btsal/ /bla ma ma rnyed sangasargyas rang / /bsad pas bla ma rnyed mi 'gyur/ /khyed 'dod sdig can nga nyid do/ /zhes grag ste bltas pa na/ rnal 'byor pa sku mdog mthing nag skra spyi bor bcing pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/'ja' 'od kyi dbus na bzhugs par mthong nas/ dga' ba dang rab tu dad pas gsol ba btab pa/ nad kyi gzer ba'i lus dang 'bus bshig pa/ /gsod dang rgyu 'dren dri ma bkru ba dang / /rgyal po rngon pa nga/mu lto nya pa'i gzugs//mchams med spyod dang 'gal mthun de bzhin 'dir/ /'chi la thug pa nyid de 'di lta bur/ /bdag la bslu ba'i cho 'phrul ci phyir mdzad/ /zhes sogs gsol bas/ bu khyod dang kho bo 'bral med du rtag par bsdad kyang / khyod rang sgrib pas bsgribs te ji bzhin ma mthong ba yin te/ sprin gyi dbang gis nyi ma zla ba dang / /rnyog pa'i dbang gis chu'i nang gi gzugs/ /nyon mongs dbang gis sems kyi sangs rgyas bzhin/ /rtag par yod kyang ma mthong byis pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te gshegs so/ /phyi bzhin rdi sduong nas maṇḍal phul te chos gsung par

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃgasol pa btab pas/ bka' stsal pa/ bu khyod skal ldan nges pa tshol ba ste//dbang bral zab mo'i nges pa su yisarnyed/ /de phyir khyod la nges par sbyin pa'i phyir/ /dang po kho nar dbang gis smin par bya/ /zhes dbang rdzas ras yug la me sreg bzhag pas thal bar gyur pa dang / go'am gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i brda' bcu gnyis la brten nas dbang bskur te bstan pa nā ro pas shes shing rtogs pa'i tshe te lo pas/ nyon mongs dri mar bcas pa'i rasayug bsreg /man shel gdod nas dri bral sna tshogs snang / /'ching byed rang mi rgya mdud rang gis bkrol/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po bla ma nyid/ /'gyur med dad pa yon tan kun gyi sgo/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni nges par ba6pa / /bde chen thig le thams cad ro gcig ste/ /rgyal ba kun grol chotshokyi 'byung gnas mchog /rdo rje zla gsang gar brgya'i rol mor ldan/ /kun tu gdam rol rnam rol gdod ma'i gsang / /rang rig ye shes smra bsam brngod las 'das/ /mnyam sbyor bdud rtsi dpag bsam shing 'bras smin/ /bcu gnyis brda shes skal dang ldan pa khyod/ /gsang chen zab mo'i snod du da gyur to/ /zhes gsungs/ bka' chen brgya gnyis ni te lo pa/gzhan du gshegs pa'i phyi bzhin du song nas bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa na/ bla mas gtsug lag khang thog rim pa bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i rtse nas phyi rol du mchong du bcug pas/ rkang lag rnams chag ste lto ba la zug /tshig rnams ni zhig /mgo bo chag pas klad pa ni 'thor/ nang khrol phal cher ni phyir byung / srog gi lhag ma cung zad lus te/ bla ma byon spya~X ci nyes gsungs pa la/ da ni 'jig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃrten pha rol bdag 'gro rje khyod kyi/ /zhabs dang nam yang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /ces pa la gsungs pa/ dad dang blo gros stobs ldan pa/ /rnam smin lus 'di zhig kyang sla/ /ḍa kyi rnams kyi gsang ba mchog khyud pa sems kyi me long ltos/ /zhes lus la phyag gis byug pas snga ma bas kyang mdzeba'iso lo gcig 'das pa na phyag 'tshal sogs sngar bzhin byas te/ nags khrod chen po zhig tu gshegs te phyogs thams cad mes skor ba'i dbus su bzhag te bud shing mang po thog tu spung nas/ me sbar bas sha lngags mtha' dag drig te gzhob tu gyur/ klad pa dang khrag dang rgyus pa dang chu ser ni rab tu skam/ chu rgyus rnams tshig cing chad pas tshigs rnams dang bral bar nye bar gyur te/ srog gi lhag ma cung zad lus pa'i tshe/ bla mas sngar bzhin gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan zhus pas/bka' stsal pa/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang byas sgyu ma'i lus/ /'di ni tshig kyang rung gi gzhan du na/ /ye shes ḍa gī kun gyi gsang ba'i gnas/ /thun mong ye shes sems kyi me long ltos/ /zhes gsungs nas phyag gi byug pas lus sngar bzhin gyur/ yang gshegs pa'i rjes su song / lo gcig 'das pa na phyag 'tshal sogs sngar bzhin byas/ de nas 'dam rdzab kyi 'ob kha zheng 'dom phyed tsam la gting zab cing srin bu padmas gang ba cig 'dug pa na rkang lag brgyang ste zam byed du bcug /steng du byon nas zhabs kyis shugs kyis 'dam rdzab tu bor nas gshegs so/ /srin bu'i rigs du mas khrag thams cad zad par 'thung nas shi la thug pa na bla ma byon nas sngar bzhin gsungs/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas bla mas/ skye rga na 'chi'i rlabs snrosdu pa/ /srid pa'i chu chen rab sgrol na//

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃsnying po med lus 'dam rdzab tu/ /srin bus rnam par bshig kyang sla/ /ngar 'dzin lus kyi ri bo 'di/ /'khyag kyang rung gi na ro pa/ /mi shig rdo rje'i dam tshig gi/ /thun mong sems kyi me long ltos/ /zhes gsungs nas phyag gis byug pas snga ma ltar gyur/ yang lo gcig 'das pa na phyag 'tshal sogs sngar bzhin byas/ smyug mdung mang po mdung rtse ltar rab tu rno bar bzhog ste til mar gyi ngar blud/ de thams cad lus la bsnun/ mdun nas rgyab dang rgyab nas mdun dang / g.yasanas g.yon dang / g.yon nas g.yas su/ phar thal tshur thal du phug pas lus thams cad snyag phung lta bur gyur nas shi la thug pa na/ bla ma byon nas ci nyes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan zhus/ bla mas/ ngar 'dzin lus kyi rgya mdud 'di/ /phug kyang rung gi na ro pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gsang ba'i gnas/ /smin grol sems kyi me long ltos/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ de nas steng sgo'i man ngag gnang / yang lo gcig 'das pa na phyag 'tshal sogs sngar bzhin byas/ bla mas rgyal po'i btsun mo 'gug par gyis shig gsungs/ song nas btsun mo'i lag pa nas bzung nas khrid pa na btsun mo bsrung ba sogs khros te/ bzung nas brdung pas shi la thug par byas/ bla ma byon nas ci nyes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan zhus/ bla mas/ ngar 'dzin lus kyi ri bo 'di/ /bcom kyang rung gi na ro pa/ /zhen med sgyu lus lha yi sku/ /stong gsal bskyed rim me long ltos/ /zhes sogs gsungs nas phyag gis byug nas sngar bzhin gyur/ yang lo gcig 'das pa na phyag 'tshal sogs sngar bzhin byas pas/ bla mas blon po'i chung ma 'gug par gyis shig gsungs/ song nas khrid pa na blon po sogs khros nas rkang lag 355
