g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃn zangs mdog dpal ri nas o rgyan rin po che 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sogs kyis rol mo'i sgras a kṣa lnga bcu bcas 'ja' 'od dar khyim gyi lam nas byon te gnyid las sad par bsam gsungs/ de nas snying ga'i bla ma spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo yar byon/ mdun gyi o rgyan chen po yang de dang dbyer med du gyur nas bzhugs par mos dgos gsungs/ bla ma mkhyen dang po ni 'khor bar zhen log gi nges 'byung rang rgyud la skye ba'i phyir dang / gnyis pa gzhan phan don gnyer gyi byang sems rgyud la skye ba'i phyir dang / gsum pa snang srid rnam dag gi dag snang rgyud la skye ba'i phyir gsol ba btab ni yin gsungs/dge ba'i dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i dran pa/ sko gsum la bya ra byed pa'i shes bzhin/ blang dor gi gnas la gzob pa lhur len pa bag yod gsungs/ ngag byin rlabs byas nas sngags 'don na lhag chad kyi nyes pa mi 'byung gsungs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i skabs/don chen gtan gyi 'dun ma mi bsgrubs par don med chud zos byed pa'i blo ngan de ldog bya yin/ ldog byed kyi thabs gnyen po ni dal brgyad 'byor bcu sogs dal 'byor gyi chos sum cu rtsa bzhi yin gsungs/ 'chi ba mi rtag skabs/ rang thang myur du mi 'chi snyam pa'i rtag 'dzin gyi blo ngan de ldog bya yin/ ldog byed kyi thabs gnyen po ni/ nam 'chi cha med sogs yin gsungs/ las rgyu 'bras skabs/ dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin byed mi nus pa'i blo ngan de ldog bya yin gsungs/ ldog byed kyi thabs gnyen po ni/ rang byas rang la smin par nges pa'ang / rgyu 'bras blang dor gzhung bzhin byed pa de yin gsungs/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs skabs/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la ci tsam spyad kyang ngoms pa med par 457

g.yu khog bla ma chosadabyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃzhakhor ba'i sdug bsngal ci tsam myong yang skyo ba med pa'i blo ngan de ldog bya yin/ldog byed kyi thabs gnyen po ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas de las thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung bsgom pa de yin gsungs/blo ldog bzhi ka la ldog bya ldog byed/ ldog tshul ldog tshad dang bzhi re yod gsungs/ ༈ skyabs 'gro'i skabs/ chos sku kun tu bzang po nas da lta'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar de mchog gsum kun 'dus/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ sku gsum kun 'dus/ brgyud gsum kun 'dus/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro kun 'dus te mdor na skyabs gnas ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad dang khyad par rdo rje'i spun grogs thams cad la brtse gdung yid la mi byed par nyin zhag gi mtha' 'das na lhung ba 'byung ni red/ des na spun grogs thams cad gu ru rin po che la 'dus par mos nas spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom na nyes pa kheg gsungs/ mdor na gu ru rin po che mig gi phye btsum/ lag pa'i bskyang bskum/rkang pa'i 'degs 'jog ste dus rgyun du skyabs gnas kun 'dus gu ru rin po che brjed mi nyan gsungs/ skyabs yul de'i drung du me tog rdog ma gcig mthong na bla ma dkon mchog gsum por mchod/ ces pas skyabs yul gsal gdab/sems bskyed rang gzhan sems can thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud par shog cig ces pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam bzhi ga tshang ni yin gsungs/ 'jigs med gling pas/ blo bla mar gtod pa skyabs 'gro'i mthar thug gsungs kyi bo de skyabs gnas mthar thugs bla ma gu ru rin po che kho na la gtod dgos gsungs/ khong gi zhal /sdu/ srog gcod mi nyan gsungs kyi tshig

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃde lung gi chos yin/ khyed cag gis de'i don nyams su len pa rtogs pa'i chos yin gsungs/ dpal sprul zhal nas/ srog gcig bcad na dge tshul slong gi lhung ba yin/ byang sems kyi pha ma bsad ni yin/ sngags kyi skabs rdo rje slob dpon bsad ni yin nyes pa shin tu che gsungs/ sems can phal pa'i srog cig bcad na bshags yul yod pas rtsa shing sogs la me 'bar na gnyen po chu yod pa dang 'dra gsungs/ sems can rnams kyi skyabs gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams yin/ ban de bla ma sogs kyis sems can gyi srog la gnod pa'i dmar chog sogs byed na sems can rnams la skyabs gnas med pas dper na rgya mtsho chen po la me 'bar na gnyen po med pa dang 'dra gsungs/sems ngo lta ba gang zhig gi srog gcig bcad na 'bum 'gyur yin pas des bsgom mi rung / srog gtan nas mi gcod na gang zag des sems ngo skyong chog gsungs/ mi phal pa zhig gis mi rta bco brgyad bsad ni bas thu gsungs/༈ sems bskyed skabs/ dmigs pa sems can thams cad la dmigs nas rnam pa sems can thams cad rgyu dge ba 'bras bu bde ba ste dge ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa/ dmigs pa sems can thams cad la dmigs nas rnam pa sems can thams cad rgyu mi dge ba 'bras bu sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje ste sems bskyed kyi rtsa ba snying rje kho na la thug gsungs/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral na ci ma rung bsam na 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ bral ba zhig bdag gis byed bsam na dam bca' dang 'brel ༷5/9sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃbar bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs par shog cig bsam na bsngo ba smon lam dang 'brel ni yin gsungs/ ༈ dad pa'i sgo nas thugs yid dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag na don dam sems bskyed dang dngos gzhi dmigs med kyi dod thub yin gsungs/ ༈rdor sems skabs/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal gdab lha dam pa rigs brgya sngags yi ge brgya pa'i rnam par shar ni yin/stobs bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bdud rtsi 'apeb sbyong dang yig brgya 'don mthar bsdu rim byas nas mnyam par bzhag na sdig sgrib 'dags pa'i mthar thug yin/ ༈ maṇḍal skabs/ sku gsum gyi zhing na mchod pa'i dngos po ji snyed yod pa dang / de'i steng du rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa sku gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog cig ces pas rgyun tu nyams len byed kyi yin gsungs/ ༈ gcod kyi skabs/ gcod kyi ngo bo stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin/ gcod yul ni chos kyi dbyings/ dper na sa gzhi lta bu yin/gcod byed bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab yin/ gcod tshul ni slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byed pa yin/ de la thogs bcas bdud 'byung bzhi'i sa sgra dang gnam ldang gi thog sogs sa ma thob bar du mi chod gsungs/ thogs med yid snang gi bdud ni rnam rtog snga ma rjes gcod/ phyi rmamadun bsu/ da lta phyi nang gi mtshan 'dzin gsum po gang rung gi sgo nas zhakhrul ni yin/rnam rtog snga ma bya ma lta bu/ rnam rtog phyi ma bya ma'i rjes su ༵ ḍibrang ba ltar de gnyis 'brel thag gi

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃzhen pa'i drwa ba de gcod dgos gsungs/ dga' brod bdud ni zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa la ma dga' na 'jug lugs med/ dga' zhing zhen pa de gcod bya yin/ snyems byed bdud ni/ zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa nyams su blang nas ngas lha 'dre'i 'gro don byed bsam na/ ngas zhes pa'i ngar 'dzin dam hrang nge ba de bdag 'dzin yin pas de gcod dgos gsungs/ mi wags kyi g.yang gzhi ni sa thob 'phags pa ma gtogs g.yug mi nyan gsungs/ so skyes rang ga mas g.yug na steng lha 'a9/gas/ bar gnyan 'a9/gas/ 'og klu 'khrugs par gsungs/ chos skyong mgon po sogs 'bod pa'i gri rkang ni skyes pa grir shi ba rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par zhe sdang gi ngang nas shi ba'i bla dgos gsungs/ dpa' bo 'bod pa'i gri rkang ni/ bu mo mkha' 'gro'i rigs can skyes pas ma gos/ brje dam nyams kyis ma gos pa'i bla dgos gsungs/ lha 'dre 'bod pa'i gri rkang ni/ dge slong 'dul khrims yang dag pa dang ldan pa thugs rgyud na byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa de'i bla dgos gsungs/ yang na gang zag byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa sems can srog la gnod 'tshe phra mo tsam yang spang ba'i gri rkang dgos gsungs/ de'i sgra lha 'dre'i tshor na gnod sems thams cad zhi byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par byed pa'i byin rlabs can yin gsungs/༈ bla rnam skabs/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus gu ru rin po che spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom dbang bzhi blang / snying gi dkyil du bsgom thugs yid dbyer med bsres gsungs/ rig 'dzin mkha' spyod grub pa'i nye lam ni 'chi khar phyi nang snod bcud zangs mdog dpal rir gsal thub na rab ma thub na rang rnal 'byor 461

g.yu khog bla ma chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsung 'bum/ oṃmar gsal ba spyi bo'i gu ru rin po ches thugs kar bstim te thugs yid dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag na ngan song gsum du mi 'gro gsungs/ bar rda'i skabs yang gu ru rin po che byon nas dbang bskur gdams pa gnang ngo sprod btab nas grol 'gro ni red gsungs/ thod pa'i skra rtse nas chu thig pang thog tu lhung ba'i yun la thugs yid dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag na bskal pa gcig gi sdig sgrib 'dags gsungs/ rjes su yi rang gi dge rtsa mnyam du thob mi thob la/ paṇa chen bsod grags lugs la mnyam du mi thob par gsungs/'jam dbyangs bzhad pas mnyam du thob gsungs/ mi pham rin po ches rjes su yi rang byas na don du dge rtsa rgya chen po thob gsungs/༈ gtong len skabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gu ru rin po che gsal btab/rang gzhan gyi dge ba rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa 'od dkar gyi rnam par phar 'phros sems can la phog /sems can gyi rgyud kyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa 'od nag gi rnam par tshur 'phros rang gi bdag 'dzin la thim/ de rjes sems can thamasdu cadā sangs rgyas par bsam/ bdag 'dzin sdig sgrib dang bcas sdo geṭwāo+oṃs// kya// dbyangs su dag par bsam nas mnyam par bzhag gsungs/462
